scope: Authored source-bound assessments. Three AI reviewers read disjoint batches, not three reviews of each record. Complete saved strings can themselves be truncated. This is not full-paper review or universal efficacy assessment.

records.title: Functional and clinical evidence for two novel heterozygous <i>BUB1B</i> variants and their value in precision genetic counseling for recurrent pregnancy loss.
records.model: Two RPL families; blood lymphocytes
records.note: W722R/A739S heterozygous VUS carriers had elevated premature chromatid separation and a trend toward reduced BUBR1; no therapeutic experiment described.

records.title: Sequential presentation of Wilms' tumor and orbital rhabdomyosarcoma in a child with mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome 3.
records.model: Child with TRIP13-related MVA3 and sequential Wilms tumor/rhabdomyosarcoma
records.note: Prior chemotherapy accompanied nephrectomy; new orbital rhabdomyosarcoma prompted MVA3 diagnosis and advice for chemoradiotherapy, without a rescue intervention result.

records.title: BubR1 Controls Heart Development by Promoting Expression of Cardiogenesis Regulators.
records.model: Cardiac-specific Bub1b knockout mouse embryos; single-cell RNA sequencing
records.note: Deletion stalled cardiac development, suppressed cardiogenesis genes and hyperactivated Wnt signaling; abstract does not test Wnt antagonism.

records.title: Recessive <i>SMC5</i> Variants in a Family with Near-Tetraploidy/Mosaic Variegated Aneuploidy.
records.model: SMC5 compound-heterozygous patient and family
records.note: Near-tetraploidy and MVA accompany a relatively mild SMC5 phenotype; genetic diagnosis rather than treatment evidence.

records.title: [Genetic analysis of two fetuses with Mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome caused by compound heterozygous variants in BUB1B and its upstream regulatory elements and a literature Review].
records.model: Two fetuses and parents with BUB1B coding/regulatory variants
records.note: Both fetuses carried S788Cfs*29 plus an upstream regulatory variant with developmental anomalies and mosaic aneuploidy; no intervention described.

records.title: A novel <i>CEP57</i> gene mutation in mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome 2: case report.
records.model: Six-year-old child with CEP57-related MVA2
records.note: Novel CEP57 duplication expands MVA2 spectrum; the statement that growth hormone response is limited is not a documented treatment outcome for this child in the abstract.

records.title: BUB1B Mitotic Kinase Dependency Reveals CENP-E Inhibition as a Tractable Approach for Castration and Enzalutamide Resistant Prostate Cancer.
records.model: Castration/enzalutamide-resistant prostate cancer cells and xenografts
records.note: CENP-E inhibitor GSK923295 phenocopied BUB1B depletion and sensitized resistant cancer to enzalutamide; genetic phosphomimic CENP-E rescue concerned tumor growth, not healthy tissue.

records.title: P53 independent pathogenic mechanisms contribute to BubR1 microcephaly.
records.model: BubR1-deficient mouse cortex with Trp53 co-deletion
records.note: Trp53 deletion gave minimal cortical size/neuron rescue and left substantial apoptosis, limiting a simple p53-blockade rationale for BubR1 microcephaly.

records.title: BUB1B MITOTIC KINASE DRIVES THERAPY RESISTANT PROSTATE CANCER
records.model: Prostate cancer cells and xenografts; preprint
records.note: Wild-type BUB1B, but not kinase-dead mutants, drove castration resistance and enzalutamide resistance; restoring cancer growth is not tissue rescue.

records.title: BUB1B is a novel prognostic-related biomarker and correlated with immune infiltrates in lung adenocarcinoma.
records.model: LUAD cohorts; A549/H1650 cells; THP-1 macrophage chemotaxis
records.note: Expression-survival and immune associations were supplemented by knockdown/overexpression experiments; BUB1B promoted EMT and CCL2/p-P65-linked macrophage recruitment.

records.title: Mosaic variegated aneuploidy as a novel feature in patients with Mulibrey nanism and <i>TRIM37</i> variants.
records.model: TRIM37/Mulibrey patient amniocytes and fibroblasts
records.note: Low-level mosaic aneuploidy occurred in index siblings and one additional subject, supporting centrosome-related disease overlap without treatment testing.

records.title: Proteostasis failure and mitochondrial dysfunction contribute to chromosomal instability-induced microcephaly.
records.model: Drosophila SAC-deficient neural stem cells and brains
records.note: Overexpressed ROS scavengers, mitochondrial chaperones and apoptosis inhibition dampened brain-size loss from complex aneuploidy; abstract reports genetic interventions, not antioxidant drug administration.
records.reconciliation_note: Fly primary study in literature-review.md and decisions.json; endpoint/version reconciliation needed

records.title: BubR1 TPR domain supports the mitotic checkpoint by promoting MCC formation and MCC-APC/C interaction.
records.model: Cellular and biochemical BubR1 TPR/MCC/APC-C assays
records.note: TPR contacts and a proposed intramolecular lasso enhance MCC assembly and APC/C engagement; no therapeutic administration described.

records.title: Mosaic variegated aneuploidy in development, ageing and cancer.
records.model: MVA patients, mouse models and cellular studies reviewed
records.note: Review links SAC/centrosome mutations to MVA, tumor susceptibility and chronic immune stress without an abstract-level administered rescue result.

records.title: BUB1B monoallelic germline variants contribute to prostate cancer predisposition by triggering chromosomal instability.
records.model: Inherited cancer cohorts, gene-edited cells and patient specimens
records.note: Monoallelic BUB1B variants lowered protein expression/stability and caused CIN-associated Taxol resistance; relevant genotype biology but no rescue claim.

records.title: Multi-omics analysis identifies BUB1B as a cell cycle-related driver of bladder cancer progression.
records.model: Bladder cancer multi-omics, cells and in vivo tumors
records.note: BUB1B promoted bladder cancer proliferation/invasion and tumorigenicity, with NF-kappaB implicated; abstract gives no named administered agent.

records.title: Sudden unexpected postnatal collapse and BUB1B mutation: first forensic case report.
records.model: Newborn with compound-heterozygous BUB1B variants and postnatal collapse
records.note: Resuscitation, hemodynamic/antibiotic therapy and hypothermia preceded severe encephalopathy and death from sepsis; BUB1B causality remained uncertain.

records.title: A Distinctive Type of Mosaic Variegated Aneuploidy: Case Report and Review of the Literature.
records.model: Patient followed over 20 years with atypical MVA and intermittent neutropenia
records.note: Predominant trisomies 18/19 and mild phenotype lacked an identified mutation after seven-gene and exome testing; no drug result described.

records.title: Chromosomal instability in development and disease: Beyond cancer evolution.
records.model: CIN in cancer, development and MVA model systems
records.note: Review discusses removal of embryonic aneuploid cells and MVA brain/tumor effects; abstract contains no administered rescue experiment.

records.title: Linking kinetochore attachment to checkpoint control: the role of Aurora B in BubR1 acetylation.
records.model: BubR1 phosphorylation/acetylation mutants; cellular imaging/biochemistry
records.note: K250 acetylation-mimetic BubR1 rescued S16A/S39A mutant defects in corona/MCC stability; identifies a modification axis but not a tested pharmacologic rescue.
records.reconciliation_note: Aurora B/MG132/TSA primary study in literature-review.md

records.title: Overexpression of BubR1 Mitotic Checkpoint Protein Predicts Short Survival and Influences the Progression of Cholangiocarcinoma.
records.model: Hamster CCA model, patient tumors and CCA cells
records.note: siBubR1 reduced CCA proliferation/EMT and synergized with unspecified chemotherapy; the therapeutic direction is killing cancer cells by lowering BubR1.

records.title: Targeting the FOXM1/BUB1B signaling network in multiple myeloma: mechanistic insights and therapeutic potential.
records.model: FOXM1/BUB1B network in multiple myeloma reviewed
records.note: Describes FOXM1 transcriptional control of BUB1B and preclinical inhibitor interest; no named drug or original administered rescue in abstract.

records.title: Translational evaluation of BUB1B as a precision medicine biomarker for hepatocellular carcinoma.
records.model: HCC multi-omics, clinical cohort and mechanistic studies
records.note: Unspecified BUB1B inhibitors reportedly suppressed MAPK nodes; sorafenib, paclitaxel and doxorubicin occur as sensitivity predictions, not documented administered rescue agents.

records.title: BUB1B Promotes Ovarian Cancer Cell Proliferation and Metastasis by Activating the Wnt/β-Catenin Pathway.
records.model: Ovarian cancer cells and tumor/metastasis models
records.note: LGK974 inhibited malignant behavior induced by BUB1B overexpression; Wnt pathway inhibition here suppresses cancer rather than rescuing deficient tissue.

records.title: Spindle Assembly Checkpoint Competency Determines Sensitivity to KIF18A Inhibition in Small Cell Lung Cancer.
records.model: SCLC cells with differing SAC competence
records.note: SAC-proficient tumors died after KIF18A inhibition; transient TTK inhibition induced acute CIN and partly restored drug sensitivity in resistant cells.

records.title: Prenatal diagnosis and long-term follow-up of a Chinese patient with mosaic variegated aneuploidy and its molecular analysis.
records.model: Long-lived Chinese patient with BUB1B-related MVA
records.note: Very short saved abstract mentions prenatal diagnosis and clinical management without identifying treatments or outcomes; primary text is needed for management details.

records.title: BUB1B promotes homologous recombination‑mediated DNA damage repair in breast cancer cells through the PI3K/AKT signaling pathway.
records.model: MDA-MB-231 breast cancer cells and xenografts with irradiation
records.note: BUB1B knockdown reduced homologous-recombination repair and radioresistance via PI3K/AKT-associated changes; no named pharmacologic rescue described.

records.title: Multi-omics analysis reveals that BUB1B is a cell cycle related gene promotes the bladder cancer development
records.model: Bladder cancer multi-omics, cells and tumor models; preprint
records.note: BUB1B promoted malignant behavior and tumorigenicity, with chemokine reductions and cell-cycle associations; precursor study should not be an independent rescue result.

records.title: Pathogenic correlation between mosaic variegated aneuploidy 1 (MVA1) and a novel BUB1B variant: a reappraisal of a severe syndrome.
records.model: Two-year-old MVA1 patient; review of 31 cases and prenatal cases
records.note: Arg893Ser was associated with severe neurologic impairment, seizures and 12% mosaic karyotype; abstract supplies no treatment response.

records.title: In silico discovery of selective TPX2 and BUB1B inhibitors as novel antimitotic agents in breast cancer therapy.
records.model: Breast cancer datasets, machine learning, virtual screening and docking
records.note: Vorinostat, BRD-K90370028, NSC19630, dasatinib and CD-437 are computational inhibitor candidates; no administration or experimentally established binding/rescue is reported.

records.title: BUB1B promotes gemcitabine resistance in lung adenocarcinoma and activates the PI3K/AKT signaling pathway.
records.model: LUAD cells and in vivo models with BUB1B perturbation
records.note: Lowering BUB1B increased gemcitabine sensitivity and apoptosis alongside PI3K/AKT inhibition; this is cancer susceptibility, not deficient-muscle rescue.

records.title: NUF2 promotes the malignant development of lung adenocarcinoma through the mTORC1 signaling pathway via binding to BUB1B.
records.model: LUAD cell lines and nude-mouse tumors
records.note: BUB1B overexpression reversed NUF2-knockdown tumor suppression and restored mTORC1 activity; the word rescue refers to restored malignancy.

records.title: Linking Kinetochore Attachment to Checkpoint Control: The Role of Aurora B in BubR1 Acetylation
records.model: Cellular BubR1 phosphomutant/acetylation assays; preprint
records.note: K250 acetylation mimic restored MCC/corona in S16A/S39A mutants; overlaps the published Aurora B acetylation study and is not independent drug evidence.
records.reconciliation_note: Preprint paired to published Aurora B/MG132/TSA study reviewed in literature-review.md

records.title: BubR1 Insufficiency Drives Transcriptomic Alterations and Pathology Associated With Cardiac Aging and Heart Failure.
records.model: BubR1-hypomorphic mouse hearts, cardiomyocytes and human heart-failure comparisons
records.note: BubR1 insufficiency caused hypertrophy, fibrosis and senescence with heart-failure-like transcription; sustaining expression is proposed but no administered rescue is given.

records.title: BubR1 TPR domain supports mitotic checkpoint by promoting MCC formation and MCC-APC/C interaction
records.model: BubR1 TPR/MCC/APC-C biochemical and cellular assays; preprint
records.note: TPR interactions and lasso structure support checkpoint assembly; overlaps published TPR work and contains no drug result.

records.title: RNA sequencing and target long-read sequencing reveal an intronic transposon insertion causing aberrant splicing.
records.model: Japanese MVA patient, transcript sequencing and minigene assays
records.note: An intronic Alu/SVA insertion and maternal splice variant caused aberrant BUB1B transcripts with severely reduced protein; no splice-correcting intervention tested in abstract.

records.title: Downregulation of BUBR1 regulates the proliferation and cell cycle of breast cancer cells and increases the sensitivity of cells to cisplatin.
records.model: Breast cancer cells and xenografts with BUBR1 shRNA
records.note: BUBR1 loss reduced TAK1/JNK phosphorylation and increased cisplatin sensitivity; lowering the deficient target is an oncology strategy.

records.title: KIFC1 Overexpression Promotes Pancreatic Carcinoma Progression via Stabilising BUB1B.
records.model: Pancreatic cancer patient samples, cells and in vivo models
records.note: KIFC1 reduced BUB1B ubiquitination/degradation and promoted tumors through BUB1B; a protein-stability mechanism, with no pharmacologic restoration shown.

records.title: Targeting BUB1B-driven cancer stemness in lung adenocarcinoma: a novel therapeutic strategy via PI3K/AKT pathway modulation.
records.model: LUAD transcriptomics, machine learning and experimental validation
records.note: BUB1B linked stemness to malignancy through Ca2+/PI3K/AKT; abstract mentions experimental approaches but does not specify an administered agent or clear perturbation protocol.

records.title: Mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome with tetraploid, and predisposition to male infertility triggered by mutant CEP192.
records.model: CEP192-variant family, infertility cohort, knock-in mice and primary cells
records.note: Biallelic CEP192 variants produced MVA/tetraploidy, spindle failure and embryonic apoptosis; monoallelic variants tracked infertility, without rescue intervention.

records.title: The conserved Spd-2/CEP192 domain adopts a unique protein fold to promote centrosome scaffold assembly.
records.model: Human/honeybee structures and Drosophila centrosome assembly
records.note: CEP192/Spd-2 cradle-interface mutations disrupted scaffold assembly; PLK1-dependent oligomerization was studied without an administered therapeutic rescue.

records.title: Estrogen receptor alpha (ERα) driven trans-regulation of mitotic checkpoint complex (MCC) components affects the clinical outcome of breast cancer
records.model: Breast cancer cohorts and ERalpha-transfected MDA-MB-231 cells; preprint
records.note: Ectopic ERalpha reduced aneuploidy and directly activated MAD2/BUB1B promoters; no estrogen or ER agonist administration is reported.

records.title: Physiological relevance of post-translational regulation of the spindle assembly checkpoint protein BubR1.
records.model: BubR1 post-translational modifications reviewed
records.note: Reviews phosphorylation, acetylation and ubiquitination enzymes in aging/cancer; abstract offers no individual administered treatment outcome.
records.reconciliation_note: Post-translational review; use cited primary studies in literature-review.md

records.title: BUBR1 Facilitated Nerve Regeneration by Modulating STAT3 Phosphorylation, Thereby Alleviating HIE in Neonatal Mice.
records.model: Neonatal mouse HIE and OGD/reoxygenated neural stem cells
records.note: Restoring BUBR1 alleviated HIE, promoted neural regeneration and reduced NSC apoptosis through STAT3 phosphorylation; the abstract does not specify restoration delivery or establish an administered drug.

records.title: The establishment of mitotic errors-driven senescence depends on autophagy.
records.model: Young oxidatively stressed and aged cells
records.note: Oxidative insult bypassed SAC and BubR1 initially rose then underwent autophagy-dependent degradation; relevant caution for autophagy modulation, not an abstract-level rescue drug.
records.reconciliation_note: Goutas autophagy study already reviewed in decisions.json/literature-review.md

records.title: The BUB1 and BUBR1 paralogs scaffold the kinetochore fibrous corona.
records.model: Corona biochemical reconstitution and cellular depletion assays
records.note: BUB1 and BUBR1 support distinct corona assembly branches through ROD and CENP-E connections; no administered rescue described.

records.title: BUB1B promotes cisplatin resistance in gastric cancer via Rad51-mediated DNA damage repair.
records.model: Cisplatin-resistant gastric cancer cells and xenografts
records.note: BUB1B enhanced DNA repair/cisplatin resistance and counteracted RAD51 inhibitor B02 tumor suppression; cancer-cell survival restoration is not tissue rescue.

records.title: Investigating the functional role of BUB1B in aflatoxin B1-associated hepatocarcinogenesis.
records.model: Hepatocyte malignant transformation and BUB1B-siRNA models
records.note: Aflatoxin altered proliferation/cycle and increased BUB1B, with IL12A-JAK2/STAT4 implicated; exposure is a carcinogenic trigger, not treatment.

records.title: Update on Recommendations for Cancer Screening and Surveillance in Children with Genomic Instability Disorders.
records.model: Children with genomic instability syndromes including MVA
records.note: Cancer-surveillance recommendations address heightened treatment toxicity and screening across syndromes, without an MVA muscle-rescue intervention.

records.title: Nearly complete deletion of BubR1 causes microcephaly through shortened mitosis and massive cell death.
records.model: Cortex-specific BubR1 knockout mice
records.note: Near-complete deletion shortened mitosis, depleted late-born neurons through apoptosis and prevented ependymal-layer formation; no administered rescue appears.

records.title: Mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome 2 with biallelic novel CEP57 splice site variation in Indian siblings: Expanding the clinical and molecular spectrum.
records.model: Indian siblings with CEP57 splice variant; protein modeling
records.note: CEP57 c.382+2T>C caused exon-3 skipping with predicted loss of function; genetic characterization without treatment.

records.title: Identification and validation of palmitoylation metabolism related biomarkers in osteoarthritis using transcriptomic and single cell RNA sequencing analyses.
records.model: OA cartilage cohorts, RT-qPCR, single-cell analysis and docking
records.note: BUB1B/KIF15 were upregulated in OA; cyclosporine was proposed only through molecular docking, not tested as an administered joint rescue.

records.title: Outcomes of pediatric cancer predisposition syndromes identified by phenotype directed recognition: an Indian cohort
records.model: Fourteen children with heterogeneous cancer predisposition syndromes; retrospective preprint
records.note: Six patients had regimen modifications including omission of radiotherapy/bleomycin; abstract does not assign specific drugs or survival outcomes to its MVA case.

records.title: Increased BUB1B/BUBR1 expression contributes to aberrant DNA repair activity leading to resistance to DNA-damaging agents.
records.model: CRT-resistant bladder cancer cells and T24R tumors
records.note: ATM inhibition with AZD0156 abrogated resistant tumor growth; BUB1B supported mutagenic NHEJ after irradiation, an oncology mechanism.

records.title: The BUB1 and BUBR1 paralogs scaffold the kinetochore corona
records.model: Corona reconstitution/cell biology; preprint
records.note: BUB1/ROD and BUBR1/CENP-E branches organize corona assembly; overlaps published study and has no therapeutic administration result.

records.title: Crystal structure of human Cep57 C-terminal domain reveals the presence of leucine zipper and the potential microtubule binding region.
records.model: Human CEP57 C-terminal crystal structure
records.note: Leucine zipper and putative microtubule-binding region suggest a scaffold role; structural characterization without rescue testing.

records.title: Identification and validation of stemness-associated hub genes in cervical cancer: a bioinformatics and experimental study.
records.model: Cervical cancer datasets and expression validation
records.note: Hub-gene analysis yielded 661 drug/chemical links but RT-PCR validated expression rather than drug efficacy; abstract does not identify administered candidates.

records.title: High glucose-induced mitochondrial fission drives pancreatic cancer progression through the H3K18la/TTK/BUB1B signal pathway.
records.model: Diabetic pancreatic cancer patients, mice and cancer cells
records.note: High glucose promoted tumors and mitochondrial fission with H3K18la/TTK/BUB1B increases; this is adverse metabolic exposure, not rescue treatment.

records.title: Premature Chromatid Separation Trait Found During the Diagnosis of Male Infertility: A Case Report.
records.model: Man with nonobstructive azoospermia and PCS trait
records.note: 40.5% PCS-positive cells were found during infertility work-up; recommendation is counseling before sperm extraction, without drug testing.

records.title: A Comprehensive Analysis Revealing BUB1B as a Potential Prognostic and Immunological Biomarker in Lung Adenocarcinoma.
records.model: Pan-cancer datasets and LUAD siRNA assays
records.note: BUB1B knockdown inhibited lung-cancer proliferation/migration after multi-database association analyses; no administered drug rescue in abstract.

records.title: Mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome with tetraploid, and predisposition to male infertility triggered by mutantCEP192
records.model: CEP192-variant family and knock-in mice; preprint
records.note: Duplicated abstract text describes embryonic arrest/tetraploidy and infertility from CEP192 variants; overlaps the published family/mouse study without rescue testing.

records.title: Radiotherapy and precision medicine's role in molecular alterations during chromosomal division: The influence of <i>MB, TP53, CENPA, BUB1B</i>, <i>MAD2L1</i>, <i>ZWINT</i> expression and noncoding RNAs in oral cancer.
records.model: Oral cancer gene/miRNA expression study
records.note: Abstract describes proposed biomarker/radiotherapy-target aims for BUB1B and other genes but supplies no quantified intervention result.

records.title: Self-priming of Plk1 binding to BubR1 ensures accurate mitotic progression.
records.model: BubR1 phosphosite mutants and engineered binding variants
records.note: Engineering higher Plk1/PP2A-B56 affinity bypassed T600/T608 phosphorylation requirements for chromosome congression and checkpoint silencing; protein engineering rather than drug rescue.

records.title: BubR1 allelic effects drive phenotypic heterogeneity in mosaic-variegated aneuploidy progeria syndrome.
records.model: BubR1 L1002P/X753/H mouse allelic combinations
records.note: Comparable low BubR1 levels produced different sarcopenia/SASP severities; monoallelic sarcopenia correlated with mTORC1 hyperactivity, without drug testing in this abstract.

records.title: Synthesis and biological assessment of BUB1B inhibitors for the treatment of clear cell renal cell carcinoma.
records.model: Caki-1 clear-cell renal carcinoma cells, enzyme/CETSA assays and docking
records.note: Forty synthesized derivatives were screened experimentally; 8h destabilized/inhibited BUB1B and induced apoptosis while TG-101209 stabilized binding, not evidence of functional tissue restoration.

records.title: Targeting the splicing factor CWC22 induces mitotic slippage through repression of BubR1 expression and CDK1 activity in cancer cells.
records.model: CWC22-depleted cancer cells with genetic overexpression
records.note: Wee1 blockade plus cyclin B1 or BubR1 overexpression mitigated shortened mitosis after CWC22 knockdown; no standalone drug rescue of BUB1B-deficient healthy tissue is established.

records.title: Cep57 regulates human centrosomes through multivalent interactions.
records.model: Human CEP57 condensates and centrosome-depleted cells
records.note: CEP57 self-assembly mutants failed to rescue centrosome defects and competitive constructs caused overduplication; no administered drug restoration.

records.title: BubR1 and SIRT2: Insights into aneuploidy, aging, and cancer.
records.model: BubR1/SIRT2/NAD pathways in aging and cancer reviewed
records.note: Reviews SIRT2 upstream control of BubR1 and NAD-dependent regulation; abstract alone gives no new dose, agent or administered rescue result.
records.reconciliation_note: SIRT2/NMN primary evidence reconciled in literature-review.md

records.title: Follow-up of two adult brothers with homozygous CEP57 pathogenic variants expands the phenotype of Mosaic Variegated Aneuploidy Syndrome.
records.model: Two adult brothers with homozygous CEP57 duplication
records.note: Adult MVA2 follow-up expands skeletal/dental phenotype and proposes a duplication mechanism; no therapeutic response reported.

records.title: Long-term remission of bilateral Wilms tumors that developed from premature separation of chromatids/mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome due to bilateral nephrectomy and peritoneal dialysis.
records.model: BUB1B-MVA child with bilateral Wilms tumors
records.note: Severe dactinomycin reaction prevented further chemotherapy; bilateral nephrectomy with home peritoneal dialysis produced 15-month remission/quality-of-life follow-up.

records.title: Cyclin B2 facilitates glycolysis and tumor progression in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma by promoting histone lactylation.
records.model: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma cells and animals
records.note: Glycolysis inhibitors suppressed tumor proliferation and CCNB2; genetic CCNB2 depletion lowered H3K18la/TTK/BUB1B, not a tissue-rescue direction.

records.title: A pivotal contribution of proteostasis failure and mitochondrial dysfunction to chromosomal instability-induced microcephaly
records.model: SAC-depleted Drosophila neural stem cells; preprint
records.note: Preprint explicitly includes autophagy activation/TOR depletion plus ROS and mitochondrial proteostasis rescue; published abstract differs, requiring version/full-text reconciliation before mTOR claims.
records.reconciliation_note: Fly primary study already reviewed; preserve abstract versus full-text endpoint distinction

records.title: BUB1b impairs chemotherapy sensitivity via resistance to ferroptosis in lung adenocarcinoma.
records.model: BUB1b-overexpressing LUAD cells and BALB/c nude-mouse tumors
records.note: NRF2 targeting with ML385 plus chemotherapy inhibited tumor growth and improved tumor-bearing mouse survival; overcoming cancer ferroptosis resistance is not healthy-tissue rescue.

records.title: Mosaic Variegated Aneuploidy syndrome 2 caused by biallelic variants in CEP57, two new cases and review of the phenotype.
records.model: Two CEP57-MVA2 cases plus phenotype review
records.note: Homozygous CEP57 duplication cases show growth/endocrine/cardiac/skeletal findings and no reported malignancies in the reviewed set; no treatment result.

records.title: [Clinical features and genetic analysis of a child with mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome].
records.model: Girl with BUB1B Asp276Metfs*21/Arg814His and severe MVA
records.note: Although treatment/prognosis appear in the objective, saved results only give phenotype, karyotype and genotype; primary text is needed for actual management details.

records.title: TOP2A, BUB1B, CENPF, KIF15 and MELK: Key senescence-related genes linked to prognosis and immune infiltration in lung adenocarcinoma.
records.model: LUAD senescence-gene datasets and TOP2A knockdown cells
records.note: BUB1B is a computational hub; functional inhibition was of TOP2A and reduced cancer viability, migration and invasion, not BUB1B-directed rescue.

records.title: Pathogenic variants of BUB1 and BUBR1 genes are not prioritized in screening tests of couples with aborted aneuploid fetuses.
records.model: Fifty aborted aneuploid fetuses screened at selected BUB1/BUBR1 sites
records.note: No targeted variants were detected in this small restricted-region screen; does not exclude broader BUB1B disease or assess treatment.

records.title: Smek1-Dependent Transcriptional Repression of Usp10 Is Essential for the Progression of Murine Spermatogenesis.
records.model: Germ-cell-specific Smek1 knockout mice
records.note: Loss of SMEK1 derepressed USP10, stabilizing BUBR1 and hyperactivating SAC with sterility; increased BubR1 is harmful in this context and no drug rescue is shown.

records.title: Evaluation of BUBR1, MCM2, and GMNN as oral cancer biomarkers.
records.model: Oral dysplasia and carcinoma immunohistochemistry cohorts
records.note: Cytoplasmic BUBR1 distinguished carcinoma from dysplasia with AUC 0.8525; expression marker study without intervention.

records.title: Biallelic MAD2L1BP (p31comet) mutation is associated with mosaic aneuploidy and juvenile granulosa cell tumors.
records.model: MAD2L1BP-mutant patients, patient cells and recombinant p31comet
records.note: Truncated p31comet impaired checkpoint silencing/HDR and associated with MVA and juvenile granulosa tumors; diagnostic/mechanistic rather than treatment study.

records.title: Sod1 deficiency in mouse oocytes during in vitro maturation increases chromosome segregation errors with a reduced BUBR1 at kinetochore.
records.model: Sod1-knockout mouse oocytes matured in 21% oxygen
records.note: Ascorbate or NAC reduced segregation errors in oxidatively stressed oocytes with reduced kinetochore BUBR1; abstract does not show drug-restored BUBR1 or BUB1B-mutant muscle rescue.

records.title: BubR1 and Mad2 regulate adult midgut remodeling in Drosophila diapause
records.model: Adult Drosophila intestinal stem cells during diapause; preprint
records.note: BubR1/Mad2 were required for reversible midgut growth arrest and starvation resistance during diapause; not a drug-treatment experiment.

records.title: Prevalence of germline mutations in the spindle assembly checkpoint gene BUB1B in individuals with early-onset colorectal cancer.
records.model: 192 early-onset colorectal cancer patients with variant functional assays
records.note: Rare heterozygous variants did not alter protein level/localization or measured binding; no frequent recessive BUB1B mutations and no therapy tested.

records.title: Correlation of BUB1 and BUB1B with the development and prognosis of endometrial cancer.
records.model: Endometrial tumors and siRNA-treated cancer cells
records.note: BUB1/BUB1B knockdown reduced migration/invasion; survival and immune associations are observational, with no administered rescue agent.

records.title: BDNF secreted by mesenchymal stem cells ameliorates the accelerated meiotic progression in aged mouse oocytes by activating the PI3K/AKT pathway.
records.model: Aged mouse oocytes in vitro and aged mice dosed intraperitoneally
records.note: MSC-secretome/BDNF slowed aberrantly fast meiosis; 7,8-DHF reduced oocyte aneuploidy and improved in vivo oocyte/early-embryo outcomes, with PI3K blockade used mechanistically.

records.title: A homozygous CEP57 c.915_925dupCAATGTTCAGC mutation in a patient with mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome with rhizomelic shortening in the upper and lower limbs and a narrow thorax.
records.model: Mexican child with homozygous CEP57 duplication
records.note: MVA2 with rhizomelic shortening and narrow-thorax respiratory insufficiency expands phenotype; no administered treatment outcome.

records.title: High-throughput screening identifies a previously undescribed checkpoint controlling mitotic progression in response to DNA damage.
records.model: DNA-damaged cells after SOD1 depletion; high-throughput screen
records.note: SOD1 depletion elevated PP2A activity and reduced BubR1/KNL1 phosphorylation, eliminating damage-induced mitotic delay; no antioxidant rescue tested in abstract.

records.title: Significant prognostic value of cell-cycle proteins in early-stage small cell carcinoma of cervix.
records.model: 88 small-cell cervical carcinoma samples
records.note: CDC20/MAD2L1/BUBR1 immunostaining risk score predicted cancer-specific survival; no intervention reported.

records.title: Biallelic <i>BUB1</i> mutations cause microcephaly, developmental delay, and variable effects on cohesion and chromosome segregation.
records.model: Two biallelic BUB1 patients and patient-cell assays
records.note: BUB1 variants differentially impaired BUBR1 recruitment versus Aurora B/SGO1/TOP2A recruitment, with functional SAC retained; not a BUB1B drug-rescue experiment.

records.title: Prenatal diagnosis of premature chromatid separation/mosaic variegated aneuploidy (PCS/MVA) syndrome.
records.model: Prenatal BUB1B-MVA diagnosis and parental cells
records.note: Fetal promoter mutation plus Alu insertion accompanied severe microcephaly and 80% PCS; prenatal diagnosis supports planning, without therapeutic result.

records.title: A Pan-Cancer Analysis of the Immunological and Prognostic Role of BUB1 Mitotic Checkpoint Serine/Threonine Kinase B (BUB1B) in Human Tumors.

records.title: Molecular causes for BUBR1 dysfunction in the human cancer predisposition syndrome mosaic variegated aneuploidy.
records.model: MVA patient-derived cells and BUBR1 replacement assays
records.note: Ectopic BUBR1 restored patient-cell SAC; mutations separated into functional defects and low-abundance/high-turnover groups, informing restoration strategy without a drug result.
records.reconciliation_note: Mutant stability/rescue experiments reconciled in literature-review.md

records.title: Exploring potential key genes and pathways associatedwith hepatocellular carcinoma prognosis through bioinformatics analysis, followed by experimental validation.
records.model: HCC datasets and AURKA-knockdown HepG2 cells
records.note: BUB1B was an overexpressed/hypomethylated hub, but functional knockdown targeted AURKA; sensitivity links were database analyses.

records.title: HURP Silencing Differentially Impacts Spindle Architecture and Metastatic Behavior in Breast Cancer Cell Lines.
records.model: HURP-silenced MCF10A, T47D and MDA-MB-231 cells/spheroids
records.note: HURP loss produced severe collapse/apoptosis in metastatic cells with attenuated BubR1 checkpoint response; no drug rescue, and total protein differed from spindle-localized protein.

records.title: Repurposing Suan-Zao-Ren-Tang as anticancer agents in apoptotic sensitization against non-small cell lung cancer cell lines through amplification of spindle assembly checkpoint activation.
records.model: A549/NCI-H460 NSCLC cells
records.note: B7E2 alone lacked cytotoxicity but amplified vinorelbine-induced SAC/MCC formation and killing; named components reproduced activity, warranting mechanism review rather than labeling a healthy-tissue rescue.

records.title: A BubR1-independent pathway for CENP-E targeting to the outer corona of kinetochores
records.model: CENP-E corona recruitment assays; preprint
records.note: Dynein-dependent BubR1-independent recruitment and a conserved CENP-E loop assemble corona; overlaps published structural/recruitment study.

records.title: Screening and Functional Transformation Analysis of Genes Related to Skeletal Muscle Development in Supplemental-Fed Oula Sheep.
records.model: Supplemental-fed Oula sheep muscle across fetal/lamb/adult stages
records.note: BUB1B is one candidate regulator from age-stage transcriptomics; supplementary feeding is background and no BUB1B-deficient muscle rescue comparison is reported.

records.title: C118P exerted potent anti-tumor effects against melanoma with induction of G2/M arrest via inhibiting the expression of BUB1B.
records.model: Human melanoma cells and A375 xenografts
records.note: Tubulin inhibitor C118P reduced BUB1B and induced G2/M arrest/apoptosis with tumor inhibition; an oncology effect in the opposite direction to BubR1 restoration.

records.title: Hyper-active RAS/MAPK introduces cancer-specific mitotic vulnerabilities.
records.model: Controlled transformation models and glioblastoma isolates
records.note: RAS/MAPK hyperactivity created BubR1 dependence through excessive kinetochore kinase activity; abstract gives no named administered rescue agent.

records.title: The analysis of TOP2A as a potential target for predicting the prognosis of brain glioma in the TCGA database and in single-center study.
records.model: TCGA glioma and 161 clinical tissue blocks
records.note: BUB1B was among an earlier 17-gene screen, but present experimental validation focused on TOP2A staining/prognosis.

records.title: SIRT1 regulates mitotic catastrophe via autophagy and BubR1 signaling.
records.model: Cells with SIRT1/BubR1 overexpression or depletion and starvation/autophagy perturbation
records.note: SIRT1 overexpression increased autophagy and BubR1 while reducing BMH-21-associated catastrophe; protective manipulations were genetic/starvation, not an administered SIRT1 agonist.

records.title: The spindle checkpoint proteins BUB1 and BUBR1: (SLiM)ming down to the basics.
records.model: BUB1/BUBR1 short linear interaction motifs and evolution
records.note: Reviews spatial/temporal SLiM organization of checkpoint hubs; no administered therapeutic result in abstract.

records.title: NFYA-Mediated TTK Up-Regulation Drives Fast Cell Cycle Progression and Its Inhibition Leads to Mitotic Catastrophe in Triple Negative Breast Cancer.
records.model: TNBC cells and xenografts
records.note: Pharmacologic/genetic TTK inhibition lowered BUB1B/MAD1L1, disrupted SAC and caused mitotic catastrophe, not an MVA rescue direction.

records.title: Multimerization of a disordered kinetochore protein promotes accurate chromosome segregation by localizing a core dynein module.
records.model: Spc105 mutants and optogenetic oligomerization assays
records.note: Normal segregation and BubR1/RZZ localization required both binding motifs and higher-order Spc105 assembly; optical/genetic restoration rather than drug efficacy.

records.title: Spindle Assembly Checkpoint Competency Determines Sensitivity to KIF18A Inhibition in Small-Cell Lung Cancer
records.model: SCLC cells with varying SAC competence; preprint
records.note: KIF18A inhibition killed SAC-competent tumors; MPS1-triggered acute CIN partly restored sensitivity, overlapping journal study and not genome rescue.

records.title: Molecular contribution to embryonic aneuploidy and karyotypic complexity in initial cleavage divisions of mammalian development.
records.model: Bovine cleavage-stage embryos with BUB1B depletion
records.note: BUB1B loss caused abnormal nuclei/divisions and chaotic aneuploidy before zygotic activation; no pharmacologic or genetic corrective rescue described.

records.title: An intrinsically disordered kinetochore protein coordinates mechanical regulation of chromosome segregation by dynein
records.model: Spc105 optogenetic and deletion assays; preprint
records.note: Binding motifs and multimerization restored BubR1/RZZ recruitment and segregation; overlaps published Spc105 mechanism study with no administered drug.

records.title: Mosaic-variegated aneuploidy syndrome mutation or haploinsufficiency in Cep57 impairs tumor suppression.
records.model: Cep57 truncation/null mice, embryonic fibroblasts and patient skin fibroblasts
records.note: Cep57 mutation caused neonatal ossification defects, centrosome failure and aneuploidy; reduced Fgf2 is a mechanistic finding without FGF2 treatment rescue.

records.title: Molecular anatomy of PLK1 master docking motifs
records.model: PLK1/PBD docking biochemistry and modeling; preprint
records.note: High-affinity CENP-U master motif did not require PBD dimerization; overlaps journal docking study and offers no therapeutic administration.

records.title: In vitro evaluation of Neosetophomone B inducing apoptosis in cutaneous T cell lymphoma by targeting the FOXM1 signaling pathway.
records.model: H9/HH cutaneous T-cell lymphoma cells
records.note: NSP-B dose-dependently reduced FOXM1/BUB1B and induced mitochondrial/caspase apoptosis; bortezomib combination enhanced cancer killing.

records.title: Identification of key candidate genes for ovarian cancer using integrated statistical and machine learning approaches.
records.model: Ovarian cancer microarray/machine-learning datasets
records.note: BUB1B was one of eight shared diagnostic/prognostic candidates validated in external datasets; no intervention experiment.

records.title: A Systems Biology and Drug Repositioning Approach for the Analysis of Mutual Genes Between Celiac Disease and Irritable Bowel Syndrome.
records.model: Celiac/IBS expression networks and SRC virtual screening
records.note: Temoporfin, rimegepant and eltrombopag were docked to SRC; BUB1B was only a network hub, and no agent was administered experimentally.

records.title: FRET-FLIM for the Study of Protein-Protein Interactions Underpinning Mitosis Checkpoints.
records.model: Plant checkpoint interaction methods using FRET-FLIM
records.note: Describes FRET-FLIM for testing plant cell-cycle protein interactions; mentions mammalian MCC composition without drug or rescue outcome.

records.title: Gradual reduction of BUBR1 protein levels results in premature sister-chromatid separation then in aneuploidy.
records.model: HeLa cells with graded BUB1B shRNA depletion
records.note: PCS increased as residual BUBR1 fell and aneuploidy emerged below 50% in this model; supports dosage sensitivity without testing restoration.

records.title: Kinesin KIF16B Participates in G2/M Transition and Microtubule Dynamics via Aurora A-PLK1 in Oocyte Meiosis.
records.model: KIF16B-depleted mouse oocytes
records.note: KIF16B loss destabilized microtubules and caused persistent BubR1/Bub3 recruitment through Aurora-A/PLK1-linked defects; no corrective drug reported.

records.title: Separation of phosphatase and kinase activity within the Bub complex is required for proper mitosis
records.model: Engineered Bub1/BubR1 chimeras; preprint
records.note: Merged phosphatase/kinase functions impaired checkpoint or segregation despite some alignment support; overlaps published chimera study.

records.title: Mitotic CDK4/6 activity sustains spindle checkpoint signalling to prevent mitotic slippage and genomic instability
records.model: Cancer and nontransformed human cells after G1/S; preprint
records.note: Acute mitotic CDK4/6 inhibition reduced CENP-E/SAC phosphorylation and BubR1 recruitment, causing slippage/aneuploidy; timing-specific drug harm rather than rescue.

records.title: Considerations for studying phosphorylation of the mitotic checkpoint pseudokinase BUBR1.
records.model: Vertebrate BUBR1 pseudokinase experiment design methods
records.note: Provides interpretation/design guidance for phosphorylation and pseudokinase studies; no administered treatment result.

records.title: Transcriptomics driven identification of hub gene miRNA interactions for biomarker and therapeutic target discovery in gynecological cancers.
records.model: Gynecologic cancer datasets and HeLa/HeLaDP RT-PCR
records.note: Predicted miRNA-hub interactions include BUB1B, but validation assessed expression rather than miRNA/drug rescue.

records.title: Deciphering the Genomic Landscape of Oropharyngeal Squamous Cell Carcinoma: Distinct Mutation Patterns in Disease.
records.model: AACR GENIE OPSCC genomic cohort
records.note: BUB1B alterations appeared in metastatic lesions among subgroup patterns; retrospective mutation analysis without administered treatment effect.

records.title: Identification of Potential Hub Genes Related to Aflatoxin B1, Liver Fibrosis and Hepatocellular Carcinoma via Integrated Bioinformatics Analysis.
records.model: AFB1/fibrosis/HCC public expression datasets
records.note: BUB1B/RRM2 were intersecting hubs and BUB1B linked to JAK-STAT/immune signatures; no prospective drug or rescue experiment.

records.title: Differentially Expressed Genes Associated with the Development of Cervical Cancer.
records.model: Cervical cancer microarray and regulatory databases
records.note: BUB1B was a predicted miRNA-regulated hub in a broad DEG network; none of the suggested regulators was an administered rescue in abstract.

records.title: BUB1B Overexpression Is an Independent Prognostic Marker and Associated with CD44, p53, and PD-L1 in Renal Cell Carcinoma.
records.model: RCC tissues and BUB1B-knockdown cell lines
records.note: BUB1B depletion reduced growth/invasion and CD44 while raising phospho-p53; nivolumab response appeared only in in-silico associations.

records.title: Lead-induced Hepatotoxicity in Rat Hepatocytes: a Transcriptomic Network Analysis Reveals Key Molecular Insights.
records.model: Rat primary hepatocyte transcriptomic datasets
records.note: Lead-exposed cells showed downregulated BUB1B and mitotic hubs amid metabolic stress; integrative dataset analysis, not rescue pharmacology.

records.title: BubR1 recruitment to the kinetochore via Bub1 enhances Spindle Assembly Checkpoint signaling
records.model: Human ectopic-SAC systems and modeling; preprint
records.note: Bub1-mediated recruitment directly strengthened SAC while BubR1 could indirectly silence it; overlaps journal study without a therapeutic endpoint.

records.title: HROB is a novel prognostic biomarker correlated with immune cell infiltration and tumor progression in lung adenocarcinoma.
records.model: LUAD datasets and HROB-knockdown cells
records.note: HROB silencing inhibited malignant behaviors; BUB1B was a co-expression hub and was not the experimentally restored target.

records.title: Constitutional aneuploidy and cancer predisposition caused by biallelic mutations in BUB1B.
records.model: Five families with BUB1B-related MVA
records.note: Truncating/missense variants connected constitutional aneuploidy with childhood cancer susceptibility; foundational genetic finding without drug testing.

records.title: Prognostic and clinicopathological value of BUB1B expression in patients with lung adenocarcinoma: a meta-analysis.
records.model: Meta-analysis of 16 LUAD studies including 2771 patients
records.note: High BUB1B predicted worse OS/PFS and advanced disease; pooled expression associations do not establish treatment effects.

records.title: BUB1B promotes extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma progression via JNK/c-Jun pathways.
records.model: Extrahepatic CCA cells, tumors and 113-patient tissue array
records.note: BUB1B loss/gain altered proliferation/invasion via JNK-c-Jun and high expression predicted recurrence; no named administered rescue in abstract.

records.title: Integrative in-silico analysis on phytocompounds of Pajanelia longifolia against hepatocellular carcinoma: gene network target identification, molecular docking, simulation and ADMET profiling
records.model: Pajanelia compound extraction and HCC docking/MD; preprint
records.note: C2/C57/C65 were virtual candidates, whereas journal abstract lists C2/C55/C65; neither abstract demonstrates cellular or animal efficacy.

records.title: Design and synthesis of novel HDAC6 inhibitor dimer as HDAC6 degrader for cancer treatment by palladium catalysed dimerisation.
records.model: PC-3 prostate and A549 lung-cancer cells; biochemical inhibition
records.note: HDAC6 dimers caused degradation, apoptosis/autophagy and kinetochore-attachment interference with BUBR1 S670 phosphorylation; checkpoint signal accompanies cytotoxicity.

records.title: BUBR1 recruits PP2A via the B56 family of targeting subunits to promote chromosome congression.
records.model: Human BUBR1/B56-binding mutants and MVA patient-derived cells
records.note: Aurora B inhibition reversed loss of BUBR1:B56-PP2A function; abstract links the complex to MVA-cell congression defects but does not establish whether the drug rescue itself used patient cells.
records.reconciliation_note: ZM447439 engineered-HeLa rescue and genetic MVA-cell rescue distinguished in literature-review.md

records.title: Maternal genetic variants associated with aneuploid conception: a narrative review.
records.model: Twenty-eight human maternal-variant/aneuploid-conception studies
records.note: Reviews heterogeneous maternal genetic associations and says direct aneuploidy links for some panel genes including BUB1B need validation; no drug rescue.

records.title: Long non-coding RNA NORAD upregulation induced by airborne particulate matter (PM<sub>10</sub>) exposure leads to aneuploidy in A549 lung cells.
records.model: A549 lung cells with NORAD siRNA and particulate exposure
records.note: PM10 increased NORAD/SAC transcripts yet decreased mitotic arrest and increased micronuclei; elevated BUB1B transcript alone did not indicate functional protection.

records.title: Bub1 kinase acts as a signalling hub for the entire Cryptococcus neoformans spindle assembly checkpoint pathway
records.model: Cryptococcus neoformans Bub1/Bub3 dissection; preprint
records.note: Single fungal Bub1 carried combined Bub1/BubR1 roles and kinase activity maintained arrest; future antifungal targeting is proposed, not tested rescue.

records.title: DNA damage repair-related methylated genes RRM2 and GAPDH are prognostic biomarkers associated with immunotherapy for lung adenocarcinoma.
records.model: LUAD methylation/expression datasets and TIDE analysis
records.note: BUB1B was hypomethylated/highly expressed but risk model emphasized RRM2/GAPDH; immunotherapy sensitivity was predicted, not a treatment experiment.

records.title: Comprehensive transcriptomic analysis of the hypothalamic-pituitary-ovarian axis reveals the role of Aurora Kinase B in regulating follicular granulosa cell development and steroid hormone synthesis in Wuding chickens.
records.model: Wuding chicken HPO transcriptomes and granulosa-cell AURKB perturbation
records.note: AURKB overexpression promoted steroid synthesis and proliferation while reducing senescence/apoptosis; BUB1B was only a hub, without administered rescue.

records.title: p21 both attenuates and drives senescence and aging in BubR1 progeroid mice.
records.model: BubR1-progeroid mice lacking p53 or p21
records.note: p53/p21 protected skeletal muscle and fat progenitors against p16-mediated senescence, while p21 promoted lens senescence; supports tissue-specific caution for p53 inhibition.
records.reconciliation_note: p53/p21 tissue effects reviewed in literature-review.md

records.title: The cell cycle protein MAD2 facilitates endocytosis of the serotonin transporter in the neuronal soma.
records.model: Primary rat serotonergic neurons and SERT interaction assays
records.note: MAD2 depletion reduced SERT endocytosis; BubR1/p31comet participated in the adaptor complex, establishing a nonmitotic role without treatment rescue.

records.title: Candidate biomarkers for diagnosis and prognosis of prostate cancer based on bioinformatics methods
records.model: Prostate cancer PPI/WGCNA and public validation; preprint
records.note: BUB1B/RRM2 carried prognosis associations within a five-gene diagnostic set; no administered-agent experiment.

records.title: Loss of BubR1 acetylation provokes replication stress and leads to complex chromosomal rearrangements.
records.model: BubR1 K243R acetylation-deficient/p53-null mice and cancer cells
records.note: Loss of BubR1 acetylation provoked replication stress and rearrangements; p53-null crossing allowed abnormal genomes/tumors to be studied, not healthy-tissue rescue.

records.title: Identification of Critical Genes Related to Breast Cancer with Brain Metastasis Through Bioinformatics Analysis.
records.model: Breast cancer brain-metastasis expression datasets
records.note: BUB1B was one poor-RFS hub; oocyte-cycle enrichment is pathway annotation and does not show a measured effect on oocytes or a rescue intervention.

records.title: BUB1B promotes hepatocellular carcinoma progression via activation of the mTORC1 signaling pathway.
records.model: HCC cells and in vivo tumor models with BUB1B manipulation
records.note: Rapamycin impaired BUB1B's oncogenic effect through mTORC1 inhibition; this supports tumor signaling context, not BubR1-deficient muscle rescue.

records.title: Bioinformatics analysis of immune infiltration and cell cycle hub genes in atopic dermatitis.
records.model: AD transcriptomic cohorts and inflammatory-stimulated keratinocytes
records.note: Inflammatory stimulation reproduced upregulation of BUB1B and four other hubs; no corrective drug administration is reported.

records.title: BUBs Are New Biomarkers of Promoting Tumorigenesis and Affecting Prognosis in Breast Cancer.
records.model: Breast cancer public expression/survival/immune databases
records.note: BUB1/BUB1B/BUB3 were linked to prognosis and immune escape through database analyses; targeting remains speculative without drug efficacy data.

records.title: RRM2 as a Key Biomarker and Therapeutic Target in Letrozole-Resistant ER+ Breast Cancer: Insights from Bioinformatics and Molecular Docking
records.model: ER-positive breast cancer cohorts and RRM2 docking; preprint
records.note: RRM2-letrozole binding was docking-based and BUB1B a co-screened gene; differs from later abstract with cell assays and does not provide BUB1B rescue.

records.title: 3,5-bis(styryl)pyrazole inhibits mitosis and induces cell death independent of BubR1 and p53 levels by depolymerizing microtubules.
records.model: MCF-7 and additional cancer/noncancer cells
records.note: Microtubule depolymerization activated SAC and caused death independently of BubR1/p53 levels, with greater cancer antiproliferative effects; no healthy-tissue rescue.

records.title: BUBR1 overexpression predicts disease-specific survival after nephroureterectomy in patients with upper tract urothelial carcinoma.
records.model: 100 upper tract urothelial carcinoma patients
records.note: BUBR1 overexpression independently associated with disease-specific mortality and chromosomal instability, without BUB1B copy gain in tested tumors; no rescue intervention reported.

records.title: CDK1 and CCNA2 play important roles in oral squamous cell carcinoma.
records.model: OSCC GEO transcriptomic datasets
records.note: Six network hubs included BUB1B, but principal expression and prognosis conclusions concerned CDK1 and CCNA2; toxicogenomics and miRNA links were computational.

records.title: Expression of spindle assembly checkpoint proteins BubR1 and Mad2 expression as potential biomarkers of malignant transformation of oral leukoplakia: an observational cohort study.
records.model: 52 oral leukoplakias and 12 normal oral tissues
records.note: Combined high BubR1/Mad2 predicted leukoplakia malignant transformation beyond histological grade; observational immunostaining does not test checkpoint restoration.

records.title: Lablab purpureus phytochemicals demonstrate potential anticancer activity as evidenced through experimental and computational analysis.
administered_agents: Lablab purpureus crude methanolic seed extract
records.model: MCF-7 and A549 cancer cells; HEK-293 comparator; molecular docking
records.note: Extract induced cancer-cell apoptosis and S or G2/M arrest with less HEK-293 toxicity; named purified sugars were computational docking ligands, not demonstrated administered BUBR1-rescue agents.

records.title: ASPM, CDC20, DLGAP5, BUB1B, CDCA8, and NCAPG May Serve as Diagnostic and Prognostic Biomarkers in Endometrial Carcinoma.
records.model: Endometrial carcinoma public expression and clinical datasets
records.note: BUB1B was one of six elevated mitotic hubs associated with unfavorable prognosis; methylation and immune analyses did not constitute drug treatment.

records.title: BubR1 alterations that reinforce mitotic surveillance act against aneuploidy and cancer.
records.model: Bub1b mutant transgenic mice
records.note: Deleting internal Cdc20-binding domain or disrupting its Phe/D boxes strengthened checkpoint and attachment correction and protected against aneuploidy/cancer; genetic domain manipulation rather than a drug result.

records.title: Tissue Biomarkers for Predicting the Risk of Oral Cancer in Patients Diagnosed With Oral Leukoplakia: A Systematic Review of the Past 4 Years.
records.model: Systematic review of oral leukoplakia biomarker studies
records.note: Fourteen studies covering 1479 patients supported several malignant-transformation markers including combined BubR1/Mad2; no therapeutic rescue study is described.

records.title: Identification of Differentially Methylated Genes Associated with Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma and Their Prognostic Values.
records.model: Clear-cell renal cancer public expression/methylation datasets
records.note: Lower BUB1B promoter methylation and survival correlations were inferred from databases; no methylation-altering agent was administered in the abstract.

records.title: Tankyrase activity is essential for asymmetric division and chromosome segregation in oocyte meiosis.
records.model: Mouse oocytes with TNKS inhibition or siRNA depletion
records.note: TNKS loss disrupted asymmetric division, chromosome segregation and BubR1 kinetochore transport; compounds are unnamed and the drug direction is injury, not rescue.

records.title: Chromosome Missegregation Triggers Tumor Cell Pyroptosis and Enhances Anti-Tumor Immunotherapy in Colorectal Cancer.
records.model: Colorectal cancer cells and in vivo tumor models
records.note: Genetic YY2 overexpression upregulated BUB1B, increased missegregation and AIM2-linked pyroptosis, and enhanced PD-1 inhibition; purposeful tumor killing is not healthy-tissue restoration.

records.title: Construction of DNA replication stress gene related risk model and for prognosis in bladder cancer
records.model: Bladder cancer TCGA/GEO risk model with qPCR cell-line validation; preprint
records.note: Nine-gene model separated risk groups and predicted differing responses across 191 drugs; abstract reports BUB1B expression validation but no administered drug or rescue outcome.

records.title: Spindle assembly checkpoint gene BUB1B is essential in breast cancer cell survival.
records.model: Breast cancer lines and MDA-MB-468 mouse tumor model
records.note: siRNA BUB1B loss reduced cancer viability, clonogenicity and tumors while increasing abnormal chromosomes; normal MCF12A viability was spared, but this is depletion for oncology.

records.title: Characteristic Analysis of Featured Genes Associated with Cholangiocarcinoma Progression.
records.model: Cholangiocarcinoma public data and five human tissue samples
records.note: Network-derived BUB1B/BUB1 hubs were verified for progression/prognosis; analysis supplies neither an administered agent nor a tissue-rescue result.

records.title: Role of ubiquitin-protein ligase UBR5 in the disassembly of mitotic checkpoint complexes.
records.model: Nocodazole-arrested HeLa extracts and recombinant proteins
records.note: UBR5 ubiquitylated MCC components and dissociated Bub3-BubR1; immunodepletion prolonged checkpoint arrest, while nocodazole was an arrest reagent rather than rescue therapy.

records.title: Requirement for BUB1B/BUBR1 in tumor progression of lung adenocarcinoma.
records.model: Lung adenocarcinoma cell lines, allograft and tail-vein mice
records.note: BUB1B knockdown sensitized cancer to anoikis and reduced growth/metastasis; N-terminal/GLEBS functions were critical and kinase domain less so, without a administered inhibitor rescue.

records.title: Monoallelic BUB1B mutations and defective mitotic-spindle checkpoint in seven families with premature chromatid separation (PCS) syndrome.
records.model: Cells from Japanese PCS/MVA families; chromosome-15 transfer
records.note: Chromosome-15 transfer restored BubR1, kinetochore p55cdc and colcemid response in patient cells; rescue was genetic and reduced mutant transcripts suggested NMD, not a drug benefit.

records.title: Pan-Cancer Analysis of BUB1B/hsa-miR-130a-3p Axis and Identification of Circulating hsa-miR-130a-3p as a Potential Biomarker for Cancer Risk Assessment.
records.model: Psoriasis and pan-cancer expression datasets
records.note: BUB1B/miR-130a-3p axis emerged computationally; circulating miRNA differed in cancers but not psoriasis blood, with no intervention tested.

records.title: Comprehensively analyzing the genetic alterations, and identifying key genes in ovarian cancer.
records.model: Ovarian cancer GEO and external databases
records.note: Four mitotic hubs including BUB1B were overexpressed; expression lacked overall-survival association whereas genetic alterations associated with survival, and chemotherapy links were database predictions.

records.title: Reduced life- and healthspan in mice carrying a mono-allelic BubR1 MVA mutation.
records.model: BubR1+/GTTA mice carrying human MVA nonsense-mutation model
records.note: Monoallelic 2211insGTTA shortened lifespan and accelerated muscle wasting, exercise impairment, cataracts and fat loss; establishes relevant phenotyping but reports no rescue treatment.

records.title: Identification and validation of KIF20A for predicting prognosis and treatment outcomes in patients with breast cancer.
records.model: Breast tumor sequencing and public/single-cell datasets
records.note: BUB1B appeared among ten hubs but validation centered KIF20A, stromal MDR-gene coexpression and treatment association; no named administered regimen or BUBR1 rescue.

records.title: Molecular mechanism of Mad2 conformational conversion promoted by the Mad2-interaction motif of Cdc20.
records.model: Purified Mad2/Cdc20 motif, time-resolved NMR and molecular dynamics
records.note: Cdc20 motif engaged transiently unfolded Mad2 hairpin to lower the barrier to closed Mad2; structural checkpoint catalysis without pharmacologic tissue testing.

records.title: BuGZ facilitates loading of spindle assembly checkpoint proteins to kinetochores in early mitosis.
records.model: BuGZ mutants and cell-derived Bub3 complexes
records.note: Core BuGZ GLEBS domain and early loading stabilized Bub3 before Bub1/BubR1 kinetochore recruitment; mutational mapping does not identify an administered agent.

records.title: Role of TOP2A and CDC6 in liver cancer.
records.model: Hepatocellular carcinoma GEO datasets
records.note: BUB1B was one of ten elevated network hubs, with claims focused on TOP2A/CDC6 diagnosis and toxicogenomics disease associations rather than treatment.

records.title: A whole-genome CRISPR screen identifies the spindle accessory checkpoint as a locus of nab-paclitaxel resistance in a pancreatic cancer cell line.
records.model: PANC-1 pancreatic cancer CRISPR screens
records.note: SAC-gene knockdown and TTK inhibitors increased survival during paclitaxel exposure; protective outcome is cancer chemoresistance under imposed injury, not nonmalignant BUBR1 restoration.

records.title: TMC5 as a Marker of Tumor-Associated Telocytes in Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
records.model: HCC/adjacent tissue single-nucleus transcriptomics
records.note: BUB1B was a telocyte network hub; TMC5 and SLC35F3 specifically marked tumor-associated telocytes and poor survival, without rescue intervention.

records.title: [Prognostic values of spindle checkpoint protein BUB1B in triple negative breast cancer].
records.model: TNBC tumor sequencing and 139 immunostained samples
records.note: Unlike several other cancer cohorts, lower BUB1B associated with worse TNBC survival; observational direction cannot establish benefit from increasing BUBR1 pharmacologically.

records.title: Liver fibrosis in biliary atresia: identification of the key gene EDIL3 via integrated bioinformatics.
records.model: Neonatal biliary-atresia transcriptomics and clinical liver tissues
records.note: BUB1B was one of seven network cores, but EDIL3 elevation and native-liver survival dominated validation; PI3K-AKT relevance was inferred, not treated.

records.title: Transcriptomics data mining to uncover signature genes in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma: a bioinformatics analysis and RNA-sequencing based validation.
records.model: HNSC public datasets, clinical tissues, FaDu/HOK lines
records.note: Four-gene model included elevated BUB1B and was expression-validated; immune infiltration correlations did not demonstrate an immunotherapy or restorative agent.

records.title: Shared transcriptional regulators and network rewiring identify therapeutic targets linking type 2 diabetes mellitus and hypertension.
records.model: T2DM and hypertension transcriptomic networks
records.note: BUB1B was a hypertension hub alongside MAPK1/RPS6, while shared HNF4A/STAT2 programs were inferred; proposed targets lack drug perturbation in abstract.

records.title: Insufficiency of BUBR1, a mitotic spindle checkpoint regulator, causes impaired ciliogenesis in vertebrates.
records.model: PCS/MVA cells and bubr1 morpholino medaka
records.note: BUBR1 insufficiency impaired ciliogenesis and embryonic patterning through CDC20 degradation/APC-Cdh1/dishevelled regulation; no pharmacologic rescue is described.

records.title: Expression and prognosis analyses of BUB1, BUB1B and BUB3 in human sarcoma.
records.model: Human sarcoma databases and cell-line expression
records.note: Higher BUB1/BUB1B/BUB3 expression associated with shorter overall and disease-free survival; therapeutic targeting is proposed from association only.

records.title: Identification and Validation of Telomere-Related Gene Signature in Intervertebral Disc Degeneration.
records.model: Human nucleus-pulposus degeneration transcriptomic datasets
records.note: BUB1B was among five telomere-related hubs with IVDD predictive value; network/miRNA analyses did not test telomere or checkpoint therapy.

records.title: Identification of Potential Key Genes Linked to Gender Differences in Bladder Cancer Based on Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) Database.
records.model: Sex-stratified bladder cancer GEO dataset
records.note: Female tumors showed higher BUB1B/CCNB1 while other hubs linked male prognosis; sex-stratified expression offers no drug rescue evidence.

records.title: The C-terminal helix of BubR1 is essential for CENP-E-dependent chromosome alignment
records.model: Mammalian mitotic cells and BubR1/CENP-E interaction mutants; preprint
records.note: BubR1 C-terminal basic helix and CENP-E acidic patch mediate motor recruitment and alignment of otherwise uncongressed chromosomes; possible mutation-domain context, without drug testing.

records.title: The Cep57-pericentrin module organizes PCM expansion and centriole engagement.
records.model: Cep57 depletion and CEP57-MVA patient cells
records.note: Cep57-pericentrin interaction organizes PCM and centriole engagement; loss yields premature disengagement and missegregation in a different MVA gene, with no rescue agent.

records.title: Attenuation of Angiotensin II-Induced Hypertension in BubR1 Low-Expression Mice Via Repression of Angiotensin II Receptor 1 Overexpression.
records.model: 24-week male BubR1-low mice and renal proximal-tubule siRNA assays
records.note: AngII caused less hypertension/fibrosis in low-BubR1 mice and BubR1 siRNA reduced AGTR1/Nox4/JNK induction; AngII was injury stimulus, not restorative treatment.

records.title: Mis-splicing of Mitotic Regulators Sensitizes SF3B1-Mutated Human HSCs to CHK1 Inhibition.
records.model: Gene-edited SF3B1-K700E human CD34+ HSPCs and in vivo engraftment
records.note: Mis-spliced/reduced BUBR1 and CDC27 conferred CHK1-inhibitor sensitivity; prexasertib eliminated mutant HSC engraftment, potentially opposite to preserving compromised tissue progenitors.

records.title: Transcriptome analysis reveals that defects in cell cycle regulation contribute to preimplantation embryo arrest.
records.model: Human arrested embryos; Ccnb2-knockdown mouse zygotes; CDC25A-silenced HEK293T
records.note: BUB1B was a transcriptomic hub; functional knockdown was of Ccnb2/CDC25A, increasing fragmentation/apoptosis and reducing development/proliferation, without rescue.

records.title: A whole-genome CRISPR screen identifies the spindle accessory checkpoint as a locus of nab-paclitaxel resistance in pancreatic cancer cells
records.model: PANC-1 CRISPR screen; preprint of PMID38987356
records.note: Full saved preprint abstract repeats SAC knockdown and TTK inhibitor protection from paclitaxel cancer-cell death; duplicate evidence family, not independent tissue-rescue support.

records.title: Clinical and genetic heterogeneity in patients with mosaic variegated aneuploidy: delineation of clinical subtypes.
records.model: Two BUB1B-negative MVA siblings and published genotype-phenotype cases
records.note: Mild mutation-negative siblings and genotype-specific clinical groups indicated additional causal genes; historical clinical series supplies no administered rescue therapy.

records.title: Silencing NDC80, RAD21 and BUB1B ameliorates intervertebral disc degeneration by promoting proliferation and inhibiting apoptosis of nucleus pulposus cells
records.model: Rat IVDD model and siRNA-transfected nucleus-pulposus cells; preprint
records.note: Silencing BUB1B/NDC80/RAD21 improved matrix synthesis and proliferation and reduced NP apoptosis where genes were elevated; nonmalignant benefit uses opposite BUB1B direction and genetic interventions.

records.title: Exploring the Target Genes of Fucosylated Chondroitin Sulfate in Treating Lung Adenocarcinoma Based on the Integration of Bioinformatics Analysis, Molecular Docking, and Experimental Verification.
records.model: A549 lung adenocarcinoma and docking
records.note: FCS reduced A549 growth and sensitized cisplatin treatment while lowering BUB1/PLK1; BUB1B was a computational overlapping hub, not demonstrated rescued target.

records.title: Exploring the mechanism and drug candidates of alveolar echinococcosis affecting liver fibrosis through analysis of existing microarray data.
records.model: Alveolar echinococcosis/liver fibrosis microarray integration
records.note: Ten hubs included BUB1B and DrugBank yielded 135 candidates; no candidate is named or administered and no antifibrotic rescue is measured in abstract.

records.title: Identification of potential biomarkers for 2022 Mpox virus infection: a transcriptomic network analysis and machine learning approach.
records.model: MPXV-infected cell transcriptomic datasets and machine learning
records.note: BUB1B was among six predictive clade-IIb biomarkers; DSigDB candidate assessment and classifier validation are computational, without therapeutic dosing.

records.title: Double homozygosity in CEP57 and DYNC2H1 genes detected by WES: Composite or expanded phenotype?
records.model: Four-month infant with homozygous CEP57 and DYNC2H1 variants
records.note: Exome sequencing resolved a composite skeletal/cardiovascular/infectious phenotype involving CEP57-MVA and dynein disease; no BUB1B intervention or treatment outcome is provided.

records.title: Discovering potential therapeutic targets in glioblastoma multiforme using a multi-omics approach.
records.model: GBM GEO expression and survival networks
records.note: BUB1B belonged to the mitotic low-grade transition signature, while inflammatory hubs characterized adult GBM; upregulation correlated with reduced survival, without therapy testing.

records.title: Kinesin KIFC3 is essential for microtubule stability and cytokinesis in oocyte meiosis.
records.model: Mouse oocytes with KIFC3 disruption
records.note: KIFC3 disruption impaired polar-body extrusion, BubR1/Bub3 recruitment and Sirt2-linked tubulin acetylation; the abstract does not name a chemical or show a restorative intervention.

records.title: Phosphorylation of Ephexin4 at Ser-41 contributes to chromosome alignment via RhoG activation in cell division.
records.model: Ephexin4-depleted mitotic cells and MDCK cysts
records.note: WT or phosphomimetic Ephexin4 restored alignment after depletion; WT prevented vincristine-exacerbated misalignment, but overexpression disrupted cyst morphology and drug served as injury challenge.

records.title: Network-Based Integrative Analysis to Identify Key Genes and Corresponding Reporter Biomolecules for Triple-Negative Breast Cancer.
records.model: TNBC PPI/WGCNA transcriptomic integration
records.note: BUB1B was among 13 reporter genes with TF/miRNA and survival associations; abstract explicitly positions these for future experimental inspection rather than reporting drug validation.

records.title: Coupling of Cdc20 inhibition and activation by BubR1.
records.model: Mitotic checkpoint biochemical/cellular systems
records.note: BubR1 recruits PP2A-B56 to dephosphorylate Cdc20 within MCC; a dephosphorylation-mimic Cdc20 bypassed arrest, showing why simply increasing phosphatase activity is not established rescue.

records.title: Centromeres in cancer: Unraveling the link between chromosomal instability and tumorigenesis.
records.model: Review of centromere abnormalities in cancer
records.note: Reviews altered centromere/checkpoint proteins and diagnostic detection, with disruption strategies for oncology; no named administered nonmalignant-rescue agent appears in saved abstract.

records.title: Identification of key molecular markers in epithelial ovarian cancer by integrated bioinformatics analysis.
records.model: Epithelial ovarian cancer microarrays and validation databases
records.note: BUB1B was one of six final hubs linked to poor prognosis and transcription-factor regulation; protein-expression validation was stronger for several other genes and no treatment was administered.

records.title: Integrating thermal proteome profiling and virtual screening to reveal the mechanism of Bletilla striata against osteoclast-driven osteoporosis.
records.model: Ovariectomized rats and RANKL-induced osteoclast differentiation
records.note: Extract decreased rat bone loss and inhibited osteoclast formation; thermal proteomics/virtual screening linked BUB1B among four targets, but purified ingredient administration, BUBR1 direction and muscle relevance remain unresolved.

supplemental_primary_check.scope: PubMed abstract and author-institution release read; journal full text not accessible (ScienceDirect 403, saved link subscription)
supplemental_primary_check.result: Institution confirms OVX rat bone protection and TPP/network method; its short key-target list names ATM, PIK3R1 and NR3C1 but omits BUB1B. This difference needs primary figure/table checking, not interpretation as a contradiction or evidence of BUB1B activation.

records.title: The Kinase Activity of Drosophila BubR1 Is Required for Insulin Signaling-Dependent Stem Cell Maintenance.
records.model: Drosophila BubR1 kinase-dead knock-in mutants
records.note: Kinase-dead flies lived longer but had reduced insulin signaling and fewer germarial cap cells; constitutively active InR genetically rescued cap-cell count, not a pharmacologic result.

records.title: Identification of key hub genes and potential therapeutic drugs for nasopharyngeal carcinoma: Insights into molecular mechanisms and treatment strategies.
records.model: Nasopharyngeal carcinoma cells following bioinformatics screening
records.note: Eight hubs including BUB1B promoted NPC proliferation when overexpressed; calcitriol was most antiproliferative at submicromolar IC50 values, without proof of healthy-cell or BUBR1 restoration.

records.title: BUB1B Promotes Proliferation of Prostate Cancer via Transcriptional Regulation of MELK.
records.model: Prostate cancer tissues and lentiviral gene perturbation
records.note: BUB1B promoted proliferation through MELK transcription and associated with poor outcomes; proposed druggable target derives from gene manipulation, not drug treatment.

records.title: BUBR1 Pseudokinase Domain Promotes Kinetochore PP2A-B56 Recruitment, Spindle Checkpoint Silencing, and Chromosome Alignment.
records.model: Human BUBR1 pseudokinase-domain mutation/removal systems
records.note: Pseudokinase defects decreased KARD phosphorylation and PP2A-B56 recruitment and produced Aurora-B imbalance; abstract does not describe chemical rescue, making full-text drug assessment necessary.

records.title: Comprehensive transcriptomic analysis of the hypothalamic-pituitary-ovarian axis reveals the role of Aurora Kinase B in regulating follicular granulosa cell development and steroid hormone synthesis in Wuding chickens
records.model: Wuding chicken HPO transcriptomics and granulosa-cell AURKB perturbation
records.note: AURKB overexpression enhanced steroid hormones/proliferation and reduced senescence/apoptosis; BUB1B was a network hub only and no Aurora drug was administered.

records.title: Predictive Value of CCNB1, BUB1B and TTK in the Progression and Prognosis of Lung Adenocarcinoma
records.model: 1174 lung-cancer expression profiles; preprint
records.note: CCNB1/BUB1B/TTK were elevated and associated with shorter survival and cell-cycle enrichment; treatment-target suggestion is not an administered intervention.

records.title: Bisphenol AP inhibits mouse oocyte maturation in vitro by disrupting cytoskeleton architecture and cell cycle processes.
records.model: Mouse oocytes in vitro
records.note: BPAP blocked polar-body extrusion with sustained BubR1, unreduced Securin/CyclinB1, spindle disruption and DNA damage; increased checkpoint signal reflects injury rather than rescue.

records.title: Aneuploidy-driven gene expression profiling in human blastocysts: insights from RNA-Seq analysis.
records.model: Human euploid and single-aneuploid blastocysts
records.note: BUB1B and four other genes were overexpressed in aneuploid embryos with autophagy/DNA-repair and mitochondrial signatures; no rescue manipulation or named ovarian-stimulation agent was reported.

records.title: Characterizing the Human Fetal Perimeiotic 45,X Ovary at Single-Cell Resolution.
records.model: Human fetal 45,X versus 46,XX ovaries
records.note: 45,X ovaries had fewer germ cells and lower BUB1B alongside proteostasis/OXPHOS genes; transcriptomic observation does not establish BUBR1-causal rescue.

records.title: Methionine Deprivation-induced Cancer Cell Death and Methylation Changes in Key Genes and Gene Promoters of Prostate Cancer Cell Lines.
records.model: PC3/DU145 prostate cancer with MEGL gene expression
records.note: Genetic methionine degradation killed cancer cells and altered BUB1B promoter methylation; methotrexate was a killing comparator, azacytidine inactive, and propargylglycine reversed imposed MEGL injury.

records.title: The identification and analysis of key genes associated with Hepatitis D Virus-related hepatocellular carcinoma through big data mining
records.model: HDV-associated HCC microarrays; preprint
