records.note: BUB1B plus five mitotic hubs were elevated and linked to unfavorable prognosis; pathway and survival analyses offered no administered treatment.

records.title: Vitamin K2 mitigates cognitive, and motor impairments induced by multiple surgery with anesthesia and analgesia in neonatal stage.
records.model: Neonatal mice receiving repeated surgery/anesthesia on postnatal days 6, 8, 10
records.note: VK2 given 30 minutes before each procedure mitigated later cognitive/fine-motor deficits and restored NAc neurogenesis; BUB1B was among validated network hubs, but causality, individual direction and muscle/MVA translation need primary appraisal.

records.title: Comparative genomic hybridization and BUB1B mutation analyses in childhood cancers associated with mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome.
records.model: BUB1B-MVA rhabdomyosarcoma and sporadic childhood cancers
records.note: MVA rhabdomyosarcoma had typical sporadic aneuploidies, and screening found no persuasive recurrent somatic BUB1B driver across childhood tumors; no rescue intervention.

records.title: KIF2C-induced nuclear condensation concentrates PLK1 and phosphorylated BRCA2 at the kinetochore microtubules in mitosis
records.model: Optogenetic KIF2C condensation and phosphopeptide-binding systems; preprint
records.note: KIF2C phosphobinding domain supports condensates concentrating active PLK1/BRCA2-pT207 near microtubules; BUBR1 participates in the described complex, without pharmacologic rescue evidence.

records.title: Prognostic value of ubiquitination-related differentially expressed genes in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma: a comprehensive analysis and future directions.
records.model: ESCC public/in-house expression datasets and qPCR
records.note: BUB1B was among five prognostic ubiquitination-related genes; differential expression and enrichment support biomarker hypotheses, not an administered ubiquitin-modifying therapy.

records.title: Molecular Contribution to Embryonic Aneuploidy and Genotypic Complexity During Initial Cleavage Divisions of Mammalian Development
records.model: Bovine cleavage-stage embryos with BUB1B depletion; preprint
records.note: BUB1B loss produced abnormal cytokinesis, chaotic aneuploidy and arrest before genome activation; live imaging characterized micronuclear fates but no rescue agent was reported.

records.title: Identification of the hub gene BUB1B in hepatocellular carcinoma via bioinformatic analysis and in vitro experiments.
records.model: HCC public datasets and in-vitro gene-function experiments
records.note: BUB1B affected HCC proliferation/invasion/apoptosis and mitochondrial function after experimental perturbation; abstract does not identify a drug or healthy-cell benefit.

records.title: Identification of Hub Genes for Psoriasis and Cancer by Bioinformatic Analysis.
records.model: Psoriasis and colon-cancer expression/network datasets
records.note: Thirteen shared mitotic hubs including BUB1B led to 251 predicted drugs; overlap with existing treatments is computational and no administered-agent result appears.

records.title: FDA-approved Levophed as an alternative multitargeted therapeutic against cervical cancer transferase, cell cycle, and regulatory proteins.
records.model: Cervical cancer network, docking, WaterMap and 100-ns simulations
records.note: Levophed was virtually screened against nine proteins including BUBR1; despite title and strong conclusion, the abstract explicitly requires experiments and reports no administration or resistance outcome.

records.title: Unveiling novel prognostic biomarkers and therapeutic targets for HBV-associated hepatocellular carcinoma through integrated bioinformatic analysis.
records.model: HBV-associated HCC integrated microarrays and TCGA
records.note: Nine hubs were validated for poor prognosis; BUB1B was among eleven remaining hubs explicitly needing functional study, without drug dosing.

records.title: Elevated expression of ECT2 as a diagnostic marker and prognostic indicator in endometrial cancer.
records.model: Endometrial neoplasia datasets and clinical samples
records.note: BUB1B appeared among candidate hubs, but strongest diagnostic and prognostic validation concerned ECT2 across benign, atypical and malignant endometria.

records.title: Comprehensive analysis of intervention and control studies for the computational identification of dengue biomarker genes.
records.model: Dengue-patient GEO expression datasets
records.note: BUB1B joined cell-cycle/immune-response biomarkers among 163 candidates; despite intervention/control wording in title this is computational patient-expression analysis, not a drug-rescue experiment.

records.title: Identification of novel candidate predisposing genes in familial nonmedullary thyroid carcinoma implicating DNA damage repair pathways.
records.model: 48 familial nonmedullary thyroid carcinoma probands
records.note: Sequencing/modeling nominated rare predisposition variants including BUB1B among DNA-repair and other genes; pathogenicity predictions are not treatment tests.

records.title: Propylparaben exposure impairs G2/M and metaphase-anaphase transition during mouse oocyte maturation.
records.model: Mouse oocytes in vitro; 600 micromolar exposure
records.note: PrPB caused mitochondrial/oxidative damage, impaired MPF transition and destabilized spindle attachments with sustained BUB3/BubR1 activation; checkpoint accumulation is injury response.

records.title: Coupling of Cdc20 inhibition and activation by BubR1
records.model: BubR1/PP2A-B56/Cdc20 checkpoint systems; preprint of PMID33819340
records.note: Read preprint separately: BubR1 directs Cdc20 dephosphorylation within MCC, while dephosphorylation-mimic Cdc20 escapes arrest; duplicate mechanistic family with no drug benefit.

records.title: Meiosis-specific functions of kinetochore protein SPC105R required for chromosome segregation in Drosophila oocytes.
records.model: Drosophila oocytes with RNAi-resistant SPC105R domain constructs
records.note: SPC105R C terminus recruits NDC80 and BUBR1/cohesion factors; N-terminal motifs govern attachments and arrest, mapped by genetics rather than an administered agent.

records.title: Chemokines and PI3K/AKT signaling pathway mediate the spontaneously ruptured hepatocellular carcinoma through the regulation of the cell cycle.
records.model: Ruptured/nonruptured human HCC clinical/transcriptomic cohorts
records.note: WBC/monocytes predicted rupture and tissue BUB1B/MACRO associated with cycle/immune signatures; PI3K-AKT treatment rationale was not tested as a drug intervention.

records.title: The miRNA-mRNA Regulatory Network in Human Hepatocellular Carcinoma by Transcriptomic Analysis From GEO.
records.model: Human HCC GEO mRNA/miRNA networks
records.note: Twenty hubs including BUB1B linked poor survival to inferred miRNA regulation; neither miRNA administration nor drug treatment was demonstrated.

records.title: BUBR1 Insufficiency Is Correlated with eNOS Reduction Experimentally In Vitro and In Vivo, and in Gastric Cancer Tissue.
records.model: Passaged/siRNA HUVECs, BubR1-insufficient mice and gastric tumors
records.note: Lower BubR1 reduced eNOS and cGMP without corresponding p-eNOS change; suggests vascular pathway context but reports no NO/cGMP-restoring drug or muscle benefit.

records.title: Germline mutations in the spindle assembly checkpoint genes BUB1 and BUB3 are infrequent in familial colorectal cancer and polyposis.
records.model: 544 familial CRC/polyposis cases screened for BUB1/BUB3
records.note: Rare BUB1/BUB3 variants mostly lacked clear functional effect or MVA traits; this concerns related genes and diagnostics, not BUB1B pharmacology.

records.title: Loss of BubR1 Acetylation instigates Replication Stress leading to Complex Chromosomal Rearrangement in tumors
records.model: BubR1 K243R/+ and p53-deficient mouse tumors/MEFs; preprint
records.note: Loss of specific BubR1 acetylation promoted replication stress, premature separation and complex rearrangements; site-specific acetylation biology cannot be equated to generic deacetylase inhibition.

records.title: Doxorubicin downregulates cell cycle regulatory hub genes in breast cancer cells.
records.model: Breast cancer cell lines after hub-gene bioinformatics
records.note: DOX reduced nine cycle-hub transcripts including BUB1B by qPCR; reduction and oncology rationale do not establish restored checkpoint function or nonmalignant benefit.

records.title: Kinesin motor KIF16A regulates microtubule stability and actin-dependent spindle migration in mouse oocyte meiosis.
records.model: Kif16A-siRNA mouse oocytes
records.note: Kif16A loss reduced tubulin acetylation, drug resistance and kinetochore BubR1 while disrupting spindle migration; unnamed drugs were stability challenges, not rescue agents.

records.title: Identification of Hub Genes and CDK1-Targeting Therapeutics in Hepatocellular Carcinoma: Bioinformatics and Simulation Study
records.model: HCC bioinformatics, virtual screening and molecular dynamics; preprint
records.note: G213-0272/E130-0174/Z666960592 and alvocidib/riviciclib were predicted CDK1 ligands; BUB1B was an expression hub and no compound was experimentally administered.

records.title: A bioinformatics exploration of lung adenocarcinoma identifies hub genes with prognostic significance: from data to discovery.
records.model: LUAD public tumor/control datasets
records.note: Integrated DEG/PPI and database survival validation identified BUB1B among nine candidate markers, explicitly requiring clinical/experimental translation.

records.title: Interspecies transcriptome profiles of human T cell activation and liver inflammation in a xenogeneic graft-versus-host disease model
records.model: Human PBMC-engrafted NSG mice after busulfan conditioning
records.note: Busulfan plus PBMCs generated hepatic GvHD with human T-cell cycle genes including BUB1B elevated; conditioning and saline controls were not restorative treatments.

records.title: Cancer-Specific requirement for BUB1B/BUBR1 in human brain tumor isolates and genetically transformed cells.
records.model: Patient-derived glioblastoma initiating cells, NSCs and transformed-cell models
records.note: BUB1B knockdown selectively blocked BTIC growth via GLEBS-dependent attachment defects while sparing NSCs/astrocytes; this is oncology depletion, not improved deficient progenitors.

records.title: Dysregulated Mechanotransduction via CCNB2 Underlies Fibroblast Hypoplasia in Developmental Dysplasia of the Hip
records.model: Human DDH joint-capsule tissues and matched controls; preprint
records.note: BUB1B was one of five reduced hubs; CCNB2 was experimentally validated with fibroblast hypoplasia, but muscle-contraction enrichment and tissue expression are not treatment evidence.

records.title: Integrative Bioinformatics Analysis for Targeting Hub Genes in Hepatocellular Carcinoma Treatment.
records.model: HCC expression and drug-network databases
records.note: Sorafenib/regorafenib/cabozantinib/lenvatinib were network lead suggestions around twenty hubs including BUB1B; no drug was experimentally administered in this study abstract.

records.title: CKAP5 stabilizes CENP-E at kinetochores by regulating microtubule-chromosome attachments.
records.model: Human cells with CKAP5 depletion and rescue constructs
records.note: CKAP5 TOG4-TOG5 and CENP-E phosphomimic restored CENP-E kinetochore behavior after CKAP5 loss; no chemical rescue or deficient BUB1B model was described.

records.title: In Silico Identification of Hub Genes as Observing Biomarkers for Gastric Cancer Metastasis.
records.model: Gastric-cancer GEO and survival databases
records.note: BUB1B and four other hubs were predicted biomarkers; the claim that suppressing them increases survival is extrapolated from in-silico associations, not observed treatment.

records.title: Predicting Infertility: How Genetic Variants in Oocyte Spindle Genes Affect Egg Quality.
records.model: Review chapter on human oocyte spindle-gene variants
records.note: Discusses BUB1B and seven other spindle genes in maturation arrest, aneuploidy and infertility; abstract provides genetic mechanism synthesis rather than drug efficacy.

records.title: Downregulation of Mad2 and BubR1 increase the malignant potential and nocodazole resistance by compromising spindle assembly checkpoint signaling pathway in cervical carcinogenesis.
records.model: Cervical lesion specimens and SiHa gene-overexpression/siRNA cells
records.note: BubR1/Mad2 depletion increased malignant behavior and nocodazole resistance; overexpression reduced malignant traits and increased drug apoptosis, not nonmalignant-tissue rescue.

records.title: Esophageal chemical burns as a risk factor for esophageal malignancies: in-silico analyses - experimental research.
records.model: Chemical-burn/esophageal-cancer gene-expression networks
records.note: Twenty-six common genes including BUB1B were identified computationally; chemical burn was a disease context and no actual tested chemical or rescue regimen is named.

records.title: Sensitization of cancer cells to paclitaxel-induced apoptosis by canagliflozin.
records.model: Ovarian and oral squamous cancer cells; ES-2 mechanistic assays
records.note: SGLT2 inhibitors potentiated paclitaxel killing; canagliflozin lowered phospho-BUBR1/cyclinB1 and increased aneuploidy/DNA damage, with GLUT inhibition supporting the synergy.

records.title: BubR1 depletion delays apoptosis in the microtubule-depolymerized cells.
records.model: BubR1-depleted and control MCF-7 cancer cells
records.note: BubR1 loss initially delayed CXI-benzo-84 apoptosis but not 72-hour death; adding cisplatin killed depleted cells more strongly, arguing against interpreting transient survival as tissue rescue.

records.title: BubR1 phosphorylates CENP-E as a switch enabling the transition from lateral association to end-on capture of spindle microtubules.
records.model: Drosophila BubR1 structure and CENP-E/microtubule cellular systems
records.note: Bubristatin was modeled as a selective BubR1 antagonist and inhibition of CENP-E phosphorylation impaired end-on capture and central spindle formation; direct binding/inhibition does not imply restoration.

records.title: Unraveling druggable cancer-driving proteins and targeted drugs using artificial intelligence and multi-omics analyses.
records.model: Machine learning, pan-cancer omics and drug repurposing
records.note: BUB1B ranked among 23 unfavorable-prognostic druggable proteins; eleven clinical drugs were computationally prioritized but not named or experimentally administered in abstract.

records.title: Simulated microgravity altered the gene expression profiles and inhibited the proliferation of Kupffer cells in the early phase by downregulating LMO2 and EZH2.
records.model: Kupffer cells after three days simulated microgravity
records.note: Microgravity reduced proliferation and LMO2/EZH2-linked mitotic transcripts including Bub1b; targets were proposed, with no countermeasure administered.

records.title: MAD2-Dependent Insulin Receptor Endocytosis Regulates Metabolic Homeostasis.
records.model: IR-MAD2 interaction-defective mice
records.note: Disrupting IR-MAD2 prolonged receptor signaling but impaired insulin clearance and increased fasting fatty acids/hepatic fat; no useful pharmacologic compensation was demonstrated.

records.title: sFRP3 inhibition improves age-related cellular changes in BubR1 progeroid mice.
records.model: BubR1H/H progeroid mice with sFRP3 genetic inhibition
records.note: sFRP3 genetic inhibition restored body/brain size, improved myelination and rescued dentate progenitor proliferation; reconfirms FRZB route without identifying an administered inhibitor or muscle outcome.

records.title: CENP-E haploinsufficiency causes chromosome misalignment and spindle assembly checkpoint activation in the spermatogonia.
records.model: CENP-E+/- mice and GC-1 spermatogonial cells
records.note: Genetic haploinsufficiency and CENP-E inhibitor experiments concern misalignment, arrest and spermatogonial loss; BubR1 recruitment disruption provides injury mechanism, not rescue.

records.title: Combined TRIP13 and Aurora Kinase Inhibition Induces Apoptosis in Human Papillomavirus-Driven Cancers.
records.model: HPV-positive/negative squamous cancer lines and patient-derived xenografts
records.note: Aurora inhibition killed HPV-positive/Rb-deficient tumors; BUB1B/MAD2L1 depletion reduced apoptosis while genetic TRIP13 depletion enhanced it, separating drug and genetic roles.

records.title: Discovering Cure Hub Genes of Chromophobe Cell Renal Carcinoma Using weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA) and the Cure Defective Models
records.model: Chromophobe RCC gene networks and statistical cure models; preprint
records.note: BUB1B was a shared prognostic hub under Gompertz/Cox modeling; modeled cure rates do not establish treatment administration or causal gene rescue.

records.title: Lysosome-related genes: A new prognostic marker for lung adenocarcinoma.
records.model: LUAD lysosome-related gene risk modeling
records.note: BUB1B entered a lysosome-associated risk network; immunotherapy/drug sensitivity were assessed computationally, and no lysosome-targeting drug benefit was demonstrated.

records.title: Identification of key regulatory genes in the pathogenesis of COVID-19 and sepsis: An observational study.
records.model: COVID-19/sepsis RNA-seq and validation cohorts
records.note: BUB1B was one of five elevated shared hubs with strong ROC performance; immune-pathway association supplies a biomarker hypothesis, not therapy testing.

records.title: Identification of Biomarkers for Ovarian Cancer Diagnosis and Prognosis by Bioinformatics Analysis and q-PCR Validation.
records.model: Five ovarian-cancer cohorts and tissue qPCR
records.note: BUB1B was among qPCR-confirmed discriminatory markers, while FGF13 predicted better survival; no drug or checkpoint-restoration experiment appears.

records.title: Analysis of two-gene signatures and related drugs in small-cell lung cancer by bioinformatics.
records.model: Small-cell lung cancer expression datasets and qPCR
records.note: Ten hubs including BUB1B were measured and ten approved drugs screened in QuartataWeb; abstract names no drug or experimental drug exposure.

records.title: The Impact of miR-155-5p on Myotube Differentiation: Elucidating Molecular Targets in Skeletal Muscle Disorders.
records.model: Treated myotubes and dystrophin-deficient muscle datasets
records.note: miR-155 changed 359 myotube transcripts including Bub1b-associated targets with dystrophy overlap; abstract does not state restored differentiation/strength or a pharmacologic anti-miR rescue.

records.title: Molecular mechanism of Mad2 conformational conversion promoted by the Mad2-interaction motif of Cdc20
records.model: Time-resolved NMR/Mad2 simulations; preprint of PMID40143766
records.note: Read full preprint: Cdc20 motif binds a transient Mad2 intermediate after hairpin unfolding, then releases beta1; structural evidence family without administered therapy.

records.title: BubR1 Insufficiency Impairs Affective Behavior and Memory Function in Mice.
records.model: BubR1H/H mice and adult dentate-gyrus knockdown
records.note: Low BubR1 increased anxiety/depression-like behavior and impaired object memory in two genetic contexts; useful functional phenotype but no therapeutic reversal.

records.title: The FOXM1/BUB1B signaling pathway is essential for the tumorigenicity and radioresistance of glioblastoma.
records.model: GBM in vitro and in vivo with radiation/shRNA manipulations
records.note: FOXM1 inhibitor reduced tumors and radioresistance; FOXM1 transcriptionally controlled BUB1B, and shRNA established dependency, without healthy-tissue checkpoint rescue.

records.title: Identification of hub genes associated with bladder cancer using bioinformatic analyses.
records.model: Bladder cancer GEO/TCGA and survival/immune databases
records.note: BUB1B overexpression associated with shorter survival among ten hubs and correlated with immune features; no administered treatment or functional restoration.

records.title: Deep genomic characterization highlights complexities and prognostic markers of pediatric acute myeloid leukemia.
records.model: 147 pediatric AML cases with variant functional characterization
records.note: Genomic profiling identified TP53 risk and BUB1B dependency in an aggressive subgroup; no named drug or nonmalignant progenitor-rescue result was described.

records.title: The study of competing endogenous RNAs regulatory network in hepatocellular carcinoma via bioinformatics
records.model: HCC circRNA/miRNA/mRNA GEO network; preprint
records.note: BUB1B was one of eight PPI hubs and ceRNA modules were inferred; molecular diagnostic/prognostic network does not test therapeutic RNA administration.

records.title: In silico analysis of deleterious single nucleotide polymorphisms in human BUB1 mitotic checkpoint serine/threonine kinase B gene.
records.model: In-silico BUB1B coding/UTR variant analysis
records.note: I82N/P334L/R814H were predicted to affect function/stability with additional UTR effects; predictions, including known R814H context, provide no drug rescue evidence.

records.title: Targeting the <i>AURKB</i>-<i>MAD2L2</i> Axis Disrupts the DNA Damage Response and Glycolysis to Inhibit Colorectal Cancer Progression.
records.model: CRC cell lines and clinical expression risk model
records.note: AURKB knockdown impaired glycolysis and cancer survival and MAD2L2 overexpression reversed those effects; BUB1B was a risk-model gene rather than tested rescue target.

records.title: Muscle cell atrophy induced by miR-155-5p reveals molecular targets in skeletal muscle disorders
records.model: Myotubes and dystrophin-deficient muscle datasets; preprint of PMID38339055
records.note: Unlike the later abstract wording, this saved preprint explicitly describes miR-155-induced atrophic myotubes; Bub1b was a regulated transcript, not an administered-rescue target.

records.title: Multiple pools of PP2A regulate spindle assembly, kinetochore attachments and cohesion in Drosophila oocytes.
records.model: Drosophila oocyte PP2A/BUBR1 domain and recruitment experiments
records.note: PP2A-B55/B56 countered AuroraB spindle assembly, with multiple B56 pools mediating attachments/cohesion; BUBR1 stabilized attachments but was dispensable for cohesion in this model.

records.title: CENP-E initiates chromosome congression by opposing Aurora kinases to promote end-on attachments
records.model: Mitotic cells under differing CENP-E activity; preprint
records.note: CENP-E reduced AuroraB phosphorylation through BubR1 to initiate bioriented congression; inhibition/rescue reagents are not specified in abstract, requiring primary inspection for chemical evidence.

records.title: Digital multiplexed mRNA analysis of functionally important genes in single human oocytes and correlation of changes in transcript levels with oocyte protein expression.
records.model: Single human IVF oocytes, younger versus older donors
records.note: BUB1B transcripts varied among oocytes and declined about 1.5-fold with age alongside marked protein loss; measurement-only study despite structured Intervention heading.

records.title: Sensitivity to BUB1B Inhibition Defines an Alternative Classification of Glioblastoma.
administered_agents: type I/II topoisomerase inhibitors (class; tested members unspecified)
records.model: GBM isolates and computational BUB1B sensitivity classifier
records.note: BUB1B-dependent GBMs had worse prognosis and predicted drug vulnerabilities, with some drug predictions experimentally validated; members and assays require full text but objective is cancer killing.

records.title: Transcriptome analysis identifies the NR4A subfamily involved in the alleviating effect of folic acid on mastitis induced by high concentration of Staphylococcus aureus lipoteichoic acid.
records.model: Mac-T bovine mammary cells and folate-supplemented mastitis cows
records.note: FA pretreatment reduced high-aLTA apoptosis and NR4A activation, with BUB1B target-expression trends corroborated in cow blood; distinct inflammatory lesion/tissue and BUBR1 causality remain unresolved.

records.title: Machine learning-based establishment and validation of age-related patterns for predicting prognosis in non-small cell lung cancer within the context of the tumor microenvironment.
records.model: NSCLC aging-gene risk and immune-response models
records.note: BUB1B was one of 53 aging-associated survival genes; aging subtypes differed in tumor microenvironment and inferred immunotherapy response, without restorative dosing.

records.title: The BUBR1 pseudokinase domain promotes efficient kinetochore PP2A-B56 recruitment to regulate spindle checkpoint silencing and chromosome alignment
records.model: Human BUBR1 pseudokinase-domain perturbation; preprint of PMID33207204
records.note: Preprint states human domain lacks phosphotransfer and allosterically supports KARD phosphorylation; mutations impair PP2A recruitment/Aurora balance, but no drug rescue is specified.

records.title: HDAC2/3 binding and deacetylation of BubR1 initiates spindle assembly checkpoint silencing.
records.model: Mitotic cells and Brca2-deficient mouse pancreatic organoids
records.note: HDAC2/3 deacetylation drove BubR1 degradation/checkpoint exit; sustained acetylation arrested metaphase, and BRCA2 loss caused HDAC-inhibitor resistance, so increased BubR1 acetylation is not automatically productive rescue.

records.title: BubR1 Is Essential for Thio-Dimethylarsinic Acid-Induced Spindle Assembly Checkpoint and Mitotic Cell Death for Preventing the Accumulation of Abnormal Cells.
records.model: HeLa, HepG2 and BubR1-siRNA cells
records.note: Thio-DMA activated BubR1/MCC and mitotic apoptosis; knockdown allowed abnormal tetraploid survivors, distinguishing toxicant resistance from healthy checkpoint restoration.

records.title: Identification of novel biomarkers and potential molecular targets for uterine cancer using network-based approach.
records.model: Uterine-cancer DEG/PPI networks
records.note: BUB1B appeared among 26 inferred regulators and miRNA links; claims about drug need/approval are not treatment evidence and no agent was experimentally assessed.

records.title: Identification Cure Hub Genes of Chromophobe Cell Renal Carcinoma : A study based on Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis (WGCNA) and the Cure Defective Models
records.model: RCC expression with Gompertz cure modeling; related preprint PPR766917
records.note: Ten hubs overlapped cure/survival statistical models with BUB1B among six predictors; expression-linked modeled cure is not observed gene-targeted therapy.

records.title: Identification of the Key Genes Involved in the Tumorigenesis and Prognosis of Prostate Cancer.
records.model: Prostate-cancer public expression and immune datasets
records.note: TOP2A/NCAPG/BUB1B associated with worse stage/survival and CMap nominated tipifarnib; no tipifarnib treatment or functional drug validation is described.

records.title: Expression of circular RNA has-circ-0009158 and identification of associated miRNA-mRNA network in hepatocellular carcinoma.
records.model: 143 HCC tissues, cell-line expression and ceRNA inference
records.note: High circ-0009158 correlated with recurrence/prognosis and inferred ten hubs including BUB1B; qPCR expression and network links do not test a therapeutic manipulation.

records.title: In silico identification and interaction analysis of Hub Genes and miRNAs in Gynecological Cancer and their potential role as biomarkers
records.model: Gynecologic-cancer mRNA/miRNA public-data integration; preprint
records.note: Ten hubs including BUB1B and thirty interacting miRNAs were predicted; top miRNA interactions are computational with no administered miRNA or drug outcome.

records.title: Identification of Novel lncRNAs Related to Colorectal Cancer Through Bioinformatics Analysis.
records.model: CRC GEO lncRNA/mRNA coexpression analysis
records.note: BUB1B joined mitotic/ribosome-associated lightpink4 module hubs; lncRNA functions were inferred from coexpression and the authors call for experimental validation.

records.title: Mad2 is dispensable for accurate chromosome segregation but becomes essential when oocytes are subjected to environmental stress.
records.model: Oocyte-specific Mad2-knockout mice; culture/temperature challenges
records.note: Mad2-null mice remained fertile/euploid in vivo with BubR1 recruitment intact, but culture and low temperature revealed segregation failure; no pharmacologic rescue.

records.title: Detection of Genetic Variations in Children with Tetralogy of Fallot Using Whole Exome Sequencing Technology Integrated Bioinformatics Analysis.
records.model: 47 surgically treated children with tetralogy of Fallot
records.note: WES implicated BUB1B among diverse developmental genes through annotation/prediction; surgery defined the cohort and no gene-targeted drug outcome was studied.

records.title: The mitotic checkpoint protein MAD2 delivers monoamine transporters to endocytosis
records.model: SERT/DAT-expressing HEK293 and serotonergic neurons; preprint
records.note: MAD2 interaction recruited BubR1/p31comet/AP2 for transporter endocytosis; MAD2 depletion reduced internalization, without testing antidepressant administration or BUBR1 restoration.

records.title: Overexpression of BUB1B, CCNA2, CDC20, and CDK1 in tumor tissues predicts poor survival in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
records.model: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma GEO/TCGA cohorts
records.note: Elevated BUB1B/CCNA2/CDC20/CDK1 associated with worse overall/disease-free survival and aggressive pathology; gene-expression prognosis is not treatment response causality.

records.title: Deciphering hub genes as potential therapeutic target involved in progression of Glioblastoma multiforme disease: A multi-omics approach
records.model: GBM multiomics expression/survival networks; preprint of PMID40168776
records.note: Separate preprint abstract repeats mitotic low-grade and inflammatory GBM hubs, including BUB1B, with reduced survival associations and no drug exposure.

records.title: Identification of prognostic biomarkers in papillary renal cell carcinoma and PTTG1 may serve as a biomarker for predicting immunotherapy response.
records.model: Papillary RCC public data and FUSCC clinical cohort
records.note: BUB1B was among eight poor-prognosis genes; PTTG1, rather than BUB1B intervention, correlated with observed checkpoint-blockade response in patients.

records.title: CBIO-24. KINETOCHORE MISREGULATION IN GLIOBLASTOMA AND OTHER CANCERS
records.model: GBM patient isolates and RAS/MEK-transformed cells; conference abstract
records.note: RAS/MAPK drove attachment instability and BUB1B dependence; an 838-gene classifier proposed orthogonal vulnerabilities, with no named administered drug or nonmalignant benefit.

records.title: Identification of most representative hub-genes for diagnosis, prognosis, and therapies of hepatocellular carcinoma.
records.model: HCC literature-integrated network and protein binding predictions
records.note: CD437, avrainvillamide and LRRK2-IN-1 were selected for predicted binding across receptor panels; no administered treatment or measured BUBR1 rescue is described.

records.title: Catalase Expression Is an Independent Prognostic Marker in Lung Adenocarcinoma.
records.model: LUAD TCGA, CL1 progression lines and CAT-silenced A549
records.note: Catalase expression predicted favorable survival and CAT silencing increased growth/BUB1B/PLK1/PKMYT1; no administered catalase or antioxidant benefit was tested.

records.title: A Bioinformatics Analysis Identifies the Telomerase Inhibitor MST-312 for Treating High-STMN1-Expressing Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
records.model: STMN1-high HCC cells and connectivity analyses
records.note: MST-312 reduced viability and STMN1/BUB1B/MCM5 protein, with STMN1 overexpression enhancing sensitivity; telomerase-inhibitor effect is tumor killing, not normal tissue restoration.

records.title: Integrated bioinformatic analysis reveals the gene signatures, epigenetic roles, and regulatory networks in endometriosis.
records.model: Six endometriosis transcriptomic datasets
records.note: BUB1B was one of fifteen hub genes in ECM/p53/focal-adhesion enriched networks; study maps miRNA/lncRNA candidates without administered treatment.

records.title: Identification of common hub genes in gastrointestinal cancers and their role in prognosis and Immune cell infiltration in hepatocellular carcinoma
records.model: Six gastrointestinal-cancer datasets and HCC validation cohorts; preprint
records.note: BUB1B was a shared hub but final HCC model used CCNB1/MAD2L1/BUB1; reduced interferon signatures in high risk were observational, not treatment-rescue evidence.

records.title: Identification of hub genes involved in the occurrence and development of hepatocellular carcinoma via bioinformatics analysis.
records.model: HCC GEO/TCGA/Oncomine expression cohorts
records.note: BUB1B and UBE2C were elevated and independently associated with prognosis; multi-database agreement does not establish a pharmacologic intervention.

records.title: BubR1 insufficiency impairs angiogenesis in aging and in experimental critical limb ischemic mice.
records.model: BubR1L/- mice after hind-limb ischemia and hypoxic smooth-muscle siRNA cells
records.note: Low BubR1 reduced HIF1alpha/VEGF, blood-flow recovery and limb salvage after ischemia; a relevant tissue-repair mechanism but no angiogenic drug rescue is demonstrated.

records.title: BubR1 Promotes Bub3-Dependent APC/C Inhibition during Spindle Assembly Checkpoint Signaling.
records.model: BubR1 loop mutants and in-vitro MCC/APC-C assays
records.note: BubR1 loop mutants assembled MCC but poorly inhibited APC-C, showing Bub3 binding or MCC abundance alone is insufficient proof of functional checkpoint rescue.

records.title: ESPL1 is Elevated in Hepatocellular Carcinoma and Predicts Prognosis.
records.model: HCC/adjacent tissue sequencing, qPCR/IHC and TCGA
records.note: ESPL1 was independently prognostic and coexpressed with BUB1B and other mitotic genes; a combined high-expression group had greater mortality without drug intervention.

records.title: Upregulation of BUB1B, CCNB1, CDC7, CDC20, and MCM3 in Tumor Tissues Predicted Worse Overall Survival and Disease-Free Survival in Hepatocellular Carcinoma Patients.
records.model: HCC GEO and TCGA expression-survival datasets
records.note: BUB1B/CCNB1/CDC7/CDC20/MCM3 elevation tracked advanced grade, vascular invasion and worse outcomes; proposed targets were not pharmacologically tested.

records.title: Identifying Hub Genes Driving Glioblastoma Multiforme Progression through Transcriptomics: To Discover Potential Diagnostic and Therapeutic Targets
records.model: GBM low-grade/advanced expression networks; related preprint to PMID40168776
records.note: Another complete saved preprint repeats BUB1B-containing mitotic signature and inflammatory advanced-GBM hubs; no independent intervention or rescue result.

records.title: Transcriptomic landscape of quiescent and proliferating human corneal stromal fibroblasts.
records.model: Primary human corneal stromal fibroblasts
records.note: Serum-free versus serum-fed cultures differed in growth/ECM programs, with BUB1B among downregulated cycle genes in quiescence; serum conditions are not a specific rescue drug.

records.title: Identification of core genes for early diagnosis and the EMT modulation of ovarian serous cancer by bioinformatics perspective.
records.model: Ovarian serous carcinoma regulatory-network and survival analyses
records.note: BUB1B/NDC80 were EMT-linked early-stage risk hubs with inferred TFAP2A/miR655/ELF3 regulation; no direct RNA or pharmacologic rescue.

records.title: Identification of Differentially Expressed Genes (DEGs) Relevant to Prognosis of Ovarian Cancer by Use of Integrated Bioinformatics Analysis and Validation by Immunohistochemistry Assay.
records.model: Ovarian-cancer GEO datasets and tissue immunohistochemistry
records.note: BUB1B/KIF11/KIF20A associated with worse survival; BUB1B protein correlated with FIGO stage and differentiation, without treatment experiment.

records.title: Meiosis-specific functions of kinetochore protein SPC105R required for chromosome segregation in Drosophila oocytes
records.model: Drosophila SPC105R domain replacements; preprint of PMID38865189
records.note: Read full preprint including significance: SPC105R domains recruit BUBR1/cohesion machinery and regulate lateral attachments; no compound or tissue-rescue assay is described.

records.title: Upregulation of ASPM, BUB1B and SPDL1 in tumor tissues predicts poor survival in patients with pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
records.model: PDAC GEO/TCGA and tissue qPCR
records.note: ASPM/BUB1B/SPDL1 were elevated with advanced stage and poor survival; pathway enrichment and expression validation remain association evidence.

records.title: Integrated Bioinformatic Analysis Reveals the Gene Signatures, Epigenetic Roles, and Regulatory Networks in Endometriosis
records.model: Six endometriosis transcriptomic datasets; preprint of PMID39306912
records.note: Read complete preprint: fifteen hubs including BUB1B accompany ECM/p53/focal-adhesion and noncoding-RNA changes; no pharmacologic treatment tested.

records.title: Differentially expressed gene profile and relevant pathways of the inhibition of LAMP5 on MLL-rearranged leukemias
records.model: LAMP5-shRNA MLL-rearranged leukemia transcriptomes; preprint
records.note: LAMP5 knockdown changed lysosome/cell-cycle pathways and ten hubs including BUB1B; intervention is shRNA rather than an administered LAMP5 drug.

records.title: Interspecies transcriptome profiles of human T cell activation and liver inflammation in a xenogeneic graft-versus-host disease model.
records.model: Human-PBMC NSG GvHD mice; MED record matching AGR IND608907204
records.note: Full MED abstract confirms conditioning-associated hepatic injury and human T-cell BUB1B elevation; duplicate study source, not a treatment rescue.

records.title: Aristolochic acid I exposure triggers ovarian dysfunction by activating NLRP3 inflammasome and affecting mitochondrial homeostasis.
records.model: Exposed mice and ovarian/oocyte analyses
records.note: AAI reduced ovarian growth/follicle development and altered NLRP3/mitochondria with abnormal BubR1/spindles; an environmental toxicant injury study without rescue therapy.

records.title: Weighted Gene Correlation Network Analysis Applied to Identify the Immune Cell-related Hub Genes in ANCA Nephritis
records.model: ANCA-nephritis expression network; preprint
records.note: PBK/CEP55/CCNB1/BUB1B were elevated relative to normal tissue; short saved abstract reports only bioinformatic hub validation and speculative treatment relevance.

records.title: Mitotic control of cancer stem cells.
records.model: Commentary on cancer stem-cell mitotic dependency
records.note: Short abstract comments on kinetochore state creating a BUB1B dependency in cancer stem cells; no original drug administration or rescue experiment is described.

records.title: Dissecting the roles of human BUB1 in the spindle assembly checkpoint.
records.model: Human BUB1 domain/recruitment experiments
records.note: BUB1 ABBA/KEN-adjacent segment supported CDC20 recruitment and SAC despite dispensable BubR1/Bub3 recruitment in this assay; no administered corrective intervention.

records.title: Sirt2-BubR1 acetylation pathway mediates the effects of advanced maternal age on oocyte quality.
records.model: Aged mouse oocytes and Sirt2-depleted oocytes
records.note: BubR1-K243R expression partly rescued Sirt2-depleted meiosis and reduced aged-oocyte aneuploidy; Sirt2/BubR1 manipulations were genetic, with site/tissue-specific acetylation effects.

records.title: NudCD1 as a prognostic marker in colorectal cancer and its role in the upregulation of cellular spindle assembly checkpoint genes and LIS1 pathways.
records.model: 100 colorectal tumors and lentiviral NudCD1 overexpression in cancer lines
records.note: NudCD1 elevated BUBR1/MPS1/LIS1 and altered S-phase distribution without apoptosis change; high tumor expression associated poor survival, not restorative drug benefit.

records.title: Mutations in CEP57 cause mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome.
records.model: Exome-sequenced constitutional mosaic aneuploidy families
records.note: Biallelic CEP57 loss-of-function established another MVA cause via centrosome/microtubule functions; different causal gene and no treatment experiment.

records.title: Machine learning and bioinformatics analysis of diagnostic biomarkers associated with the occurrence and development of lung adenocarcinoma.
records.model: LUAD machine-learning expression model and qPCR
records.note: Random forest/LASSO selected BUB1B/CENPF/PLK1 with expression/ROC validation; no drug perturbation despite treatment-guidance framing.

records.title: The structural flexibility of MAD1 facilitates the assembly of the Mitotic Checkpoint Complex.
records.model: MAD1 hinge mutants, recombinant MCC assembly and cell signaling
records.note: MAD1 hinge flexibility enabled folded catalytic assembly of CDC20-MAD2 and SAC activity; mutation rescue demonstrates structural dependence without a therapeutic agent.

records.title: Combined BubR1 protein down-regulation and RASSF1A hypermethylation in Wilms tumors with diverse cytogenetic changes.
records.model: 25 Wilms tumors with cytogenetic/protein/methylation analyses
records.note: Aneuploid tumors often combined low BubR1 protein with RASSF1A methylation despite detectable BUB1B mRNA and no mutations; no demethylating or stabilizing treatment was tested.

records.title: Therapeutic role of 2-stearoxyphenethyl phosphocholine targeting microtubule dynamics and Wnt/β-catenin/EMT signaling in human colorectal cancer cells.
records.model: HT29/HCT116 colorectal cancer cells
records.note: stPEPC increased phospho-BUBR1/MCC-associated arrest and tubulin polymerization while reducing growth/invasion via Wnt/EMT changes; checkpoint activation accompanies tumor catastrophe, not rescue.

records.title: Exploring diverse programmed cell-death patterns to develop a novel gene signature for predicting the prognosis of lung adenocarcinoma patients.
records.model: LUAD nine-gene cell-death index and IHC/external cohorts
records.note: BUB1B was included in a validated prognostic signature; higher index associated immune infiltration, but no gene-targeted or pharmacologic cell-death intervention was administered.

records.title: A novel mutation in the N-terminal domain of Drosophila BubR1 affects the spindle assembly checkpoint function of BubR1.
records.model: Drosophila BubR1 KAN/KEN1 motif mutants
records.note: Novel KAN mutation accelerated mitosis and reduced kinetochore Fzy more than KEN1 mutation; motif-function mapping contains no drug rescue.

records.title: Next generation antimitotic β-carboline derivatives modulate microtubule dynamics and downregulate NF-κB, ERK 1/2 and phospho HSP 27.
records.model: A549 cells/spheroids and WI-38 fibroblasts
records.note: MJ-211 suppressed BubR1/Mad2 and several survival pathways, promoted apoptosis and reduced spheroid growth; lower normal-cell toxicity does not demonstrate restoration in deficient tissue.

records.title: Simvastatin activates the spindle assembly checkpoint and causes abnormal cell division by modifying small GTPases.
records.model: Synchronized and live-imaged dividing cells
records.note: Simvastatin increased kinetochore BubR1 and prolonged mitosis with misorientation/blebbing; Mps1 inhibition canceled delay, whereas cholesterol removal accelerated progression, arguing against interpreting SAC activation as rescue.

records.title: BUB-1 targets PP2A:B56 to regulate chromosome congression during meiosis I in <i>C. elegans</i> oocytes.
records.model: C. elegans oocyte PP2A/BUB-1 recruitment systems
records.note: BUB-1 LxxIxE motif recruits B56 for congression in a species whose BUBR1 ortholog lacks that motif; species-specific mechanistic finding without pharmacologic rescue.

records.title: Exploring the pathogenesis of colorectal carcinoma complicated with hepatocellular carcinoma via microarray data analysis.
records.model: CRC/HCC microarray overlap and PPI analysis
records.note: BUB1B was one of ten shared mitotic hubs; abstract contains an unrelated psoriasis/atherosclerosis methods phrase, and proposed common pathways lack therapeutic validation.

records.title: lncRNA CCAT1 is a biomarker for the proliferation and drug resistance of esophageal cancer via the miR-143/PLK1/BUBR1 axis.
records.model: ESCC cell lines and nude-mouse xenografts with CCAT1/miR143 manipulation
records.note: CCAT1 knockdown or miR143 expression reduced proliferation and cisplatin resistance via PLK1/BUBR1 axis; genetic sensitization of tumors is not healthy-tissue drug rescue.

records.title: Integrative Bioinformatics Analysis: Unraveling Variant Signatures and Single-Nucleotide Polymorphism Markers Associated with 5-FU-Based Chemotherapy Resistance in Colorectal Cancer Patients.
records.model: CRC chemotherapy responder/nonresponder datasets and SNP prediction
records.note: BUB1B contributed a candidate damaging SNP, but strongest prediction concerned CDK1 Val124Gly; no variant-specific drug experiment was performed and independent validation was requested.

records.title: Role of ubiquitylation of components of mitotic checkpoint complex in their dissociation from anaphase-promoting complex/cyclosome.
records.model: Recombinant MCC with Cdc20/BubR1 lysine mutants
records.note: Ubiquitylation of both BubR1 and Cdc20 aided MCC release, with mutant blockade slowing dissociation; biochemical stabilization alone does not prove productive tissue rescue.

records.title: Novel insights into the circadian modulation of lipid metabolism in chicken livers revealed by RNA sequencing and weighted gene co-expression network analysis.
records.model: Chicken embryonic liver under light-dark versus dark incubation
records.note: Light cycling restored rhythmic lipid profiles and BUB1B appeared among ten correlated hubs; environmental timing, not a drug or BUBR1 rescue treatment.

records.title: PARP12 regulates mouse oocyte meiotic maturation.
records.model: Parp12-depleted mouse oocytes
records.note: PARP12 depletion disrupted actin/spindles and raised aneuploidy with active BubR1 checkpoint; no PARP inhibitor or restorative compound was administered in abstract.

records.title: Germline mutations in the spindle assembly checkpoint genes BUB1 and BUB3 are risk factors for colorectal cancer.
records.model: 208 familial/early-onset CRC germline screens
records.note: BUB1/BUB3 variants or haploinsufficiency occurred in 2.9% with variegated aneuploidy; distinct genes and no therapeutic intervention.

records.title: BubR1 Insufficiency Results in Decreased Macrophage Proliferation and Attenuated Atherogenesis in Apolipoprotein E-Deficient Mice.
records.model: BubR1-low/ApoE-null mice, marrow transfers and macrophages
records.note: Low BubR1 reduced atherosclerosis via diminished macrophage proliferation, including marrow and nonmarrow contributions; opposite-direction genetic benefit is not restoration for deficient muscle.

records.title: Two functionally distinct kinetochore pools of BubR1 ensure accurate chromosome segregation.
records.model: Defined human BubR1/Bub3 recruitment mutants
records.note: Bub1-bound pool supports alignment while direct KNL1-MELT-bound pool supports MCC incorporation/SAC; localization amount alone can conflate two functions.

records.title: BubR1 Insufficiency Impairs Liver Regeneration in Aged Mice after Hepatectomy through Intercalated Disc Abnormality.
records.model: BubR1-low mice after partial hepatectomy and keratinocyte knockdown
records.note: Low BubR1 delayed liver recovery and caused necrosis/intercellular defects with failed DSC1 upregulation; no administered drug rescued regeneration.

records.title: Construction and investigation of a combined hypoxia and stemness index lncRNA-associated ceRNA regulatory network in lung adenocarcinoma.
records.model: LUAD hypoxia/stemness transcriptomic ceRNA models
records.note: BUB1B was a prognostic hub, while final proposed regulatory axis was AC079160.1-miR539-CENPF; computational stemness links are not therapeutic perturbation.

records.title: Overexpression of BUB1B contributes to progression of prostate cancer and predicts poor outcome in patients with prostate cancer.
records.model: Prostate cancer cells and clinical tissues
records.note: BUB1B overexpression increased growth/migration/invasion but depletion did not alter tested functions; high expression predicted biochemical recurrence rather than overall survival.

records.title: Inferring evolutionary trajectories from cross-sectional transcriptomic data to mirror lung adenocarcinoma progression.
records.model: Cross-sectional LUAD transcriptomic progression model
records.note: Trajectory linked BUB1B/BUB1/BUB3 overexpression, SAC disruption and progression; abstract emphasizes computational inference and cohort validation without a named drug treatment.

records.title: Mosaic variegated aneuploidy without microcephaly: implications for cytogenetic diagnosis.
records.model: BUB1B-negative female MVA case with hypotonia and obesity
records.note: Expanded blood karyotyping identified multiple rare trisomies despite normal skin fibroblasts and no BUB1B variant; diagnostic lesson, not drug efficacy.

records.title: Identification of hub genes associated with follicle development in multiple births sheep by WGCNA.
records.model: Sheep ovarian transcriptomes across estrous stages
records.note: BUB1B was among seven follicle-development hubs within cycle/PI3K/oocyte pathways; no hormone or other therapeutic intervention is described.

records.title: BUB1 Is Essential for the Viability of Human Cells in which the Spindle Assembly Checkpoint Is Compromised.
records.model: MAD1/MAD2-deficient human HAP1 synthetic-lethal screens
records.note: SAC-deficient HAP1 cells required BUB1/congression but not BUBR1, underscoring cell-context dependence without showing a rescue drug.

records.title: <i>CCNB1</i> may as a biomarker for the adipogenic differentiation of adipose-derived stem cells in the postoperative fat transplantation of breast cancer.
records.model: Adipose-derived stem-cell differentiation datasets and qPCR
records.note: BUB1B was among ten downregulated cycle hubs during adipogenesis; experimental validation focused early CCNB1 change, with no defined drug-mediated fat or muscle rescue.

records.title: Screening and identification of key biomarkers and related transcription factors in ovarian cancer by integrated bioinformatics analysis
records.model: Ovarian-cancer microarrays and biomarker databases; preprint related to PMID34794761
records.note: Read full preprint: BUB1B among mitotic hubs linked poor survival, with TF associations and differential expression; no administered inhibitor or rescue study.

records.title: The kinetochore proteins CENP-E and CENP-F directly and specifically interact with distinct BUB mitotic checkpoint Ser/Thr kinases.
records.model: Metazoan kinetochore cells and biochemical reconstitution
records.note: Direct BubR1-CENP-E versus Bub1-CENP-F interactions require coiled coils/kinase domains; this study found BubR1 dispensable for CENP-E localization, a context difference from later papers.

records.title: Overexpression of BUBR1 is associated with chromosomal instability in bladder cancer.
records.model: 104 human urothelial bladder carcinomas
records.note: BUBR1 overexpression correlated with CIN, centrosome amplification and progression despite rare copy-number changes; no pharmacologic checkpoint manipulation was performed.

records.title: BubR1 is a spindle assembly checkpoint protein regulating meiotic cell cycle progression of mouse oocyte.
records.model: Mouse oocytes with BubR1 overexpression/depletion and spindle challenge
records.note: Exogenous BubR1 overexpression arrested maturation, while depletion accelerated meiosis and overrode nocodazole arrest with misalignment; supports testing productive outcomes beyond protein increase.

records.title: Identification and verification of potential biomarkers in sertoli cell-only syndrome via bioinformatics analysis.
records.model: Sertoli-cell-only syndrome microarrays/single-cell data and clinical samples
records.note: Six cell-cycle hubs including BUB1B were reduced; authors explicitly distinguish biomarkers from proven pathogenesis, important where cell-composition loss could drive expression.

records.title: Identification of key molecular players and associated pathways in cervical squamous cell carcinoma progression through network analysis.
records.model: Cervical squamous carcinoma DEG/network analyses
records.note: BUB1B was among seven central/vulnerable nodes but not four statistically prognostic genes; no compound was administered in the network study.

records.title: Tracking footprints of artificial and natural selection signatures in breeding and non-breeding cats.
records.model: Genotyped stray/household/Siamese/Oriental cats
records.note: BUB1B lay in a stray-cat selected region associated historically with reproduction/lifespan; this is population-genetic selection, not a longevity intervention experiment.

records.title: TCF21/POD-1, a Transcritional Regulator of SF-1/NR5A1, as a Potential Prognosis Marker in Adult and Pediatric Adrenocortical Tumors.
records.model: Adult and pediatric adrenocortical tumors
records.note: TCF21 inversely correlated with BUB1B in adult tumors but expression patterns differed in childhood; proposed score needs validation and no rescue therapy was evaluated.

records.title: Identifying of biomarkers associated with gastric cancer based on 11 topological analysis methods of CytoHubba.
records.model: Gastric-cancer GEO expression and multi-algorithm PPI/survival analysis
records.note: BUB1B was one of seven statistically supported hubs after eleven topology methods; cellular senescence enrichment is not evidence for administered senolytics.

records.title: The Genetic Association Identified Between Intervertebral Disc Degeneration and Associated Risk Factors Based on a Systems Biology Approach.
records.model: IDD/risk-factor transcriptomic systems biology
records.note: Dexamethasone, nicotine and resveratrol were gene-chemical network suggestions around BUB1/BUB1B/CCNB1; abstract reports no dosing, functional rescue or disease-specific efficacy.

records.title: CDK1, CCNB1, CDC20, BUB1, MAD2L1, MCM3, BUB1B, MCM2, and RFC4 May Be Potential Therapeutic Targets for Hepatocellular Carcinoma Using Integrated Bioinformatic Analysis.
records.model: HCC integrated GEO/TCGA databases and qPCR
records.note: Nine hubs including BUB1B were upregulated and survival-associated, with inferred MYBL2/KDM5B/MYC/SOX2/E2F4 regulation; no drug or genetic rescue experiment.

records.title: Bioinformatics analysis to identify breast cancer-related potential targets and candidate small molecule drugs.
records.model: Breast cancer cells after database drug nomination
records.note: Fostamatinib experimentally inhibited growth and G2/M progression and lowered MELK/AURKA/NEK2; BUB1B was a network hub, not demonstrated rescued protein.

records.title: Genetic association of CCL18 and EGF genes elevate the risk of breast cancer
records.model: Breast-cancer CCL18/EGF expression/network analysis; preprint
records.note: BUB1B entered a ZWINT interaction list within an otherwise CCL18/EGF analysis, with inconsistent reported list count; neither growth factor was administered as treatment.

records.title: Connections between sister and non-sister telomeres of segregating chromatids maintain euploidy.
records.model: Drosophila neuronal stem-cell anaphase imaging
records.note: DNA damage stabilized telomeric threads recruiting BubR1/Polo/AuroraB/BAF to retain lagging fragments; rescue is endogenous mechanical behavior, not drug treatment.

records.title: Identification of key genes associated with cell cycle in ER+ breast cancer by bioinformatic analysis
records.model: ER-positive breast-cancer public expression datasets; preprint
records.note: Ten cell-cycle hubs including BUB1B associated shorter relapse-free survival; pathway overlap nominates targets without administered therapeutic evidence.

records.title: PP2A-B56 isoform specificity at the centromere and kinetochore
records.model: PP2A-B56 isoform chimeras/site mutants; ETH thesis record
records.note: Read all truncated saved text and the complete official Dundee abstract: isoform-specific BubR1/Sgo2 affinity and holoenzyme assembly regulate PP2A localization. The abstract continuation gap is resolved; no drug result is reported there. The thesis manuscript remains unreviewed.

supplemental_primary_check.scope: Complete official institutional abstract read; thesis manuscript not read
supplemental_primary_check.result: Continuation states holoenzyme assembly is needed for centromeric accumulation and interferes with B56alpha kinetochore accumulation, with a PP2AC post-translational modification model. No drug result in completed abstract. Saved-source truncation remains documented; continuation gap resolved for abstract only.

records.integration_correction: Root rechecked the official institutional abstract after the independent integration audit; main note now reflects the already documented supplemental recovery.

records.title: Kinetochore recruitment of CENP-F illustrates how paralog divergence shapes kinetochore composition and function
records.model: Kinetochore proteins and biochemical reconstitution; preprint of PMID29748388
records.note: Read complete preprint: direct BubR1-CENP-E/Bub1-CENP-F axes have paralogous determinants, while BubR1 was dispensable for CENP-E localization in these assays.

records.title: Crystal structure of a PP2A B56-BubR1 complex and its implications for PP2A substrate recruitment and localization.
records.model: Crystal structure/biochemistry of PP2A-B56-BubR1
records.note: BubR1 LxxIxE binds a B56 groove distant from catalytic and shugoshin interfaces; structure informs localization rather than showing pharmacologic activation or rescue.

records.title: Kinesin-7 CENP-E is essential for chromosome alignment and spindle assembly of mouse spermatocytes.
records.model: Mouse spermatocytes and GC-2 spd cells with inhibitor/siRNA
records.note: CENP-E inhibition/depletion disrupted BubR1 recruitment, alignment and spindles and induced arrest; no protective drug outcome is described.

records.title: Integrative analyses of noncoding RNAs reveal the potential mechanisms augmenting tumor malignancy in lung adenocarcinoma.
records.model: LUAD lines, orthotopic lung models and chemotherapy cohort
records.note: PTTG3P upregulation enhanced viability under chemotherapy and tumor growth through FOXM1-BUB1B; genetic cancer resistance is not healthy-cell restorative pharmacology.

records.title: Transcription of the human cell cycle regulated BUB1B gene requires hStaf/ZNF143.
records.model: Human BUB1B promoter reporters and transcription-factor binding assays
records.note: Two ZNF143 sites support promoter activity and CDE/CHR motifs regulate G2/M expression; mapped transcription control without testing a drug upregulator.

records.title: PIGN spatiotemporally regulates the spindle assembly checkpoint proteins in leukemia transformation and progression.
records.model: Leukemia patient cells and cell lines with PIGN perturbation
records.note: PIGN loss dysregulated MAD1/MAD2/BUBR1/MPS1 and impaired arrest; PIGN overexpression restored MAD2 expression, not an administered BUBR1-rescue drug.

records.title: Therapeutic role of 2-stearoxyphenethyl phosphocholine targeting microtubule dynamics and Wnt/β-catenin/EMT signaling in human colorectal cancer cells
records.model: HT29/HCT116 CRC cells; preprint of PMID37926298
records.note: Full preprint confirms phospho-BUBR1-associated mitotic accumulation, tumor-cell apoptosis and reduced Wnt/EMT signaling; duplicate oncology evidence, not tissue rescue.

records.title: Signaling protein abundance modulates the strength of the spindle assembly checkpoint.
records.model: Human mitotic cells with Bub1 abundance manipulation
records.note: Bub1 overexpression increased BubR1 recruitment and delayed anaphase; competition between kinetochores explains signal strength, without demonstrated drug-mediated chromosome or tissue repair.

records.title: Aneuploid abortion correlates positively with MAD1 overexpression and miR-125b down-regulation.
records.model: Aneuploid versus euploid miscarriage villi
records.note: MAD1 rose as miR125b fell and BUB3 transcript/protein differed; BUBR1 overexpression rescue is cited background, not an experiment performed in this abstract.

records.title: Germline Missense Variants in CDC20 Result in Aberrant Mitotic Progression and Familial Cancer.
records.model: Familial CDC20 variants, HeLa/patient fibroblasts and N331K mice
records.note: CDC20 L151R/N331K impaired BubR1 binding while retaining APC-C activation, causing slippage and accelerated Myc cancer; no pharmacologic correction described.

records.title: BubR1 Acts as a Promoter in Cellular Motility of Human Oral Squamous Cancer Cells through Regulating MMP-2 and MMP-9.
records.model: OSCC lines compared with normal oral cells
records.note: BubR1 knockdown reduced invasion and MMP2/9 with little proliferation effect; cancer motility dependency does not constitute restoration of BUBR1-deficient tissue.

records.title: BUBR1 Insufficiency in Mice Increases their Sensitivity to Oxidative Stress.
records.model: BubR1L/L and WT mice given 2 g/L KBrO3 for 16 weeks
records.note: Low BubR1 increased mortality and proliferative splenic abnormalities after oxidant exposure; establishes susceptibility but no antioxidant rescue treatment was tested.

records.title: Phylogenomics-guided discovery of a novel conserved cassette of short linear motifs in BubR1 essential for the spindle checkpoint
records.model: Bub1/BubR1 comparative genomics and human ABBA motif deletions; preprint
records.note: ABBA1-KEN2-ABBA2 cassette conservation led to deletion experiments that abolished SAC/APC-C interactions; no compound was administered.

records.title: Phylogenomics-guided discovery of a novel conserved cassette of short linear motifs in BubR1 essential for the spindle checkpoint.
records.model: Comparative phylogenomics and human BubR1 motif mutagenesis
records.note: Published study corroborates ABBA motifs flanking KEN2 as essential for SAC and APC-C-Cdc20 binding; same evidence family as preprint without a drug rescue result.

records.title: Retrospective Analysis of Prognostic Factors in Pediatric Patients with Adrenocortical Tumor from Unique Tertiary Center with Long-Term Follow-Up.
records.model: 95 pediatric adrenocortical tumor patients in retrospective cohort
records.note: BUB1B-PINK1 expression difference joined age/stage/hormone/histology markers of malignancy; proposed adjuvant treatment was not a named tested rescue regimen.

records.title: Exploration of the regulatory mechanism for hepatocellular carcinoma based on ceRNA networks analysis and immune infiltration
records.model: HCC TCGA ceRNA/immune networks; preprint
records.note: Lower BUB1B/NDC80 expression associated longer survival and immune-cell correlations; ceRNA risk-model performance does not demonstrate administered therapy.

records.title: Haplo-insufficiency of both BubR1 and SGO1 accelerates cellular senescence.
records.model: Primary MEFs singly/doubly haploinsufficient for BubR1 and SGO1
records.note: Double deficiency increased senescence morphology/beta-gal and p21 but not p16; genetic lesion study without senolytic or restorative treatment.

records.title: Genetic Inhibition of sFRP3 Prevents Glial Reactivity in a Mouse Model of Accelerated Aging.
records.model: BubR1H/H;sfrp3 double-mutant mice
records.note: sFRP3 genetic inhibition reduced astrogliosis and microglial activation in hypomorphic mice; reinforces FRZB route but does not establish a drug, motor endpoint or muscle rescue.

records.title: Uncoupling of the spindle-checkpoint and chromosome-congression functions of BubR1.
records.model: Human BubR1 phosphorylation/KEN/GLEBS motif mutants
records.note: Five phosphosite mutations disrupted attachments while sparing SAC, and KEN mutations impaired SAC while sparing congression; mechanistic reason to require both functional readouts.

records.title: Identification of Differentially Expressed Genes Associated with the Prognosis and Diagnosis of Hepatocellular Carcinoma by Integrated Bioinformatics Analysis.
records.model: 81 HCC and 10 control GEO samples with network/database analysis
records.note: BUB1B appeared among ten central mitotic genes; NCAPG/NDC80 were highlighted as novel and molecular therapy remains a future proposal.

records.title: The E2F activators control multiple mitotic regulators and maintain genomic integrity through Sgo1 and BubR1.
records.model: E2F-overexpressing MCF10A cells, Sgo1/BubR1 silencing and breast-cancer datasets
records.note: Combined E2Fs elevated mitotic regulators without added centrosome amplification; BubR1 knockdown caused chromosome loss and Sgo1 knockdown additional damage, with no drug rescue.

records.title: ESPL is elevated in Hepatocellular Carcinoma and Predicts Prognosis
records.model: HCC ESPL1 sequencing/qPCR and TCGA; preprint of PMID36465268
records.note: Read full preprint: ESPL1/BUB1B-containing coexpression panel associated mortality and ESPL1 immune infiltration, extending association but not treatment evidence.

records.title: The progeroid gene BubR1 regulates axon myelination and motor function.
records.model: BubR1H/H mouse brain/spinal cord and motor testing
records.note: Low BubR1 reduced oligodendrocyte progenitors, myelin genes and CNS myelination alongside strength/coordination/balance deficits; motor impairment need not be exclusively muscle-intrinsic.

records.title: Division of labour between PP2A-B56 isoforms at the centromere and kinetochore.
records.model: PP2A-B56 isoform chimeras and mitotic localization
records.note: Distinct B56 isoforms use Sgo2 or BubR1/LxxIxE binding, with Sgo1 contributing both sites; C-terminal-loop mapping supports specificity without administering a PP2A drug.

records.title: Screening of the Key Genes for the Progression of Liver Cirrhosis to Hepatocellular Carcinoma Based on Bioinformatics.
records.model: Cirrhosis versus HCC GEO and validation analyses
records.note: BUB1B was among six elevated hubs distinguishing HCC and correlating with immune infiltration; no treatment reversing cirrhosis or promoting healthy regeneration was tested.

records.title: Comprehensive analysis of differentially expressed genes associated with PLK1 in bladder cancer.
records.model: PLK1-siRNA T24 bladder cancer cells and tissue correlations
records.note: PLK1 knockdown lowered BUB1B and other cycle genes while reducing proliferation/invasion; intervention is siRNA, not a pharmacologic rescue of MVA.

records.title: BubR1 localizes to centrosomes and suppresses centrosome amplification via regulating Plk1 activity in interphase cells.
records.model: PCS/MVA patient cells and interphase BubR1-Plk1 assays
records.note: Plk1 knockdown suppressed centrosome amplification in patient cells with elevated Plk1 activity; concrete same-disease cellular rescue warrants drug-translation follow-up, without claiming an administered inhibitor.

supplemental_primary_check.scope: Publisher abstract/landing page read; manuscript subscription-gated
supplemental_primary_check.result: Confirms Plk1 knockdown suppresses PCS patient-cell centrosome amplification; no named chemical rescue in available abstract. Full text remains needed.

records.title: Glioma Subtypes Based on the Activity Changes of Immunologic and Hallmark Gene Sets in Cancer.
records.model: Glioma TCGA/GEO gene-set subtype analysis
records.note: BUB1B was one of fourteen mitotic genes associated with subtype/prognosis; GSVA classes and immune gene sets did not test therapeutic administration.

records.title: Comparative transcriptomics analysis identifies crucial genes and pathways during goose spleen development.
records.model: Landes and Sichuan White goose spleens across ages
records.note: BUB1B/BUB1/TTK were inferred age-dependent spleen hubs, distinct from breed-associated neural receptor genes; no administered agent or BUBR1 rescue result.

records.title: Female meiosis II and pronuclear fusion require the microtubule transport factor Bicaudal D.
records.model: Drosophila eggs; C. elegans pronuclear fusion
records.note: Acute BicD degradation disrupted female meiosis-II products, SAC-component localization and pronuclear fusion; the cross-species transport mechanism is genetic, with no rescue drug described.

records.title: Identification of a Prognostic Model Based on 2-Gene Signature and Analysis of Corresponding Tumor Microenvironment in Alcohol-Related Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
records.model: Alcohol-related HCC transcriptomic cohorts
records.note: TCGA/GEO analysis selected BUB1B and CENPF for a two-gene poor-prognosis model and compared immune microenvironments; no administered therapy was tested in the abstract.

records.title: Utilizing Bioinformatics Process to Compare the Single-Cell Sequencing Results of Normal and Ascending Thoracic Aortic Aneurysm Tissue Samples to Obtain Key Genes from Holistic Level
records.model: Human ascending thoracic aortic aneurysm single-cell datasets
records.note: A computational conversion and differential-expression workflow identified BUB1B among downregulated ATAA hub genes and smooth-muscle genes among upregulated hubs; proposed medical targeting was not tested.

records.title: Bub3-BubR1-dependent sequestration of Cdc20Fizzy at DNA breaks facilitates the correct segregation of broken chromosomes.
records.model: Mitotic broken-chromosome segregation model
records.note: Bub3 binding recruits BubR1 to broken chromosomes and its KEN box sequesters Cdc20, locally inhibiting APC/C; a mechanistic fidelity result without a stated administered rescue.

records.title: Kinetochore-catalyzed MCC formation: A structural perspective.
records.model: SAC/MCC structural literature
records.note: Reviews the kinetochore scaffold, Mps1 phosphorylation and Mad2 conformational conversion that accelerate MCC formation; it does not report a new drug intervention.

records.title: The Mechanism of Quercetin in the Treatment of Lung Squamous Cell Carcinoma Based on a Protein-Protein Interaction Network.
records.model: Lung squamous carcinoma cells; TCGA and docking
records.note: Quercetin inhibited cancer proliferation, migration, invasion and cell-cycle progression; BUB1B was a computationally shortlisted target, while the reported protein validation was PLK1 downregulation.

records.title: Identification Cure Hub Genes of Chromophobe Cell Renal Carcinoma : A study based on Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis (WGCNA) and the Cure Defective Models
records.model: Renal carcinoma expression and survival datasets; preprint
records.note: WGCNA plus defective-Gompertz/Cox models associated BUB1B and other hubs with survival; high-expression cure associations are observational, not demonstrated therapeutic gene activation.

records.title: Spindle and Kinetochore-Associated Complex Is Associated With Poor Prognosis in Adrenocortical Carcinoma.
records.model: Adrenocortical carcinoma public datasets
records.note: SKA-subunit overexpression correlated with poor prognosis; BUB1B appeared among interacting differential-expression hubs, without experimental pharmacology.

records.title: Role of Intrinsic and Extrinsic Factors in the Regulation of the Mitotic Checkpoint Kinase Bub1.
records.model: Purified Bub1/BubR1 domains and Bub3 complexes
records.note: BubR1 bound nucleotides without detectable catalytic activity in vitro; Bub1 was an active autonomously regulated kinase and 1:1 Bub3 complexes could form a heterotetramer.

records.title: A new enrichment approach for candidate gene detection in unexplained recurrent pregnancy loss and implantation failure.
records.model: 35 women with unexplained recurrent pregnancy loss/implantation failure
records.note: Exome analysis nominated 43 variants in 39 genes and modeled BUB1B structure; future personalized therapies were proposed rather than administered.

records.title: Aneuploid Abortion Positively Correlate With MAD1 Overexpression and mir125b Depression
records.model: Aneuploid versus euploid miscarriage villi; preprint
records.note: Aneuploid villi had lower miR125b and BUB3 RNA and higher MAD1 RNA/protein; the BUBR1 overexpression benefit is background literature, not the intervention tested here.

records.title: Multiple pools of Protein Phosphatase 2A-B56 function to antagonize spindle assembly, promote kinetochore attachments and maintain cohesion in Drosophila Oocytes
records.model: Drosophila acentrosomal oocytes; PP2A-subunit knockdowns
records.note: Aurora-B inhibition showed continuous kinase activity is needed for spindle maintenance; B56 genetic depletion impaired cohesion and attachments. This mixed drug/genetic experiment does not establish BUBR1 rescue.

records.title: BubR1 insufficiency inhibits neointimal hyperplasia through impaired vascular smooth muscle cell proliferation in mice.
records.model: BubR1 L/L mice, carotid ligation, vascular smooth-muscle cells
records.outcome_direction: reduced pathological hyperplasia with proliferation impairment
records.note: BubR1 at 20% suppressed neointimal hyperplasia through delayed VSMC S-phase entry; reciprocal p38/BubR1 inhibition lowered expression. This antiproliferative vascular result is not restored muscle regeneration.

records.title: Juxtaposition of Bub1 and Cdc20 on phosphorylated Mad1 during catalytic mitotic checkpoint complex assembly.
records.model: MCC scaffold biochemical/structural assays
records.note: Mps1-phosphorylated Mad1 juxtaposes Bub1 and Cdc20 to place the Cdc20 motif near open Mad2 and accelerate MCC assembly; no therapeutic intervention is reported.

records.title: Functional and Structural Characterization of Bub3·BubR1 Interactions Required for Spindle Assembly Checkpoint Signaling in Human Cells.
records.model: Human cancer cells and purified Bub3-BubR1 complexes
records.note: Bub3 knockdown and disruption of its high-affinity BubR1 interaction abolished checkpoint activity and induced apoptosis; identified binding hotspots support cancer inhibition, not BUBR1-deficiency rescue.

records.title: Bioinformatics analysis shows that TOP2A functions as a key candidate gene in the progression of cervical cancer.
records.model: Cervical cancer microarray datasets
records.note: TOP2A was the survival-associated hub and correlated with BUB1B expression; naming BUB1B as a diagnostic/treatment target was computational nomination without tested therapy.

records.title: A molecular basis for the differential roles of Bub1 and BubR1 in the spindle assembly checkpoint.
records.model: Engineered BubR1 and kinetochore/SAC assays
records.note: Grafting a Bub1 motif enabled Bub1-independent BubR1 recruitment but failed to sustain a functional checkpoint; direct Bub1-BubR1 heterodimerization explains distinct roles.

records.title: BubR1 kinase: protection against aneuploidy and premature aging.
records.model: BubR1 checkpoint and aging literature
records.note: Summarizes BubR1 interactions protecting chromosome fidelity, non-SAC functions and aging mouse models, with anticancer targeting discussed as a prospect.

records.title: Overexpression of Fbxo6 inactivates spindle checkpoint by interacting with Mad2 and BubR1.
records.model: Fbxo6-overexpressing HeLa cells
records.note: Fbxo6 overexpression accelerated escape from nocodazole arrest and produced binuclear/multilobed cells with reduced viability through Mad2/BubR1 interaction; nocodazole is the challenge agent.

records.title: Kinesin KIF15 regulates tubulin acetylation and spindle assembly checkpoint in mouse oocyte meiosis.
records.model: Mouse oocytes
records.note: KIF15 depletion/inhibition destabilized K-fibers and increased misalignment/aneuploidy; recruitment of HDAC6, NAT10 and SIRT2 controlled tubulin acetylation. No SIRT2 drug rescue is stated.

records.title: Clinicopathologic significance of BubR1 and Mad2 overexpression in oral cancer.
records.model: OSCC cell lines and 65 patient tumors
records.note: BubR1/Mad2 were overexpressed despite attenuated checkpoint activity; BubR1 associated with advanced disease and shorter survival, highlighting abundance versus function.

records.title: Network module function enrichment analysis of lung squamous cell carcinoma and lung adenocarcinoma.
records.model: Lung squamous and adenocarcinoma expression networks
records.note: Weighted modules linked clinical traits to hub genes; higher BUB1B, BUB1, TTK and UBE2C expression correlated with lower survival without a drug test.

records.title: Evaluation of the TRIP13 level in breast cancer and insights into potential molecular pathways.
records.model: Breast cancer cells, patient data and 4T1 mouse metastases
records.note: TRIP13 suppression inhibited proliferation/migration and related PI3K-AKT-mTOR genes; BUB1B was a network hub, not a demonstrated restoration intervention.

records.title: Twist1 induces chromosomal instability (CIN) in colorectal cancer cells.
records.model: Twist1-overexpressing colorectal cancer cells and TCGA
records.note: Twist1 overexpression lowered checkpoint factors including BubR1 and increased chromosomal copy-number changes, mitotic abnormalities and DNA breaks; RACIPE associations complement the genetic perturbation.

records.title: Six potential biomarkers for bladder cancer: key proteins in cell-cycle division and apoptosis pathways.
records.model: Bladder cancer expression datasets and Human Protein Atlas
records.note: Network analysis connected CCNB1, BUB1B and AURKB; six candidate biomarkers were proposed for future wet-lab evaluation, with no administered rescue.

records.title: LGG subtypes based on the activity changes of immunologic and hallmark gene sets in cancer
records.model: Low-grade glioma TCGA/GSEA cohorts; preprint
records.note: GSVA defined three LGG subtypes and nominated 17 core genes including BUB1B from survival/enrichment analyses; treatment utility remains proposed.

records.title: BUB1B promotes multiple myeloma cell proliferation through CDC20/CCNB axis.
records.model: Multiple myeloma patient subgroups and cells
records.note: Higher BUB1B promoted myeloma proliferation and correlated with CDC20/CCNB1/2; the abstract supports cancer targeting rather than healthy-tissue restoration.

records.title: Microcephaly is not mandatory for the diagnosis of mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome.
records.model: Single MVA syndrome patient
records.note: An MVA case without microcephaly had growth/developmental delay and mosaic trisomies in lymphocytes/fibroblasts without premature centromere division; no treatment response is described.

records.title: Mitotic Checkpoint Regulators Control Insulin Signaling and Metabolic Homeostasis.
records.model: p31-comet knockout mice and hepatocytes
