records.note: BUBR1 depletion or MAD2-binding-deficient insulin receptor suppressed metabolic consequences of p31-comet ablation by altering receptor endocytosis; this is genetic insulin regulation, not a pharmacologic MVA rescue.

records.title: Identification of crucial genes associated with lung adenocarcinoma by bioinformatic analysis.
records.model: LUAD GEO datasets and tissue immunohistochemistry
records.note: BUB1B was one of ten computational hubs and nine adverse-survival genes; wet-lab validation concerned UBE2C expression, not a BUB1B intervention.

records.title: Mouse oocytes depend on BubR1 for proper chromosome segregation but not for prophase I arrest.
records.model: Conditional BubR1-knockout mouse oocytes
records.note: Knockout separated BubR1 requirements for sustained SAC, meiosis-I timing and robust kinetochore attachments from dispensability for prophase-I arrest; no administered age-related rescue is described.

records.title: Spatiotemporal coordination of the RSF1-PLK1-Aurora B cascade establishes mitotic signaling platforms.
records.model: Mitotic centromere/kinetochore signaling and structural modeling
records.note: RSF1-recruited PLK1 activates Aurora B at Thr236, then spatial repositioning stops activation and phosphorylates BubR1; the feedback explains attachment control without a therapeutic result.

records.title: Identification of novel candidate genes and predicted miRNAs in atopic dermatitis patients by bioinformatic methods.
records.model: 571 atopic-dermatitis/healthy skin samples from nine datasets
records.note: BUB1B was one of four cell-cycle-pathway candidates among 225 overlapping DEGs; miRNA-target networks require the explicitly requested future experimental verification.

records.title: Demystifying the Role of Prognostic Biomarkers in Breast Cancer through Integrated Transcriptome and Pathway Enrichment Analyses.
records.model: Breast cancer TCGA transcriptomes and methylation/mutation analyses
records.note: Elevated BUB1B and four other hubs associated with poor overall survival and hypomethylation; chromosomal-instability interpretation does not constitute a drug experiment.

records.title: Transcriptome Profiling of HCT-116 Colorectal Cancer Cells with RNA Sequencing Reveals Novel Targets for Polyphenol Nano Curcumin.
records.model: HCT-116 colorectal cancer cells
records.note: Gemini-Cur caused cytotoxicity/apoptosis and altered cell-cycle transcripts; BUB1B was a central gene with PCR/protein modulation confirmed, but the abstract does not specify its direction or any nonmalignant rescue.

records.title: Screening of significant biomarkers with poor prognosis in hepatocellular carcinoma via bioinformatics analysis.
records.model: Hepatocellular carcinoma GEO and survival datasets
records.note: CCNB1, CDK1, RRM2 and BUB1B overexpression associated with poor HCC survival; p53/cell-cycle enrichment is computational target nomination.

records.title: Division of labour between different PP2A-B56 complexes during mitosis
records.model: PP2A-B56 isoform chimeras during mitosis; preprint
records.note: B56 C-terminal-loop chimeras mapped centromere versus kinetochore specificity through Sgo2 versus BubR1/LxxIxE interactions; no pharmacological rescue is reported.

records.title: Predictive and prognostic values of BubR1 and synuclein-gamma expression in breast cancer.
records.model: 55 taxane-treated breast cancer patients, retrospective tissue study
records.note: Low BubR1 expression had borderline correlation with greater taxane sensitivity, while high SNCG predicted lower sensitivity; the study measures tumor response rather than restoration of deficient tissues.

records.title: A novel HDAC6 inhibitor interferes microtubule dynamics and spindle assembly checkpoint and sensitizes cisplatin-induced apoptosis in castration-resistant prostate cancer.
records.model: CRPC PC-3 and DU-145 cells
records.note: 25202 inhibited HDAC6, disturbed microtubules and prolonged SAC arrest with BUBR1 phosphorylation; cisplatin sensitization accompanied impaired DNA repair, not chromosome-fidelity rescue.

records.title: Wilms tumor, AML and medulloblastoma in a child with cancer prone syndrome of total premature chromatid separation and Fanconi anemia.
records.model: Child with Fanconi anemia/chromosomal instability and three malignancies
records.note: Reports Wilms tumor, AML and medulloblastoma in a child with premature chromatid separation; MVA is contextual prior literature, and no therapeutic rescue outcome is given.

records.title: Discovery of Novel Agents on Spindle Assembly Checkpoint to Sensitize Vinorelbine-Induced Mitotic Cell Death Against Human Non-Small Cell Lung Cancers.
records.model: NSCLC NCI-H460 and A549 cells
records.note: YL-9, a sildenafil-related low-PDE5-activity compound, amplified vinorelbine-induced spindle abnormalities, BUBR1 phosphorylation/cleavage, arrest and apoptosis; structural similarity does not transfer efficacy to sildenafil.

records.title: Germline Missense Variants in CDC20 Result in Aberrant Mitotic Progression and Familial Cancer
records.model: Familial CDC20 variants, HeLa/patient fibroblasts and engineered mice; preprint
records.note: CDC20 L151R/N331K retained APC/C activation but bound BUBR1 less, increasing slippage; heterozygous N331K accelerated Myc-driven tumors, without drug testing.

records.title: A case report of a fetus with mosaic autosomal variegated aneuploidies and literature review.
records.model: Prenatal MVA case with repeat amniocentesis
records.note: Repeated amniocytes showed premature chromatid separation and variable autosomal gains/losses; ultrasound identified small head and vermis defect, with no intervention study.

records.title: Nivalenol affects Cyclin B1 level and activates SAC for cell cycle progression in mouse oocyte meiosis.
records.model: Mouse oocytes exposed to mycotoxin
records.note: Nivalenol lowered Cyclin B1, destabilized microtubules and sustained MAD2/BUBR1 kinetochore activation with metaphase-I arrest; SAC activation reflects toxic disruption.

records.title: Aberrations of BUBR1 and TP53 gene mutually associated with chromosomal instability in human colorectal cancer.
records.model: 139 colorectal cancer cases
records.note: High BUBR1 expression co-occurred with TP53 mutation and stronger aneuploidy but less MSI; this observational interaction does not establish a therapeutic direction.

records.title: Identification of key candidate genes and pathways in anaplastic thyroid cancer by bioinformatics analysis.
records.model: Anaplastic thyroid carcinoma datasets and three cell lines
records.note: Seven network hubs including BUB1B were expression-validated by qRT-PCR in ATC lines; pathway enrichment and target suggestions are not treatment tests.

records.title: Rare germline variants in pancreatic cancer and multiple primary cancers: an autopsy study.
records.model: 189 Japanese autopsy cases with targeted germline sequencing
records.note: BUB1B was among genes with pathogenic/likely pathogenic cancer-associated variants; the principal VUS associations involved MMR/POLQ and no rescue intervention was assessed.

records.title: Identifying a Three-Gene Signature and Associated Drugs for Hepatitis B Virus-Related Hepatocellular Carcinoma Using Comprehensive Bioinformatics Analysis.
records.model: HBV-related HCC GEO and drug-target databases
records.note: BUB1B was a hub, while fostamatinib was only database-predicted against CDK1; no fostamatinib administration or BUB1B restoration is reported.

records.title: Tumor relevant protein functional interactions identified using bipartite graph analyses.
records.model: Pan-cancer expression/functional-association networks across 18 cancers
records.note: Bipartite centrality highlighted upregulated BUB1B among cell-cycle genes and downregulated muscle-related proteins; network integration provided no drug efficacy experiment.

records.title: Generation of Centromere-Associated Protein-E CENP-E-/- Knockout Cell Lines using the CRISPR/Cas9 System.
records.model: CRISPR CENP-E-null HeLa cells
records.note: CENP-E deletion produced chromosome misalignment and abnormal BubR1 localization; the cell line is proposed for inhibitor specificity/toxicity testing without a named rescue result.

records.title: Identification of potential crucial genes and molecular mechanisms in glioblastoma multiforme by bioinformatics analysis.
records.model: GBM TCGA datasets and qRT-PCR validation
records.note: BUB1B was one of five candidate hubs; survival significance was reported for CENPA, and no pharmacological intervention was tested.

records.title: SIRT2 induces the checkpoint kinase BubR1 to increase lifespan.
records.model: Wild-type aging mice and SIRT2-overexpressing BubR1 H/H mice
records.outcome_direction: drug-associated abundance increase; genetic lifespan extension
records.note: NMN administration increased BubR1 abundance in vivo; lifespan extension in BubR1 H/H animals belonged to SIRT2 overexpression. The abstract cannot assign the genetic survival result to NMN or niacin.

records.title: Immunohistochemical expression of budding uninhibited by benzimidazole related 1 in leukoplakia and oral squamous cell carcinoma.
records.model: 30 specimens each of normal mucosa, oral leukoplakia and OSCC
records.note: BUBR1 immunostaining increased with dysplasia and tumor grade; a proposed prognostic indicator rather than drug rescue.

records.title: Fabrication and characterization of photosensitive non-isocyanate polyurethane acrylate resin for 3D printing of customized biocompatible orthopedic surgical guides.
records.model: Bone/muscle cell compatibility and implant models for orthopedic resin
records.note: NIPUA resin was less inflammatory/cytotoxic than commercial resins; BUB1b upregulation came from exposed bone-cell transcriptomics, not a systemic therapeutic or BUB1B-deficiency muscle intervention.

records.title: High-dose metformin induces a low-glucose dependent genotoxic stress.
records.model: Cancer lines, NCM460 and HUVECs under varying glucose
records.note: Metformin at 1–16 mM induced SAC-associated genome damage and suppressed cancer growth; noncancer toxicity depended on glucose, with reduced high-glucose genotoxicity in HUVECs. No deficient-BUBR1 rescue was tested.

records.title: Deacetylation of the mitotic checkpoint protein BubR1 at lysine 250 by SIRT2 and subsequent effects on BubR1 degradation during the prometaphase/anaphase transition.
records.model: SIRT2 knockdown and BubR1 biochemical/cell assays
records.note: SIRT2 deacetylated BubR1 K250, but knockdown-associated acetylation did not appreciably raise total BubR1 or delay prometaphase/anaphase transition; this differs from the K668 stabilization mechanism.

records.title: Loss of Centromere Cohesion in Aneuploid Human Oocytes Correlates with Decreased Kinetochore Localization of the Sac Proteins Bub1 and Bubr1.
records.model: Human donor oocytes across ages
records.note: Older oocytes showed weaker centromere cohesion and lower kinetochore BUB1/BUBR1; MPS1-dependent localization supports active SAC biology but no administered age-reversal treatment is described.

records.title: Insufficient HtrA2 causes meiotic defects in aging germinal vesicle oocytes.
records.model: Young and aged mouse germinal-vesicle oocytes
records.note: HtrA2 knockdown activated BubR1-positive SAC and disrupted spindle/chromosomes; HtrA2 overexpression partly restored organization and lowered aneuploidy in aged oocytes. A genetic proteostasis lead without a drug implementation.

records.title: Pellino 1 inactivates mitotic spindle checkpoint by targeting BubR1 for ubiquitinational degradation.
records.model: Pellino-1 expression in vitro and in vivo
records.note: Pellino 1 bound BubR1 and promoted ubiquitination-mediated degradation, allowing mitotic adaptation and aneuploidy; targeting this E3 is a hypothesis, with no inhibitor rescue in the abstract.

records.title: Bimodal activation of BubR1 by Bub3 sustains mitotic checkpoint signaling.
records.model: Reconstituted and cell-based MCC assays
records.note: Bub3 supported both kinetochore Cdc20 recruitment and cytoplasmic Mad2-primed BubR1-Cdc20 binding, producing selective APC/C inhibition; no therapeutic agent was tested.

records.title: PP2A-B56γ is required for an efficient spindle assembly checkpoint.
records.model: Primary B56-gamma-deficient cells
records.note: Loss of PP2A-B56gamma destabilized BubR1 during nocodazole arrest, permitting aberrant segregation; isoform-specific phosphatase activity is protective genetically, without a pharmacological rescue.

records.title: BUB-1 targets PP2A:B56 to regulate chromosome congression during meiosis I in C. elegans oocytes
records.model: C. elegans oocytes; preprint
records.note: BUB-1 recruits PPTR-1/2 through a phosphorylated LxxIxE motif and kinase-domain-dependent mechanism; worm BUBR1 lacks the B56-binding domain, limiting direct mammalian transfer.

records.title: Insufficient HtrA2 causes meiotic defects by inducing cytoskeletal disorganization in aging germinal vesicle oocytes
records.model: Aged and young mouse GV oocytes; preprint
records.note: HtrA2 overexpression partially rescued aged-oocyte spindle organization and aneuploidy, while knockdown increased BubR1 kinetochore retention; overlaps the journal study PMID 36539842 and is not independent drug evidence.

records.title: SPDL1 Overexpression Is Associated With the 18F-FDG PET/CT Metabolic Parameters, Prognosis, and Progression of Esophageal Cancer.
records.model: Esophageal cancer cohorts, 53 PET/CT patients and cell assays
records.note: SPDL1 silencing inhibited cancer growth/migration; BUB1B was a correlated network hub, and FDG supplied diagnostic imaging rather than therapy.

records.title: Pediatric T-ALL type-1 and type-2 relapses develop along distinct pathways of clonal evolution.
records.model: 38 paired pediatric T-ALL diagnosis/relapse samples
records.note: Type-2 relapses arose from minor ancestral clones with predisposition variants and hypermutator phenotypes including BUB1B/PMS2; no named drug rescue is tested.

records.title: PIGN Spatiotemporally Regulates the Spindle Assembly Checkpoint Proteins in Myelodysplastic Syndromes
records.model: Leukemic patient cells and cell lines; preprint
records.outcome_direction: checkpoint disruption and genetic protein restoration
records.note: PIGN loss dysregulated MAD1/MAD2/BUBR1/MPS1 and impaired checkpoint activation; ectopic PIGN restored MAD2 expression, not demonstrated BUB1B-MVA drug rescue.

records.title: Screening and identification of key biomarker in osteoarthritis and rheumatoid arthritis: Evidence from microarray analysis
records.model: OA/RA synovial microarray datasets; preprint
records.note: BUB1B was a proposed hub target among inflammatory synovial DEGs and predicted miRNA relationships; no intervention was administered.

records.title: Overexpression of SKA Complex Is Associated With Poor Prognosis in Gliomas.
records.model: Glioma public expression/prognosis databases
records.note: SKA1/SKA3 and ten interacting hubs including BUB1B were elevated and associated with poorer prognosis; no causal treatment result is provided.

records.title: Variegated-like mosaicism and ring syndrome in a r(4) boy. Appraisal of 38 patients with a fairly complete ring 4.
records.model: Ring-chromosome-4 boy and review of 38 cases
records.note: Dynamic ring-4 mosaicism resembled MVA but lacked its reported cancer pattern; colchicine was a laboratory culture condition, not treatment of growth failure.

records.title: Bioinformatics Analysis Highlight Differentially Expressed CCNB1 and PLK1 Genes as Potential Anti-Breast Cancer Drug Targets and Prognostic Markers.
records.model: Breast cancer TCGA and validation databases
records.note: BUB1B was among PPI hubs, while CCNB1/PLK1 were emphasized for adverse survival and potential drug targeting; no drug was tested.

records.title: Identification of biomarkers and pathways of mouse embryonic fibroblasts with the dysfunction of mitochondrial DNA
records.model: YME1L-deleted mouse embryonic fibroblast dataset; preprint
records.note: mtDNA dysfunction altered metabolism/immune pathways and implicated BUB1B among interacting genes; L1000fwd predicted unnamed regulators without administration.

records.title: Signaling protein abundance modulates the strength of the Spindle Assembly Checkpoint
records.model: Human kinetochore protein-expression perturbations; preprint
records.note: Bub1 overexpression increased Bub1/BubR1 kinetochore recruitment and prolonged anaphase delay; competition for limited SAC proteins explains signal scaling, without a drug or muscle assay.

records.title: FOXM1 repression increases mitotic death upon antimitotic chemotherapy through BMF upregulation.
records.model: Cancer cells under antimitotic chemotherapy
records.note: FOXM1 repression increased BMF and death in mitosis through a shared regulatory region influencing BUB1B oppositely; improved chemotherapy killing is not tissue rescue.

records.title: Transcriptome-wide N6-methyladenine methylation in granulosa cells of women with decreased ovarian reserve.
records.model: Granulosa cells from younger and older women
records.note: Older granulosa cells had more m6A-modified genes; BUB1B was among expression/methylation candidates validated by qRT-PCR, with fertility treatment only proposed.

records.title: Analysis of the role of GSK3 in the mitotic checkpoint.
records.model: Spindle-toxin-arrested cells; GSK3beta knockout/RNAi
records.note: Three GSK3 inhibitors relieved toxin-induced arrest; GSK3 loss reduced kinetochore BubR1/Mad2/Bub1 and MCC assembly. WNT/PI3K inhibition prolonged Taxol arrest, so LiCl cannot be assumed checkpoint-restorative.

records.title: The Identification of Key Genes and Biological Pathways in Heart Failure by Integrated Bioinformatics Analysis.
records.model: Heart-failure GSE21610 expression data
records.note: BUB1B was among five PPI hubs after DEG/pathway analysis; peroxisome/cAMP findings are biomarkers rather than intervention evidence.

records.title: Prediction of drug candidates for clear cell renal cell carcinoma using a systems biology-based drug repositioning approach.
records.model: ccRCC patient signatures and human kidney/cancer cell assays
records.note: Computational repositioning selected drugs against BUB1B/RRM2/ASF1B/CCNB2 and in-vitro treatment lowered target protein and viability; the abstract omits drug identities, requiring full text for agent accounting, not rescue promotion.

records.title: Evaluation of the Spindle Assembly Checkpoint Integrity in Mouse Oocytes.
records.model: Mouse oocyte SAC-assay protocol
records.note: Combines nocodazole-induced depolymerization, Securin-destruction kinetics and MAD2 recruitment to assess checkpoint integrity; a useful functional-assay reference, not a therapeutic result.

records.title: Screening of Key Prognosis Genes of Lung Adenocarcinoma Based on Expression Analysis on TCGA Database.
records.model: LUAD TCGA/GEPIA datasets
records.note: Ten hubs including BUB1B were overexpressed and related to survival; the enrichment/network analysis provides no drug experiment.

records.title: Cancer predisposition genes in Japanese children with rhabdomyosarcoma.
records.model: 20 Japanese children with rhabdomyosarcoma
records.note: Targeted sequencing found BUB1B among predisposition variants; reported drug-induced cardiomyopathy concerned LIG4 carriers and unnamed treatments, not BUB1B muscle rescue.

records.title: RSF1 in cancer: interactions and functions.
records.model: RSF1 cancer and chromosome-stability literature
records.note: Reviews optimal-level protective RSF1 versus overexpression-related resistance/checkpoint inhibition and interactions including BubR1; inhibitor use remains prospective.

records.title: Demystifying the role of prognostic biomarkers in breast cancer through integrated transcriptome and pathway enrichment analyses
records.model: Breast cancer TCGA analysis; preprint
records.note: Five elevated hubs including BUB1B were associated with poor survival and hypomethylation; apparent preprint counterpart of PMID 36980449, not a second intervention study.

records.title: Construction and validation of a joint diagnosis model based on random forest and artificial intelligence network for hepatitis B-related hepatocellular carcinoma.
records.model: HBV-HCC GEO cohorts and machine-learning validation
records.note: Nine genes including BUB1B formed an RF/ANN classifier with reported independent-dataset sensitivity/specificity; immune-infiltration analysis is descriptive, without treatment testing.

records.title: Septin 9 controls CCNB1 stabilization via APC/C<sup>CDC20</sup> during meiotic metaphase I/anaphase I transition in mouse oocytes.
records.model: Septin-9 siRNA/mRNA-injected mouse oocytes
records.note: Septin-9 depletion retained Mad1/BubR1 at kinetochores and prevented CCNB1 loss; Septin-9 or CDC20 mRNA partially rescued MI arrest, not demonstrated corrected segregation or drug rescue.

records.title: Identification of Key Pathways and Genes in SARS-CoV-2 Infecting Human Intestines by Bioinformatics Analysis.
records.model: SARS-CoV-2-infected intestinal gene-expression dataset
records.note: BUB1B was among nine validated computational hub genes from 24-/60-hour infection profiles; proposed digestive-disease targets were not pharmacologically tested.

records.title: An Inhibitor of PIDDosome Formation.
records.model: DNA-damage/ionizing-radiation cell models
records.note: The PIDDosome inhibitor in the title is endogenous BubR1, which competes with RAIDD and delays PIDD-dependent apoptosis; no small-molecule inhibitor is described.

records.title: Identification of Hub Genes and Their Correlation With Immune Infiltration Cells in Hepatocellular Carcinoma Based on GEO and TCGA Databases.
records.model: HCC GEO/TCGA datasets
records.note: Fourteen upregulated hubs including BUB1B associated with shorter survival and immune-cell fractions; KIF2C/UBE2C were emphasized, without intervention results.

records.title: The E3 ubiquitin ligase HECTD1 contributes to cell proliferation through an effect on mitosis.
records.model: HECTD1 knockdown/knockout HEK293T and HeLa cells
records.note: HECTD1 loss prolonged mitosis and reduced SAC activity despite unchanged BUB3/BUBR1/MAD2 abundance, with BUB3 identified as an interactor; no rescue pharmacology.

records.title: Vascular Cell Senescence Contributes to Blood-Brain Barrier Breakdown.
records.model: Senescent BBB co-culture and BubR1 H/H mice
records.note: Senescent vascular cells and BubR1 H/H mice showed poor tight-junction coverage and barrier leakage despite intact astrocyte end-foot coverage; tracers were readouts, not senolytic treatment.

records.title: Identification of RRM2 as Novel Potential Sero-Diagnostic Marker for Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
records.model: NSCLC datasets and patient serum; preprint
records.note: BUB1B appeared in the hub network but experimental serum validation and diagnostic combinations concerned RRM2/CEA/NSE, not a therapeutic intervention.

records.title: The Cdc20-binding Phe box of the spindle checkpoint protein BubR1 maintains the mitotic checkpoint complex during mitosis.
records.model: BubR1 motif mutants in human mitotic cells
records.outcome_direction: MCC maintenance defect with retained checkpoint
records.note: Removing BubR1 D/Phe boxes impaired MCC maintenance but still supported checkpoint function, showing biochemical complex abundance and checkpoint output are separable.

records.title: Juxtaposition of Bub1 and Cdc20 on phosphorylated Mad1 during catalytic mitotic checkpoint complex assembly
records.model: MCC structural/biochemical assays; preprint
records.note: Phosphorylated Mad1 positions Bub1/Cdc20 and Mad2 for catalytic conversion; the preprint additionally describes Cdc20 MIM sufficiency and overlaps journal PMID 36289199.

records.title: Role of phosphatases in the end-on conversion process
records.model: Kinetochore phosphatases in end-on attachment; thesis
records.note: All saved text was read, but the stored abstract explicitly ends '(continues)' after reporting an essential role for BubR1-recruited PP2A-B56; the full thesis/abstract is a source-completeness gap.

records.title: Bioinformatic analysis of key pathways and genes shared between endometriosis and ovarian cancer.
records.model: Endometriosis/ovarian cancer expression cohorts
records.note: Shared DEGs implicated p53-pathway deactivation; BUB1B and five hubs associated with poorer ovarian-cancer survival without treatment testing.

records.title: Prognostic Prediction Using a Stemness Index-Related Signature in a Cohort of Gastric Cancer.
records.model: Gastric cancer stemness/transcriptomic cohorts
records.note: WGCNA found 17 stemness-associated genes and a nine-gene prognostic model containing BUB1B; inhibition of stemness is proposed, not an administered-drug result.

records.title: Heat shock-induced mitotic arrest requires heat shock protein 105 for the activation of spindle assembly checkpoint.
records.model: Heat-shocked and Hsp105-knockdown cells
records.note: Hsp105 knockdown reduced BubR1 localization, increased lagging chromosomes and reduced Taxol sensitivity; endogenous chaperone support does not demonstrate pharmacological HSP induction rescue.

records.title: Peloruside A, a microtubule-stabilizing agent, induces aneuploidy in ovarian cancer cells.
records.model: 1A9 ovarian carcinoma cells
records.note: Low 40 nM peloruside A caused polar chromosomes and early checkpoint-protein dissociation compared with 100 nM, inducing aneuploidy without obligatory G2/M block; microtubule stabilization was not fidelity rescue.

records.title: NUP62 is required for the maintenance of the spindle assembly checkpoint and chromosomal stability.
records.model: Human cells and neural stem cells; NUP62 Q391P
records.note: NUP62 loss or pathogenic Q391P impaired SAC and induced neural-stem-cell aneuploidy despite retained kinetochore checkpoint proteins; nocodazole was an assay challenge.

records.title: Stranglehold on the spindle assembly checkpoint: the human papillomavirus E2 protein provokes BUBR1-dependent aneuploidy.
records.model: HPV18 E2-expressing cells
records.note: E2 interaction with MCC caused DNA breaks/aneuploidy, and BUBR1 silencing rescued its mitotic phenotype; this context-specific suppression cannot justify reducing deficient BUBR1 in MVA.

records.title: Detection of immune-related cells and genes in the glioma tumor microenvironment from the CGGA database using bioinformatics strategies
records.model: Glioma CGGA immune-expression analysis; preprint
records.note: BUB1B/NCAPH were associated with macrophage-M0 infiltration and claimed anti-PD1 response; methods are bioinformatic and do not establish administered BUB1B-directed rescue.

records.title: Gene Expression Analysis Reveals Key Genes and Signalings Associated with the Prognosis of Prostate Cancer.
records.model: Prostate cancer datasets and cell-line expression validation
records.note: Twelve cell-cycle regulators including BUB1B were elevated and correlated with shorter disease-free survival; targeting pathways was a proposal.

records.title: Bioinformatic analysis revealing mitotic spindle assembly regulated NDC80 and MAD2L1 as prognostic biomarkers in non-small cell lung cancer development.
records.model: NSCLC GEO/TCGA cohorts
records.note: BUB1B correlated with three other checkpoint genes, but multivariate independent predictors were NDC80 in LUAD and MAD2L1 in LUSC; authors call for experiments before drug-target use.

records.title: PP2A-B56 opposes Mps1 phosphorylation of Knl1 and thereby promotes spindle assembly checkpoint silencing.
records.model: Mammalian SAC cell and biochemical assays
records.note: BubR1-associated PP2A-B56 removes Mps1-dependent Knl1 phosphorylation to silence SAC, expanding its role beyond antagonizing Aurora B; no therapeutic administration is described.

records.title: Comparative transcriptome analysis identified crucial genes and pathways affecting sperm motility in the reproductive tract of drakes with different libido.
records.model: Drakes with differing libido; reproductive-tract RNA sequencing
records.note: Higher-libido drakes had better sperm motility and distinct tissue pathways; BUB1B/ESPL1 were epididymal cell-cycle hubs, without pharmacological manipulation.

records.title: Identification of biomarkers and candidate regulators for multiple myeloma under the knockout of AURKA
records.model: AURKA-knockout multiple-myeloma dataset; preprint
records.note: Analysis of a genetic AURKA-knockout dataset identified BUB1B-related pathways and unnamed L1000fwd regulator predictions; background mention of AURKA inhibitors is not a new treatment experiment.

records.title: LMO7 exerts an effect on mitosis progression and the spindle assembly checkpoint.
records.model: Human LMO7/LIM-domain overexpression cells
records.note: Excess LMO7, an Emery-Dreifuss-related regulator, disrupted MAD2/BUBR1 recruitment; its isolated LIM peptide also prolonged mitosis and impaired congression. Muscular-dystrophy relevance is background, not measured muscle rescue.

records.title: Bioinformatic Analysis Revealing Mitotic Spindle Assembly regulated NDC80 and MAD2L1 as Prognostic Biomarkers in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer Development
records.model: NSCLC GEO/TCGA datasets; preprint
records.note: BUB1B was among four correlated checkpoint genes; independent predictors were NDC80 and MAD2L1, matching journal PMID 32795325 rather than an independent treatment study.

records.title: Increased expression of the spindle checkpoint protein BubR1 is associated with high cell proliferation in primary gastrointestinal diffuse large B cell lymphoma.
records.model: 20 primary GI diffuse large B-cell lymphomas
records.note: BubR1 staining correlated with Ki-67 but not survival, H. pylori or BCL6 rearrangement; no therapeutic perturbation was performed.

records.title: Identification of the driving mechanisms associated with aggressive transformation and prognosis in follicular lymphomas
records.model: Follicular/transformed lymphoma expression databases; preprint
records.note: Ten hubs included BUB1B, but CDK1/RRM2/AURKA were the emphasized transformation markers; drug regulatory networks are predictions without administered-agent evidence.

records.title: The internal Cdc20 binding site in BubR1 facilitates both spindle assembly checkpoint signalling and silencing.
records.model: BubR1 internal Cdc20-binding-domain deletion assays
records.note: Deleting IC20BD reduced Cdc20 kinetochore localization yet only modestly altered SAC because the same domain promotes MCC disassembly and checkpoint silencing.

records.title: Systems Biology and Bioinformatics approach to Identify blood based signatures molecules and drug targets of patient with COVID-19.
records.model: COVID-19 PBMC RNA-seq/microarray datasets
records.note: Three datasets shared 102 DEGs; BUB1B was one of ten nominated hubs for diagnosis/therapy development, without a therapeutic test.

records.title: SKA1/2/3 is a biomarker of poor prognosis in human hepatocellular carcinoma.
records.model: HCC public expression/clinical databases
records.note: SKA1-3 and interacting hubs including BUB1B were increased and prognostically adverse; inferred Fanconi/homologous-repair pathways do not establish intervention effects.

records.title: [Screening of cell cycle-related genes regulated by KIAA0101 in gastric cancer].
records.model: Gastric cancer and paired adjacent tissue expression analyses
records.note: KIAA0101 expression covaried with cell-cycle genes; qRT-PCR confirmed higher BUB1B/MAD2L/CDK1/CCNE1/CCNB2, but the reported workflow is not drug rescue.

records.title: The PP2A<sup>B56</sup> phosphatase promotes the association of Cdc20 with APC/C in mitosis.
records.model: B56-depleted mitotic cells and APC/C biochemistry
records.note: B56 depletion delayed APC/C activation through impaired Cdc20 association rather than increased MCC; the assembly-promoting role was independent of BubR1 binding.

records.title: Oncoprotein YAP regulates the spindle checkpoint activation in a mitotic phosphorylation-dependent manner through up-regulation of BubR1.
records.model: YAP expression/phosphorylation cell models
records.note: Active YAP increased BubR1-dependent checkpoint hyperactivation and mitotic defects; BubR1 knockdown relieved this oncogenic context. More BubR1 alone did not imply better fidelity.

records.title: Co---expression analysis to identify core regulatory genes of colon cancer stem cells
records.model: Colon adenocarcinoma stemness networks; preprint
records.note: Nine coexpression hubs including BUB1B were elevated across tumors; suppression as a stem-cell therapy was proposed without experimental pharmacology.

records.title: Three BUB1 and BUBR1/MAD3-related spindle assembly checkpoint proteins are required for accurate mitosis in Arabidopsis.
records.model: Arabidopsis SAC protein interaction and double-knockout plants
records.note: mad3.1/mad3.2 loss produced misalignment, lagging chromosomes and micronuclei; BUBR1-related proteins interact with MAP65-3 to support plant chromosome attachment. RETRACTED: notice PMID 27874987 (batch index 236) reports edited/duplicated figures undermining yeast-two-hybrid evidence; do not treat as reliable support.

records.title: Identification and Validation of Hub Genes with Poor Prognosis in Hepatocellular Carcinoma by Integrated Bioinformatical Analysis.
records.model: HCC GEO/TCGA expression and survival cohorts
records.note: Eight survival-linked hubs included BUB1B and drug-metabolism genes; enrichment in xenobiotic metabolism is not evidence of administered therapeutic rescue.

records.title: Gene markers of fracture healing in early stage and the regulatory mechanism during the process using microarray analysis.
records.model: Three fractured versus three unfractured samples in GSE45156
records.note: Bub1b/Plk1 were upregulated network hubs during early fracture healing; the authors explicitly require experimental validation, with no drug-mediated regeneration shown.

records.title: Relationship between the deep features of the full-scan pathological map of mucinous gastric carcinoma and related genes based on deep learning
records.model: Mucinous gastric carcinoma TCGA histology/genomics
records.note: VGG16-derived image features correlated with 24 disease-related hubs including BUB1B; classification/correlation analysis supplies no therapeutic experiment.

records.title: A novel in vitro model of sarcopenia using BubR1 hypomorphic C2C12 myoblasts.
records.model: BubR1-shRNA C2C12 myoblasts (C2C12BKD)
records.note: BubR1 knockdown reduced myotube fusion, MyoD and myogenin while increasing Atrogin-1/MuRF-1; directly relevant muscle assay model, but no administered rescue was tested in the saved abstract.

records.title: Identification of candidate biomarkers correlated with poor prognosis of breast cancer based on bioinformatics analysis.
records.model: Breast cancer GEO expression and survival datasets
records.note: Twelve hubs included BUB1B and eleven associated with prognosis; cell-cycle/p53 enrichment adds biomarker hypotheses without intervention evidence.

records.title: The Effect of Phototherapy on Cancer Predisposition Genes of Diabetic and Normal Human Skin Fibroblasts.
records.model: Normal and diabetic human fibroblasts exposed to LED light
records.note: Red/green/blue LED exposure at 0.67 J/cm2 altered cancer-predisposition transcripts including BUB1B; no protein, checkpoint, muscle or disease-rescue outcome was established.

records.title: Child with mosaic variegated aneuploidy and embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma.
records.model: Seven-year-old MVA patient with embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma
records.note: Serial somatic/tumor cytogenetics supported MVA and possible malignancy risk; the abstract describes surveillance implications without a treatment outcome.

records.title: Polo-Like Kinase 1 Regulates Chromosomal Instability and Paclitaxel Resistance in Breast Cancer Cells.
records.model: Breast cancer cells and mouse xenografts
records.note: PLK1 knockdown lowered BubR1/Mad2, produced multipolar spindles and sensitized tumors to paclitaxel; greater tumor killing came with destabilized mitosis.

records.title: Exploration of the Common Gene Characteristics and Molecular Mechanism of Parkinson's Disease and Crohn's Disease from Transcriptome Data.
records.model: Parkinson/Crohn disease expression cohorts
records.note: BUB1B was among 12 shared hubs from 178 DEGs; independent clinical-severity associations concerned LYN/RAF1, with no treatment experiment.

records.title: Identification of FoxM1/Bub1b signaling pathway as a required component for growth and survival of rhabdomyosarcoma.
records.model: Rhabdomyosarcoma cells and xenografts
records.note: Bub1b shRNA regressed established tumors; FoxM1 shRNA or siomycin A lowered Bub1b and tumor-cell growth/survival. This muscle-lineage cancer result is not nonmalignant muscle restoration.

records.title: Increased expression of BubR1 protects against aneuploidy and cancer and extends healthy lifespan.
records.model: BubR1-overexpressing transgenic mice, including oncogenic Ras contexts
records.note: Sustained BubR1 expression corrected checkpoint and attachment defects, reduced tumors/aneuploidy and extended healthy lifespan; the result is a transgene benchmark, not efficacy of a named drug.

records.title: The Origin of Stroma Influences the Biological Characteristics of Oral Squamous Cell Carcinoma.
records.model: Gingival/periodontal stromal cells with OSCC in vitro/in vivo
records.note: Both stromal sources promoted OSCC growth/invasion and reduced differentiation; BUB1B was nominated by expression analysis, without an administered molecular rescue agent.

records.title: Proper chromosome alignment depends on BRCA2 phosphorylation by PLK1.
records.model: BRCA2 S206C/T207A variants and mitotic protein complexes
records.note: Disrupting PLK1 docking on BRCA2 altered its PP2A/phospho-BUBR1 complex, impairing attachments and segregation; the findings define a BRCA2 mechanism without drug rescue.

records.title: Contribution of BubR1 to oxidative stress-induced aneuploidy in p53-deficient cells.
records.model: MRC5 fibroblasts with p53 knockdown and gastric tumor specimens
records.note: KBrO3 suppressed BubR1/Mad2 when p53 was functional; in p53-depleted cells, BubR1 knockdown reduced oxidant-induced polyploidization. This context-specific damage response is not MVA restoration.

records.title: Differentially Expressed Genes in Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma Tissues and Their Correlation with Recurrence and Metastasis of Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma.
records.model: Nasopharyngeal carcinoma primary/metastasis GEO datasets
records.note: BUB1B was a cell-cycle PPI hub, whereas VRK2 was the cross-dataset metastasis candidate; no pharmacologic intervention is reported.

records.title: Evaluation of clinical value and potential mechanism of MTFR2 in lung adenocarcinoma via bioinformatics.
records.model: LUAD MTFR2 coexpression/clinical datasets
records.note: MTFR2 and ten correlated cell-cycle genes including BUB1B were increased and associated with poor outcome; pathway involvement is inferred from enrichment.

records.title: Screening Hub Genes as Prognostic Biomarkers of Hepatocellular Carcinoma by Bioinformatics Analysis.
records.model: HCC GEO expression and survival analyses
records.note: Fifteen upregulated hubs including BUB1B associated with lower survival; authors explicitly request in-vivo/in-vitro verification of the computational findings.

records.title: Direct binding between BubR1 and B56-PP2A phosphatase complexes regulate mitotic progression.
records.model: BubR1 B56-binding/phosphorylation mutants
records.outcome_direction: attachment defect after lost phosphatase recruitment
records.note: Mutations around BubR1 S670 disrupted B56 binding, metaphase alignment and progression; Cdk1/Plk1 phosphorylation facilitated B56 recruitment, without administered rescue evidence.

records.title: Endocrine Disrupting Chemicals Influence Hub Genes Associated with Aggressive Prostate Cancer.
records.model: Prostate-cancer microarrays and toxicogenomic databases
records.note: Seventeen EDCs were inferred from CTD relationships with transcription factors; BUB1B was a downregulated hub, but no chemical exposure experiment was performed here.

records.title: Abnormal expression of the mitotic checkpoint protein BubR1 contributes             to the anti-microtubule drug resistance of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma             cells.
records.model: Esophageal squamous cancer tissues and cells
records.note: BubR1 overexpression increased paclitaxel resistance while RNAi restored sensitivity; the drug endpoint is tumor killing, not preservation of deficient normal tissue.

records.title: Identification of potential crucial genes and key pathways shared in Inflammatory Bowel Disease and cervical cancer by machine learning and integrated bioinformatics.
records.model: IBD/cervical cancer GEO/TCGA machine-learning analyses
records.note: Ten classifier hubs included BUB1B and a gene-drug database identified seven unnamed compounds; there is no reported administered efficacy experiment.

records.title: Loss of BubR1 acetylation causes defects in spindle assembly checkpoint signaling and promotes tumor formation.
records.model: BubR1 K243R/+ mice and embryonic fibroblasts
records.note: Acetylation-deficient BubR1 degraded prematurely, destabilized MCC and reduced B56alpha binding, combining weak SAC and attachment defects; nocodazole was a test condition.

records.title: In silico spatial simulations reveal that MCC formation and excess BubR1 are required for tight inhibition of the anaphase-promoting complex.
records.model: Spatial computational APC/C-regulation simulations
records.note: Only the model with both MCC and direct BubR1 inhibition reproduced wild-type and mutant behavior; the five inhibitors are modeled regulatory mechanisms, not five administered drugs.

records.title: Mapping Proximity Associations of Core Spindle Assembly Checkpoint Proteins.
records.model: BioID2 proteomics of mitotic SAC components
records.note: Proximity maps for five core SAC proteins recovered known complexes and identified an ELYS-MAD1L1 interaction; this is interaction mapping without a rescue intervention.

records.title: Construction and validation of a joint diagnosis model based on random forest and artificial intelligence network for hepatitis B-related hepatocellular carcinoma
records.model: HBV-HCC diagnostic expression models; preprint
records.note: Nine-gene RF/ANN model including BUB1B distinguished HBV-HCC and immune profiles; overlaps journal PMID 38482416 without new intervention evidence.

records.title: Mosaic variegated aneuploidy with growth hormone deficiency and congenital heart defects.
records.model: 12-year-old MVA boy with GH deficiency and cardiac defects
records.note: Subnormal GH-stimulation response accompanied short stature; clinical course suggested intrinsic growth-plate GH unresponsiveness. The abstract does not specify a therapeutic GH regimen or response, requiring primary clarification.

records.title: Sumoylated BubR1 plays an important role in chromosome segregation and mitotic timing.
records.model: BubR1 sumoylation mutants and mitotic cells
records.note: Trichostatin A reduced BubR1 sumoylation; sumoylation-deficient mutants remained on kinetochores and caused anaphase delay with premature chromatid separation. HDAC blockade is not uniformly beneficial BubR1 stabilization.

records.title: Dominantly Inherited Hereditary Nonpolyposis Colorectal Cancer Not Caused by MMR Genes.
records.model: Hereditary MMR-proficient nonpolyposis colorectal-cancer literature
records.note: BUB1B is among candidate predisposition genes with limited cumulative contributions; the review addresses missing heritability, not pharmacologic rescue.

records.title: CENP-E--dependent BubR1 autophosphorylation enhances chromosome alignment and the mitotic checkpoint.
records.model: CENP-E depletion and BubR1 phosphomimetic/nonphosphorylatable mutants
records.note: Phosphomimetic BubR1 reduced polar chromosomes after CENP-E depletion, while nonphosphorylatable replacement weakened checkpoint/alignment; rescue is engineered protein, not an administered kinase drug.

records.title: Female meiosis II and pronuclear fusion require Bicaudal-D
records.model: Drosophila eggs and C. elegans; preprint
records.note: BicD loss mislocalized spindle stabilizers and SAC proteins, allowing polar-body cell-cycle reentry and blocking pronuclear fusion; overlaps journal PMID 35723263.

records.title: Mad2 and BubR1 modulates tumourigenesis and paclitaxel response in MKN45 gastric cancer cells.
records.model: MKN45/ST2957 gastric cancer cells
records.note: Mad2/BubR1 silencing reduced malignant behavior but increased paclitaxel-treated cell survival and senescence-like traits without changed apoptotic markers; survival is not restored chromosome fidelity.

records.title: Identification of potential crucial genes in sarcopenia: a bioinformatic analysis
records.model: Sarcopenia GSE1428 expression data; preprint
records.note: BUB1B was one of ten hubs among 603 DEGs; skeletal-muscle relevance is observational and no drug, functional strength outcome or causal rescue was tested.

records.title: EZH2 is required for mouse oocyte meiotic maturation by interacting with and stabilizing spindle assembly checkpoint protein BubRI.
records.model: Mouse oocytes with EZH2 perturbation
records.outcome_direction: no maturation effect from catalytic inhibitors; genetic defects
records.note: EZH2 inhibitors did not alter meiotic maturation, whereas depletion or excess EZH2 caused abnormalities; BubR1 stabilization was a methyltransferase-independent protein interaction, not demonstrated drug rescue.

records.title: Identification of five hub genes as monitoring biomarkers for breast cancer metastasis in silico.
records.model: Breast cancer metastasis-expression cohorts
records.note: BUB1B was one of five hub biomarkers associated with distant metastasis-free survival; network and ROC validation did not test treatment.

records.title: High risk of malignancy in mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome.
records.model: Young MVA boy with myelodysplasia progressing to leukemia
records.note: A monosomy-7 marrow clone preceded acute lymphoblastic leukemia and death; comparison with reported MVA malignancies supports predisposition, without a therapeutic outcome.

records.title: Distinct domains in Bub1 localize RZZ and BubR1 to kinetochores to regulate the checkpoint.
records.model: Bub1 domain-deletion kinetochore assays
records.note: Separate Bub1 regions recruit RZZ and BubR1; deleting the BubR1-binding region increased checkpoint strength, demonstrating opposing signaling activities rather than a drug strategy.

records.title: Elevated BUBR1 expression is associated with poor survival in early breast cancer patients: 15-year follow-up analysis.
records.model: 98 stage-II breast cancers and 2422-patient expression database
records.note: Higher BubR1 protein and mRNA predicted poorer long-term outcomes; no intervention or normal-tissue restoration was assessed.

records.title: BUB1 and BUBR1 inhibition decreases proliferation and colony formation, and enhances radiation sensitivity in pediatric glioblastoma cells.
records.model: Pediatric SF188 glioblastoma cells with siRNA and radiation
records.note: BUB1/BUBR1 RNAi reduced growth/clonogenicity and increased micronuclei; TMZ/radiation combinations increased arrest, apoptosis and killing, not checkpoint rescue.

records.title: Integrated bioinformatics analysis for the screening of hub genes and therapeutic drugs in ovarian cancer.
records.model: Ovarian-cancer expression/survival and DGIdb databases
records.note: BUB1B was an adverse-progression hub; 62 small molecules were database-selected candidates, with no administered-agent experiment in the abstract.

records.title: Dependence of Human Colorectal Cells Lacking the FBW7 Tumor Suppressor on the Spindle Assembly Checkpoint.
records.model: FBW7-null versus wild-type colorectal cells
records.note: BUBR1/BUB1/MPS1 knockdown selectively harmed FBW7-null cells, increasing aneuploidy and p53; this is genetic cancer targeting rather than deficient-tissue rescue.

records.title: Catalytic assembly of the mitotic checkpoint inhibitor BubR1-Cdc20 by a Mad2-induced functional switch in Cdc20.
records.model: Biochemical MCC assembly/APC-C inhibition
records.note: Mad2-induced Cdc20 conformational change enabled BubR1 binding and catalytic amplification; BubR1 rather than Mad2 directly inhibited cyclin-B ubiquitination.

records.title: The ABBA motif binds APC/C activators and is shared by APC/C substrates and regulators.
records.model: APC/C regulator/substrate ABBA motif assays
records.note: Shared ABBA motifs bind CDC20; BubR1/Bub1 motifs support full SAC and recruitment, while cyclin-A competes for the same site. No administered rescue.

records.title: Lack of Diaph3 relaxes the spindle checkpoint causing the loss of neural progenitors.
records.model: Diaph3-deficient embryonic cortical progenitors
records.note: Diaph3 loss lowered BubR1 and weakened SAC, causing aneuploidy and depletion of neural progenitors; identifies a maintenance pathway without a pharmacological rescue.

records.title: Integrative genomics analysis of hub genes and their relationship with prognosis and signaling pathways in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.
records.model: ESCC GEO/TCGA cohorts and tissue staining
records.note: BUB1B was a hub among cell-cycle DEGs; survival significance involved EFNA1/COL4A1 and protein validation involved PTTG1, with no drug result.

records.title: Construction of Potential Gene Expression and Regulation Networks in Prostate Cancer Using Bioinformatics Tools.
records.model: Prostate cancer mRNA/miRNA databases
records.note: BUB1B was proposed as a biomarker from 4339 DEGs and miRNA-network construction; no administered therapy was examined.

records.title: Chromosomal instability syndrome of total premature chromatid separation with mosaic variegated aneuploidy is defective in mitotic-spindle checkpoint.
records.model: Skin fibroblasts from two infants with PCS/MVA
records.note: Colcemid failed to block mitosis and cells rereplicated to 8C without proper segregation/cytokinesis; the spindle inhibitor is a diagnostic challenge, not attempted restoration.

records.title: Bub3-Bub1 Binding to Spc7/KNL1 Toggles the Spindle Checkpoint Switch by Licensing the Interaction of Bub1 with Mad1-Mad2.
records.model: Spc7-MELT/Bub3/Bub1/Mph1 spindle-checkpoint assays
records.note: Bub3 multivalent Spc7 binding enables Mph1-dependent Bub1 interaction with Mad1-Mad2; a SAC-assembly mechanism without rescue pharmacology.

records.title: The vertebrate mitotic checkpoint protein BUBR1 is an unusual pseudokinase.
records.model: Evolutionary paralog analysis and human BUBR1 functional assays
records.note: Human BUBR1 putative catalysis was dispensable for faithful segregation, whereas conventional ATP-binding residues maintained conformation; relevant to distinguishing stabilizers from kinase inhibitors.

records.title: Environmental Phenol and Paraben Exposure Risks and Their Potential Influence on the Gene Expression Involved in the Prognosis of Prostate Cancer.
records.model: NHANES urine exposure/PCa data and CTD/TCGA analysis
records.note: Urinary phenol/paraben measures associated with self-reported PCa and BUB1B was a high-grade tumor hub; database exposure links are not controlled administration or rescue.

records.title: Characteristic Analysis of Featured Genes Associated With Stemness Indices in Colorectal Cancer.
records.model: CRC stemness TCGA/Oncomine analysis
records.note: Eight stemness-associated genes included BUB1B with transcription/protein correlations and checkpoint enrichment; individual-treatment strategies remain proposed.

records.title: Fbf1 regulates mouse oocyte meiosis by influencing Plk1.
records.model: Fbf1-siRNA mouse oocytes
records.note: Fbf1 loss lowered spindle-pole Plk1 and retained BubR1 checkpoint signaling with failed polar-body extrusion; Taxol/nocodazole were microtubule-mechanism probes.

records.title: A supervised machine learning approach identifies gene-regulating factor-mediated competing endogenous RNA networks in hormone-dependent cancers.
records.model: Four hormone-dependent cancer multi-omic datasets
records.note: LASSO integrating methylation, copy number and TFs identified BUB1/BUB1B as shared ceRNAs; pathway/survival analysis provides no administered rescue.

records.title: BubR1 is modified by sumoylation during mitotic progression.
records.model: HeLa cells and BubR1 K250 sumoylation mutants
records.note: Extended spindle-drug treatment induced SUMO-modified BubR1; sumoylation-deficient expression caused mitotic delay/missegregation, so modified-protein accumulation is not evidence of therapeutic rescue.

records.title: Identification of candidate biomarkers correlated with the pathogenesis and prognosis of breast cancer via integrated bioinformatics analysis.
records.model: Seven breast-cancer GEO datasets with expression validation
records.note: Ten elevated hubs including BUB1B were associated with lower overall survival; experimental validation confirmed expression trends without a drug intervention.

records.title: Relationship between the deep features of the full-scan pathological map of mucinous gastric carcinoma and related genes based on deep learning.
records.model: Mucinous gastric carcinoma TCGA histology/genomics
records.note: VGG16 features correlated with BUB1B and other hubs; same study as AGR IND608040929, not an independent biological intervention.

records.title: The Mre11-Rad50-Nbs1 complex mediates the robust recruitment of Polo to DNA lesions during mitosis in Drosophila.
records.model: Drosophila mitotic chromosomes after micro-irradiation
records.note: Mre11/Rad50 supported Polo recruitment to breaks and Polo kinase activity enabled BubR1/Bub3 recruitment; ectopic Mre11 tethering was the genetic sufficiency test.

records.title: Assessing the genetic impact of Enterococcus faecalis infection on gastric cell line MKN74
records.model: E. faecalis-infected MKN74 gastric cell dataset
records.note: Reanalysis found twelve proliferation-related genes including BUB1B downregulated after live infection; reduced cancer progression was hypothesized, not a measured therapeutic benefit.

records.title: Identification and verification of hub genes associated with the progression of non-small cell lung cancer by integrated analysis.
records.model: NSCLC expression cohorts and A549/SPCA1 cells
records.note: Nine hubs including BUB1B increased with progression/cisplatin resistance; hub knockdown inhibited growth. Cisplatin is a resistance context, not a named BUB1B-rescue experiment.

records.title: Identification of Core Genes and Pathways in Medulloblastoma by Integrated Bioinformatics Analysis.
records.model: Medulloblastoma GEO and pan-cancer TCGA datasets
records.note: Eight core genes including BUB1B tracked diagnostic/prognostic features with cell-cycle/p53 enrichment; no intervention efficacy is reported.

records.title: Tank Binding Kinase 1 modulates spindle assembly checkpoint components to regulate mitosis in breast and lung cancer cells.
records.model: Breast/lung cancer cells with TBK1 depletion and inhibition
records.note: TBK1 inhibition altered Cdc20/APC-C/BubR1 association; TBK1/TTK inhibition reduced viability and increased centrosome amplification/micronuclei. Full text is needed for drug identities, not rescue attribution.

records.title: Partial Hepatectomy in Acetylation-Deficient BubR1 Mice Corroborates that Chromosome Missegregation Initiates Tumorigenesis.
records.model: BubR1 K243R/+ mouse liver after partial hepatectomy
records.note: Regenerating mutant hepatocytes had more misalignment and micronuclei without altered centrosome/nuclear counts; partial hepatectomy was a mitotic assay, not treatment of BUBR1 deficiency.

records.title: Synuclein γ compromises spindle assembly checkpoint and renders resistance to antimicrotubule drugs.
records.model: SNCG-expressing breast cancer cells/xenografts and clinical specimens
records.note: SNCG bound BubR1, changed its structure and weakened Cdc20 interaction/SAC, conferring resistance; genetic oncogenic resistance does not demonstrate a pharmacologic stabilizer.

records.title: Targeting of BUB1b Gene Expression in Sentinel Lymph Node Biopsies of Invasive Breast Cancer in Iranian Female Patients.
records.model: Breast-cancer sentinel-node biopsies
records.note: BUB1b expression distinguished metastatic from normal node/breast samples after cytokeratin confirmation; 'targeting' in the title refers to measurement, not therapy.

records.title: Identification of potential target genes and crucial pathways in small cell lung cancer based on bioinformatic strategy and human samples.
records.model: SCLC GEO and human tumor specimens
records.note: Eight hub genes including BUB1B were upregulated in tumor and validated in patient tissues; individualized medication was proposed without a drug test.

records.title: A sequential multi-target Mps1 phosphorylation cascade promotes spindle checkpoint signaling.
records.model: Reconstituted MCC and human Bub1/Mad1 phosphosite mutants
records.note: Sequential Mps1 phosphorylation of Knl1/Bub1/Mad1 promotes MCC/APC-C inhibition; phosphorylation-site mutations abolished checkpoint signaling, without administered rescue.

records.title: Evaluation of Clinical Value and Potential Mechanism of MTFR2 in Lung Adenocarcinoma via Bioinformatics
records.model: MTFR2 LUAD computational study; preprint
records.note: Higher MTFR2 and ten coexpressed cell-cycle genes including BUB1B associated with poor prognosis; preprint counterpart of PMID 34039308.

records.title: Identification of key genes and carcinogenic pathways in hepatitis B virus-associated hepatocellular carcinoma through bioinformatics analysis.
records.model: HBV-HCC 70 tumors/37 adjacent tissues
records.note: Fourteen hubs including BUB1B mapped nuclear division and p53/cell-cycle changes; no pharmacological validation is described.

records.title: Identification of therapeutic targets and mechanisms of tumorigenesis in non-small cell lung cancer using multiple-microarray analysis.
records.model: NSCLC two-microarray bioinformatics analysis
records.note: BUB1B was among ten PPI hubs from 419 DEGs; metabolic/cell-cycle pathways were nominated for future therapeutic targeting.

records.title: Association between polymorphisms in segregation genes BUB1B and TTK and gastric cancer risk.
records.model: Gastric cancer case-control SNP study
records.note: BUB1B rs1031963/rs1801376 and TTK rs151658 showed genotype/subtype associations; authors call for broader-population confirmation, without intervention evidence.

records.title: Gene expression profile analysis to discover molecular signatures for early diagnosis and therapies of triple-negative breast cancer.
records.model: TNBC expression, network pharmacology and docking
records.note: Imatinib, regorafenib, pazopanib, teniposide and dexrazoxane were docking/network candidates; BUB1B was a hub but top docked proteins were other targets. No drug administration occurred in this abstract.

records.title: Identification of Core Genes Related with Trophinin-Associated Protein (TROAP) Expression in Liver Cancer
records.model: TROAP-downregulated liver cancer cells plus transcriptomics; preprint
records.note: TROAP downregulation inhibited proliferation/migration and nominated BUB1B among ten network hubs; no BUB1B-restoring drug was reported.

records.title: The role of BUB and CDC proteins in low-grade breast cancers.
records.model: 1858 breast tumor tissue microarrays
records.note: BUB1B tracked higher grade whereas BUB1/BUB3/CDC42 favored low-grade luminal patterns; long-term outcome associations do not demonstrate pharmacologic restoration.

records.title: CBX8 interacts with chromatin PTEN and is involved in regulating mitotic progression.
records.model: PTEN/CBX8 knockdown and expression cell assays
records.note: CBX8 interacted with chromatin PTEN and its phosphorylation coincided with phospho-BubR1; PTEN/CBX8 loss increased H3K27me3, without drug rescue.

records.title: The p90 ribosomal S6 kinase 2 specifically affects mitotic progression by regulating the basal level, distribution and stability of mitotic spindles.
records.model: RSK2-depleted mitotic cells
records.note: RSK2 loss weakened K-fibers/tension and retained BubR1 on kinetochores; BubR1 depletion abolished the resulting arrest but did not establish restored segregation.

records.title: Integration of kinase and phosphatase activities by BUBR1 ensures formation of stable kinetochore-microtubule attachments.
records.model: BUBR1 KARD deletion/phosphorylation-defective mitotic cells
records.note: Aurora-B inhibition reversed failed K-fiber formation caused by defective BUBR1 KARD; PLK1 inhibition instead reduced B56 recruitment. Genuine same-protein functional compensation, with drug identity, fidelity and tissue transfer requiring full text.

records.title: Predictive and prognostic values of Tau and BubR1 protein in prostate cancer and their relationship to the Gleason score.
records.model: 30 metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer patients
records.note: BubR1/Tau expression did not predict docetaxel response; lower BubR1 correlated with longer survival. This clinical cohort does not confirm preclinical chemosensitivity assumptions.

records.title: Identification of potential biomarkers associated with immune infiltration in papillary renal cell carcinoma.
records.model: Papillary RCC immune-infiltration/expression datasets
records.note: Nine immune-related biomarker hubs included BUB1B; Cox/WGCNA/PPI analyses did not test administered immunotherapy or BUB1B rescue.

records.title: Simultaneous reduction of MAD2 and BUBR1 expression induces mitotic spindle alterations associated with p53 dependent cell cycle arrest and death.
records.model: Near-diploid tumor cells with MAD2/BUBR1 RNAi
records.note: Dual depletion induced hyperdiploidy, arrest and death beyond individual knockdowns; p53 limited propagation of aneuploid cells, with no administered rescue agent.

records.title: [Research progress on spindle assembly checkpoint gene BubR1].
records.model: BubR1 checkpoint/aging/disease literature
records.note: Reviews dose-dependent SAC support and roles in meiosis, DNA damage, infertility and aging; no new pharmacologic result is stated.

records.title: Identification of Prognostic Markers and Potential Therapeutic Targets in Gastric Adenocarcinoma by Machine Learning Based on mRNAsi Index.
records.model: STAD TCGA/GEO stemness analysis
records.note: Nineteen stemness-associated hubs included BUB1B; higher mRNAsi had better overall survival despite tumor upregulation, and target suggestions remain computational.

records.title: Identification of Candidate Biomarkers Correlated Poorer Prognosis of Breast Cancer via Bioinformatics Method
records.model: Breast cancer GEO/prognosis study; preprint
records.note: Twelve hubs and eleven prognosis associations match the 58-normal/203-tumor study published as PMID 34384030; not independent treatment evidence.

records.title: How chromosome mis-segregation leads to cancer: lessons from BubR1 mouse models.
records.model: BubR1 mouse-model cancer literature
records.note: Compares mouse models to examine aneuploidy as cause/consequence of cancer and SAC compromise; no new administered rescue is described.

records.title: New insights into the role of BubR1 in mitosis and beyond.
records.model: BubR1 structural/regulatory and nonmitotic literature
records.note: Covers classical checkpoint/attachment roles plus meiosis, DNA damage and centrosome/basal-body functions; disease links are reviewed rather than drug tested.

records.title: BRCA2 fine-tunes the spindle assembly checkpoint through reinforcement of BubR1 acetylation.
records.model: BRCA2-deficient cells and BRCA2-BubR1-interaction transgenic mice
records.note: BRCA2 recruited PCAF to acetylate BubR1; disrupted interaction reduced BubR1 acetylation/SAC and caused aneuploidy and tumors in 40% of transgenic mice. No pharmacological rescue is reported.

records.title: Mad2 "opens" Cdc20 for BubR1 binding.
records.model: Commentary on Han et al. MCC study
records.note: Briefly interprets Mad2-dependent Cdc20 opening for BubR1 binding; it is commentary on another primary study, not additional drug evidence.

records.title: BubR1 is frequently repressed in acute myeloid leukemia and its re-expression sensitizes cells to antimitotic therapy.
records.model: AML/lymphoblastic cells and BubR1/cyclin-B restoration
records.note: Restoring BubR1 or cyclin B enhanced spindle-poison response in BubR1-low AML; the abstract leaves restoration modality/drug identities incomplete, and the endpoint is cancer killing.

records.title: SLC2As as diagnostic markers and therapeutic targets in LUAD patients through bioinformatic analysis.
records.model: LUAD glucose-transporter expression/methylation/immune datasets
records.note: SLC2A1/BUB1B cell-cycle association was one proposed mechanism among GLUT signatures; no glucose-transporter or BUBR1 therapy was tested.

records.title: Identification of Caffeic Acid Phenethyl Ester (CAPE) as a Potent Neurodifferentiating Natural Compound That Improves Cognitive and Physiological Functions in Animal Models of Neurodegenerative Diseases.
records.model: Human neuroblastoma differentiation, Drosophila AD and mouse amnesia models
records.outcome_direction: neuronal differentiation and organismal symptom improvement
records.note: CAPE induced differentiation with lower BubR1/proliferation proteins and reportedly improved fly/mouse neurological phenotypes with higher BDNF/Nestin/NeuN. A genuine administered non-MVA functional result requiring primary dose/endpoints review; it is not BUBR1 restoration.

records.title: polo Is Identified as a Suppressor of bubR1 Nondisjunction in a Deficiency Screen of the Third Chromosome in Drosophila melanogaster.
records.model: Drosophila bubR1 D1326N/rev1 genetic deficiency screen
records.note: Polo-locus deficiencies suppressed bubR1 meiotic nondisjunction by slowing prophase and restoring chiasmata/SMC2 loading; an allele-specific genetic compensation route, without a Polo inhibitor experiment.

records.title: Syndrome of microcephaly, Dandy-Walker malformation, and Wilms tumor caused by mosaic variegated aneuploidy with premature centromere division (PCD): report of a new case and review of the literature.
records.model: MVA/PCD infant with bilateral Wilms tumors
records.note: Multiple-tissue aneuploidy, congenital brain anomalies and parental PCD supported inherited MVA syndrome; no rescue treatment is described.

records.title: Identification of MCM4 as a Prognostic Marker of Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
records.model: HCC TCGA/GEO and 60 paired tissue samples
records.note: MCM4 expression showed diagnostic/survival associations and correlated with BUB1B; experimental validation was biomarker expression, not treatment.

records.title: Polymyxin Induces Significant Transcriptomic Perturbations of Cellular Signalling Networks in Human Lung Epithelial Cells.
records.model: A549 human lung epithelial cells
records.note: Polymyxin B at 1 mM for 24 hours caused approximately 19% cell death and cell-cycle/DNA-damage pathway perturbation; BUB1B was a network hub in toxicity, not rescue.

records.title: Comprehensive Analysis of the Control of Cancer Stem Cell Characteristics in Endometrial Cancer by Network Analysis.
records.model: Endometrial cancer stemness/immune-expression networks
records.note: BUB1B was one of nineteen cell-cycle/DNA-replication hubs; proposed upstream PLK1/CDK1/MAD2L1 regulation arose from network analysis without intervention testing.

records.title: SKA3 Serves as a Biomarker for Poor Prognosis in Kidney Renal Papillary Cell Carcinoma.
records.model: Papillary renal cancer TCGA/GSCALite datasets
records.note: SKA3/BUB1B hub associations led to predicted MEK inhibitors trametinib, selumetinib, PD0325901 and RDEA119; no administered experiment is reported.

records.title: Proximity mapping of human separase by the BioID approach.
records.model: Human separase BioID and C. elegans BubR1-homologue depletion
records.note: BUBR1 was a separase-proximity interactor, and worm homologue depletion delayed chromosomal separase arrival and anaphase; no drug intervention.

records.title: Dot1L mediated histone H3 lysine79 methylation is essential to meiosis progression in mouse oocytes.
records.model: Dot1L-siRNA mouse oocytes
records.note: Dot1L/H3K79 methylation depletion retained BubR1 on chromosomes and arrested MI with incomplete histone deacetylation; genetic methylation requirement does not imply benefit of catalytic inhibitors.

records.title: Novel immune-related signature for risk stratification and prognosis in prostatic adenocarcinoma.
records.model: Prostatectomy discovery/TCGA validation cohorts
records.note: Five immune-related genes including BUB1B formed a recurrence-risk signature and correlated with immune composition; treatment was clinical background, not a rescue experiment.

records.title: Evaluation of clinical value and potential mechanism of MTFR2 in lung adenocarcinoma via bioinformatics
records.model: LUAD MTFR2 computational study; preprint
records.note: MTFR2/BUB1B coexpression and adverse-survival associations repeat the study represented by PPR266238 and PMID 34039308; no new pharmacologic result.

records.title: Expanding the PP2A Interactome by Defining a B56-Specific SLiM.
records.model: B56-RepoMan/BubR1 structural complexes
records.note: Three structures defined an LSPIxE interaction motif and nominated PP2A regulators/substrates; cancer-target relevance is prospective without administered PP2A rescue.

records.title: Identification and Verification of Feature Biomarkers Associated With Immune Cells in Dilated Cardiomyopathy by Bioinformatics Analysis.
records.model: Dilated-cardiomyopathy cardiac expression datasets
records.note: BUB1B was a PPI hub, but the validated diagnostic model used CCL2, CCL5 and TLR2; no cardiac drug rescue was tested.

records.title: Genomic Integrity Safeguards Self-Renewal in Embryonic Stem Cells.
records.model: Embryonic-stem-cell phosphoregulator shRNA screen
records.note: Bub1b and four other phosphoregulator depletions triggered genome instability/p53 and differentiation; a stem-cell maintenance mechanism without pharmacologic restoration.

records.title: ¹H, ¹³C and ¹⁵N resonance assignments of the kinetochore localisation domain of BUBR1, a central component of the spindle assembly checkpoint.
records.model: Purified isotope-labeled human BUBR1 N-terminal domain
records.note: NMR resonance assignments of Blinkin-bound BUBR1 map its recruitment interface; no cell or treatment rescue was assessed.

records.title: BubR1 is required for the mitotic block induced by combretastatin-A4 and a novel cis-restricted ß-lactam analogue in human cancer cells.
records.model: Cervical and breast cancer cells
records.note: Both agents depolymerized microtubules, induced BubR1 phosphorylation then cleavage, and caused arrest/apoptosis; BUBR1 RNAi increased polyploidy during exposure.

records.title: Spindle assembly checkpoint protein expression correlates with cellular proliferation and shorter time to recurrence in ovarian cancer.
records.model: 72 ovarian-cancer patients, tissue microarray
records.note: BUBR1 tracked stage/histology/proliferation; lower MAD2 nuclear staining predicted shorter recurrence-free survival, including taxane/platinum recipients. No deficient-normal-tissue benefit was shown.

records.title: Prenatal diagnosis of premature centromere division-related mosaic variegated aneuploidy.
records.model: Prenatal PCD-related MVA case
records.note: Repeated amniocenteses and multiple fetal tissues showed PCD/MVA after IUGR/microcephaly/oligohydramnios; no restorative treatment was evaluated.

records.title: Hub gene identification and prognostic model establishment for patients with HBV-related hepatocellular carcinoma
records.model: HBV-HCC GEO/ICGC/TCGA datasets; preprint
records.note: BUB1B was a top-ten hub, while the final four-gene model used ZWINT/EZH2/FOXM1/CDK1; target nomination does not establish intervention response.

records.title: Molecular basis of APC/C regulation by the spindle assembly checkpoint.
records.model: Human APC/C-MCC cryo-EM structures
records.note: BubR1 degron-like sequences block Cdc20 recognition and UbcH10 binding; structural flexibility permits Cdc20 ubiquitination and reactivation, without administered rescue.

records.title: Genomic Profiling Reveals the Molecular Landscape of Gastrointestinal Tract Cancers in Chinese Patients.
records.model: 432 Chinese gastrointestinal tumor genomes
records.note: High CIN associated with BUB1B copy loss and other segregation/cell-cycle lesions; tumor-location and MSI analyses support stratification, not treatment efficacy.

records.title: Whole chromosome aneuploidy in the brain of Bub1bH/H and Ercc1-/Δ7 mice.
records.model: Bub1b H/H and Ercc1 mutant developing/adult mouse brain
records.outcome_direction: developmental aneuploidy with low adult prevalence
records.note: Bub1b H/H embryonic cortex had high aneuploidy but adult brains resembled controls for three autosomes; early clearance was hypothesized, not experimentally induced or pharmacologically rescued.

records.title: KIAA0101 in Malignant Pleural Mesothelioma: A Potential Diagnostic and Prognostic Marker.
records.model: Mesothelioma GEO/TCGA expression models
records.note: BUB1B was one of six initial candidates but absent from the final three-gene LASSO model; KIAA0101 was the independent prognostic factor, with no drug test.

records.title: Mosaic variegated aneuploidy with multiple congenital abnormalities: homozygosity for total premature chromatid separation trait.
records.model: Two PCS/MVA infants and extended families
records.outcome_direction: severe congenital disease and early death
records.note: Repeated cultures showed extensive premature separation and mosaic aneuploidy, with familial PCS supporting inferred inheritance; no restorative treatment outcome was given.

records.title: Integrated analysis reveals key genes with prognostic value in lung adenocarcinoma.
records.model: Lung adenocarcinoma GEO/GEPIA/cBioPortal cohorts
records.note: Six upregulated hubs including BUB1B correlated with worse survival; mutation annotation and pathway enrichment did not constitute intervention testing.

records.title: Structure of a Blinkin-BUBR1 complex reveals an interaction crucial for kinetochore-mitotic checkpoint regulation via an unanticipated binding Site.
records.model: BUBR1-Blinkin crystal structure and residue-substitution cells
records.note: A 2.2-Angstrom structure defined the Blinkin interface, and BUBR1 binding-residue substitutions impaired SAC; the study does not administer a restorative drug.

records.title: The architecture of the BubR1 tetratricopeptide tandem repeat defines a protein motif underlying mitotic checkpoint-kinetochore communication.
records.model: KNL1-BubR1 TPR-complex mechanistic discussion
records.note: Discusses disorder-to-order KNL1 binding and mutant checkpoint defects, proposing effects on partner recognition; no new administered-drug result is described.

records.title: Tumor suppressor protein DAB2IP participates in chromosomal stability maintenance through activating spindle assembly checkpoint and stabilizing kinetochore-microtubule attachments.
records.model: DAB2IP-deficient/reconstituted prostate-cancer cells
records.outcome_direction: genetic restoration of checkpoint and drug sensitivity
records.note: DAB2IP loss reduced Plk1/BubR1 signaling and attachments; reconstitution sensitized cells to taxanes and BI2536. The restorative manipulation was genetic, while drugs measured tumor sensitivity.

records.title: Structural analysis reveals features of the spindle checkpoint kinase Bub1-kinetochore subunit Knl1 interaction.
records.model: Bub1/BubR1 TPR-KNL1 structural and mutant assays
records.note: KI-interface mutations impaired binding without major kinetochore displacement; a separate Bub1 segment with Bub3 binding supplied recruitment, distinguishing interface affinity from localization function.

records.title: Combined expression of BUB1B, DLGAP5, and PINK1 as predictors of poor outcome in adrenocortical tumors: validation in a Brazilian cohort of adult and pediatric patients.
records.model: 53 adult/pediatric Brazilian adrenocortical tumors
records.note: BUB1B-PINK1 predicted adult overall survival, but pediatric outcome associations were weak/absent; no therapeutic intervention is described.

records.title: Diaphragm muscle sarcopenia in aging mice.
records.model: Young/old wild-type mice and four BubR1 H/H mice
records.note: Maximum specific diaphragm force was 57% lower and IIx/IIb fiber area 47% smaller in H/H versus young mice; a direct same-gene muscle endpoint model, with no rescue intervention.

records.title: Exposure to Mono-n-Butyl Phthalate in Women with Endometriosis and Its Association with the Biological Effects on Human Granulosa Cells.
records.model: Endometriosis exposure cohort and human granulosa cells
records.note: Higher urinary MnBP associated with endometriosis, and direct MnBP treatment altered BUB1B/cell-cycle genes, reduced mitochondrial potential and anti-Mullerian hormone; exposure harm, not rescue.

records.title: Retraction.
records.model: Retraction notice for Arabidopsis SAC paper PMID 25262777
records.note: Notice reports inappropriate editing/duplication in Figures 1/2a undermining yeast-two-hybrid integrity and retracts the study reviewed at batch index 116; that study must not count as reliable supportive evidence.

records.title: Cisplatin plus sodium arsenite and hyperthermia induces pseudo-G1 associated apoptotic cell death in ovarian cancer cells.
records.model: A2780 and A2780/CP70 ovarian cancer cells with 39-degree hyperthermia
records.note: Cisplatin plus 20 micromolar arsenite/hyperthermia caused postmitotic pseudo-G1 apoptosis without confirmed mitotic arrest or BUBR1 phosphorylation; G2/M accumulation alone was misleading.

records.title: Integrated Transcriptome Analysis Reveals the Impact of Photodynamic Therapy on Cerebrovascular Endothelial Cells.
records.model: B.END3 cerebrovascular endothelial cells
records.note: Low-dose PDT altered transporter/mitotic genes including BUB1B and upregulated inflammatory signaling despite no significant DNA/skeleton damage; authors infer detrimental BBB effects, not rescue.

records.title: Construction of protein phosphorylation networks by data mining, text mining and ontology integration: analysis of the spindle checkpoint.
records.model: BUB1B/MAD3 literature/database phosphorylation-network curation
records.note: Integrates text mining, ontology and PPI data to represent phosphorylation-state-specific checkpoint networks; it is not an independent drug or biological rescue experiment.

records.title: Novel insight into m6A regulator-mediated methylation modification patterns and immune characteristics in intracranial aneurysm.
records.model: Intracranial aneurysm expression datasets
