records.note: BUB1B was a predicted m6A-modified hub in immune/apoptosis networks; the diagnostic model used other regulators and no treatment was tested.

records.title: Integrated Bioinformatics Analysis for the Screening of Hub Genes and Therapeutic Drugs in Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
records.model: HCC expression and drug-interaction databases
records.note: Eleven hubs including BUB1B yielded 32 DGIdb drug candidates; expression/survival validation did not establish administered efficacy.

records.title: Dendrite development regulated by the schizophrenia-associated gene FEZ1 involves the ubiquitin proteasome system.
records.model: Hippocampal granule and olfactory bulb neurons
records.note: HDAC11-dependent BubR1 deacetylation disinhibited CDC20/APC-mediated FEZ1 degradation and altered dendrites; genetic mechanism, no named pharmacologic rescue.

records.title: Checkpoint signaling and error correction require regulation of the MPS1 T-loop by PP2A-B56.
records.model: Mammalian MPS1 phosphomutants and PP2A-B56 regulation
records.note: Constitutively active MPS1 caused prolonged arrest and persistent attachment turnover; BubR1-bound PP2A balances signaling rather than simply maximizing it.

records.title: Altered gene expression in CHO cells following polyamine starvation
records.model: CHO-K1 cells deprived of polyamines for three days
records.note: Polyamine deprivation increased Bub1b/Mad2l1 transcripts while arresting growth; higher checkpoint mRNA here is a starvation response, not restoration.

records.title: Aneuploidy in the normal and diseased brain.
records.model: Normal and diseased neural aneuploidy reviewed
records.note: Discusses euploid/aneuploid brain mosaicism and MVA/Down syndrome; no specific administered rescue experiment in abstract.

records.title: Radiogenomics analysis reveals the associations of dynamic contrast-enhanced-MRI features with gene expression characteristics, PAM50 subtypes, and prognosis of breast cancer.
records.model: Breast cancer MRI/transcriptomic cohorts
records.note: BUB1B entered an eight-gene imaging-linked prognosis signature; MRI prediction of subtype/outcome is not a drug intervention.

records.title: Identification of key regulators associated with colon cancer prognosis and pathogenesis.
records.model: Colon cancer microarray and regulatory databases
records.note: BUB1B was among ten mitotic hubs with predicted TF/miRNA/metabolite links; no therapeutic manipulation tested.

records.title: PLK4 is a key molecule in the formation of PGCCs and promotes invasion and migration of progeny cells derived from PGCCs.
records.model: LoVo/HCT116 colorectal cancer cells and PLK4 knockdown
records.note: Bufalin induced polyploid giant cancer cells with invasive progeny; BUB1B was a prognosis-screen hit while PLK4/CDC25C were functionally studied.

records.title: BubR1 acetylation at prometaphase is required for modulating APC/C activity and timing of mitosis.
records.model: BubR1 K250 acetylation mutants in mitotic cells
records.note: K250Q stabilized BubR1 but markedly delayed segregation, whereas K250R destabilized it and accelerated mitosis; stabilization is not automatically functional rescue.

records.title: HNF1B Loss Exacerbates the Development of Chromophobe Renal Cell Carcinomas.
records.model: HNF1B-deficient MEFs/ACHN cells and ChRCC specimens
records.note: HNF1B loss reduced MAD2L1/BUB1B and altered chromatin; combination with TP53 mutation increased survival/proliferation and aneuploidy, not corrective rescue.

records.title: Bioinformatics study on genes related to a high-risk postoperative recurrence of lung adenocarcinoma.
records.model: LUAD recurrence expression datasets
records.note: High BUB1B and seven other mitotic genes correlated with shorter recurrence-free survival; database biomarkers without administered therapy.

records.title: Diagnostic and Prognostic Biomarkers of Adrenal Cortical Carcinoma.
records.model: Adrenal adenoma/carcinoma tissue microarray
records.note: BUB1B was one immunostained mitotic marker; angioinvasion outperformed biomarkers for low-grade adverse-outcome prediction and no intervention was tested.

records.title: Reduced proliferation of aged human vascular smooth muscle cells--role of oxygen-derived free radicals and BubR1 expression.
records.model: Young versus aged human aortic smooth-muscle cells
records.note: Angiotensin/H2O2 raised BubR1 in young cells and inhibitors blocked the increase; BubR1 siRNA lowered proliferation, so inhibitor use is not restorative evidence.

records.title: Significance of Identifying Key Genes Involved in HBV-Related Hepatocellular Carcinoma for Primary Care Surveillance of Patients with Cirrhosis.
records.model: HBV-HCC datasets and HBx-expressing cell proteomics
records.note: BUB1B was one of fifteen transition-associated genes; direct HBx interaction validation involved CDK1/RRM2/ANLN/HMMR, not a BUB1B rescue.

records.title: Identification of genes involved in the four stages of colorectal cancer: Gene expression profiling.
records.model: CRC stages and expression validation
records.note: BUB1B was an interaction partner of stage-linked mitotic genes; PCR confirmed other rising genes, with no drug experiment.

records.title: Integrated bioinformatic analysis unveils significant genes and pathways in the pathogenesis of supratentorial primitive neuroectodermal tumor.
records.model: sPNET expression versus fetal/adult brain
records.note: BUB1B/CDK1/CDC20/BUB1 were network hubs in tumor-versus-brain analyses; no treatment or neural restoration measured.

records.title: Identification of a Gene Signature Closely Related to Immunosuppressive Tumour Microenvironment Predicting Prognosis of Patients in EGFR Mutant Lung Adenocarcinoma.
records.model: EGFR-mutant LUAD expression/survival cohorts
records.note: BTLA/BUB1B/CENPE signature stratified risk and immune context; immune-checkpoint benefit was background, not a newly administered result.

records.title: Identification of key genes and biological pathways in lung adenocarcinoma via bioinformatics analysis.
records.model: LUAD GEO, GEPIA and toxicogenomic databases
records.note: Five mitotic hubs including BUB1B were associated with survival and database drugs; no named compound was experimentally administered in abstract.

records.title: Downregulation of miR-10B* is correlated with altered expression of mitotic kinases in osteosarcoma.
records.model: Osteosarcoma samples
records.note: Reduced miR-10b-star correlated with PLK1/PLK4/BUB1/BUBR1 expression; tumor-suppressor/genome-stability role explicitly awaits functional confirmation.

records.title: Identification of Novel Biomarkers in Hepatocellular Carcinoma by Integrated Bioinformatical Analysis and Experimental Validation
records.model: HCC datasets and tissue expression validation; preprint
records.note: Repeated saved abstract reports six expression-validated hubs and CMAP candidates; predicted reversal of HCC was not a drug experiment.

records.title: EPEN-09. SUPER ENHANCER GENES AS MOLECULAR TARGETS IN C11ORF95-RELA FUSION EPENDYMOMA
records.model: Ependymoma RNA-interference screen; conference abstract
records.note: BUB1B was a positive-control growth dependency among 267 enhancer-associated targets; no pharmacologic rescue or drug treatment shown.

records.title: Identification of Potential Biomarkers Associated With Immune Infiltration in Papillary Renal Cell Carcinoma
records.model: Papillary RCC immune/prognostic datasets; preprint
records.note: Nine immune-associated hubs included BUB1B; validation used survival/expression databases rather than treatment experiments.

records.title: Identification of genes predicting unfavorable prognosis in hepatitis B virus-associated hepatocellular carcinoma.
records.model: HBV-HCC expression cohorts
records.note: BUB1B was one of fourteen dysregulated hubs, while TOP2A had the highlighted adverse-survival association; no intervention.

records.title: CHK1 monitors spindle assembly checkpoint and DNA damage repair during the first cleavage of mouse early embryos.
records.model: Mouse first-cleavage embryos with CHK1 activity loss
records.note: Loss of CHK1 accelerated cleavage but impaired blastocyst development, BubR1 recruitment and DNA repair; abstract does not specify whether activity loss was pharmacologic.

records.title: The clinicopathological significance of BUBR1 overexpression in hepatocellular carcinoma.
records.model: HCC and dysplastic nodules; expression and tissue arrays
records.note: BUBR1 overexpression occurred in about 45% of HCCs and correlated with advanced features/poor survival; no administered therapy.

records.title: Ki67 and BUBR1 may discriminate clinically insignificant prostate cancer in the PSA range <4 ng/ml.
records.model: Prostate biopsies in low-PSA patients
records.note: Ki67/BUBR1 staining helped classify clinically insignificant cancers for surveillance; markers were not therapeutic interventions.

records.title: Correlation between reduced expression of the spindle checkpoint protein BubR1 and bad prognosis in tonsillar carcinomas.
records.model: 105 tonsillar carcinomas
records.note: BubR1 staining independently contributed prognostic information beyond stage/age/HPV; no manipulation or drug response tested.

records.title: Identifying Potential Prognostic Biomarkers Associated With Clinicopathologic Characteristics of Hepatocellular Carcinoma by Bioinformatics Analysis
records.model: HCC microarray/TCGA and clinical qPCR/IHC; preprint
records.note: Mitotic hubs including BUB1B were upregulated with poor outcomes and possible hypomethylation; no demethylating-drug experiment.

records.title: BUBR1 expression in oral squamous cell carcinoma and its relationship to tumor stage and survival.
records.model: 49 oral squamous carcinomas
records.note: BUBR1 overexpression associated with less advanced stage; survival/recurrence differences had nonsignificant reported P values, limiting prognostic interpretation.

records.title: Identification and Validation of the Diagnostic Characteristic Genes of Ovarian Cancer by Bioinformatics and Machine Learning.
records.model: Ovarian cancer datasets and machine learning
records.note: BUB1B was one of nine diagnostic candidates; immune/prognostic validation did not administer a drug or establish rescue.

records.title: [Bioinformatics analysis of core differentially expressed genes in hepatitis B virus-related hepatocellular carcinoma].
records.model: HBV-HCC GEO/UALCAN/survival datasets
records.note: BUB1B was a PPI hub, but validated prognostic emphasis was CDK1/KIF11/KIF20A; no intervention.

records.title: Identification of the hub genes and prognostic indicators of gastric cancer and correlation of indicators with tumor-infiltrating immune cell levels.
records.model: Gastric cancer datasets and cell expression validation
records.note: BUB1B was an upregulated mitotic hub while LUM/VCAN/EFNA4 carried prognostic/immune analyses; no drug testing.

records.title: Checkpoint signaling and error correction require regulation of the MPS1 T-loop by PP2A-B56
records.model: MPS1 T-loop mutants in mammalian cells; preprint
records.note: Phosphomimetic MPS1 escaped BubR1-bound PP2A control and caused persistent arrest/attachment turnover; duplicate study lineage of PMID31511308.

records.title: Network analysis reveals potential markers for pediatric adrenocortical carcinoma.
records.model: Pediatric adrenal carcinoma expression networks
records.note: CDK1/CCNB1/CDC20/BUB1B were common network hubs; authors explicitly require experimental authentication.

records.title: BRCA1/MAD2L1 Deficiency Disrupts the Spindle Assembly Checkpoint to Confer Vinorelbine Resistance in Mesothelioma.
records.model: Mesothelioma cells, primary explants and treated patient subset
records.note: BRCA1/MAD2L1 loss prevented BUBR1 recruitment and vinorelbine apoptosis; survival differences concern tumor response, not healthy-tissue rescue.

records.title: BubR1 blocks substrate recruitment to the APC/C in a KEN-box-dependent manner.
records.model: BubR1 RNAi complementation and in-vitro ubiquitination
records.note: KEN1 promoted MCC assembly while KEN2 blocked APC/C substrate recruitment; distinct domains control checkpoint functions without a drug rescue.

records.title: Cross-talk between BubR1 expression and the commitment to differentiate in adipose-derived mesenchymal stem cells.
records.model: Human adipose-derived mesenchymal stem cells
records.note: BubR1 depletion preceded lost differentiation and senescence, possibly via methylation; abstract omits the decitabine experiment described in existing primary review, so absence is not negative evidence.

records.title: Transcriptome Analysis Reveals the Negative Effect of 16 T High Static Magnetic Field on Osteoclastogenesis of RAW264.7 Cells.
records.model: RAW264.7 cells under 16-tesla static magnetic field
records.note: High magnetic field slowed cycle/differentiation despite increased Bub1b transcripts; expression increase did not demonstrate restored productive function.

records.title: Checkpoint Proteins Bub1 and Bub3 Delay Anaphase Onset in Response to Low Tension Independent of Microtubule-Kinetochore Detachment.
records.model: Engineered Taxol-sensitive budding yeast
records.note: Reduced tension caused a transient Bub1/Bub3-dependent delay independent of Mad3/BubR1; Taxol was an experimental perturbation, not rescue.

records.title: Identification of Key Genes Associated With Early Calf-Hood Nutrition in Subcutaneous and Visceral Adipose Tissues by Co-Expression Analysis.
records.model: Calf adipose RNA-seq after over 100 days feeding
records.note: BUB1B was a high-nutrition subcutaneous-fat hub; dataset reanalysis did not establish gene-specific restoration or muscle rescue.

records.title: Defining the molecular basis of BubR1 kinetochore interactions and APC/C-CDC20 inhibition.
records.model: Human BubR1 TPR crystallography and interaction assays
records.note: A TPR groove bound Blinkin and downstream regions mediated Bub1 recruitment; structure-directed engineering is proposed, not pharmacologic rescue.

records.title: Stathmin 1 is highly expressed and associated with survival outcome in malignant adrenocortical tumours.
records.model: Adrenal carcinoma cell lines/secondary cultures and patient cohorts
records.note: Paclitaxel reduced STMN1 activation/migration/invasion; BUB1B was an expression correlate, not a restored disease target.

records.title: BUBR1 expression in benign oral lesions and squamous cell carcinomas: correlation with human papillomavirus.
records.model: OSCC/benign oral lesions and HPV assays
records.note: High BUBR1 associated with malignant lesions, shorter survival and HPV prevalence; observational staining/PCR, no treatment.

records.title: ATRT-09. IDENTIFICATION OF HUB GENES IN ATYPICAL TERATOID/RHABDOID TUMORS BY MULTIPLE-MICROARRAY ANALYSIS
records.model: ATRT multi-microarray analysis; conference abstract
records.note: BUB1B appeared among fifteen cell-cycle hubs with predicted TF regulation; no experiment tested candidate therapeutic activity.

records.title: Bub1 is not essential for the checkpoint response to unattached kinetochores in diploid human cells.
records.model: Diploid human cells with Bub1 loss
records.note: Bub1 was needed for BubR1 kinetochore recruitment but not strictly for unattached-kinetochore SAC response; no administered rescue.

records.title: Spindle checkpoint silencing at kinetochores with submaximal microtubule occupancy.
records.model: Human kinetochores with tuned microtubule affinity
records.note: About half occupancy could shed MAD2 and silence SAC while BUB1-BUBR1 persisted; local protein retention alone does not measure checkpoint activation.

records.title: Phyllanthus emblica Fruit Extract Activates Spindle Assembly Checkpoint, Prevents Mitotic Aberrations and Genomic Instability in Human Colon Epithelial NCM460 Cells.
records.model: Nontransformed human NCM460 colon epithelial cells
records.note: Extract reduced micronuclei/bridges/buds and mitotic abnormalities while increasing BubR1 and delaying anaphase; genuine non-MVA functional protection already reviewed.

records.title: Bub1 and BubR1: at the interface between chromosome attachment and the spindle checkpoint.
records.model: Bub1/BubR1 checkpoint and attachment functions reviewed
records.note: Summarizes conflicting kinase-activity evidence and attachment control; no administered therapeutic result in abstract.

records.title: High expression of BUBR1 is one of the factors for inducing DNA aneuploidy and progression in gastric cancer.
records.model: Gastric tumors and BUBR1-transfected MKN-28/SNU-1 cells
records.note: BUBR1 overexpression correlated with poor outcomes and experimentally changed ploidy/increased Ki67; overexpression is not universally protective.

records.title: BubR1 and AURKB overexpression are associated with a favorable prognosis in gastric cancer.
records.model: 100 resected gastric cancers
records.note: Higher BubR1/AURKB expression linked to early stage and favorable survival, contrasting other cohorts without establishing causal treatment benefit.

records.title: BUBR1 and closed MAD2 (C-MAD2) interact directly to assemble a functional mitotic checkpoint complex.
records.model: BUBR1/closed-MAD2 binding and MCC assays
records.note: MAD2 residues Arg133/Gln134 were required for BUBR1 interaction and functional MCC; no small-molecule or disease-rescue experiment.

records.title: Prognostic implications of securin expression and sub-cellular localization in human breast cancer.
records.model: 470 breast cancer specimens
records.note: Securin amount/localization predicted outcome and coexpression with BUBR1 suggested regulation; no therapeutic intervention.

records.title: Cross-species genomic landscape comparison of human mucosal melanoma with canine oral and equine melanoma.
records.model: Human/canine/equine mucosal melanoma genome comparisons
records.note: BUB1B was a candidate driver from copy-number comparisons, alongside other cross-species alterations; no drug testing.

records.title: Identification of high-risk genes in triple-negative breast cancer by bioinformatics
records.model: TNBC expression/survival databases; preprint
records.note: BUB1B was one of fourteen relapse/metastasis-associated genes; bioinformatic prognosis does not demonstrate administered efficacy.

records.title: Drosophila Polo regulates the spindle assembly checkpoint through Mps1-dependent BubR1 phosphorylation.
records.model: Drosophila Polo/Mps1/BubR1 checkpoint assays
records.note: Constitutively active Polo restored Mps1 recruitment after Aurora-B inhibition; genetic bypass supported BubR1 phosphorylation and sustained SAC, not a therapeutic drug rescue.

records.title: Construction of Novel mRNA-miRNA-lncRNA Regulatory Networks Associated with Prognosis of HCV Related HCC
records.model: HCV-HCC ceRNA networks; preprint
records.note: BUB1B was expression-validated among six genes, but prioritized survival network centered on BUB1/miR-193a/MALAT1; no intervention.

records.title: Casein kinase 2 modulates the spindle assembly checkpoint to orchestrate porcine oocyte meiotic progression.
records.model: Porcine oocytes
records.note: CK2 inhibition disrupted spindle stability/DNA repair and arrested maturation with kinetochore BubR1; checkpoint activation marked harm.

records.title: Wasabi Compound 6-(Methylsulfinyl) Hexyl Isothiocyanate Induces Cell Death with Coexisting Mitotic Arrest and Autophagy in Human Chronic Myelogenous Leukemia K562 Cells.
records.model: K562 leukemia cells
records.note: Wasabi compound induced spindle multipolarity, mitotic arrest/autophagy and cell death despite increased BubR1/Mad2; no restorative tissue outcome.

records.title: RAF associates with phosphorylated nuclear BubR1 during endoreduplication induced by JAK inhibition.
records.model: HL-60 leukemia cells
records.note: GW5074 blocked JAK-inhibitor-induced endoreduplication and nuclear RAF/MEK/BubR1 phosphorylation changes; real pharmacologic prevention in a drug-injury cancer-cell model, not BUB1B-MVA rescue.

records.title: Pak2 kinase promotes cellular senescence and organismal aging.
records.model: Pak2-depleted fibroblasts and BubR1-progeroid mice
records.note: Pak2 depletion delayed senescence and extended BubR1-model lifespan; abstract contains no PAK inhibitor experiment and omits physical-function limits established in prior review.

records.title: Separating the spindle, checkpoint, and timer functions of BubR1.
records.model: Drosophila BubR1 kinase-dead/KEN-box/Mad2 mutants
records.note: Kinase-dead BubR1 retained SAC but impaired spindles, whereas KEN mutants lost SAC; fly timing/segregation findings do not establish mammalian drug equivalence.

records.title: Bioinformatics analysis to reveal key biomarkers for early and late hepatocellular carcinoma.
records.model: Early/late HCC expression datasets and qPCR
records.note: BUB1B was a PPI hub, but final proposed biomarkers emphasized four other mRNAs/two lncRNAs; no drug tested.

records.title: Different Functionality of Cdc20 Binding Sites within the Mitotic Checkpoint Complex.
records.model: Fission yeast MCC/Cdc20/APC15 mutants
records.note: Different Cdc20 sites mediated sequestration, second-Cdc20 inhibition and APC/C occupancy; genetic concentration dependence, not drug rescue.

records.title: BUB1 and BUBR1: multifaceted kinases of the cell cycle.
records.model: BUB1/BUBR1 domains and regulation reviewed
records.note: Structural review separates checkpoint roles of homologous proteins; no specific administered treatment outcome.

records.title: Recruitment of Cdc20 to the kinetochore requires BubR1 but not Mad2 in Drosophila melanogaster.
records.model: Drosophila S2 cells and syncytial embryos
records.note: MG132 arrested embryos and enhanced checkpoint-protein interactions; drug-induced arrest is an assay condition rather than a disease rescue.

records.title: Altered gene expression in CHO cells following polyamine starvation.
records.model: Polyamine-starved CHO-K1 cells
records.note: Starvation increased Bub1b transcripts alongside cell-cycle/repair stress; MED counterpart of AGR IND606941299, not an independent supplementation rescue.

records.title: Identification of the Tumor Immune Microenvironment and Therapeutic Biomarkers by a Novel Molecular Subtype Based on Aging-Related Genes in Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
records.model: HCC aging-gene/immune datasets and expression validation
records.note: Sorafenib/gemcitabine/rapamycin sensitivity was model-derived, while experiments validated three other genes; no administered BubR1 restoration.

records.title: Intermediates in the assembly of mitotic checkpoint complexes and their role in the regulation of the anaphase-promoting complex.
records.model: Purified MCC subcomplexes
records.note: Mad2 release reduced MCC inhibition and a two-Cdc20 complex contributed to APC/C suppression; no cellular drug-rescue endpoint.

records.title: EDD, a ubiquitin-protein ligase of the N-end rule pathway, associates with spindle assembly checkpoint components and regulates the mitotic response to nocodazole.
records.model: EDD-depleted cells under spindle stress
records.note: EDD siRNA phenocopied BUBR1 depletion by blocking nocodazole arrest and reducing viability; nocodazole was a challenge reagent.

records.title: Dysfunction of Sister Chromatids Separation Promotes Progression of Hepatocellular Carcinoma According to Analysis of Gene Expression Profiling.
records.model: HCC tumor/non-tumor expression dataset
records.note: Sister-chromatid separation genes including BUB1B were dysregulated; further study is required before biomarker/drug-target claims.

records.title: Expression of cell-cycle regulatory proteins BUBR1, MAD2, Aurora A, cyclin A and cyclin E in invasive ductal breast carcinomas.
records.model: 117 invasive ductal breast carcinomas
records.note: BUBR1 staining associated with Ki67, while grade association weakened in multivariate analysis; no treatment experiment.

records.title: Functional interaction between BubR1 and securin in an anaphase-promoting complex/cyclosomeCdc20-independent manner.
records.model: BubR1/securin binding assays and cancer expression
records.note: BubR1 stabilized securin through competition with CDC20 independently of conventional APC/C inhibition; no drug administration reported.

records.title: An Aurora kinase inhibitor, AMG900, inhibits glioblastoma cell proliferation by disrupting mitotic progression.
records.model: Glioblastoma cell lines
records.note: Pan-Aurora inhibition prevented BubR1 recruitment, induced micronuclei/multinuclei and senescence, reducing tumor-cell survival rather than correcting division.

records.title: Chelidonine induces mitotic slippage and apoptotic-like death in SGC-7901 human gastric carcinoma cells.
records.model: SGC-7901 gastric cancer with supporting MCF-7/HepG2 observations
records.note: Chelidonine depolymerized microtubules, later reduced BubR1/cyclin-B1/CDK1 and caused slippage/apoptotic-like death; no restorative outcome.

records.title: Identification of hub genes and small molecule therapeutic drugs related to breast cancer with comprehensive bioinformatics analysis.
records.model: Breast cancer expression/drug databases
records.note: Cladribine, gallium nitrate, alvocidib and plant compounds were candidate database hits; no drug administration or BUB1B rescue demonstrated.

records.title: Modulation of HAT activity by the BRCA2 N372H variation is a novel mechanism of paclitaxel resistance in breast cancer cell lines.
records.model: Breast cancer cells with BRCA2 N372H variation
records.note: TSA restored HAT activity and paclitaxel sensitivity in BRCA2-variant cancer cells; increased chemosensitivity is not healthy-tissue rescue.

records.title: Potential Biological Molecules and Immune Cell for Rheumatoid Arthritis Synovial Lesions
records.model: RA synovial datasets; preprint
records.note: BUB1B was one of ten hubs in inferred immune/regulatory networks; no administered RA or MVA treatment tested.

records.title: Identification of Key Genes for Controlling Cancer Stem Cell Characteristics in Gastric Cancer
records.model: Gastric cancer stemness expression networks; preprint
records.note: BUB1B was one of sixteen mRNAsi-associated genes, while RAD54L/TPX2/XRCC2 were prioritized; no functional drug evidence.

records.title: Identification of Hub Genes in Atypical Teratoid/Rhabdoid Tumor by Bioinformatics Analyses.
records.model: ATRT integrated expression datasets
records.note: Mitotic hubs including BUB1B and predicted MYC/SOX2/KDM5B regulation overlap the conference report; no treatment efficacy measured.

records.title: Tumor-Infiltrating Leukocyte Compositions and Prognostic Immune-Related Genes in Pancreatic Cancer.
records.model: Pancreatic cancer TCGA/GTEx; preprint
records.note: BUB1B entered a twelve-gene immune prognosis signature; leukocyte differences and PI3K-Akt enrichment were computational, without treatment.

records.title: A Systematic Analysis Identifies Key Regulators Involved in Cell Proliferation and Potential Drugs for the Treatment of Human Lung Adenocarcinoma.
records.model: LUAD transcriptomic/regulatory analysis
records.note: TSA, hycanthone, vorinostat and mebeverine were identified as potential agents; abstract reports candidate nomination, not administered-cell rescue.

records.title: Identification of potential hub genes via bioinformatics analysis combined with experimental verification in colorectal cancer.
records.model: CRC datasets and DSN1-silenced cells
records.note: DSN1 silencing reduced migration/colonies; BUB1B interaction was predicted computationally rather than a manipulated rescue target.

records.title: Role of phosphorylation of Cdc20 in p31(comet)-stimulated disassembly of the mitotic checkpoint complex.
records.model: Purified/biochemical MCC disassembly assays
records.note: CDK inhibitors partly blocked p31comet-stimulated CDC20 release from BubR1; biochemical retention of MCC is not functional tissue rescue.

records.title: Leptomeningeal Metastasis from Adrenocortical Carcinoma: A Case Report.
records.model: Young woman with aggressive adrenal carcinoma
records.note: Metastatic disease progressed despite surgery/chemotherapy; BUB1B/PINK1 ratio was a retrospective prognostic marker, not a therapeutic target result.

records.title: Systems Biology Modeling of Five Pathways for Regulation and Potent Inhibition of the Anaphase-Promoting Complex (APC/C): Pivotal Roles for MCC and BubR1.
records.model: Systems-biology models of APC/C regulation
records.note: Combined MCC/BubR1 inhibition best reproduced published wild-type/mutant behavior; model validation is not a new intervention experiment.

records.title: Histone methyltransferase SETD2 is required for meiotic maturation in mouse oocyte.
records.model: SETD2-depleted mouse oocytes
records.note: Loss of SETD2 reduced H3K36 methylation, caused spindle defects/aneuploid eggs and increased kinetochore BubR1; heightened SAC reflects damage.

records.title: Dissection of the Spindle Assembly Checkpoint by Proximity Proteomics
records.model: BioID2 proximity maps of five SAC proteins; preprint
records.note: BUBR1-centered proximity mapping found known/new checkpoint associations during prometaphase, without testing a drug restoration.

records.title: BubR1 N terminus acts as a soluble inhibitor of cyclin B degradation by APC/C(Cdc20) in interphase.
records.model: Conditional BubR1 knockout and domain-complementation cells
records.note: BubR1 N-terminal CDC20 binding preserved interphase cyclin-B accumulation and multiple functions; domain replacement, not pharmacologic rescue.

records.title: EPEN-16. TRANSCRIPTIONAL REGULATORY CIRCUITRIES AS MOLECULAR TARGETS IN EPENDYMOMA
records.model: Ependymoma enhancer-gene RNAi screen; conference abstract
records.note: BUB1B was a positive-control dependency in the 267-gene screen; overlaps PMC8168162 conference study without administered therapy.

records.title: Transcriptome analysis revealed that aflatoxin M1 could cause cell cycle arrest in differentiated Caco-2 cells.
records.model: Differentiated Caco-2 cells exposed for 48 hours
records.note: AFM1 altered cell-cycle genes including BUB1B and induced arrest; toxic exposure, not restorative intervention.

records.title: Prognostic Signature for Lung Adenocarcinoma Patients Based on Cell-Cycle-Related Genes.
records.model: LUAD gene-expression/protein-validation cohorts
records.note: BUB1B formed part of a ten-gene risk signature with IHC support; prognostic validation does not establish intervention benefit.

records.title: Icariin enhances youth-like features by attenuating the declined gut microbiota in the aged mice.
records.model: 24-month-old mice treated 100 mg/kg/day for 15 days
records.note: Icariin improved motor coordination/learning and multiple markers including BUB1b; donor-fecal transfer reproduced effects, without demonstrating BUBR1 mediation or deficient-muscle rescue.

records.title: Spindle proteins in resected pancreatic head adenocarcinomas: BubR1 is an independent prognostic factor in pancreatobiliary-type tumours.
records.model: 218 resected pancreatic-head adenocarcinomas
records.note: BubR1 predicted poor survival in pancreatobiliary but not intestinal tumors, independently of ploidy; no treatment tested.

records.title: MAD1: Kinetochore Receptors and Catalytic Mechanisms.
records.model: MAD1 recruitment and catalytic checkpoint mechanisms reviewed
records.note: Reviews MAD1-promoted MAD2 activation and MCC formation with BUBR1/CDC20; no therapeutic experiment described.

records.title: Blood transcriptome analysis revealed the crosstalk between COVID-19 and HIV.
records.model: COVID-19/HIV blood transcriptome intersections
records.note: Ten candidate drugs including dasatinib/resveratrol/steroids were database-ranked; no infected-patient or BUB1B-directed treatment efficacy tested.

records.title: Identification of new candidate genes and signalling pathways associated with the development of neuroendocrine pancreatic tumours based on next generation sequencing data.
records.model: Twenty-four pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors with targeted sequencing
records.note: BUB1B was a candidate driver and SMAD2/3 alterations occurred; shared pathway mentions do not establish myostatin-blockade rescue.

records.title: MAD2 expression in oral squamous cell carcinoma and its relationship to tumor grade and proliferation.
records.model: 49 oral squamous carcinomas
records.note: MAD2 overexpression tracked grade/nodes/Ki67; BUBR1 was a comparison marker with no intervention.

records.title: Identification of genes and pathways associated with pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma by bioinformatics analyses.
records.model: Six PDAC versus five control expression profiles
records.note: CDC20/BUB1B were highly connected hubs in cell-cycle/p53 networks; no drug or genetic rescue was tested.

records.title: Identification of grade-related genes and construction of a robust genomic-clinicopathologic nomogram for predicting recurrence of bladder cancer.
records.model: Bladder cancer grade/recurrence datasets
records.note: Eight mitotic genes including BUB1B rose with grade and recurrence and informed a nomogram; prediction rather than treatment experiment.

records.title: Interaction of Aβ peptide with tubulin causes an inhibition of tubulin polymerization and the apoptotic death of cancer cells.
records.model: MCF7/A549/HeLa cells and tubulin assays
records.note: A-beta bound tubulin, inhibited polymerization and activated BubR1/Mad2 with apoptosis; checkpoint activation accompanied injury, not rescue.

records.title: Identification of Core Gene Expression Signature and Key Pathways in Colorectal Cancer.
records.model: CRC samples and MAD2L1-knockdown cells
records.note: MAD2L1 loss impaired cycle and induced apoptosis; BUB1B was a coidentified hub rather than the functionally tested target.

records.title: Conformation-specific anti-Mad2 monoclonal antibodies for the dissection of checkpoint signaling.
records.model: MAD2 antibody development and MCC/APC-C complex analysis
records.note: Antibodies distinguished open/closed MAD2 and checkpoint complex makeup; assay tools, not therapeutic administration.

records.title: A spindle assembly checkpoint protein functions in prophase I arrest and prometaphase progression.
records.model: BubR1-depleted mouse oocytes
records.note: BubR1 loss both released prophase arrest and blocked completion of MI through reduced Cdh1/APC activity; highlights stage-specific functions without drug correction.

records.title: Screening and authentication of molecular markers in malignant glioblastoma based on gene expression profiles.
records.model: Glioblastoma GEO and public validation datasets
records.note: BUB1B was one of ten hub genes associated with GBM; no administered chemosensitivity experiment despite therapeutic framing.

records.title: Monopolar spindle 1 (MPS1) kinase promotes production of closed MAD2 (C-MAD2) conformer and assembly of the mitotic checkpoint complex.
records.model: MPS1-inhibited cells expressing locked-closed MAD2
records.note: Reversine disrupted MCC interactions; C-MAD2 expression restored checkpoint despite failed kinetochore localization, so the rescue was genetic and the drug caused damage.

records.title: Investigating how the Spindle Assembly Checkpoint inhibits the onset of anaphase
records.model: BubR1/MCC cell-biology and biochemical thesis
records.note: Saved thesis text discusses Bub3-dependent BubR1 localization but ends '(continues)'; full saved text read, complete thesis findings remain unresolved.

records.title: Protein interaction domain mapping of human kinetochore protein Blinkin reveals a consensus motif for binding of spindle assembly checkpoint proteins Bub1 and BubR1.
records.model: Blinkin replacement/motif mutants in human cells
records.note: Restoring a Bub1/BubR1-binding N-terminal segment relieved dominant-negative Blinkin effects; genetic architecture, not administered rescue.

records.title: RIPK1 and Caspase-8 Ensure Chromosome Stability Independently of Their Role in Cell Death and Inflammation.
records.model: Mitosis-specific inhibition and Ripk1/caspase-8 genetic models
records.note: RIPK1/caspase-8 loss or inhibition caused alignment defects through PLK1/BUBR1 regulation; broad caspase blockade cannot inherit a cleavage-resistant BubR1 benefit.

records.title: A conserved arginine-rich motif within the hypervariable N-domain of Drosophila centromeric histone H3 (CenH3) mediates BubR1 recruitment.
records.model: Drosophila CenH3 tethering and cross-species reporter constructs
records.note: An arginine-rich CenH3 N-terminal motif recruited BubR1 and silenced a reporter; reporter silencing is not correction of a disease phenotype.

records.title: A mitosis-sensing caspase activation platform? New insights into the PIDDosome.
records.model: PIDDosome/BUBR1 mechanistic commentary
records.note: BUBR1 directly blocked DNA-damage PIDDosome assembly at kinetochores; no pharmacologic or MVA-muscle rescue described.

records.title: Spindle proteins are differentially expressed in the various histological subtypes of testicular germ cell tumors.
records.model: 279 testicular germ-cell tumor specimens
records.note: BUB1B/MAD2 were reduced in carcinoma-in-situ and BUB1B in nonseminomas; immunostaining rather than treatment.

records.title: Assays for the spindle assembly checkpoint in cell culture.
records.model: Mammalian SAC live imaging/gene targeting/biochemical methods
records.note: Describes assays for checkpoint behavior and MCC/APC-C regulation; no novel administered rescue result.

records.title: Mitotic checkpoint genes, hsMAD2 and BubR1, in oesophageal squamous cancer cells and their association with 5-fluorouracil and cisplatin-based radiochemotherapy.
records.model: ESCC cell lines and radiochemotherapy patients
records.note: Lower checkpoint expression linked to greater taxane sensitivity in two cell lines, while patient radiochemotherapy response did not correlate; not tissue restoration.

records.title: FTO Knockout Causes Chromosome Instability and G2/M Arrest in Mouse GC-1 Cells.
records.model: FTO-knockout mouse GC-1 spermatogonia
records.note: Wild-type but not catalytically inactive FTO partly rescued instability/arrest; m6A on Bub1b and other regulators was directly targeted, without a drug experiment.

records.title: Susceptibility of human cumulus cells to bisphenol a In vitro.
records.model: Primary human cumulus cells
records.note: High-concentration BPA reduced CDC20/BUB1B/HAS2 and increased caspase-3-positive cells; imposed toxicant damage without rescue treatment.

records.title: Expression of BUBR1 in human oral potentially malignant disorders and squamous cell carcinoma.
records.model: Oral premalignant lesions and SCC immunostaining
records.note: BUBR1 staining rose from normal to premalignant to malignant tissue; no intervention or efficacy measured.

records.title: Key Genes and Prognostic Analysis in HER2+ Breast Cancer.
records.model: HER2-positive breast cancer datasets
records.note: BUB1B was among ten upregulated hubs, while TPX2/RRM2/DLGAP5 dominated risk analysis; no drug testing.

records.title: G2/M inhibitors as pharmacotherapeutic opportunities for glioblastoma: the old, the new, and the future.
records.model: Glioblastoma G2/M therapies reviewed
records.note: Reviews antimitotic regulators including BUBR1 and investigational inhibitors; abstract provides no distinct healthy-tissue rescue experiment.

records.title: Anti-malarial drug dihydroartemisinin downregulates the expression levels of CDK1 and CCNB1 in liver cancer.
records.model: Liver cancer expression networks and treated cells
records.note: DHA reduced CDK1/CCNB1 and tumor-cell proliferation; BUB1B was a screened hub, not a demonstrated pharmacologically rescued target.

records.title: BubR1- and Polo-coated DNA tethers facilitate poleward segregation of acentric chromatids.
records.model: Drosophila neural stem cells with I-CreI-induced acentric chromosomes
records.note: BubR1/Polo-coated tethers enabled acentric segregation and survival; reduced function worsened loss, with no pharmacologic correction.

records.title: Extract of bulbus Fritillaria cirrhosa perturbs spindle assembly checkpoint, induces mitotic aberrations and genomic instability in human colon epithelial cell line.
records.model: Human NCM460 colon epithelial cells
records.note: At 80/160 micrograms/mL extract reduced BubR1/CENP-E/Mad2 and increased segregation errors/micronuclei; a harmful preparation distinct from Phyllanthus.

records.title: BubR1 is an effector of multiple mitotic kinases that specifies kinetochore: microtubule attachments and checkpoint.
records.model: BubR1 phosphorylation/attachment literature
records.note: Different phosphosites respond to attachment/tension and S670 must later be dephosphorylated; no single uniformly beneficial phosphorylation direction or drug result.

records.title: Chromosome damage in mitosis induces BubR1 activation and prometaphase arrest.
records.model: Mammalian cells with mitotic double-strand breaks and BubR1 siRNA
records.note: DNA breaks induced BubR1 hyperphosphorylation/kinetochore retention; BubR1 depletion removed delay rather than repairing chromosomes.

records.title: Identification of Four Pathological Stage-Relevant Genes in Association with Progression and Prognosis in Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma by Integrated Bioinformatics Analysis.
records.model: ccRCC stage-specific expression datasets
records.note: UBE2C/BUB1B/RRM2/TPX2 correlated with stage and survival with expression validation; no intervention experiment.

records.title: Combinatorial Bioinformatics Analysis Reveals Novel Biomarkers for Improved Ovarian Cancer Prognosis
records.model: Ovarian cancer microarray/survival data; preprint
records.note: BUB1B appeared in an upregulated cell-cycle set with prognostic associations; no administered therapeutic validation.

records.title: Identification of a Four-Gene Signature With Prognostic Significance in Endometrial Cancer Using Weighted-Gene Correlation Network Analysis.
records.model: Endometrial hyperplasia/cancer datasets
records.note: Four-gene nomogram assigned a protective coefficient to BUB1B despite adverse overall risk group; association is not evidence that raising it treats cancer.

records.title: Polo-like kinase 1 facilitates chromosome alignment during prometaphase through BubR1.
records.model: BubR1/Plk1-depleted human cells with addback variants
records.note: Phosphomimetic BubR1-2E rescued alignment even after combined Plk1/BubR1 depletion; wild-type addback required Plk1, defining a genetic bypass without drug implementation.

records.title: Identification of 5 Hub Genes Related to the Early Diagnosis, Tumour Stage, and Poor Outcomes of Hepatitis B Virus-Related Hepatocellular Carcinoma by Bioinformatics Analysis.
records.model: HBV-HCC expression/prognosis databases
records.note: BUB1B was among top ten hubs but not final five highlighted diagnostic/prognostic genes; no treatment tested.

records.title: Elucidating the role of Bub1 in human checkpoint signalling
records.model: BUB1 CRISPR knockout hTERT-RPE1 cells; thesis
records.note: Investigates dual KNL1/RZZ checkpoint routes; saved text stops before results at '(continues)', so omitted findings need original thesis.

records.title: The mechanisms of the spindle assembly checkpoint and the mitotic cell death
records.model: CDC20-MAD2 proximity ligation in HeLa cells; thesis
records.note: Studies spatial/temporal MCC assembly, but source ends '(continues)' before complete findings; all available saved text was read.

records.title: lncRNA Expression Reveals the Potential Regulatory Roles in Hepatocyte Proliferation during Rat Liver Regeneration.
records.model: Rat liver regeneration transcriptomics
records.note: Bub1b was a proliferation-associated hub in lncRNA-mRNA networks; expression during regenerative growth is not administered rescue evidence.

records.title: Image analysis of mechanistic protein biomarkers for the characterization of genotoxicants: Aneugens, clastogens, and reactive oxygen species inducers.
records.model: TK6 cells with imaging biomarkers
records.note: BubR1-S640 phosphorylation identified spindle-interfering aneugens; a raised phosphosignal can indicate genotoxicity rather than treatment benefit.

records.title: BubR1 as a prognostic marker for recurrence-free survival rates in epithelial ovarian cancers.
records.model: 160 ovarian carcinoma specimens after first-line therapy
records.note: Positive BubR1 staining associated with 27 versus 83 months recurrence-free survival and advanced disease; no randomized intervention comparison.

records.title: Depletion of BubR1 promotes premature centrosomal localization of cyclin B1 and accelerates mitotic entry.
records.model: BubR1-siRNA HeLa cells during G2
records.note: BubR1 depletion lowered cyclin B1 yet prematurely localized it to centrosomes with aberrant CDK1 activity; no corrective compound tested.

records.title: Identification of Core Genes Related to Progression and Prognosis of Hepatocellular Carcinoma and Small-Molecule Drug Predication.
records.model: HCC WGCNA/survival/CMap analysis
records.note: Nine-gene risk signature included BUB1B and CMap nominated molecules; drug predictions were not administered efficacy results.

records.title: Differential gene expression induced by Verteporfin in endometrial cancer cells.
records.model: Endometrial cancer cells and mouse subcutaneous tumors
records.note: Verteporfin altered CDC23/BUB1B-associated expression and regressed tumors by inhibiting cell-cycle proteins; cancer cytotoxicity, not healthy-tissue rescue.

records.title: Characterization of spindle checkpoint kinase Mps1 reveals domain with functional and structural similarities to tetratricopeptide repeat motifs of Bub1 and BubR1 checkpoint kinases.
records.model: Human MPS1 N-terminal TPR structure/overexpression assays
records.note: TPR overexpression displaced endogenous MPS1 and weakened alignment/arrest; structural homology to BubR1 does not establish a restoration drug.

records.title: Identification of CDK1 as a candidate marker in cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma by integrated bioinformatics analysis.
records.model: Cutaneous SCC expression datasets and validation
records.note: BUB1B was one candidate hub; experimental emphasis was CDK1 expression, with no drug-rescue test.

records.title: Proper chromosome alignment depends on BRCA2 phosphorylation by PLK1
records.model: BRCA2 phosphosite cancer variants and PLK1/PP2A/BUBR1 complex; preprint
records.note: BRCA2 S206C/T207A weakened PLK1 docking and disrupted a PP2A/phospho-BUBR1 complex causing aneuploidy; no administered rescue.

records.title: Identification of Potential Target Genes in HER-2 Positive Breast Cancer by Bioinformatics Analysis.
records.model: HER2-positive breast cancer expression datasets
records.note: The network-derived BUB1B signal accompanies adverse survival; the abstract reports no administered agent or rescue experiment.

records.title: Integrative analysis of key candidate genes and signaling pathways in ovarian cancer by bioinformatics.
records.model: Ovarian cancer GEO datasets and public validation datasets
records.note: BUB1B belongs to a mitotic hub set; the authors explicitly leave experimental validation of the candidate genes for future work.

records.title: Tension-sensitive Plk1 phosphorylation on BubR1 regulates the stability of kinetochore microtubule interactions.
records.model: Mitotic cells with BubR1 phosphosite analysis
records.note: CDK1 priming enables tension-sensitive PLK1 phosphorylation of BubR1 S676, linking attachment stability to alignment without an apparent checkpoint role.

records.title: Overexpression of the ∆Np73 isoform is associated with centrosome amplification in brain tumor cell lines.
records.model: HGG-02, GM7 and Daoy brain tumor cell lines
records.note: DeltaNp73 overexpression increases centrosome amplification, while the proposed centrosomal colocalization with BubR1 was not detected.

records.title: PTEN is a negative regulator of mitotic checkpoint complex during the cell cycle.
records.model: Cell-cycle PTEN localization and depletion experiments
records.note: Arsenic trioxide alters nuclear PTEN and checkpoint-complex associations; PTEN depletion increases MCC formation and chromosome instability, not healthy-tissue rescue.

records.title: Single-nucleus RNA-sequencing reveals novel potential mechanisms of ovarian insufficiency in 45,X Turner Syndrome
records.model: Human 45,X and 46,XX fetal ovaries
records.note: The small fetal-ovary study associates reduced BUB1B and other cell-cycle transcripts with germ-cell depletion and altered oogonial states without intervention.

records.title: Unattached kinetochores catalyze production of an anaphase inhibitor that requires a Mad2 template to prime Cdc20 for BubR1 binding.
records.model: Purified chromosomes and spindle-checkpoint proteins
records.note: A kinetochore Mad1-Mad2 template primes Cdc20 for BubR1 binding and anaphase inhibition in a reconstituted system.

records.title: Genome-wide profiling identification of prognostic novel signatures in papillary renal cell carcinoma based on large-scale sequencing data
records.model: Papillary renal cell carcinoma sequencing datasets
records.note: BUB1B is one of eight prognostic cell-cycle candidates; immunohistochemical validation centers on PTTG1 rather than a drug intervention.

records.title: Cdk1 phosphorylation of BubR1 controls spindle checkpoint arrest and Plk1-mediated formation of the 3F3/2 epitope.
records.model: Xenopus BubR1 phosphorylation and checkpoint experiments
records.note: CDK1 phosphorylation of BubR1 Thr605 primes Plx1 recruitment and formation of the 3F3/2 epitope required for checkpoint arrest.

records.title: LSD1 is required for chromosome segregation during mitosis.
records.model: Mitotic cells with LSD1 depletion and gene re-expression
records.note: LSD1 depletion lowers MAD2 and BUBR1 and disrupts segregation; exogenous MAD2 and BUBR1 partly rescue the defects, identifying transcriptional support without a beneficial drug test.

records.title: SKA1/2/3 serves as a biomarker for poor prognosis in human lung adenocarcinoma.
records.model: Lung adenocarcinoma public datasets and clinical samples
records.note: SKA-family overexpression predicts poor outcome and BUB1B appears in the associated interaction network; no rescue treatment is tested.

records.title: Novel molecular markers of malignancy in histologically normal and benign breast.
records.model: Human breast specimens and tissue microarrays
records.note: BUB1B protein helps validate a molecular malignancy signature that can appear in histologically normal or benign breast samples.

records.title: C12, a combretastatin-A4 analog, exerts anticancer activity by targeting microtubules.
records.model: MCF-7 and other cancer cells; MCF-7 xenografts
records.note: C12 suppresses microtubule dynamics and tumor growth while increasing BubR1/Mad2 checkpoint signals and disrupting chromosome movement; this is tumor killing.

records.title: Combining Bioinformatics and Experiments to Identify and Verify Key Genes with Prognostic Values in Endometrial Carcinoma.
records.model: Endometrial carcinoma expression cohorts and tissue validation
records.note: BUB1B is among hub genes associated with poor prognosis, whereas tissue validation focuses on UBE2C; no administered treatment is evaluated.

records.title: Molecular Signature of Subtypes of Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer by Large-Scale Transcriptional Profiling: Identification of Key Modules and Genes by Weighted Gene Co-Expression Network Analysis (WGCNA).
records.model: Non-small-cell lung cancer RNA-sequencing cohorts
records.note: BUB1B emerges as an adenocarcinoma network hub associated with clinical aggressiveness and outcome without causal intervention.

records.title: Gene Ontology and Expression Studies of Strigolactone Analogues on a Hepatocellular Carcinoma Cell Line.
records.model: HepG2 hepatocellular carcinoma cells
records.note: TIT3 treatment reduces BUB1B and other mitotic, epigenetic and DNA-repair transcripts in a proapoptotic anticancer setting.

records.title: B56-PP2A regulates motor dynamics for mitotic chromosome alignment.
records.model: Mitotic cells depleted of B56-PP2A and HSET/KIFC1
records.note: HSET/KIFC1 codepletion restores chromosome movement and stable kinetochore fibers after B56 depletion, suggesting a motor-balance route but no inhibitor is tested.

records.title: Differential promoter methylation may be a key molecular mechanism in regulating BubR1 expression in cancer cells.
records.model: Cancer cell promoter-methylation studies; colorectal tumor samples
records.note: Demethylation relieves MBD2/HDAC1 occupancy and raises BubR1 expression; the abstract does not establish functional rescue of BUB1B-deficient cells.

records.title: Phosphorylation sites in BubR1 that regulate kinetochore attachment, tension, and mitotic exit.
records.model: BubR1 phosphosite and kinetochore experiments
records.note: Distinct phosphorylation sites separate attachment sensing from tension sensing and coordinate error correction; no beneficial administered agent is described.

records.title: Co-expression Network Analysis Identifies Four Hub Genes Associated With Prognosis in Soft Tissue Sarcoma.
records.model: Soft tissue sarcoma coexpression datasets
records.note: BUB1B belongs to a four-gene hub set linked to worse overall and disease-free survival in sarcoma without intervention evidence.

records.title: Screening and Identification of Key Biomarkers in Inflammatory Breast Cancer Through Integrated Bioinformatic Analyses.
records.model: Inflammatory breast cancer expression cohorts and clinical samples
records.note: BUB1B is one of six cell-cycle hubs validated by expression and survival analyses, without an administered therapy or functional rescue.

records.title: HBV X protein targets hBubR1, which induces dysregulation of the mitotic checkpoint.
records.model: HBV X protein expression and binding studies
records.note: Viral HBx binding weakens the BubR1-CDC20 interaction and promotes mitotic slippage and chromosome bridges; a binding-defective HBx truncation lacks these effects.

records.title: Integrative Proteogenomic Analyses Identify TOPs as Prognostic Markers and Therapeutic Targets in Sarcoma
records.model: Sarcoma public proteogenomic and clinical datasets
records.note: The TOP-family analysis links BUB1B and other associated hubs to unfavorable prognosis but reports no therapeutic intervention.

records.title: Drosophila BubR1 is essential for meiotic sister-chromatid cohesion and maintenance of synaptonemal complex.
records.model: Drosophila bubR1 kinase-domain mutant meiosis
records.note: A viable allele retaining mitotic checkpoint activity nevertheless disrupts meiotic sister cohesion and prematurely disassembles the synaptonemal complex.

records.title: Opposing roles for p16Ink4a and p19Arf in senescence and ageing caused by BubR1 insufficiency.
records.model: BubR1-insufficient mice with p16Ink4a or p19Arf inactivation
records.note: Loss of p16 attenuates skeletal-muscle and fat senescence and premature aging, whereas p19Arf loss worsens them; this is genetic evidence, not a tested senolytic.

records.title: Identification of genetic polymorphisms in unexplained recurrent spontaneous abortion based on whole exome sequencing.
records.model: Couples with unexplained recurrent spontaneous abortion
records.note: Exome screening identifies paternal BUB1B p.R550* among candidate pathogenic variants; the study does not establish a treatment response.

records.title: Distinct Roles of the Chromosomal Passenger Complex in the Detection of and Response to Errors in Kinetochore-Microtubule Attachment.
records.model: Xenopus egg extracts with altered chromosomal passenger complex localization
records.note: An active CPC excluded from centromeres cannot correct attachment errors and fails to assemble the tension-sensing kinetochore context that recruits BubR1.

records.title: A Next-Generation Sequencing of Plasma Exosome-Derived microRNAs and Target Gene Analysis with a Microarray Database of Thermally Injured Skins: Identification of Blood-to-Tissue Interactions at Early Burn Stage.
records.model: Severe burn patient exosomes and burned-skin expression datasets
records.note: BUB1B appears in a predicted miRNA-mRNA network linking circulating exosomes and burned skin, without perturbation or treatment validation.

records.title: Transcriptome profiling of human oocytes experiencing recurrent total fertilization failure.
records.model: Human zygotes from recurrent total fertilization failure cases
records.note: Single-cell profiles associate reduced BUB1B and other cell-cycle transcripts with pronuclear arrest in a limited patient sample.

records.title: BubR1 and CENP-E have antagonistic effects upon the stability of microtubule-kinetochore attachments in Drosophila S2 cell mitosis.
records.model: Drosophila S2 cells depleted of BubR1 and CENP-meta
records.note: CENP-meta codepletion partly rescues unattached chromosomes after BubR1 depletion; MG132 arrest alone rarely restores full alignment, so a CENP-E inhibitor benefit remains untested.

records.title: Indibulin dampens microtubule dynamics and produces synergistic antiproliferative effect with vinblastine in MCF-7 cells: Implications in cancer chemotherapy.
records.model: MCF-7 breast cancer and differentiated or undifferentiated SH-SY5Y cells
records.note: Indibulin activates BubR1/Mad2 while damaging spindle dynamics and synergizing with vinblastine; relative neuronal sparing is distinct from rescuing BUB1B deficiency.

records.title: Lung cellular senescence is independent of aging in a mouse model of COPD/emphysema.
records.model: Young and old mice exposed to chronic cigarette smoke
records.note: Smoke increases a senescence-associated transcript set including Bub1b while impairing lung structure and function; higher expression here accompanies damage.

records.title: Aging-associated vascular phenotype in mutant mice with low levels of BubR1.
records.model: BubR1-low mutant mouse arteries
records.note: Mutant arteries show smooth-muscle depletion, fibrosis, reduced nitric-oxide signaling and impaired responses even to an exogenous NO donor; these are challenge assays rather than rescue.

records.title: BubR1 and APC/EB1 cooperate to maintain metaphase chromosome alignment.
records.model: Xenopus egg extracts and purified BubR1/APC/EB1 proteins
records.note: BubR1 associates with APC and EB1 and phosphorylates APC in a complex needed for stable metaphase alignment.

records.title: Identification of potential key genes and pathways in hepatitis B virus-associated hepatocellular carcinoma by bioinformatics analyses.
records.model: HBV-associated hepatocellular carcinoma expression cohorts
records.note: BUB1B is among strongly increased cell-cycle genes in tumors compared with HBV-infected nontumor tissue, with no functional drug experiment.

records.title: BubR1 is required for a sustained mitotic spindle checkpoint arrest in human cancer cells treated with tubulin-targeting pyrrolo-1,5-benzoxazepines.
records.model: Human cancer cell lines with BubR1 depletion
records.note: BubR1 supports PBOX-induced arrest; depletion reduces arrest without improving apoptotic efficacy and leaves polyploid cells, not normal-cell rescue.

records.title: Bioinformatics Analysis of Candidate Genes and Pathways Related to Hepatocellular Carcinoma in China: A Study Based on Public Databases.
records.model: Chinese hepatocellular carcinoma public expression datasets
records.note: The ten-gene prognostic hub list includes BUB1B, with database validation but no candidate treatment tested.

records.title: Identification of the Hub Genes Associated with the Prognosis of Ovarian Cancer Patients via Integrated Bioinformatics Analysis and Experimental Validation.
records.model: Ovarian cancer datasets and SKOV3 cells
records.note: BUB1B is a prognostic hub, but the actual functional interventions knock down KIF11 or KIF23 to suppress cancer proliferation and invasion.

records.title: Phosphodiesterase Type 5 Inhibitors Synergize Vincristine in Killing Castration-Resistant Prostate Cancer Through Amplifying Mitotic Arrest Signaling.
records.model: Castration-resistant prostate cancer cells and tumor model
records.note: PDE5 inhibition strengthens vincristine-induced mitotic arrest, BUBR1 phosphorylation and cleavage, mitochondrial damage and tumor killing; it does not demonstrate tissue rescue.

records.title: Playing polo during mitosis: PLK1 takes the lead.
records.model: Review of mitotic PLK1 regulation
records.note: The review places PLK1 upstream of Aurora B, Haspin, MPS1, BUB1 and BUBR1 regulation without reporting a new administered-agent rescue.

records.title: The closed form of Mad2 is bound to Mad1 and Cdc20 at unattached kinetochores.
records.model: Mitotic cells with Cdc20 depletion and re-expression
records.note: Wild-type Cdc20, but not a Mad2-binding mutant, restores kinetochore Mad2 after depletion, clarifying a localization assay rather than a drug rescue.

records.title: The interaction between mitotic checkpoint proteins, CENP-E and BubR1, is diminished in epothilone B-resistant A549 cells.
records.model: A549 and epothilone-B-resistant EpoB40 cancer cells
records.note: Drug-resistant cells have reduced CENP-E/BubR1 interaction and kinetochore targeting; CENP-E overexpression does not change sensitivity and depletion moderately increases it.

records.title: Melatonin Improves In Vitro Development of Vitrified-Warmed Mouse Germinal Vesicle Oocytes Potentially via Modulation of Spindle Assembly Checkpoint-Related Genes.
records.model: Vitrified-warmed mouse germinal-vesicle oocytes
records.note: Melatonin at 10^-7 M throughout the experiment improves maturation, spindle morphology and mitochondrial/redox measures alongside checkpoint-gene expression changes; BUBR1 causality is unproven.

records.title: BubR1 deficiency results in enhanced activation of MEK and ERKs upon microtubule stresses.
records.model: BubR1-haploinsufficient mouse fibroblasts and BubR1-depleted HeLa cells
records.note: Microtubule stress hyperactivates MEK/ERK in BubR1-deficient cells and supports cell-cycle completion despite damage; the abstract does not establish beneficial pathway inhibition.

records.title: Expression of mitotic checkpoint proteins BUB1B and MAD2L1 in salivary duct carcinomas.
records.model: Twenty-seven salivary duct carcinomas
records.note: BUB1B and MAD2L1 staining fails to predict survival in this cohort, whereas nodal status has prognostic value.

records.title: Screening and Functional Prediction of Key Candidate Genes in Hepatitis B Virus-Associated Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
records.model: HBV-associated hepatocellular carcinoma expression dataset
records.note: BUB1B is one of ten network hubs associated with overall survival; predicted upstream regulators are not administered interventions.

records.title: Comprehensive Analysis of Differential Gene Expression to Identify Common Gene Signatures in Multiple Cancers.
records.model: Five cancer expression datasets
records.note: Cross-cancer analysis nominates BUB1B among shared adverse-survival hubs and offers a target hypothesis without treatment experiments.

records.title: Novel Mutations and Genes That Impact on Growth in Short Stature of Undefined Aetiology: The EPIGROW Study.
records.model: European children with unexplained short stature
records.note: BUB1B appears in gene-based burden analyses of short stature, distinct from the individual mutations classified as diagnostic findings.

records.title: Aneuploidy impairs hematopoietic stem cell fitness and is selected against in regenerating tissues in vivo.
records.model: Aneuploid hematopoietic stem cells and Bub1b-hypomorphic mice
records.note: Aneuploid cells lose competitive fitness during hematopoietic reconstitution, and regenerative tissues select for euploid cells in Bub1b mutants; increased proliferation alone is not a fidelity endpoint.

records.title: Identification of potential key genes for HER-2 positive breast cancer based on bioinformatics analysis.
records.model: HER2-positive breast cancer expression cohorts
records.note: BUB1B is a network hub, but the reported adverse survival association specifically concerns RAC1 and RRM2.

records.title: Mutant mice with small amounts of BubR1 display accelerated age-related gliosis.
records.model: BubR1-hypomorphic mouse brain
records.note: Low BubR1 produces early cortical/thalamic astroglial activation and later microgliosis, establishing brain pathology without a treatment test.

records.title: Structural characterisation of the N-terminal α-helical region of BubR1 essential for the mitotic checkpoint
records.model: Purified human BubR1 and yeast Mad3 N-terminal proteins
records.note: The thesis develops stable N-terminal proteins and resolves a TPR-like helical fold relevant to checkpoint ligand binding; one crystallographic detail is garbled in the saved text.

records.title: Distinct Genomic Alterations in Prostate Tumors Derived from African American Men.
records.model: Prostate tumors from African American and European American cohorts
records.note: BUB1B copy-number alterations differ between cohorts, while the strongest clinical associations concern other genomic regions; no rescue is studied.

records.title: 212Pb-radioimmunotherapy potentiates paclitaxel-induced cell killing efficacy by perturbing the mitotic spindle checkpoint.
records.model: Human colon-cancer intraperitoneal xenografts in mice
records.note: Sequential paclitaxel and targeted alpha radiation reduce BubR1 expression/phosphorylation while increasing micronuclei and apoptosis, consistent with tumor-directed checkpoint disruption.

records.title: Liver regeneration in aged mice: new insights.
records.model: Review of liver regeneration in aging rodents
records.note: The review connects reduced BubR1 with impaired regeneration and discusses young plasma, autophagy and senescent-cell removal, without a new BubR1-directed drug experiment.

records.title: Insight into residues involved in the structure and function of the breast cancer associated protein human gamma synuclein.
records.model: Computational structural modeling of gamma-synuclein complexes
records.note: Models predict gamma-synuclein interfaces with BubR1, Hsp70 and an ANK peptide; earlier peptide activity is background rather than newly demonstrated rescue.

records.title: Novel downstream molecular targets of SIRT1 in melanoma: a quantitative proteomics approach.
records.model: Human melanoma cells with parallel SIRT1/SIRT2 silencing
records.note: Tenovin-1 lowers BUB-family proteins, and selective genetic silencing attributes this effect to SIRT1 rather than SIRT2 in melanoma, making sirtuin direction context dependent.

records.title: Pharicin A, a novel natural ent-kaurene diterpenoid, induces mitotic arrest and mitotic catastrophe of cancer cells by interfering with BubR1 function.
records.model: Leukemia and solid-tumor-derived cells
records.note: Pharicin A directly binds BubR1 in vitro and causes misalignment, abnormal localization and premature chromatid separation; binding is disruptive rather than restorative.

records.title: Identification of Potential Key Genes for Hepatitis B Virus-Associated Hepatocellular Carcinoma by Bioinformatics Analysis.
records.model: HBV-positive hepatocellular carcinoma public datasets
records.note: BUB1B belongs to the ten-hub list, while TOP2A and CDC20 receive the specific survival and alpha-fetoprotein associations.

records.title: Identification and Analysis of Potential Key Genes Associated With Hepatocellular Carcinoma Based on Integrated Bioinformatics Methods.
records.model: Hepatocellular carcinoma datasets and toxicogenomics database
records.note: Topotecan, oxaliplatin and azathioprine are database-derived candidates predicted to lower seven hubs including BUB1B; no administered-drug experiment is reported.

records.title: p53 activation in response to mitotic spindle damage requires signaling via BubR1-mediated phosphorylation.
records.model: BubR1-depleted cells and p53-null cells
records.note: Exogenous BubR1 restores p53 stability after depletion, while combined BubR1 and p53 deficiency accelerates instability under spindle stress.

records.title: Reprogramming to pluripotency can conceal somatic cell chromosomal instability.
records.model: Reprogrammed BubR1- or RanBP2-insufficient mouse fibroblasts
records.note: BubR1-hypomorphic fibroblasts yield predominantly aneuploid and unstable iPSC clones, showing that successful reprogramming does not establish genomic rescue.

records.title: Identification of key genes controlling cancer stem cell characteristics in gastric cancer.
records.model: Gastric cancer expression and stemness datasets
records.note: BUB1B appears in a sixteen-gene stemness module; survival-consistent candidates singled out are RAD54L, TPX2 and XRCC2.

records.title: Overexpression of the mitotic checkpoint genes BUB1 and BUBR1 is associated with genomic complexity in clear cell kidney carcinomas.
records.model: Clear-cell renal carcinoma and normal kidney specimens
records.note: Higher BUB1/BUBR1 expression correlates with copy-number complexity and tumor grade, providing no evidence that abundance alone improves fidelity.

records.title: Small-molecule inducer of cancer cell polyploidy promotes apoptosis or senescence: Implications for therapy.
records.model: Cancer cells and in vivo tumor models; normal proliferating comparators
records.note: R1530 downregulates BubR1 and drives abortive mitosis, polyploidy and cancer-cell death or senescence; normal-cell resistance is not BUB1B-deficiency rescue.

records.title: Sister centromere fusion during meiosis I depends on maintaining cohesins and destabilizing microtubule attachments.
records.model: Drosophila oocytes with SPC105R/PP1-87B pathway perturbation
records.note: PP1-87B maintains sister-centromere fusion by antagonizing Polo/BubR1-dependent attachment stabilization, distinct from the cohesin-protection route.

records.title: Caspase-3-dependent mitotic checkpoint inactivation by the small-molecule inducers of mitotic slippage SU6656 and geraldol.
records.model: T98G and caspase-3-deficient or complemented MCF-7 cells
records.note: MG-132 or DEVD-CHO blocks SU6656/geraldol-induced slippage and BubR1/Cdc20 degradation; this limited drug-challenge result does not show restored normal segregation or survival benefit.

records.title: Human Blinkin/AF15q14 is required for chromosome alignment and the mitotic checkpoint through direct interaction with Bub1 and BubR1.
records.model: Human cells with Blinkin/KNL1 depletion and interaction analysis
records.note: Blinkin directly docks Bub1/BubR1 at kinetochores, and its depletion causes rapid checkpoint-defective mitosis and chromosome misalignment.

records.title: Mitotic arrest-associated apoptosis induced by sodium arsenite in A375 melanoma cells is BUBR1-dependent.
records.model: A375 melanoma cells
records.note: Roscovitine reduces arsenite-induced checkpoint signaling and protects melanoma cells from apoptosis; this is tumor-cell survival under chemotherapy, not healthy-tissue rescue.

records.title: Ajuba: a new microtubule-associated protein that interacts with BUBR1 and Aurora B at kinetochores in metaphase.
records.model: Mitotic cells and purified Ajuba binding assays
records.note: Ajuba binds microtubules and interacts with Aurora B and BubR1; BubR1 depletion disrupts alignment and changes Ajuba localization.

records.title: Comprehensive analysis of transcriptome data stemness indices identifies key genes for controlling cancer stem cell characteristics in gastric cancer.
records.model: Gastric cancer transcriptome and stemness datasets
records.note: A nineteen-gene proliferative module includes BUB1B, while the stemness score associates with both advanced pathology and longer survival in this dataset.

records.title: Method for screening an anticancer drug using acetylated BubR1
records.model: Patent proposing an acetylated-BubR1 cancer-cell screen
records.note: The patent describes candidate-compound screening by acetylated BubR1 levels and associated reagents but identifies no successful restorative agent.

records.title: Identification of potential therapeutic targets for melanoma using gene expression analysis.
records.model: Normal melanocyte and metastatic melanoma expression samples
records.note: BUB1B is a highly connected expression-network candidate; the abstract explicitly states that further experiments are needed.

records.title: Identification of potential therapeutic targets for colorectal cancer by bioinformatics analysis.
records.model: Paired colorectal cancer and normal-tissue expression datasets
records.note: BUB1B is prominent in a cell-cycle interaction network, while predicted miRNA targets involve other genes and remain unvalidated.

records.title: Identification of Hub Genes Associated With Progression and Prognosis in Patients With Bladder Cancer.
records.model: Bladder cancer datasets with six-gene survival signature
records.note: BUB1B contributes to a six-gene prediction model for disease progression and survival, without a drug or genetic rescue experiment.

records.title: Dynein light intermediate chain 1 is required for progress through the spindle assembly checkpoint.
records.model: Human cells depleted of dynein LIC1
records.note: Wild-type or phosphomimetic LIC1 restores checkpoint silencing, whereas BubR1 depletion suppresses the delay by disabling checkpoint signaling rather than proving fidelity rescue.

records.title: BubR1 is involved in regulation of DNA damage responses.
records.model: BubR1-haploinsufficient mouse fibroblasts and human knockdown cells
records.note: BubR1-deficient cells leave mitosis despite DNA damage and show reduced p53/p21 and compromised PARP1 retention, cautioning against equating division with repair.

records.title: The closed form of Mad2 is bound to Mad1 and Cdc20 at unattached kinetochores
records.model: Mitotic cells with Cdc20 depletion and re-expression; preprint record
records.note: This preprint also finds that Mad2-binding-competent Cdc20 restores kinetochore Mad2, so Mad2 abundance there cannot directly substitute for a Mad1 measurement.

records.title: The Mitotic Checkpoint Complex Requires an Evolutionary Conserved Cassette to Bind and Inhibit Active APC/C.
records.model: Cells with BubR1 ABBA-motif mutations
records.note: Mutating the ABBA motifs prevents MCC binding to active APC/C and abolishes checkpoint arrest, defining a required structural cassette rather than a drug target result.

records.title: A small-molecule inhibitor of Haspin alters the kinetochore functions of Aurora B.
records.model: HeLa cells with Haspin inhibition and forced Aurora B localization
records.note: Phosphatase inhibition reverses loss of Bub1/BubR1 recruitment under 5-ITu; forced centromeric Aurora B also restores recruitment yet fails to restore the checkpoint.

records.title: Selective vulnerability of aneuploid human cancer cells to inhibition of the spindle assembly checkpoint
records.model: Aneuploid and near-diploid human cancer cells; genetic and chemical screens
records.note: Aneuploid cells initially slip through SAC inhibition but accumulate mitotic defects and later lose fitness; KIF18A experiments modify sensitivity rather than demonstrate healthy-cell rescue.

records.title: All together now: Polo joins the kinase network controlling the spindle assembly checkpoint in Drosophila.
records.model: Commentary on Drosophila spindle-checkpoint kinase hierarchy
records.note: The article summarizes Polo-dependent Mps1 recruitment and BubR1 phosphorylation needed for Cdc20 recruitment and sustained checkpoint activity.

records.title: Chronic low dose arsenic exposure preferentially perturbs mitotic phase of the cell cycle.
records.model: Human BEAS-2B lung epithelial cells and keratinocytes
records.note: Chronic 0.5 micromolar arsenite sustains Akt/Plk1/BubR1 signaling and aneuploidy; Akt suppression reverses abnormalities, but the abstract does not identify whether suppression is pharmacologic or genetic.

records.title: HDAC3 promotes meiotic apparatus assembly in mouse oocytes by modulating tubulin acetylation.
records.model: HDAC3-depleted mouse oocytes with tubulin-mutant expression
records.note: HDAC3 loss increases kinetochore BubR1 despite poor attachments; deacetylation-mimetic tubulin K40R partly rescues spindle defects, cautioning against generic HDAC inhibition.

records.title: Aneuploid acute myeloid leukemia exhibits a signature of genomic alterations in the cell cycle and protein degradation machinery.
records.model: Aneuploid and euploid acute myeloid leukemia specimens
records.note: Integrated genomic data place BUB1B among cell-cycle alterations in aneuploid leukemia and nominate degradation machinery, without testing a treatment.

records.title: Cyclin B3 controls anaphase onset independent of spindle assembly checkpoint in meiotic oocytes.
records.model: Cyclin-B3-depleted meiotic oocytes
records.note: Securin RNAi restores metaphase-anaphase transition after cyclin B3 depletion, while Mad2 knockdown or Cdc20 overexpression does not; this arrest is checkpoint independent.

records.title: Structural and functional insights into the role of the N-terminal Mps1 TPR domain in the SAC (spindle assembly checkpoint).
records.model: Human Mps1 N-terminal structure and dimerization perturbations
records.note: The Mps1 TPR structure differs from Bub1/BubR1 in docking and dimerization features, and disrupting dimerization mislocalizes the kinase.

records.title: Genomic instability and increased expression of BUB1B and MAD2L1 genes in ductal breast carcinoma.
records.model: Invasive ductal breast carcinoma and control tissue
records.note: BUB1B transcripts correlate with intrachromosomal instability in tumors, again separating high expression from proven chromosome protection.

records.title: SUMOylated NKAP is essential for chromosome alignment by anchoring CENP-E to kinetochores.
records.model: Human cells with NKAP depletion and SUMOylation mutants
records.note: SUMOylated NKAP supports CENP-E binding at BubR1-containing kinetochores; depletion or defective SUMOylation causes misalignment and aneuploidy.

records.title: Subcellular localization of the spindle proteins Aurora A, Mad2, and BUBR1 assessed by immunohistochemistry.
records.model: Immunohistochemistry of normal and malignant human tissues
records.note: Antibody quality and antigen retrieval affect interpretation of BubR1 localization, which shifts from mainly cytoplasmic normal staining to mixed nuclear/cytoplasmic tumor staining.

records.title: Identification of key genes involved in the metastasis of clear cell renal cell carcinoma.
records.model: Metastatic and nonmetastatic clear-cell renal carcinoma datasets
records.note: BUB1B belongs to a broad metastasis-associated hub set correlated with survival; enrichment analysis supplies no administered-agent evidence.

records.title: Circulating levels of monocyte chemoattractant protein-1 as a potential measure of biological age in mice and frailty in humans.
administered_agents: pharmacologic aging interventions (unspecified; Ercc1 and wild-type mice)
