records.model: Wild-type, Ercc1-progeroid and BubR1-hypomorphic mice; frail humans
records.note: MCP-1 rises early in BubR1-hypomorphic mice, but the stated intervention-induced reductions are in Ercc1 and wild-type mice; drug identity and gene-specific treatment must be checked in primary text.

records.title: Identification of candidate genes associated with the pathogenesis of small cell lung cancer via integrated bioinformatics analysis.
records.model: Small-cell lung cancer expression datasets
records.note: BUB1B is one of five highly expressed hubs nominated for follow-up, based on integrated expression rather than a functional treatment study.

records.title: The human spindle assembly checkpoint protein Bub3 is required for the establishment of efficient kinetochore-microtubule attachments.
records.model: Human cells depleted of BubR1, Bub1 or Bub3
records.note: Aurora B inhibition partially rescues alignment in BubR1-depleted cells but worsens alignment after Bub1 or Bub3 depletion, making the benefit target-context specific.

records.title: Identification of a gene signature closely related to immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment predicting prognosis of patients in EGFR mutant lung adenocarcinoma
records.model: EGFR-mutant lung adenocarcinoma TCGA cohorts
records.note: A BUB1B/CENPE/BTLA signature predicts risk and immune-context differences, without administering checkpoint inhibitors or another treatment.

records.title: Molecular Profiling of Pheochromocytoma and Abdominal Paraganglioma Stratified by the PASS Algorithm Reveals Chromogranin B as Associated With Histologic Prediction of Malignant Behavior.
records.model: Pheochromocytoma and abdominal paraganglioma specimens
records.note: BUB1B has a histologic association, whereas chromogranin B is the strongest validated marker of aggressive behavior in tissue and plasma.

records.title: Microtubule capture by CENP-E silences BubR1-dependent mitotic checkpoint signaling.
records.model: Purified BubR1/CENP-E/microtubules and motorless-CENP-E experiments
records.note: Motorless CENP-E maintains BubR1 checkpoint activation despite attachment, whereas intact motor-mediated microtubule capture silences the complex.

records.title: Crocin, a carotenoid, suppresses spindle microtubule dynamics and activates the mitotic checkpoint by binding to tubulin.
records.model: HeLa cells and purified tubulin
records.note: Crocin binds tubulin and suppresses spindle dynamics before ROS/DNA damage, activates BubR1/Mad2 and enhances anticancer cytotoxicity; saffron origin does not imply rescue.

records.title: Drosophila Mis12 complex acts as a single functional unit essential for anaphase chromosome movement and a robust spindle assembly checkpoint.
records.model: Drosophila mis12/nsl1 mutants
records.note: Mutants preserved congression but disrupted anaphase movement; residual BubR1 supported only a weakened checkpoint, showing alignment alone misses segregation failure.

records.title: Integrated analysis of multiple gene expression profiling datasets revealed novel gene signatures and molecular markers in nasopharyngeal carcinoma.
records.model: Eight NPC expression studies and tissue microarrays
records.note: BUB1B was consistently elevated across NPC studies and high protein correlated with poorer survival; gene signature analysis supplied no drug treatment.

records.title: A fine balancing act: A delicate kinase-phosphatase equilibrium that protects against chromosomal instability and cancer.
records.model: Review of mitotic kinase-phosphatase balance in cancer
records.note: Proposes that mildly disturbed BUB1/BUBR1/BUB3-controlled balance could be pushed further to kill CIN tumors; no administered healthy-tissue rescue is reported.

records.title: Rab6a is a novel regulator of meiotic apparatus and maturational progression in mouse oocytes.
records.model: Rab6a-knockdown mouse oocytes
records.note: Rab6a loss caused attachment defects, metaphase-I arrest and aneuploidy with increased kinetochore BubR1; elevated checkpoint marker accompanies damage.

records.title: Hmga1 null mouse embryonic fibroblasts display downregulation of spindle assembly checkpoint gene expression associated to nuclear and karyotypic abnormalities.
records.model: Hmga1-null and heterozygous mouse embryonic fibroblasts
records.note: Hmga1 loss reduced Bub1b and other checkpoint genes with micronuclei/binucleation and karyotype defects; prior overexpression also destabilized cancer cells, indicating dosage context.

records.title: mRNAsi Index: Machine Learning in Mining Lung Adenocarcinoma Stem Cell Biomarkers.
records.model: LUAD TCGA/GEO stemness network analysis
records.note: BUB1B joined thirteen cell-cycle hubs correlated with stage/stemness; therapeutic inhibition was proposed computationally, without drug experiments.

records.title: Mosaic variegated aneuploidy with microcephaly: a new human mitotic mutant?
records.model: 17-year-old girl with multilineage mosaic trisomies
records.note: Persistent trisomies across four tissues supported an early MVA syndrome description; no causal BUB1B analysis or restorative intervention was reported.

records.title: Caspase-mediated specific cleavage of BubR1 is a determinant of mitotic progression.
records.model: HeLa cells with caspase-resistant BubR1 mutants
records.note: Caspase blockade preserved BubR1 and prolonged mitosis; cleavage-resistant BubR1 strengthened spindle-drug delay but ultimately increased aneuploidy, opposing stability-only rescue claims.

records.title: p31comet-mediated extraction of Mad2 from the MCC promotes efficient mitotic exit.
records.model: p31comet RNAi/overexpression and recombinant MCC assays
records.note: p31comet removed Mad2 from BubR1-Cdc20 complexes, while resistant Mad2 delayed anaphase; molecular checkpoint silencing without drug administration.

records.title: Cohesin acetyltransferase Esco2 regulates SAC and kinetochore functions via maintaining H4K16 acetylation during mouse oocyte meiosis.
records.model: Esco2-morpholino mouse oocytes
records.note: Esco2 loss reduced H4K16 acetylation and kinetochore BubR1, bypassed nocodazole arrest and increased aneuploid eggs; no corrective acetylation drug was tested.

records.title: Spindle assembly checkpoint protein dynamics reveal conserved and unsuspected roles in plant cell division.
records.model: Arabidopsis SAC proteins and spindle-disruption assays
records.note: BUBR1/BUB3/MAD2 interacted and localized at unattached kinetochores; BUB3 additionally occupied phragmoplast, without named drug rescue.

records.title: The mitotic checkpoint gene BubR1 has two distinct functions in mitosis.
records.model: HeLa cells expressing BubR1 fragments and kinase-dead mutants
records.note: N-terminal 1-477 preserved nocodazole checkpoint but prolonged prometaphase without drug; GLEBS fragment disrupted checkpoint, separating arrest from chromosome-movement functions.

records.title: Expression data of HeLa cells treated with CENP-E siRNA or Eg5 siRNA in the presence of BubR1 siRNA.
records.model: HeLa siCENP-E or siEg5 combined with siBubR1 transcriptomes
records.note: Data report compares misalignment versus monopolar-spindle effects after checkpoint knockdown; no chemical intervention or rescue result appears.

records.title: The Expression of CCAT2, a Novel Long Noncoding RNA Transcript, and rs6983267 Single-Nucleotide Polymorphism Genotypes in Colorectal Cancers.
records.model: 149 colorectal cancer specimens
records.note: CCAT2 expression associated microsatellite-stable tumors, not prognosis; BubR1 was a measured correlation variable and no intervention was administered.

records.title: Spindle proteins Aurora A and BUB1B, but not Mad2, are aberrantly expressed in dysplastic mucosa of patients with longstanding ulcerative colitis.
records.model: 31 longstanding-ulcerative-colitis colectomy specimens
records.note: BUB1B rose with dysplasia while AuroraA fell; both tracked Ki67 but no spindle-protein association with aneuploidy was found, limiting causal interpretation.

records.title: Maternal expression of the checkpoint protein BubR1 is required for synchrony of syncytial nuclear divisions and polar body arrest in Drosophila melanogaster.
records.model: Drosophila maternal BubR1 hypomorph embryos
records.note: Maternal deficiency caused asynchronous syncytial divisions, premature separation and failed polar-body arrest; establishes developmental requirement without rescue treatment.

records.title: SUMO-1 plays crucial roles for spindle organization, chromosome congression, and chromosome segregation during mouse oocyte meiotic maturation.
records.model: Mouse oocyte SUMO1/UBC9 depletion or antibody inhibition
records.note: Loss disrupted attachments, BubR1/REC8/securin localization and increased aneuploidy; SUMO1 overexpression had no significant maturation benefit, with no small-molecule rescue.

records.title: The conserved N-terminal region of the mitotic checkpoint protein BUBR1: a putative TPR motif of high surface activity.
records.model: Purified human BubR1 N-terminal 1-204 domain
records.note: Alpha-helical domain resembled PP5 TPR and formed stable interfaces; fatty-acid regulation belonged to comparator PP5 and was not demonstrated BubR1 therapy.

records.title: Identification of potential significant genes in HBV related hepatocellular carcinoma via bioinformatical analysis
records.model: HBV-HCC GEO datasets and network/survival validation; preprint
records.note: BUB1B was among thirteen elevated poor-prognosis hubs; pathway references to drug metabolism are not administered-drug evidence.

records.title: Enhanced genomic instabilities caused by deregulated microtubule dynamics and chromosome segregation: a perspective from genetic studies in mice.
records.model: Genetically engineered spindle-checkpoint mouse models
records.note: Reviews SAC gene loss, chromosomal instability and tumor development; rational anticancer targeting is proposed without a named tested rescue agent.

records.title: Spindle checkpoint function requires Mad2-dependent Cdc20 binding to the Mad3 homology domain of BubR1.
records.model: Human BubR1 binding-domain mutants
records.note: Strong central Cdc20 binding was dispensable whereas N-terminal Mad2-dependent binding was required for SAC; affinity alone does not establish checkpoint function.

records.title: Unprotected Drosophila melanogaster telomeres activate the spindle assembly checkpoint.
records.model: Drosophila HOAP/cav and DDR/checkpoint mutants
records.note: Uncapped telomeres recruited BubR1 and activated SAC; mutations relieved arrest but no correction of underlying telomere injury or pharmacologic rescue was reported.

records.title: Geraniin Differentially Modulates Chromosome Stability of Colon Cancer and Noncancerous Cells by Oppositely Regulating their Spindle Assembly Checkpoint.
records.model: Noncancerous CCD841 colon epithelial and HCT116 cancer cells
records.note: Geraniin raised Mad1/BubR1 transcripts, strengthened SAC and reduced mitotic aberrations/CIN in CCD841 while slightly inhibiting proliferation; opposite HCT116 checkpoint weakening/killing makes this a genuine selective functional follow-up.

records.title: ROS-Induced Activation of DNA Damage Responses Drives Senescence-Like State in Postmitotic Cochlear Cells: Implication for Hearing Preservation.
records.model: Cochlear cells and SAMP8 aging mice
records.note: EUK207 reduced peroxide DNA damage/senescence in vitro and systemic dosing preserved hearing/hair cells in SAMP8; BubR1 decline was part of injury phenotype, not proven drug mediator.

records.title: Phospho-Bcl-xL(Ser62) influences spindle assembly and chromosome segregation during mitosis.
records.model: Bcl-xL phosphorylation mutants in dividing cells
records.note: S62A impaired checkpoint-complex binding and increased aberrant spindles/aneuploidy under drug challenges; Bcl-xL phosphorylation has mitotic functions beyond antiapoptosis.

records.title: Evaluation of 2',4'-dihydroxy-3,4,5-trimethoxychalcone as antimitotic agent that induces mitotic catastrophe in MCF-7 breast cancer cells.
records.model: MCF-7 breast cancer cells
records.note: Chalcone induced abnormal spindles, Mad2/Bub1/BubR1 accumulation and prolonged arrest followed by death; protein accumulation reflects antimitotic injury.

records.title: Regulation of mitotic progression by the spindle assembly checkpoint.
records.model: Review of kinetochore-MCC assembly and APC-C inhibition
records.note: Summarizes positioning of checkpoint proteins and Mad2/BubR1-Cdc20 inhibition; no administered drug or tissue-rescue outcome in abstract.

records.title: Plk1 and Mps1 Cooperatively Regulate the Spindle Assembly Checkpoint in Human Cells.
records.model: Human mitotic Plk1/Mps1 signaling experiments
records.note: Plk1 phosphorylates KNL1/Mps1 and boosts Mps1 activity and BubR1 recruitment, supporting SAC; relevant counterbalance to assuming broad PLK1 suppression is uniformly protective.

records.title: Transcriptional control of BubR1 by p53 and suppression of centrosome amplification by BubR1.
records.model: Early/late-passage p53-null mouse cells
records.note: Late-passage cells regained BubR1 and stable centrosomes/checkpoint responses after early instability; restoration arose during culture/genomic convergence, not drug administration.

records.title: Synthesis and biological evaluation of quinazolin-4(3H)-one derivatives bearing dithiocarbamate side chain at C2-position as potential antitumor agents.
records.model: Five cancer lines; HT29 mechanistic assays
records.note: 5c at micromolar potency induced G2/M arrest, phospho-BubR1 and tubulin polymerization; SAC activation serves antiproliferation, not healthy-tissue rescue.

records.title: Identification of key genes and microRNAs involved in kidney Wilms tumor by integrated bioinformatics analysis.
records.model: Wilms tumor GEO/TCGA and miRNA networks
records.note: BUB1B was one of five elevated cell-cycle hubs within an inferred miRNA-mRNA network; no drug or gene-specific rescue was experimentally tested.

records.title: Identification of epithelial-mesenchymal transition-related circRNA-miRNA-mRNA ceRNA regulatory network in breast cancer.
records.model: ZEB1-transfected breast cancer cells and circRNA/network validation
records.note: ZEB1 perturbation identified circRNAs linked computationally to BUB1B and other prognostic hubs; no therapeutic compound was administered.

records.title: Reduced level of the spindle checkpoint protein BUB1B is associated with aneuploidy in colorectal cancers.
records.model: Aneuploid versus diploid colorectal adenocarcinoma tissues
records.note: All spindle proteins exceeded normal tissue, but BUB1B was lower in aneuploid versus diploid cancers; observational dosage relationship does not establish drug restoration.

records.title: The yin and yang of the Cdkn2a locus in senescence and aging.
records.model: BubR1-hypomorphic Cdkn2a pathway mouse studies
records.note: Review describes p16 deletion delaying muscle/fat aging but p19Arf deletion worsening it; senescence-pathway inhibition is not uniformly restorative and no drug result is given.

records.title: Airborne particulate matter induces mitotic slippage and chromosomal missegregation through disruption of the spindle assembly checkpoint (SAC).
records.model: A549 lung cancer cells after 24-hour particulate exposure
records.note: PM10 lowered BubR1/Mad2 and other checkpoint proteins, altered MAD2 localization and raised micronuclei; environmental injury rather than a therapeutic rescue.

records.title: Colonic tumorigenesis in BubR1+/-ApcMin/+ compound mutant mice is linked to premature separation of sister chromatids and enhanced genomic instability.
records.model: BubR1+/-ApcMin/+ mice and MEFs
records.note: Double-mutant mice developed tenfold more colon tumors and MEFs had checkpoint slippage/premature chromatid separation; beta-catenin increase is disease mechanism, not administered Wnt therapy.

records.title: Loss of CENPF leads to developmental failure in mouse embryos.
records.model: Mouse zygotes and embryos with CENPF/CAAX perturbations
records.note: FTI prevented CENPF degradation and altered localization; CENPF depletion blocked embryo development, so retained protein after farnesylation inhibition is not demonstrated rescue.

records.title: Identification and purification of a soluble region of BubR1: a critical component of the mitotic checkpoint complex.
records.model: E. coli expression of soluble BubR1 constructs
records.note: Construct-length/secondary-structure optimization yielded soluble BubR1 for biochemical studies; increased purification yield is not cellular protein restoration.

records.title: The kinetochore-dependent and -independent formation of the CDC20-MAD2 complex and its functions in HeLa cells.
records.model: Single-cell HeLa CDC20-MAD2 analysis
records.note: CDC20-MAD2 formed before SAC activation via Tpr and declined during prolonged nocodazole arrest with cyclinB1; no intervention corrected this decline.

records.title: Identification of Seven Cell Cycle-Related Genes with Unfavorable Prognosis and Construction of their TF-miRNA-mRNA regulatory network in Breast Cancer.
records.model: Breast cancer public datasets and qPCR
records.note: Seven cell-cycle genes including BUB1B were elevated, prognostic and linked to predicted TF/miRNA control; no administered regulator or rescue experiment.

records.title: Genetic variation in the major mitotic checkpoint genes associated with chromosomal aberrations in healthy humans.
records.model: Healthy-human lymphocyte checkpoint-variant cohorts
records.note: Individual checkpoint variants including BUB1B contributed little; significant paired associations involved PTTG1/ZWILCH/ZWINT, without pharmacologic perturbation.

records.title: Aurora-B kinase pathway controls the lateral to end-on conversion of kinetochore-microtubule attachments in human cells.
records.model: Human kinetochore attachment tracking and phosphatase comparisons
records.note: AuroraB retarded end-on conversion while BubR1-associated PP2A counteracted it; abstract names no compound and functional pharmacologic rescue remains a full-text question.

records.title: Identification of 40S ribosomal protein S8 as a novel biomarker for alcohol‑associated hepatocellular carcinoma using weighted gene co‑expression network analysis.
records.model: Alcohol-associated HCC transcriptomic/clinical samples
records.note: BUB1B entered a broader prognostic hub list, but RPS8 alone distinguished alcohol-associated disease in validation; no administered drug was evaluated.

records.title: BUBR1 deficiency results in abnormal megakaryopoiesis.
records.model: BubR1 knockout/heterozygous mice and marrow/MEF RNAi
records.note: Deficiency caused embryonic apoptosis and increased abnormal megakaryocytes without more platelets due to poor proplatelet production; more progenitors is not functional hematopoietic rescue.

records.title: Aneuploidy in health, disease, and aging.
records.model: Review of aneuploidy mouse models and aging
records.note: Summarizes BubR1-model links between chromosome instability, cancer and aging; saved abstract does not identify an administered restorative treatment.

records.title: Dynein-dependent transport of spindle assembly checkpoint proteins off kinetochores toward spindle poles.
records.model: Dynein cargo assays in mitotic cells
records.note: ATP reduction revealed dynein-dependent removal of BubR1 and other SAC/KMN proteins toward poles, including after checkpoint satisfaction; no energy-restoring therapy tested.

records.title: Gene co-expression network reveals shared modules predictive of stage and grade in serous ovarian cancers.
records.model: 788 serous ovarian-cancer samples plus validation datasets
records.note: BUB1B entered grade-associated mitotic module, distinct from stage-associated ECM genes; network reproducibility does not demonstrate therapeutic intervention.

records.title: Bioinformatics analysis reveals meaningful markers and outcome predictors in HBV-associated hepatocellular carcinoma.
records.model: HBV-HCC GSE121248 and survival/protein databases
records.note: Fifteen hub genes including BUB1B distinguished tumor tissue and associated poor survival; no administered agent despite therapeutic-target framing.

records.title: Newly identified roles for an old guardian: profound deficiency of the mitotic spindle checkpoint protein BubR1 leads to early aging and infertility.
records.model: Commentary on graded BubR1 hypomorphic/knockout mice
records.note: Reviews dosage threshold for adulthood and deficiency-related aging/infertility; no restorative drug exposure is described.

records.title: Suppression of genomic instabilities caused by chromosome mis-segregation: a perspective from studying BubR1 and Sgo1.
records.model: Review of BubR1/Sgo1 checkpoint biology
records.note: Summarizes checkpoint gene mechanisms and anticancer target rationale; neither a named administered therapy nor nonmalignant rescue is reported.

records.title: Cancer-Testis Gene Expression in Hepatocellular Carcinoma: Identification of Prognostic Markers and Potential Targets for Immunotherapy.
records.model: HCC cancer-testis gene databases and 72-patient validation cohort
records.note: BUB1B correlated with CD8 exclusion and survival; demethylation was inferred regulation rather than administered demethylating therapy.

records.title: Gene set enrichment analysis and meta-analysis to identify six key genes regulating and controlling the prognosis of esophageal squamous cell carcinoma.
records.model: ESCC six-dataset meta-analysis and TCGA
records.note: BUB1B/BUB1/TTK plus nuclear-pore genes were proposed prognostic/chemotherapy factors; gene elimination is explicitly future work, not current treatment evidence.

records.title: KIF2A regulates the spindle assembly and the metaphase I-anaphase I transition in mouse oocyte.
records.model: KIF2A-siRNA mouse oocytes
records.note: KIF2A depletion disrupted spindles/migration and activated BubR1 arrest; taxol/nocodazole supported tubulin colocalization experiments, not maturation rescue.

records.title: 6,7-Dimethoxy-3-(3-methoxyphenyl)isoquinolin-1-amine induces mitotic arrest and apoptotic cell death through the activation of spindle assembly checkpoint in human cervical cancer cells.
records.model: Cervical cancer cells and HeLa xenografts
records.note: CWJ082 induced tubulin polymerization, phospho-BubR1 and mitotic apoptosis and reduced xenograft growth; BubR1/Mad2 knockdown attenuated killing, not a healthy-tissue endpoint.

records.title: Germinal Cell Aplasia in Kif18a Mutant Male Mice Due to Impaired Chromosome Congression and Dysregulated BubR1 and CENP-E.
records.model: Kif18a-null mice and GC-1/HeLa RNAi cells
records.note: KIF18A loss caused male sterility, spindle defects and BubR1/CENP-E degradation with premature chromatid separation; no rescue agent is described.

records.title: Axin-1 Regulates Meiotic Spindle Organization in Mouse Oocytes.
records.model: Axin1-siRNA mouse oocytes
records.note: LiCl improved spindle morphology and pronuclear formation after Axin1 depletion; BubR1 retention marked injury, and this is distinct from BubR1 deficiency or FRZB genetic rescue.

records.title: KI motifs of human Knl1 enhance assembly of comprehensive spindle checkpoint complexes around MELT repeats.
records.model: Knl1-depleted human cells with targeted domain constructs
records.note: Knl1 residues1-250 containing KI/MELT motifs restored SAC/alignment; domain reconstitution is genetic and no drug is administered.

records.title: Screening and function analysis of hub genes and pathways in hepatocellular carcinoma via bioinformatics approaches.
records.model: HCC GSE64041 and validation databases
records.note: BUB1B was one of ten overexpressed hubs, while PLK1/CCNA2 were prognostic; authors require future laboratory validation.

records.title: An Arabidopsis tissue-specific RNAi method for studying genes essential to mitosis.
records.model: Arabidopsis petal-specific RNAi lines
records.note: CENPC knockdown arrested cells but MAD2/BUBR1 knockdown mainly altered petal growth without demonstrated mitotic requirement; tissue-RNAi method, no drug result.

records.title: Expression of the Long Intergenic Non-Protein Coding RNA 665 (LINC00665) Gene and the Cell Cycle in Hepatocellular Carcinoma Using The Cancer Genome Atlas, the Gene Expression Omnibus, and Quantitative Real-Time Polymerase Chain Reaction.
records.model: HCC LINC00665 databases and tissue qPCR
records.note: LINC00665 overexpression linked poor survival with inferred ten-gene cycle pathway including BUB1B; no lncRNA therapy or administered compound.

records.title: Slippage of mitotic arrest and enhanced tumor development in mice with BubR1 haploinsufficiency.
records.model: BubR1+/- mice and MEFs
records.note: Haploinsufficiency lowered securin/Cdc20 and increased micronuclei and carcinogen-triggered tumors; no administered protective compound was evaluated.

records.title: Kinetochore KMN network gene CASC5 mutated in primary microcephaly.
records.model: Three consanguineous CASC5-microcephaly families
records.note: Shared exon18-skipping mutation truncated kinetochore-binding CASC5; BUBR1 interaction is mechanistic context and no treatment was tested.

records.title: Usp16 regulates kinetochore localization of Plk1 to promote proper chromosome alignment in mitosis.
records.model: Usp16-downregulated human mitotic cells
records.note: Usp16 deubiquitination retained Plk1 through BubR1 interactions for proper alignment; loss reduced Plk1 kinetochore presence, with no chemical restoration.

records.title: Mitotic catenation is monitored and resolved by a PKCε-regulated pathway.
records.model: Catenation-challenged mammalian mitotic cells
records.note: PKCepsilon pathway delayed exit and helped resolve catenanes; inhibition produced PICH-positive bridges despite BubR1-high kinetochores, so checkpoint escape is injury.

records.title: The accuracy of survival time prediction for patients with glioma is improved by measuring mitotic spindle checkpoint gene expression.
records.model: 771 glioma microarrays and independent qPCR cohort
records.note: BUB1B expression predicted survival better than grade/Ki67 in the measured cohort; prediction accuracy does not establish benefit from manipulating expression.

records.title: Identification of Key Pathways and Genes in Anaplastic Thyroid Carcinoma via Integrated Bioinformatics Analysis.
records.model: Anaplastic thyroid carcinoma GEO datasets
records.note: BUB1B was one of ten mitotic hubs; downregulated muscle-action-potential enrichment is annotation, not muscle treatment data.

records.title: Targeted Assessment of G0S2 Methylation Identifies a Rapidly Recurrent, Routinely Fatal Molecular Subtype of Adrenocortical Carcinoma.
records.model: ACC-TCGA and 114 adrenal tumors
records.note: G0S2 methylation with BUB1B-PINK1 stratified survival; methylation assay and proposed adjuvant selection are not demethylating therapy.

records.title: Mps1 is SUMO-modified during the cell cycle.
records.model: Mps1 SUMO-site mutants in mitotic cells
records.note: SUMO-resistant Mps1 bound BubR1 more strongly yet affected kinetochore targeting/progression; stronger protein interaction is not demonstrated functional rescue.

records.title: Characterization of the tetratricopeptide-containing domain of BUB1, BUBR1, and PP5 proves that domain amphiphilicity over amino acid sequence specificity governs protein adsorption and interfacial activity.
records.model: Purified Bub1/BubR1/PP5 TPR domains
records.note: Biophysical assays found shared amphiphilic interface properties despite sequence differences; no candidate lipid or other therapeutic administration.

records.title: Multiple Duties for Spindle Assembly Checkpoint Kinases in Meiosis.
records.model: Yeast and mouse-oocyte SAC kinases review
records.note: Explains distinct meiotic roles of Bub1/Mps1/BubR1/Aurora kinases and aneuploidy susceptibility, without a named drug-rescue experiment.

records.title: CDK5RAP2 is required for spindle checkpoint function.
records.model: Cancer cells with CDK5RAP2 knockdown/re-expression
records.note: CDK5RAP2 loss reduced BUBR1/MAD2 and increased drug resistance; re-expression partially reversed resistance, which is resensitization for cancer killing rather than tissue protection.

records.title: Gene expression profiling, pathway analysis and subtype classification reveal molecular heterogeneity in hepatocellular carcinoma and suggest subtype specific therapeutic targets.
records.model: 423 HCC TCGA expression samples
records.note: BUB1B was among 59 overexpressed kinases across HCC subtypes; predicted subtype-specific targets were not pharmacologically tested.

records.title: Aneuploidy is associated with TP53 expression but not with BRCA1 or TERT expression in sporadic colorectal cancer.
records.model: 55 colorectal tumors and 37 normal mucosa samples
records.note: Only TP53 alteration associated aneuploidy; BUB1B was among correlated spindle proteins without evidence that expression caused chromosomal instability or was treated.

records.title: BubR1 is essential for kinetochore localization of other spindle checkpoint proteins and its phosphorylation requires Mad1.
records.model: BubR1-depleted Xenopus egg extracts with recombinant add-back
records.note: WT, kinase-dead or kinase-domain-deleted BubR1 restored checkpoint-protein recruitment/interactions; direct protein add-back in extracts is not a drug rescue in tissue.

records.title: The Bub1-Plk1 kinase complex promotes spindle checkpoint signalling through Cdc20 phosphorylation.
records.model: BubR1/Mad2-depleted human cells with phosphomimetic Cdc20
records.note: Phosphomimetic Cdc20 restored nocodazole arrest despite BubR1 depletion, identifying parallel APC-C inhibition; no corrected segregation/productive tissue or administered rescue drug.

records.title: Mps1Mph1 Kinase Phosphorylates Mad3 to Inhibit Cdc20Slp1-APC/C and Maintain Spindle Checkpoint Arrests.
records.model: Fission yeast and purified Mad3/APC/C assays
records.note: Mad3 phosphosite mutants still localize and assemble MCC but bind APC/C poorly; phosphomimics inhibit APC/C in vitro. Genetic and biochemical checkpoint mechanism, not drug rescue.

records.title: Novel microtubule-targeting agents, pyrrolo-1,5-benzoxazepines, induce cell cycle arrest and apoptosis in prostate cancer cells.
records.model: PC3 androgen-independent prostate cancer cells
records.note: PBOX agents depolymerize microtubules and cause prolonged arrest followed by BubR1 degradation and apoptosis; sequential flavopiridol increases killing. No healthy-tissue rescue shown.

records.title: Gene expression profiling of spontaneously occurring canine mammary tumours: Insight into gene networks and pathways linked to cancer pathogenesis.
records.model: Canine benign and malignant mammary tumors versus healthy tissue
records.note: BUB1B is a central malignant-tumor expression-network node; proteomic confirmation concerns other listed markers. Neither BUBR1 manipulation nor drug rescue is tested.

records.title: Molecular pathways: regulation and targeting of kinetochore-microtubule attachment in cancer.
records.model: Cancer and glioblastoma kinetochore literature
records.note: Review proposes kinetochore attachment and GLEBS domains of BubR1/BuGZ as cancer targets; abstract supplies no administered agent or normal-tissue rescue.

records.title: TRAIL inactivates the mitotic checkpoint and potentiates death induced by microtubule-targeting agents in human cancer cells.
records.model: T98G and HCT116 cancer cells
records.note: TRAIL plus microtubule agents lowers BubR1/Bub1 and increases apoptosis; caspase inhibitors or cleavage-resistant BubR1 partly block these effects. Probe reversal is not tissue rescue.

records.title: Bub1 autophosphorylation feeds back to regulate kinetochore docking and promote localized substrate phosphorylation.
records.model: Cellular Bub1 phosphosite mutation and kinetochore tethering experiments
records.note: Bub1 T589 autophosphorylation controls kinetochore residence and localized H2A phosphorylation; mutant spreads shugoshin and impairs chromosome resolution. Tethering restores localization, not pharmacologic rescue.

records.title: A novel NCSTN gene mutation in a Chinese family with acne inversa.
records.model: Chinese family with acne inversa and idiopathic guttate hypomelanosis
records.note: NCSTN frameshift cosegregates with acne inversa; BUB1B is among exome candidates that fail segregation. No BUB1B-directed intervention or therapeutic result.

records.title: Structural analysis of human Cdc20 supports multisite degron recognition by APC/C.
records.model: Human Cdc20 crystal structures and APC/C substrate assays
records.note: Cdc20 structures identify KEN- and D-box binding surfaces; securin ubiquitination and peptide competition establish degron roles. Assay peptides are not therapeutic interventions.

records.title: Microarray expression analysis of MYCN-amplified neuroblastoma cells after inhibition of CDK2.
records.model: Reanalysis of CDK2-inhibited IMR32 neuroblastoma expression data
records.note: BUB1B appears among cell-cycle differential-expression genes after source-dataset CDK2 inhibition. Abstract does not specify inhibition modality or compound and does not establish drug rescue.

records.title: Spindle assembly checkpoint gene expression in childhood adrenocortical tumors (ACT): Overexpression of Aurora kinases A and B is associated with a poor prognosis.
records.model: Childhood adrenocortical tumors and primary TP53 p.R337H ACT culture
records.note: Tumor BUBR1 expression is associated with malignancy; Aurora inhibitor ZM447439 suppresses proliferation and colonies in primary ACT culture. No restoration in deficient healthy cells.

records.title: The beta2-adaptin clathrin adaptor interacts with the mitotic checkpoint kinase BubR1.
records.model: Two-hybrid, binding, and cellular localization assays
records.note: Beta2-adaptin trunk interacts with BubR1 kinase domain throughout the cell cycle; possible vesicle-traffic connection remains mechanistic. No administered agent.

records.title: BubR1 insufficiency causes early onset of aging-associated phenotypes and infertility in mice.
records.model: BubR1-insufficient mice and graded-expression embryonic fibroblasts
records.note: Reduced BubR1 causes progressive aneuploidy, cachectic dwarfism, fat loss, cataracts and poor wound healing; graded fibroblasts senesce. Foundational model, without drug rescue.

records.title: Checkpoint kinase 1 modulates sensitivity to cisplatin after spindle checkpoint activation in SW620 cells.
records.model: Fission yeast screen and SW620 colon cancer cells
records.note: Nocodazole followed by cisplatin increases SW620 death; Chk1 depletion removes synergy. High BubR1/Chk1 is cancer sensitivity context, not normal-tissue rescue.

records.title: Selective Sirt2 inhibition by ligand-induced rearrangement of the active site.
records.model: Sirt2 structures and HeLa cells
records.note: Selective Sirt2 inhibitor SirReal2 increases tubulin acetylation and destabilizes BubR1 in HeLa cells. Direct counterevidence to using SIRT2 suppression for BubR1 restoration.

records.title: Breast cancer-specific gene 1 interacts with the mitotic checkpoint kinase BubR1.
records.model: BCSG1-transfected and endogenous breast cancer cell lines
records.outcome_direction: protein-loss prevention without demonstrated functional rescue
records.note: BCSG1 lowers BubR1 protein without lowering transcript and impairs nocodazole checkpoint; MG132 prevents protein loss. Abstract does not show MG132 restores checkpoint fidelity or tissue function.

records.title: Identifying hub genes and dysregulated pathways in hepatocellular carcinoma.
records.model: Integrated hepatocellular carcinoma microarrays
records.note: BUB1B joins five other cell-cycle hub genes in integrated HCC expression and pathway analyses; no intervention is administered.

records.title: Kinetochore function is controlled by a phospho-dependent coexpansion of inner and outer components.
records.model: Xenopus egg extracts with structured illumination microscopy
records.note: Unattached kinetochores expand CENP-C and outer components including BubR1; kinase/phosphatase dependence concerns assembly regulation, without a named therapeutic agent.

records.title: Activating and silencing the mitotic checkpoint through CENP-E-dependent activation/inactivation of BubR1.
records.model: Purified proteins and Xenopus egg extracts
records.note: CENP-E activates BubR1; antibodies or microtubule attachment silence signaling. Only a fraction must be kinase competent, alongside stoichiometric Cdc20 inhibition.

records.title: Replication-compromised cells require the mitotic checkpoint to prevent tetraploidization.
records.model: Normal human fibroblasts expressing mutant DNA polymerases
records.note: Pol-alpha mutants progressively lose Mad2/BubR1 and become tetraploid and senescent; Pol-delta mutants retain arrest and normal ploidy. No rescue compound.

records.title: Centromere-associated protein-E is essential for the mammalian mitotic checkpoint to prevent aneuploidy due to single chromosome loss.
records.model: CENP-E-depleted primary mouse fibroblasts and regenerating hepatocytes
records.note: CENP-E loss lowers kinetochore BubR1 and checkpoint signaling, producing substantial chromosome loss; purified CENP-E stimulates BubR1. No administered rescue drug.

records.title: Loading of the 3F3/2 antigen onto kinetochores is dependent on the ordered assembly of the spindle checkpoint proteins.
records.model: Immunodepleted Xenopus extracts and rephosphorylation assays
records.note: Mps1/Bub1 precede BubR1/Plx1 and Mad1/Mad2 kinetochore loading; 3F3/2 epitope formation needs Mps1/Bub1 kinase activities but not BubR1 kinase.

records.title: Role of CCT chaperonin in the disassembly of mitotic checkpoint complexes.
records.model: HeLa extracts and purified CCT chaperonin subunits
records.note: CCT releases Cdc20 and disassembles Mad2-free MCC subcomplexes; combined CCT/TRIP13 action terminates checkpoint. No pharmacologic result.

records.title: Mitotic checkpoint responses in Chinese hamster cells
records.model: CHO-K1 and human-chromosome-15 hybrid 15A cells
records.note: 15A hybrids have greater basal mitotic index yet more instability under nocodazole; proposed CHO BubR1 lesion investigation is cut off by saved abstract '(continues)'.

records.title: Chromium induces chromosomal instability, which is partly due to deregulation of BubR1 and Emi1, two APC/C inhibitors.
records.model: HeLa and normal lung bronchial epithelial cells
records.note: Chronic noncytotoxic chromium suppresses BubR1 activation and Emi1, compromises nocodazole arrest, and disrupts APC/C substrate control. Nocodazole is the checkpoint probe.

records.title: WT1 interacts with MAD2 and regulates mitotic checkpoint function.
records.model: Cellular WT1 depletion and MCC interaction experiments
records.note: WT1 preferentially binds closed Mad2 and sustains MCC-mediated APC/C inhibition; WT1 depletion accelerates securin turnover and causes segregation defects.

records.title: Spontaneous development of Alzheimer's disease-associated brain pathology in a Shugoshin-1 mouse cohesinopathy model.
records.model: Aged Sgo1- and BubR1-haploinsufficient mice
records.note: Sgo1 haploinsufficient brains accumulate amyloid/Tau-associated pathology whereas age-matched BubR1 haploinsufficient mice do not; no administered drug.

records.title: The human mitotic checkpoint protein BubR1 regulates chromosome-spindle attachments.
records.model: BubR1-depleted human cells
records.note: Aurora kinase inhibition restores stable microtubule attachments after BubR1 depletion; abstract leaves inhibitor identity and modality unspecified and does not establish whole-tissue rescue.

records.title: Mad2-Independent inhibition of APCCdc20 by the mitotic checkpoint protein BubR1.
records.model: Purified human checkpoint proteins, Xenopus extracts and Cdc20-overexpressing cells
records.outcome_direction: BubR1 inhibits APC/C and restores arrest
records.note: BubR1 blocks Cdc20-APC association independently of Mad2 and its own kinase activity; protein-mediated rescue of nocodazole arrest is not drug rescue.

records.title: c-MYC delays prometaphase by direct transactivation of MAD2 and BubR1: identification of mechanisms underlying c-MYC-induced DNA damage and chromosomal instability.
records.model: Conditional c-MYC cancer cell lines and colorectal biopsies
records.outcome_direction: mitotic delay, apoptosis and chromosome instability
records.note: c-MYC directly raises MAD2/BubR1 and delays mitosis, yet resulting CIN is independent of their induction and associated with replication damage.

records.title: Identification of significant genes with poor prognosis in ovarian cancer via bioinformatical analysis.
records.model: Integrated ovarian cancer expression and survival datasets
records.outcome_direction: high cell-cycle genes associate with poor prognosis
records.note: BUB1B/BUB1/TTK/CCNB1 are elevated prognostic cell-cycle genes in bioinformatic ovarian cancer analyses; no tested intervention.

records.title: Closed MAD2 (C-MAD2) is selectively incorporated into the mitotic checkpoint complex (MCC).
records.model: Human cell-cycle and recombinant MCC experiments
records.note: BUBR1:BUB3:CDC20 forms before mitosis; closed Mad2 incorporation supplies potent APC/C inhibition. Conformation-locked mutant induces premature assembly without a drug.

records.title: Inhibitory factors associated with anaphase-promoting complex/cylosome in mitotic checkpoint.
records.model: Extracts from checkpoint-arrested cells
records.note: ATP gamma S stabilizes extract checkpoint arrest for isolation of APC/C-bound inhibitors; nocodazole prepares arrested cells. These are biochemical probes, not therapeutic rescue.

records.title: Potential key molecular correlations in laryngeal squamous cell carcinoma revealed by integrated analysis of mRNA, miRNA and lncRNA microarray profiles.
records.model: Paired laryngeal squamous cell carcinoma expression arrays
records.note: Integrated mRNA/miRNA/lncRNA analysis links BUB1B and CENPE to XLOC_l2_010636 regulation; selected expression differences are confirmed but no drug intervention is tested.

records.title: Inherent Instability of Correct Kinetochore-Microtubule Attachments during Meiosis I in Oocytes.
records.model: Mouse meiosis-I oocytes
records.note: Aurora B/C proximity destabilizes attachments until Cdk1-dependent BubR1 phosphorylation recruits PP2A-B56; explains meiotic error susceptibility without a specified administered therapy.

records.title: Weakened spindle checkpoint with reduced BubR1 expression in paclitaxel-resistant ovarian carcinoma cell line SKOV3-TR30.
records.model: SKOV3 and paclitaxel-resistant SKOV3-TR30 ovarian cancer cells
records.note: Resistant cells have lower BubR1, premature APC/C-substrate loss and chromatid separation, and fail drug-induced mitotic arrest. This is cancer resistance, not rescue.

records.title: Survival-based bioinformatics analysis to identify hub genes and key pathways in non-small cell lung cancer.
records.model: NSCLC public microarray, TCGA and protein datasets
records.note: BUB1B is one of six validated expression hubs in survival-based NSCLC analysis; target nomination is computational without pharmacologic testing.

records.title: Checkpoint protein BubR1 acts synergistically with Mad2 to inhibit anaphase-promoting complex.
records.model: Purified human checkpoint proteins and arrested-cell complexes
records.note: BubR1 directly inhibits Cdc20 independent of kinase activity and cooperates with Mad2 at physiological concentrations; no small-molecule intervention.

records.title: The dynamic protein Knl1 - a kinetochore rendezvous.
records.model: Knl1 kinetochore scaffold literature
records.note: Commentary reviews Knl1 motifs recruiting Bub1/BubR1/Bub3 and phosphoregulation; it does not present an administered treatment or rescue experiment.

records.title: Phenethyl isothiocyanate alters the gene expression and the levels of protein associated with cell cycle regulation in human glioblastoma GBM 8401 cells.
records.model: GBM8401 human glioblastoma cells
records.note: PEITC causes G0/G1-associated expression changes including lower BUB1B, CDC20 and cyclin B1; anticancer transcriptional effects do not support BubR1 restoration.

records.title: Overexpression of the dynein light chain km23-1 in human ovarian carcinoma cells inhibits tumor formation in vivo and causes mitotic delay at prometaphase/metaphase.
records.model: Tet-off km23-1 ovarian cancer cells and xenografts
records.note: Doxycycline removal induces km23-1 transgene, suppressing growth/tumorigenicity and retaining BubR1 at metaphase. Doxycycline is expression-system control, not the therapeutic driver.

records.title: Deregulation of HMGA1 expression induces chromosome instability through regulation of spindle assembly checkpoint genes.
records.model: HMGA1-perturbed cells and human colon carcinomas
records.note: HMGA1 binds and activates Ttk/Mad2l1/Bub1/Bub1b promoters; depletion lowers SAC genes and disrupts mitosis. Cancer-linked transcriptional mechanism without a drug.

records.title: Induction of premature chromatid separation (PCS) in individuals with PCS trait and in normal controls.
records.model: PCS/MVA patient, carrier and control lymphocytes/lymphoblasts
records.note: PCS increases with hypotonic temperature/duration and can disappear without hypotonic processing; standardized 37C/20min distinguishes groups. Assay handling is not an in-vivo treatment.

records.title: When Mad met Bub.
records.model: Spindle checkpoint Mad1 literature
records.note: Commentary discusses recent Mad1 work and hierarchical SAC recruitment; no named administered drug or new rescue outcome is supplied.

records.title: SIRT2 downregulation confers resistance to microtubule inhibitors by prolonging chronic mitotic arrest.
records.model: SIRT2/BubR1-depleted HCT116 cancer cells
records.note: SIRT2 depletion prolongs arrest and induces centrosome fragmentation, whereas BubR1 loss abolishes checkpoint. Reduced cancer death reflects distinct resistance mechanisms, not normal-tissue rescue.

records.title: Expression profiling of 519 kinase genes in matched malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor/plexiform neurofibroma samples is discriminatory and identifies mitotic regulators BUB1B, PBK and NEK2 as overexpressed with transformation.
records.model: Matched MPNST and plexiform neurofibroma specimens
records.note: BUB1B/PBK/NEK2 overexpression is validated at protein level amid heterogeneous kinase changes; kinase inhibitors are proposed but none is administered in the abstract.

records.title: CENP-A is required for accurate chromosome segregation and sustained kinetochore association of BubR1.
records.model: CENP-A-depleted chicken DT40 cells
records.note: BubR1 initially reaches CENP-A-depleted kinetochores but cannot remain under checkpoint activation; unequal segregation follows transient delay. No pharmacologic intervention.

records.title: p55CDC/hCDC20 is associated with BUBR1 and may be a downstream target of the spindle checkpoint kinase.
records.model: Human cells, sf9 expression and purified binding assays
records.note: BUBR1 overexpression increases mitotic accumulation and binds/phosphorylates Cdc20; nocodazole enhances checkpoint-associated binding. Nocodazole is a perturbation probe, not rescue.

records.title: Differential mitotic checkpoint protein requirements in somatic and germ cells.
records.model: Male mice with individual or combined checkpoint-gene disruptions
records.note: Spermatogenesis and male fertility depend strongly on BubR1 relative to other tested checkpoint genes; illustrates germline-specific requirement without drug treatment.

records.title: Kinetochore-microtubule interactions "in check" by Bub1, Bub3 and BubR1: The dual task of attaching and signalling.
records.model: Kinetochore attachment literature
records.note: Review separates Bub1/Bub3/BubR1 attachment regulation and checkpoint signaling, including localization interdependencies; no administered therapeutic result in abstract.

records.title: Malignancy in Pheochromocytoma or Paraganglioma: Integrative Analysis of 176 Cases in TCGA.
records.model: TCGA pheochromocytoma/paraganglioma 176-case analysis
records.note: BUB1B belongs to upregulated cell-cycle pathways in metastatic tumors; mutation/survival comparisons do not test target manipulation or treatment.

records.title: Bioinformatic analysis of prognostic value of ZW10 interacting protein in lung cancer.
records.model: Lung cancer specimens and public expression/survival datasets
records.note: BUB1B is a predicted ZWINT interaction-network member; experimental validation centers on ZWINT expression, without drug testing or BubR1 rescue.

records.title: p31comet Promotes disassembly of the mitotic checkpoint complex in an ATP-dependent process.
records.model: Arrested-cell extracts and isolated MCC
records.note: p31comet promotes Cdc20 dissociation from BubR1 despite binding Mad2, requiring hydrolyzable ATP. Mechanism of checkpoint exit without therapeutic administration.

records.title: Identification of therapeutic targets in ovarian cancer through active tyrosine kinase profiling.
records.model: Ovarian cancer cells and in-vivo tumor models
records.note: T-DM1 causes aberrant spindles, phospho-BUBR1 accumulation and later multinucleation/death; increased phospho-BUBR1 is an arrest marker, not restoration evidence.

records.title: Cell cycle and centromere FISH studies in premature centromere division.
records.model: Four-member family with isolated premature centromere division
records.note: PCD occurs with and without colchicine processing and accompanies shorter generation time despite centromere DNA integrity. Colchicine is a culture/assay agent.

records.title: Analysis of the spindle assembly checkpoint in vertebrates
records.model: Chicken DT40 BubR1 targeting thesis
records.note: Heterozygotes retain growth/checkpoint, while second-allele targeting fails and exogenous expression appears detrimental. Saved abstract ends '(continues)', leaving its concluding result unavailable.

records.title: Impaired phosphorylation and mis-localization of Bub1 and BubR1 are responsible for the defective mitotic checkpoint function in Brca2-mutant thymic lymphomas.
records.model: Brca2-mutant mouse thymic lymphomas
records.note: Tumor-derived Bub1/BubR1 mutants show defective phosphorylation and kinetochore localization after spindle damage, linking mutations to chromosome instability; no named drug rescue.

records.title: Centrobin regulates the assembly of functional mitotic spindles.
records.model: Centrobin-depleted cells with live imaging
records.note: Centrobin loss disrupts centrosome anchoring and stable attachments; Mad2 co-depletion relieves arrest but does not establish correction of spindle integrity.

records.title: Sequential assembly of centromeric proteins in male mouse meiosis.
records.model: Mouse spermatocytes and Shugoshin-2 perturbation
records.note: BubR1/CENP-E load last and reload during interkinesis; Shugoshin-2 supports MCAK recruitment but is dispensable for their loading. No drug result.

records.title: Kinetochore localisation and phosphorylation of the mitotic checkpoint components Bub1 and BubR1 are differentially regulated by spindle events in human cells.
records.model: Human mitotic cells exposed to spindle toxins
records.note: Brief nocodazole or taxol rapidly alters Bub1 localization/phosphorylation, whereas BubR1 changes little; compounds are spindle-damage probes, not restorative treatments.

records.title: Targeted inhibition of Polo-like kinase 1 by a novel small-molecule inhibitor induces mitotic catastrophe and apoptosis in human bladder cancer cells.
records.model: 5637/T24 bladder cancer cells and nude-mouse xenografts
records.outcome_direction: cancer mitotic catastrophe with BubR1 reduction
records.note: PLK1 inhibitor RO3280 slows tumors, increases mitotic catastrophe/apoptosis and lowers BubR1. This opposes abundance restoration and qualifies translation of genetic PLK1 suppression.

records.title: Mad3/BubR1 phosphorylation during spindle checkpoint activation depends on both Polo and Aurora kinases in budding yeast.
records.model: Budding yeast Mad3 phosphosite mutants
records.note: Mad3 hyperphosphorylation depends chiefly on Cdc5 and partly Ipl1; serine mutations reduce phosphorylation. Unspecified depolymerizers are checkpoint triggers, not rescue candidates.

records.title: Regulation of AURORA B function by mitotic checkpoint protein MAD2.
records.model: MAD2-depleted and overexpressing cells
records.note: MAD2 loss mislocalizes Aurora B and reduces histone-H3 phosphorylation; overexpression has opposite effects. This extends checkpoint-protein roles without administering a drug.

records.title: Identification of genes associated with osteoarthritis by microarray analysis.
records.model: OA and non-OA knee tibial-plateau microarrays
records.note: BUB1B occurs in enriched cell-cycle pathways in OA expression data; kinesin-domain and ECM signals are computational disease associations, not treatment results.

records.title: Studying roles of the kinetochore component Ndc80 in spindle assembly checkpoint
records.model: Fission yeast ndc80-AK01 thesis
records.note: Study isolates a linker/hairpin-region ndc80 mutant to probe SAC recruitment, but saved abstract cuts off before detailed mutant findings with '(continues)'.

records.title: Attenuation of p38α MAPK stress response signaling delays the in vivo aging of skeletal muscle myofibers and progenitor cells.
records.model: Aged dominant-negative haploinsufficient p38-alpha mice
records.outcome_direction: preserved muscle mass and protective factors
records.note: Genetically attenuated p38-alpha preserves gastrocnemius mass, BubR1/ALDH proteins and progenitor state while reducing senescence/damage markers; no p38 inhibitor is administered in abstract.

records.title: Re-evaluating the role of Tao1 in the spindle checkpoint.
records.model: Multiple Tao1 siRNAs and Mad2 complementation
records.outcome_direction: off-target correction of proposed checkpoint target
records.note: Only original Tao1 siRNA also lowers Mad2; exogenous Mad2, not Tao1, rescues its checkpoint phenotype. Independent siRNAs do not support Tao1 checkpoint membership.

records.title: Melanoma genome evolution across species.
records.model: BRAF-V600E/p53-null zebrafish melanoma and human comparison
records.note: Four months of vemurafenib selects resistant melanoma with BUB1B/PINK1/COL16A1 mutations and transcriptome changes; BUB1B alteration is resistance association, not rescue.

records.title: Deleterious Germline Mutations in Patients With Apparently Sporadic Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma.
records.model: Germline sequencing in pancreatic/periampullary surgical cohorts
records.note: One BUB1B germline mutation is found among 854 pancreatic cancer cases; therapeutic targetability discussion does not specify BUB1B treatment or patient response.

records.title: p53: guardian of ploidy.
records.model: p53 ploidy surveillance literature
records.note: Review places BubR1 with Lats2/BRCA proteins in p53-dependent suppression of tetraploid propagation; no intervention is tested.

records.title: The condensin component NCAPG2 regulates microtubule-kinetochore attachment through recruitment of Polo-like kinase 1 to kinetochores.
records.model: Human and C. elegans NCAPG2 depletion; structural assays
records.note: NCAPG2 loss weakens attachment through mislocalized PLK1 and reduced BubR1 phosphorylation; mechanistic support cautions that broad PLK1 suppression can impair attachments.

records.title: Stable MCC binding to the APC/C is required for a functional spindle assembly checkpoint.
records.model: Cdc20 IR/C-box mutant cells
records.note: Mutants assemble MCC but defective APC/C binding compromises checkpoint through uninhibited Cdc20 competition; assembly alone does not establish functional checkpoint rescue.

records.title: Physical and functional interactions between mitotic kinases during polyploidization and megakaryocytic differentiation.
records.model: K562 erythroleukemic differentiation model
records.note: PMA induces megakaryocyte markers/polyploidy with increased Plk3/Aurora A and reduced BubR1. Deliberate lineage polyploidization is not BubR1-deficient muscle rescue.

records.title: Different spindle checkpoint proteins monitor microtubule attachment and tension at kinetochores in Drosophila cells.
records.model: Drosophila S2 cells and detergent-extracted kinetochore assays
records.note: Low-dose taxol removes tension without occupancy loss and recruits BubR1, unlike Mad2/Bub1; phosphorylation dependence dissects checkpoint sensing, not treatment benefit.

records.title: PTHLH coupling upstream negative regulation of fatty acid biosynthesis and Wnt receptor signal to downstream peptidase activity-induced apoptosis network in human hepatocellular carcinoma by systems-theoretical analysis.
records.model: HCC versus hepatitis/cirrhosis GEO network inference
records.note: Computational GO-network inference links upstream/downstream BUB1B to PTHLH and apoptosis; network activation language does not describe administered PTHLH or a drug.

records.title: Full-length single-cell RNA-seq applied to a viral human cancer: applications to HPV expression and splicing analysis in HeLa S3 cells.
records.model: Single-cell RNA sequencing of HeLa S3 cells
records.note: BUB1B is one of 283 HPV E6/E7 co-regulated genes in a single-cell platform study; no BUBR1 manipulation or administered rescue agent.

records.title: Bub1 is required for kinetochore localization of BubR1, Cenp-E, Cenp-F and Mad2, and chromosome congression.
records.model: Bub1 RNAi in human somatic cells
records.note: Bub1 depletion removes several kinetochore components including BubR1 and increases lagging chromosomes, yet residual spindle-checkpoint activity remains. No drug rescue.

records.title: Bub1 and aurora B cooperate to maintain BubR1-mediated inhibition of APC/CCdc20.
records.model: Bub1-deficient human somatic cells
records.note: ZM447439 eliminates residual arrest in Bub1-deficient cells; Bub1 and Aurora arms support MCC-APC/C binding. Qualifies attachment rescue by Aurora inhibition with checkpoint tradeoffs.

records.title: New prognostic factors in breast cancer.
records.model: Breast cancer prognostic-marker literature
records.note: Review considers BUBR1/S100P tumor dynamics and separate chemoresistance markers; no BUBR1-directed treatment is administered in abstract.

records.title: Mad2 and BubR1 function in a single checkpoint pathway that responds to a loss of tension.
records.model: PtK1 cells at 23C versus 37C
records.note: Cooling lowers tension and prolongs metaphase; inhibitory Mad2 reagents or BubR1 antibody abolish delay. These are mechanistic microinjection probes, not rescue medications.

records.title: CM363, a novel naphthoquinone derivative which acts as multikinase modulator and overcomes imatinib resistance in chronic myelogenous leukemia.
records.model: K562 CML cells, resistant cells and xenografts
records.note: CM363 lowers BUBR1, induces DNA damage/apoptosis, synergizes with imatinib and suppresses xenografts at 10mg/kg; no healthy-tissue restoration.

records.title: Cancer-prone syndrome of mosaic variegated aneuploidy and total premature chromatid separation: report of five infants.
records.model: Five infants and literature cases with PCS/MVA syndrome
records.outcome_direction: developmental disease and early tumor predisposition
records.note: Infants show growth/developmental impairment, mosaic aneuploidy and early Wilms/rhabdomyosarcoma risk; differing laboratory PCS frequencies further qualify cytogenetic endpoints. No rescue therapy.

records.title: BUBR1 phosphorylation is regulated during mitotic checkpoint activation.
records.model: Human tissue expression, cell lines and recombinant BUBR1
records.note: BUBR1 increases in later S/G2 and becomes phosphorylated during nocodazole arrest; electrophoretic shifts measure checkpoint state, not pharmacologic restoration.

records.title: Hexavalent chromium induces energy metabolism disturbance and p53-dependent cell cycle arrest via reactive oxygen species in L-02 hepatocytes.
records.model: Chromium-exposed human L-02 hepatocytes
records.outcome_direction: toxin-induced metabolic and checkpoint changes rescued
records.note: NAC rescues ATP depletion/arrest; pifithrin-alpha restores Mrc1/BubR1 and reduces arrest after chromium. Toxin/p53 context does not establish congenital BUB1B or muscle benefit.

records.title: Cenp-meta is required for sustained spindle checkpoint.
records.model: Drosophila cenp-meta mutant neuroblasts
records.outcome_direction: checkpoint cannot sustain despite protein localization
records.note: Mutants initially arrest after colchicine yet slowly degrade cyclin B and segregate inaccurately despite kinetochore Mad2/BubR1; localization alone is insufficient.

records.title: Drosophila CENP-A mutations cause a BubR1-dependent early mitotic delay without normal localization of kinetochore components.
records.model: Drosophila CENP-A-null embryos
records.note: CENP-A mutants retain checkpoint responses despite absent sustained kinetochore localization; BubR1 mutation partly suppresses delay without demonstrating accurate segregation rescue.

records.title: Dynamic autophosphorylation of mps1 kinase is required for faithful mitotic progression.
records.model: Human Mps1 phosphosite mutant cells
records.note: Mps1 phosphomimic weakens kinetochore recruitment of Mps1/BubR1/Mad2 and causes errors; nonphosphorylatable variant prolongs anaphase timing. No pharmacologic rescue.

records.title: IPP51, a chalcone acting as a microtubule inhibitor with in vivo antitumor activity against bladder carcinoma.
records.model: Bladder cancer cells, purified tubulin and mouse xenografts
records.note: IPP51 competes at colchicine tubulin site, disrupts alignment and increases chromosome-bound BubR1 during arrest; tumor inhibition is not restored healthy-cell checkpoint function.

records.title: Arrayed BUB recruitment modules in the kinetochore scaffold KNL1 promote accurate chromosome segregation.
records.model: Engineered human KNL1 recruitment-module variants
records.note: Few modules sustain checkpoint while more improve biorientation; replacing modules with designed arrays preserves function. Genetic scaffold engineering, not administered drug.

records.title: Anemone altaica Induces Apoptosis in Human Osteosarcoma Cells.
records.model: HOS/U2OS osteosarcoma and hFOB osteoblast cells
records.note: Extract induces intrinsic apoptosis in tumor cells while sparing hFOB viability; BUB1B expression changes are not directionally specified and do not show healthy-tissue rescue.

records.title: Recruitment of Mad1 to metaphase kinetochores is sufficient to reactivate the mitotic checkpoint.
records.model: Engineered metaphase kinetochore Mad1 recruitment assay
records.note: Chemical dimerization relocates engineered Mad1 and reactivates checkpoint without increased BubR1/Mps1; reagent controls an artificial localization system, not a therapeutic rescue test.

records.title: PARP targeting counteracts gliomagenesis through induction of mitotic catastrophe and aggravation of deficiency in homologous recombination in PTEN-mutant glioma.
records.model: PTEN-mutant glioblastoma cells and in-vivo tumors
records.note: PARP inhibition lowers BUBR1 and exacerbates HR deficiency/genomic instability; erlotinib combination reduces tumors. Cancer killing is opposite to healthy-tissue checkpoint restoration.

records.title: A synthetic dolastatin 10 analogue suppresses microtubule dynamics, inhibits cell proliferation, and induces apoptotic cell death.
records.model: HeLa/MCF7 and other cancer cells; purified tubulin
records.note: D5 suppresses microtubule dynamics, causes multipolar spindles and recruits BubR1/Mad2 during arrest before apoptosis. Increased localization is a damage response.

records.title: Timing and checkpoints in the regulation of mitotic progression.
records.model: RNAi and live imaging in HeLa cells
records.note: All tested checkpoint-protein depletions remove stress arrest, but only Mad2/BubR1 loss accelerates ordinary mitosis; cytosolic timing function differs from kinetochore signaling.

records.title: METHODS FOR DETERMINING A PROGNOSIS IN MULTIPLE MYELOMA
records.model: Multiple-myeloma prognosis patent
records.note: Patent abstract uses BUB1B/HDAC3 and two additional gene pairs in a prognostic signature; no administered drug or rescue experiment is described.

records.title: Aurora B couples chromosome alignment with anaphase by targeting BubR1, Mad2, and Cenp-E to kinetochores.
records.model: Human mitotic cells with Aurora inhibition and RNAi
records.note: ZM447439 compromises BubR1 recruitment/phosphorylation, alignment, segregation and cytokinesis; blocks paclitaxel arrest. Direct liability evidence for broad Aurora inhibition despite attachment-rescue reports.

records.title: Compromised spindle assembly checkpoint due to altered expression of Ubch10 and Cdc20 in human papillomavirus type 16 E6- and E7-expressing keratinocytes.
records.model: HPV16 E6/E7-expressing keratinocytes with DNA damage
records.note: Excess Ubch10/Cdc20 permits cyclin-B degradation despite some Cdc20-BubR1 complexes, allowing damaged-cell cycling; abstract specifies no therapeutic agent.

records.title: Inhibitory effect of wild-type p53 gene on excessive replication of centrosomes in leukemia cell line K562.
records.model: Adenoviral wild-type-p53-transduced K562 leukemia cells
records.outcome_direction: fewer amplified centrosomes and increased BubR1
records.note: Wild-type p53 gene transfer raises BubR1/Gadd45a and lowers Aurora A alongside reduced centrosome amplification; polybrene facilitates transduction and is not the rescue driver.

records.title: Identification of Biomarkers for Controlling Cancer Stem Cell Characteristics in Bladder Cancer by Network Analysis of Transcriptome Data Stemness Indices.
records.model: Bladder-cancer stemness-index public-data analysis
records.note: BUB1B is one of 13 computational stemness hubs; upstream AURKB/PLK1 targeting is proposed without administered inhibitor or normal-tissue result.

records.title: Drosophila cell cycle under arrest: uncapped telomeres plead guilty.
records.model: Drosophila telomere/checkpoint literature
records.note: Review describes BubR1 accumulation on uncapped chromosome ends activating SAC alongside DNA-damage responses; no pharmacologic rescue result.

records.title: Strategies for outcrossing and genetic manipulation of Drosophila compound autosome stocks.
records.model: Drosophila compound-autosome breeding stocks
records.note: Cold shock or bubR1 mutations generate complementary nullo gametes to enable breeding; useful genetics technique, not recovery of deficient cell function.

records.title: Spindle assembly checkpoint is sufficient for complete Cdc20 sequestering in mitotic control.
records.model: ODE and spatial models of checkpoint inhibition
records.note: Models incorporating MCC binding a second Cdc20 reproduce literature data and predict full APC/C inhibition; no new administered-agent experiment.

records.title: Optic atrophy, microcephaly, mental retardation and mosaic variegated aneuploidy: a human mitotic mutation.
records.model: Twelve-year-old girl with mosaic variegated aneuploidy
records.note: Optic atrophy, microcephaly, developmental impairment, short stature and mosaic karyotypes are described; no BUB1B genotype or treatment response is supplied.

records.title: TAp73 regulates the spindle assembly checkpoint by modulating BubR1 activity.
records.model: TAp73-deficient murine/human cells and lung cancer specimens
records.note: TAp73 directly interacts with Bub proteins and regulates localization/activity; its loss produces arrest defects and aneuploidy. No drug intervention.

records.title: A microtubule-associated zinc finger protein, BuGZ, regulates mitotic chromosome alignment by ensuring Bub3 stability and kinetochore targeting.
records.model: BuGZ discovery and kinetochore functional assays
records.note: BuGZ binds/stabilizes Bub3 and aids microtubule-dependent kinetochore loading of Bub3/BubR1/CENP-E; molecular chaperone mechanism without a small-molecule stabilizer.

records.title: METHODS FOR DETERMINING A PROGNOSIS IN MULTIPLE MYELOMA
records.model: Multiple-myeloma prognosis patent
records.note: US patent abstract repeats BUB1B-containing six-gene prognostic signature; distinct patent record, not an independent rescue or treatment experiment.

records.title: Recruitment of Mad2 to the kinetochore requires the Rod/Zw10 complex.
records.model: Live fluorescent checkpoint-protein localization
records.note: Rod/Zw10 recruits and removes Mad2 at outer kinetochore corona, while BubR1 occupies a different region and recruits independently. No drug intervention.

records.title: In silico study of kinetochore control, amplification, and inhibition effects in MCC assembly.
records.model: Dynamic mathematical models of MCC assembly
records.note: Model favors kinetochore control of Bub3:BubR1 reactions and MCC-APC/C inhibition over complete Cdc20 sequestration; predictions are not administered-agent experiments.

records.title: Expansion of myeloid-derived suppressor cells with aging in the bone marrow of mice through a NF-κB-dependent mechanism.
records.model: Aged, ERCC1-deficient and BubR1-hypomorphic mice
records.note: MDSCs expand in both progeroid models, but p65 reduction rescues expansion only as tested in ERCC1 mice; no BubR1-model drug rescue.

records.title: A minimal number of MELT repeats supports all the functions of KNL1 in chromosome segregation.
records.model: KNL1 MELT-repeat deletion variants
records.note: Four of twelve MELT repeats retain chromosome congression/checkpoint; further reduction impairs function, and PP1 limits Bub recruitment. Genetic mechanism without a drug.

records.title: An antimitotic and antivascular agent BPR0L075 overcomes multidrug resistance and induces mitotic catastrophe in paclitaxel-resistant ovarian cancer cells.
records.model: Parental and paclitaxel-resistant ovarian cancer cell lines
records.outcome_direction: cancer killing by apoptosis or mitotic catastrophe
records.note: BPR0L075 raises BubR1 in parental cells but kills resistant low-BubR1 cells through mitotic catastrophe; abundance changes do not indicate healthy-cell rescue.

records.title: Spatial regulation of the spindle assembly checkpoint and anaphase-promoting complex in Aspergillus nidulans.
records.model: Aspergillus fluorescent SAC fusions and gamma-tubulin mutant
records.note: SAC proteins converge at mitotic spindle poles; gamma-tubulin mutation selectively blocks nuclear localization of Mps1/Bub1-R1. No administered agent.

records.title: Mammalian mad2 and bub1/bubR1 recognize distinct spindle-attachment and kinetochore-tension checkpoints.
records.model: HeLa mitotic cells
records.note: Nanomolar vinblastine lowers tension and recruits Bub1/BubR1 while higher doses recruit Mad2 through spindle disruption; drug is a checkpoint probe.

records.title: The hairpin region of Ndc80 is important for the kinetochore recruitment of Mph1/MPS1 in fission yeast.
records.model: Fission yeast ndc80-AK01 mutant
records.note: Ndc80 hairpin mutation prevents SAC recruitment; artificial kinetochore tethering of Mph1 restores signaling. Genetic localization rescue, not drug benefit.

records.title: Quantitative phosphoproteomic analysis reveals system-wide signaling pathways regulated by site-specific phosphorylation of Keratin-8 in skin squamous cell carcinoma derived cell line.
records.model: Keratin-8 phosphosite mutants in A431 SCC cells
records.note: K8-S431 mutants alter BUB1B S1043 phosphorylation amid proliferation/migration networks; no BUBR1 restorative agent is tested.

records.title: Chk1 is required for spindle checkpoint function.
records.model: Chk1-deficient vertebrate cells and biochemical assays
records.note: Chk1 deficiency impairs Aurora-B activity and BubR1 localization/phosphorylation during taxol stress, but not complete depolymerization arrest. Resistance is not functional rescue.

records.title: ARF-induced downregulation of Mip130/LIN-9 protein levels mediates a positive feedback that leads to increased expression of p16Ink4a and p19Arf.
records.model: p53-null and Arf-null mouse embryonic fibroblasts
records.note: LIN9 knockdown lowers BubR1/CDC6 transcription and indirectly raises p16/ARF, yielding genotype-specific senescence; no administered compound.

records.title: Value of Molecular Classification for Prognostic Assessment of Adrenocortical Carcinoma.
records.model: 368 surgically treated adrenocortical carcinoma patients
records.note: BUB1B/PINK1 expression contributes to targeted molecular classifiers with recurrence value in localized ACC; abstract does not test BUB1B treatment response.

records.title: CXI-benzo-84 reversibly binds to tubulin at colchicine site and induces apoptosis in cancer cells.
records.model: Cancer cells and purified tubulin assays
records.note: Colchicine-site benzimidazole depolymerizes microtubules and recruits Mad2/BubR1 before apoptosis; checkpoint accumulation follows damaging antimitotic action.

records.title: Synuclein-gamma targeting peptide inhibitor that enhances sensitivity of breast cancer cells to antimicrotubule drugs.
records.model: SNCG-overexpressing breast cancer cells
records.note: Microinjected ANK peptide and genetically expressed ANK reduce SNCG-mediated antimitotic resistance, likely freeing BubR1; normal tissue lacks described SNCG expression and rescue is cancer killing.

records.title: The ARF tumor suppressor prevents chromosomal instability and ensures mitotic checkpoint fidelity through regulation of Aurora B.
records.model: ARF-null primary mouse embryonic fibroblasts and mice
records.outcome_direction: normalizing Aurora B rescues mitotic defects
records.note: ARF loss raises Mad2/BubR1/Aurora B; only excess Aurora B reproduces defects, and near-normal Aurora B restores mitosis. Abstract does not specify a drug.

records.title: Screening feature genes of lung carcinoma with DNA microarray analysis.
records.model: Lung cancer versus normal expression microarrays
records.note: PPI analysis identifies BUB1B/MAD2L/TOP2A hubs alongside predicted transcriptional regulators; therapeutic language is nomination without administered agents.

records.title: Prognostic factors of survival rate in oral squamous cell carcinoma: clinical, histologic, genetic and molecular concepts.
records.model: Oral squamous-cell carcinoma prognosis literature
records.note: Review lists BUBR1 among molecular prognostic markers alongside clinical/histologic factors; no BubR1-directed drug or rescue experiment is reported.

records.title: Disassembly of mitotic checkpoint complexes by the joint action of the AAA-ATPase TRIP13 and p31(comet).
records.model: HeLa extracts and checkpoint complexes
records.note: TRIP13 and p31comet release Mad2 from MCC using ATP and terminate APC/C inhibition; no pharmacologic modulation is tested.

records.title: Differential Cellular Effects of Plk1 Inhibitors Targeting the ATP-binding Domain or Polo-box Domain.
records.model: Cellular PLK1 inhibitor comparisons
records.note: ATP-site inhibitors activate BubR1 and induce metaphase arrest; PBD inhibitors increase p21 and S-phase arrest. BubR1 activation marks drug-induced arrest, not rescue.

records.title: NUP98 fusion oncoproteins promote aneuploidy by attenuating the mitotic spindle checkpoint.
records.model: NUP98-fusion-expressing myeloid cells
records.note: NUP98 oncoproteins displace BubR1 from APC/C-Cdc20, destabilize arrest and promote missegregation; PEST deletion reproduces phenotype. No drug intervention.

records.title: Overexpression of Aurora-C interferes with the spindle checkpoint by promoting the degradation of Aurora-B.
records.model: Aurora-C-overexpressing somatic cancer cells
records.note: Excess Aurora C displaces CPC, destabilizes Aurora B and eliminates BubR1 activation under nocodazole. Drug is checkpoint stimulus; genetic overexpression causes damage.

records.title: Upregulation of CDKN2A and suppression of cyclin D1 gene expressions in ACTH-secreting pituitary adenomas.
records.model: 43 pituitary adenoma specimens
records.note: BUBR1 and several other regulators do not differ among ACTH, silent-corticotroph and nonfunctioning adenomas; CDKN2A/cyclin changes dominate. No treatment test.

records.title: Cohesin and microtubule dependent mechanisms regulate sister centromere fusion during meiosis I
records.model: Drosophila oocyte RNAi and double-depletion preprint
records.outcome_direction: two mechanisms preserve meiotic centromere fusion
records.note: SPC105R protects cohesion whereas PP1-87B opposes Polo/BubR1 attachment stabilization; drugs probe spindle forces, with identities and therapeutic implications absent.

records.title: Mode of interaction of TRIP13 AAA-ATPase with the Mad2-binding protein p31comet and with mitotic checkpoint complexes.
records.model: TRIP13 oligomer and checkpoint-complex binding assays
records.note: p31comet and closed-Mad2 complexes mutually promote TRIP13 binding, explaining MCC disassembly substrate specificity. No drug result.

records.title: Relaying the checkpoint signal from kinetochore to APC/C.
records.model: Commentary on two checkpoint-signaling studies
records.note: Brief commentary introduces Mad2/BubR1 relay findings from other papers and supplies no administered-agent experiment.

records.title: Mechanisms of aneuploidy in thyroid cancer cell lines and tissues: evidence for mitotic checkpoint dysfunction without mutations in BUB1 and BUBR1.
records.model: Thyroid tumor cell lines and follicular specimens
records.outcome_direction: checkpoint defects usually lack BUB mutations
records.note: Three lines fail nocodazole arrest; BUB1/BUBR1 mutations are uncommon and do not explain most thyroid aneuploidy. Nocodazole is a diagnostic perturbation.

records.title: Synuclein gamma inhibits the mitotic checkpoint function and promotes chromosomal instability of breast cancer cells.
records.model: SNCG-expressing breast cancer cells
records.note: Enforced BubR1 overexpression overcomes SNCG-mediated checkpoint suppression and drug resistance; this is genetic cancer-sensitivity rescue, not pharmacologic BUB1B restoration.

records.title: Genetic variation in the major mitotic checkpoint genes does not affect familial breast cancer risk.
records.model: 441 familial breast cancer cases and 552 matched controls
records.note: Nine SNPs across six checkpoint genes, including BUB1B, show no individual, haplotype or gene-interaction association with familial breast-cancer risk.

records.title: Overexpression of the mitotic checkpoint genes BUB1, BUBR1, and BUB3 in gastric cancer--association with tumour cell proliferation.
records.model: 43 gastric carcinomas and matched mucosa
records.outcome_direction: BUB expression tracks proliferation, not ploidy
records.note: BUBR1 is overexpressed in 68% of tumors and correlates with Ki67 but not ploidy; supports caution interpreting abundance as improved checkpoint function.
