records.title: A double missense variation of the BUB1 gene and a defective mitotic spindle checkpoint in the pancreatic cancer cell line Hs766T.
records.model: Pancreatic cancer cell lines and xenograft sequencing
records.note: Hs766T carries two same-allele BUB1 missense changes and defective checkpoint; BUB1B findings are polymorphisms. Association does not establish BUB1B therapy.

records.title: Inactivation of the mitotic checkpoint as a determinant of the efficacy of microtubule-targeted drugs in killing human cancer cells.
records.model: Breast, ovarian and other human cancer cells
records.note: BubR1 RNAi abolishes checkpoint and reverses antimitotic resistance; lower BubR1 correlates with death after transient arrest. Opposite resistance directions across cancer contexts limit extrapolation.

records.title: MicroRNA-101 regulated transcriptional modulator SUB1 plays a role in prostate cancer.
records.model: SUB1/miR101-perturbed prostate cancer models
records.note: SUB1 regulates BUB1B/PLK1/MYC transcription; PLK1 inhibition or knockdown mitigates SUB1 oncogenic effects. Abstract leaves compound unnamed and does not demonstrate normal-tissue rescue.

records.title: Conditional targeting of MAD1 to kinetochores is sufficient to reactivate the spindle assembly checkpoint in metaphase.
records.model: Engineered FKBP-MAD1/FRB-MIS12 cells
records.note: Rapamycin induces engineered heterodimerization to move Mad1 to kinetochores and stop cyclin-B degradation; this is not evidence of mTOR-mediated pharmacologic rescue.

records.title: Lethality to human cancer cells through massive chromosome loss by inhibition of the mitotic checkpoint.
records.model: Human cancer cells including chromosomally unstable colorectal lines
records.note: BubR1/Mad2 depletion or BubR1 kinase inhibition causes massive chromosome loss and apoptosis unless cytokinesis is blocked; abstract specifies no inhibitor identity or modality.

records.title: Low concentrations of taxol cause mitotic delay followed by premature dissociation of p55CDC from Mad2 and BubR1 and abrogation of the spindle checkpoint, leading to aneuploidy.
records.model: Human cellular taxol concentration comparison
records.note: 5-10nM taxol permits delayed exit with Cdc20-Mad2/BubR1 dissociation and aneuploidy; higher concentrations sustain arrest. Dose-dependent checkpoint activation is not rescue.

records.title: Senescent cells: a novel therapeutic target for aging and age-related diseases.
records.model: Senescence and BubR1 progeroid-mouse literature
records.note: Review describes causal p16-positive-cell clearance benefits in BubR1 progeroid mice, but supplies no named administered senolytic or conventional drug result.

records.title: Piperlongumine inhibits LMP1/MYC-dependent mouse B-lymphoma cells.
records.model: LMP1/MYC-driven mouse B-lymphoma and normal B cells
records.outcome_direction: selective tumor apoptosis with Bub1b suppression
records.note: Piperlongumine suppresses LMP1/MYC/NFkB targets including Bub1b and kills neoplastic B cells while sparing normal viability; no healthy-tissue restorative result.

records.title: Phosphorylation at serine 331 is required for Aurora B activation.
records.model: Aurora-B S331A mutant and Chk1 studies
records.note: S331 mutation causes missegregation, multinucleation and unstable kinetochore BubR1; taxol/nocodazole distinguish signaling contexts. No beneficial drug rescue.

records.title: A motif from Lys216 to Lys222 in human BUB3 protein is a nuclear localization signal and critical for BUB3 function in mitotic checkpoint.
records.model: Human BUB3 localization-signal mutants
records.note: BUB3 mutants retain BubR1/Bub1/Mad2 binding but lose effective kinetochore localization and arrest, separating complex interaction from functional checkpoint output.

records.title: The APC/C subunit Mnd2/Apc15 promotes Cdc20 autoubiquitination and spindle assembly checkpoint inactivation.
records.model: Purified budding-yeast APC/C and Mnd2 deletion
records.outcome_direction: Cdc20 ubiquitination controls arrest and exit
records.note: General ubiquitination inhibition prevents checkpoint establishment, whereas Mnd2 deletion delays release; distinct genetic effects argue against undifferentiated checkpoint stabilization.

records.title: Impaired Bub1 function in vivo compromises tension-dependent checkpoint function leading to aneuploidy and tumorigenesis.
records.model: Bub1-hypomorphic mice and embryonic fibroblasts
records.note: Low Bub1 causes senescence/aneuploidy, reduced BubR1 localization and poor taxol response despite nocodazole arrest; genetic background changes survival. No rescue agent.

records.title: Increased expression of mitotic checkpoint genes in breast cancer cells with chromosomal instability.
records.model: Breast cancer cell lines, tumors and normal mammary comparators
records.outcome_direction: high checkpoint proteins coexist with instability
records.note: Unstable cancers have increased BUB1B and other checkpoint proteins without functional sequence variants; abundance may compensate for defects rather than prove fidelity.

records.title: Role and regulation of the kinetochore protein Spc7 in fission yeast mitosis
records.model: Fission yeast Spc7/PP1-binding thesis
records.note: Thesis investigates two N-terminal Spc7 PP1-binding motifs, but saved abstract stops mid-result with '(continues)'; no drug in the available portion.

records.title: Investigating the role of spindle checkpoint mutations in colorectal cancer
records.model: Colorectal BUBR1-DE5 transcript and yeast/human models thesis
records.note: DE5 transcript occurs in a quarter of young-patient aneuploid tumors; planned functional yeast/human comparisons are truncated before results in saved abstract.

records.title: Survivin is required for a sustained spindle checkpoint arrest in response to lack of tension.
records.model: Survivin-depleted mammalian cells
records.note: Survivin loss mislocalizes Aurora B and prematurely releases BubR1/Mad2, producing polyploidy despite initial arrest; drug challenges probe the defect, not rescue it.

records.title: MiR-210 disturbs mitotic progression through regulating a group of mitosis-related genes.
records.model: Hypoxic CNE cells and mouse metastatic-tumor model
records.outcome_direction: mitotic disruption and reduced tumor formation
records.note: miR210 directly suppresses PLK1/CDC25B/CCNF/BUB1B/FAM83D; administered mimic reduces tumors while disturbing mitosis. Nucleic-acid cancer intervention, not BUB1B restoration.

records.title: Human papillomavirus type 16 E7 oncoprotein engages but does not abrogate the mitotic spindle assembly checkpoint.
records.model: HPV16-E7-expressing cells and checkpoint RNAi
records.note: E7 impairs mitotic-cyclin degradation through SAC engagement yet retains poison response, contrasting with broad checkpoint-abrogation claims; no restorative drug result.

records.title: The GPER agonist G-1 induces mitotic arrest and apoptosis in human vascular smooth muscle cells independent of GPER.
records.model: Human vascular smooth-muscle cells
records.note: G-1 at 1-10uM increases phospho-BubR1 while damaging spindles and killing vascular SMCs; GPER/MEK blockade does not prevent effects. Not muscle rescue.

records.title: Longevity pathways are associated with human ovarian ageing.
records.model: 38 human germinal-vesicle oocytes from women aged 25-43
records.note: BUB1B belongs to declining pro-longevity expression genes; mTOR-related associations are observational. FSH dosage is a clinical covariate, not tested BUBR1-rescue treatment.

records.title: MDM4 overexpressed in acute myeloid leukemia patients with complex karyotype and wild-type TP53.
records.model: Complex-karyotype AML samples and MDM4-overexpressing HepG2 cells
records.note: MDM4 overexpression lowers p21/BubR1/securin and mitotic index after nocodazole, with aneuploidy/polyploidy; no MDM4 inhibitor is administered.

records.title: Ubiquitination by the anaphase-promoting complex drives spindle checkpoint inactivation.
records.model: APC/C-Cdc20 ubiquitination and deubiquitination assays
records.note: APC-driven multiubiquitination releases Mad2/BubR1 from Cdc20 and a directed deubiquitinase reverses it; molecular mechanism without drug rescue.

records.title: Visceral obesity stimulates anaphase bridge formation and spindle assembly checkpoint dysregulation in radioresistant oesophageal adenocarcinoma.
records.model: Radioresponsive/resistant esophageal adenocarcinoma cells and patient tumors
records.note: Adipose medium increases anaphase bridges, especially in resistant cells; BUB1B is assayed but reported significant expression changes center on MAD2L2. No therapeutic agent.

records.title: Early aging-associated phenotypes in Bub3/Rae1 haploinsufficient mice.
records.model: Bub3/Rae1 double-haploinsufficient mice versus BubR1 hypomorphs
records.outcome_direction: senescence tracks premature aging beyond aneuploidy
records.note: Double haploinsufficiency causes early aging/senescence, but greater aneuploidy than faster-aging BubR1 mice; cautions against aneuploidy alone as tissue-benefit surrogate.

records.title: Complex cytogenetic analysis of early lethality mouse embryos.
records.model: Bub1b-deficient E7.5-E9.5 mouse embryos
records.note: Combines embryo genotyping, chromosome spreading and metaphase/anaphase analysis to study early lethality; methods paper supplies no rescue intervention.

records.title: Germline mutations in candidate predisposition genes in individuals with cutaneous melanoma and at least two independent additional primary cancers.
records.model: 57 melanoma patients with multiple additional cancers and 1358 controls
records.note: Potentially pathogenic BUB1B variants occur among numerous candidate genes; uncertain individual causality and possible blood-derived somatic variants require care. No treatment result.

records.title: The mouse mitotic checkpoint gene bub1b, a novel bub1 family member, is expressed in a cell cycle-dependent manner.
records.model: Mouse tissue/thymocyte expression and human gene mapping
records.note: Early characterization distinguishes Bub1a/Bub1b and their G2/M timing; tissue expression tracks proliferation. No compound-induced restoration or functional rescue.

records.title: Mad3p, a pseudosubstrate inhibitor of APCCdc20 in the spindle assembly checkpoint.
records.model: Budding yeast Mad3 degron mutants and binding assays
records.note: Mad3 KEN/D boxes mediate Cdc20 competition with substrates instead of Mad3 turnover; Mad2 promotes binding. No administered agent.

records.title: Cyclin G1 regulates the outcome of taxane-induced mitotic checkpoint arrest.
records.model: CCNG1-perturbed cells and treated ovarian-cancer cohort
records.note: CCNG1 induction is independent of BubR1 signaling; overexpression aids survival while depletion delays slippage and increases paclitaxel apoptosis. Cancer response is not tissue rescue.

records.title: Molecular dynamic simulations of the tubulin-human gamma synuclein complex: structural insight into the regulatory mechanism involved in inducing resistance against Taxol.
records.model: Tubulin-gamma-synuclein molecular dynamics
records.note: Simulations predict gamma-synuclein rearranges tubulin loops and weakens Taxol binding; neither Taxol administration nor BubR1 rescue was tested here.

records.title: APC inactivation associates with abnormal mitosis completion and concomitant BUB1B/MAD2L1 up-regulation.
records.model: APC-mutant human colorectal samples and mouse models
records.note: APC loss associated with defective mitotic completion and increased BUB1B/MAD2L1, with in-vitro modulation supporting a causal expression link; increased protein is not demonstrated rescue.

records.title: Homeostatic control of mitotic arrest.
records.model: p31-comet-depleted mitotic cells
records.note: p31 depletion stabilized Cdc20/MCC, strongly inhibited APC/C and delayed exit; proposed antitubulin sensitization is not administered healthy-tissue rescue.

records.title: Deleterious variants in genes regulating mammalian reproduction in Neanderthals, Denisovans and extant humans.
records.model: Eight archaic hominin genomes and extant human datasets
records.note: BUB1B was among reproductive genes carrying predicted deleterious homozygous variants in some archaic individuals; computational pathogenicity and mating predictions are not therapeutic data.

records.title: APC/C- and Mad2-mediated degradation of Cdc20 during spindle checkpoint activation.
records.model: Spindle-checkpoint-activated cells
records.note: Spindle-poison activation caused Mad2-dependent APC/C-mediated Cdc20 degradation, proposed to sustain inhibition; a checkpoint mechanism without a rescue treatment.

records.title: Sumoylation of Kif18A plays a role in regulating mitotic progression.
records.model: SUMO-resistant Kif18A-expressing cells
records.note: Kif18A SUMO-site mutations prolonged exit and impaired BubR1 kinetochore removal despite little change in localization/stability; no pharmacological correction was reported.

records.title: A stringent requirement for Plk1 T210 phosphorylation during K-fiber assembly and chromosome congression.
records.model: Human PLK1 T210A/T210D gene replacements
records.note: T210D failed to support chromosome congression through defective BubR1 phosphorylation; chemical genetics bypassed this to reveal cytokinesis capacity, not a general segregation rescue.

records.title: Bub1 overexpression induces aneuploidy and tumor formation through Aurora B kinase hyperactivation.
records.model: Bub1-overexpressing mouse/cell models
records.note: Suppressing Aurora B pharmacologically or by BubR1 overexpression largely corrected Bub1-overexpression-induced segregation errors. Genuine fidelity compensation in a distinct hyperactive-Bub1 model; primary drug details needed.

records.title: Protein tyrosine phosphatase Shp2 (Ptpn11) plays an important role in maintenance of chromosome stability.
records.model: Shp2-depleted/reconstituted cells
records.note: Wild-type but not catalytically inactive Shp2 restored checkpoint and chromosome alignment; Shp2 supports PLK1/Aurora-B activation and BubR1 recruitment, without a rescue drug.

records.title: DNA damage response, checkpoint activation and dysfunctional telomeres: face to face between mammalian cells and Drosophila.
records.model: Drosophila/mammalian dysfunctional-telomere literature
records.note: Reviews telomere uncapping, DNA-damage responses and BubR1 recruitment to fly telomeres; no new administered intervention.

records.title: Novel target genes responsive to apoptotic activity by Ocimum gratissimum in human osteosarcoma cells.
records.model: U2-OS/HOS osteosarcoma and hFOS osteoblast cells
records.note: Extract induced osteosarcoma apoptosis while sparing the reported osteoblast line and downregulated BUB1B/SKA2; antioxidant framing does not make this BUBR1-restoration evidence.

records.title: APC15 mediates CDC20 autoubiquitylation by APC/C(MCC) and disassembly of the mitotic checkpoint complex.
records.model: Human APC15/MCC biochemical and cell assays
records.note: APC15 enabled MCC-associated Cdc20 autoubiquitylation/degradation and timely anaphase but was dispensable for other APC/C substrate ubiquitylation; no drug rescue.

records.title: Dependence of paclitaxel sensitivity on a functional spindle assembly checkpoint.
records.model: Cancer cells with MAD2/BUBR1 suppression or MAD2 overexpression
records.note: MAD2 overexpression restored checkpoint and drug sensitivity only in MAD2-low defects; MAD2/BUBR1 suppression caused paclitaxel resistance. Drug killing and genetic checkpoint rescue must remain distinct.

records.title: Physiological relevance of cell cycle kinases.
records.model: Mammalian cell-cycle kinase physiology literature
records.note: Reviews tissue-specific kinase roles in stem-cell renewal, regeneration and metabolism; proposed enzymatic modulation has no new drug efficacy result in this abstract.

records.title: The spindle checkpoint: how do cells delay anaphase onset?
records.model: Models of spindle-checkpoint APC/C regulation
records.note: Compares Cdc20 sequestration, MCC association, turnover and modification models and calls for flux/structural/reconstitution experiments; no administered candidate.

records.title: The novel synthetic compound 6-acetyl-9-(3,4,5-trimetho-xybenzyl)-9H-pyrido[2,3-b]indole induces mitotic arrest and apoptosis in human COLO 205 cells.
records.model: COLO205 colorectal cancer cells
records.note: HAC-Y6 increased BubR1/cyclin B1 while depolymerizing microtubules and inducing polyploidy/apoptosis; higher BubR1 accompanies cytotoxic arrest rather than restoration.

records.title: Defining pathways of spindle checkpoint silencing: functional redundancy between Cdc20 ubiquitination and p31(comet).
records.model: p31-comet depletion and nonubiquitinatable Cdc20 mutants
records.note: p31 loss delayed Mad2 dissociation from Cdc20 mutants, showing redundancy with Cdc20 ubiquitination in MCC disassembly; no rescue pharmacology.

records.title: Dishevelled, a Wnt signalling component, is involved in mitotic progression in cooperation with Plk1.
records.model: Dvl2/Plk1/Wnt-receptor cell assays
records.note: Plk1-dependent Dvl2 phosphorylation supports orientation/attachments while SAC recruitment uses a distinct pathway; Wnt receptors affect orientation but not SAC, limiting broad Wnt extrapolation.

records.title: Microtubule-dependent changes in assembly of microtubule motor proteins and mitotic spindle checkpoint proteins at PtK1 kinetochores.
records.model: PtK1 kinetochore quantitative imaging
records.note: Drug-induced depolymerization expanded outer kinetochores, whereas Taxol tension loss left metaphase BubR1 levels unchanged; this distinguishes attachment from tension responses, not rescue.

records.title: Making an effective switch at the kinetochore by phosphorylation and dephosphorylation.
records.model: Kinetochore phosphorylation literature
records.note: Reviews Aurora-B, PLK-BubR1-PP2A and Mps1/KNL1/PP1 switches regulating attachment and SAC; no newly tested agent.

records.title: p31(comet) acts to ensure timely spindle checkpoint silencing subsequent to kinetochore attachment.
records.model: Human/marsupial p31-comet-depleted cells
records.note: p31 loss blocked metaphase exit despite mature bipolar attachments and a satisfied checkpoint; normal mitosis requires active silencing, not simply increased arrest.

records.title: Roles of different pools of the mitotic checkpoint complex and the mechanisms of their disassembly.
records.model: Purified APC/C-MCC and Xenopus egg cell-free systems
records.note: Free MCC formed without APC/C and preceded bound MCC; distinct processes disassemble free versus APC/C-bound pools, without therapeutic intervention.

records.title: Spindle checkpoint function is required for mitotic catastrophe induced by DNA-damaging agents.
records.model: p53-deficient cancer cells with MAD2/BUBR1 RNAi
records.outcome_direction: mitotic catastrophe or resistant abnormal escape
records.note: DNA damage caused prolonged metaphase arrest/death; SAC knockdown allowed escape and abnormal mitosis, so restored cell survival is chemotherapy resistance rather than fidelity rescue.

records.title: Diagnostic of immune graft tolerance using TMTC3 gene expression levels
records.model: Grafted-subject expression-profile patent
records.note: Patent proposes TMTC3-based graft-tolerance classification and explicitly excludes a particular seven-gene combination including BUB1B; not a treatment experiment.

records.title: CDK-dependent potentiation of MPS1 kinase activity is essential to the mitotic checkpoint.
records.model: MPS1 phosphosite mutants in Xenopus egg extracts
records.note: MPS1 S283 phosphorylation enhanced catalytic efficiency and MAD1/MAD2 recruitment, lowering the kinetochore threshold for arrest; no administered drug rescue.

records.title: Spindle checkpoint protein dynamics at kinetochores in living cells.
records.model: GFP-tagged checkpoint proteins in living PtK2 cells
records.note: FRAP distinguished fast/slow Cdc20-BubR1 exchange from stable Mad1/Bub1 and supported catalytic signaling; this is quantitative basic mechanism.

records.title: HBxAPα/Rsf-1-mediated HBx-hBubR1 interactions regulate the mitotic spindle checkpoint and chromosome instability.
records.model: HBx/Rsf1 interaction and RNAi cell models
records.note: Rsf1 enabled HBx-BubR1 binding, reducing BubR1-Cdc20 association and increasing mitotic aberrations; Rsf1 depletion altered viral targeting without a rescue drug.

records.title: Activated amelogenin Y-linked (AMELY) regulation and angiogenesis in human hepatocellular carcinoma by biocomputation.
records.model: HCC versus hepatitis/cirrhosis GEO network inference
records.note: AMELY upstream networks incorporating BUB1B linked Wnt/calcium signaling to growth/angiogenesis; activation is a modeled relationship, not an administered intervention.

records.title: Phosphodependent recruitment of Bub1 and Bub3 to Spc7/KNL1 by Mph1 kinase maintains the spindle checkpoint.
records.model: Spc7 MELT/Mph1 checkpoint assays
records.note: Mph1 phosphorylation of MELT motifs recruited Bub1/Bub3 to maintain SAC, complementing PP1 silencing; no drug-rescue result.

records.title: Mechanism of mitotic arrest induced by dolastatin 15 involves loss of tension across kinetochore pairs.
records.model: HeLa cells and purified microtubules
records.note: Dolastatin15 reduced kinetochore tension, recruited BubR1 and arrested mitosis; LU103793/tasidotin were background analogues, not tested rescue agents.

records.title: Ansamitocin P3 depolymerizes microtubules and induces apoptosis by binding to tubulin at the vinblastine site.
records.model: Multiple cancer cell lines and purified tubulin
records.note: Picomolar growth inhibition accompanied chromosome-segregation disruption and Mad2/BubR1 checkpoint activation; tubulin binding/docking supports anticancer mechanism, not restoration.

records.title: The Drosophila Grp/Chk1 DNA damage checkpoint controls entry into anaphase.
records.model: X-irradiated/I-CreI-cut Drosophila neuroblasts
records.note: Extensive irradiation engaged BubR1 and Grp/Chk1, whereas targeted nonkinetochore breaks required Grp/Chk1 alone; no drug-mediated rescue.

records.title: Molecular analysis of the mitotic checkpoint genes BUB1, BUBR1 and BUB3 in human lung cancers.
records.model: 44 lung cancer cases
records.note: BUB1/BUBR1/BUB3 mutations did not commonly explain checkpoint defects; molecular screening gives no intervention result.

records.title: A novel treatment strategy targeting shugoshin 1 in hematological malignancies.
records.model: Leukemia cells and SGOL1-expressing hematopoietic progenitors
records.outcome_direction: oncogenic colony growth; RNAi-mediated tumor apoptosis
records.note: SGOL1 overexpression increased myeloid colonies, while knockdown separated chromatids, raised BubR1 and caused leukemia apoptosis; no administered SGOL1 inhibitor.

records.title: RINGO C is required to sustain the spindle-assembly checkpoint.
records.model: RINGO-C-siRNA cells
records.note: RINGO C loss impaired Mad2/Bub1/BubR1 recruitment and mislocalized active Aurora B, allowing premature exit despite spindle poisons; no rescue drug.

records.title: Breast cancer risk associated with genotypic polymorphism of the mitotic checkpoint genes: a multigenic study on cancer susceptibility.
records.model: 698 breast cancer cases and 1492 controls
records.note: TTK/BUB1B/PTTG1 haplotypes and reproductive factors associated with breast-cancer risk; estrogen exposure is an epidemiological premise, not a therapeutic intervention.

records.title: Cell cycle kinases in cancer.
records.model: Cell-cycle kinase and cancer literature
records.note: Discusses CDK and mitotic-kinase dysregulation as cancer targets; no new agent or healthy-tissue efficacy is established.

records.title: The spindle assembly checkpoint is satisfied in the absence of interkinetochore tension during mitosis with unreplicated genomes.
records.model: Human cells undergoing mitosis with unreplicated genomes
records.note: Unpaired kinetochores supported SAC arrest to spindle drugs, but attachment alone silenced SAC despite retained BubR1; informative assay context, not rescue.

records.title: Genetic and epigenetic alteration in gastric carcinogenesis.
records.model: Gastric carcinogenesis literature
records.note: Reviews risk variants, activated BUBR1 and other oncogenes plus HER2 targeting; no novel BUB1B rescue experiment.

records.title: The APC/C maintains the spindle assembly checkpoint by targeting Cdc20 for destruction.
records.model: Human APC/C-Cdc20 checkpoint biochemistry
records.note: Mad2 promotes BubR1-Cdc20 binding and APC/C targets Cdc20 for degradation during SAC; no therapeutic agent is tested.

records.title: Mad2-independent spindle assembly checkpoint activation and controlled metaphase-anaphase transition in Drosophila S2 cells.
records.model: MAD2- or BubR1-depleted Drosophila S2 cells
records.outcome_direction: transient-arrest rescue specific to MAD2 deficiency
records.note: Transient mitotic delay restored segregation/SAC after MAD2 depletion, but BubR1-depleted cells still failed arrest. Identify the arrest method before nominating it, and retain this direct limitation for BUBR1 rescue.

records.title: Targeting of tubulin polymerization and induction of mitotic blockage by Methyl 2-(5-fluoro-2-hydroxyphenyl)-1H-benzo[d]imidazole-5-carboxylate (MBIC) in human cervical cancer HeLa cell.
records.model: HeLa cervical cancer cells
records.outcome_direction: cytotoxic mitotic disruption and combination synergy
records.note: MBIC disrupted tubulin, produced multinucleation/unsegregated chromosomes and apoptosis while increasing BubR1; combination activity is anticancer cytotoxicity.

records.title: Bub1 is a fission yeast kinetochore scaffold protein, and is sufficient to recruit other spindle checkpoint proteins to ectopic sites on chromosomes.
records.model: Fission yeast Bub1 tethering/FRAP
records.note: Telomere-tethered Bub1 recruited anaphase inhibitors without kinase activity, supporting a scaffolding role; no administered rescue.

records.title: DIAGNOSTIC OF IMMUNE GRAFT TOLERANCE USING TMTC3 GENE EXPRESSION LEVELS
records.model: TMTC3 transplant-tolerance patent
records.note: Patent claims TMTC3 expression diagnosis and TMTC3-protein graft-rejection treatment; BUB1B appears in an excluded diagnostic panel, with no administered efficacy experiment.

records.title: Inhibition of AKT enhances mitotic cell apoptosis induced by arsenic trioxide.
records.model: HeLa-S3 cells with AKT1 expression/knockdowns
records.note: AKT inhibition sensitized cells to arsenic; active AKT reduced BubR1/Mad2 recruitment and permitted abnormal surviving nuclei. Survival and genomic restoration run in different directions.

records.title: Caspase activity is not required for the mitotic checkpoint or mitotic slippage in human cells.
records.model: Nontransformed RPE1 cells with caspase inhibition/depletion
records.outcome_direction: no basal mitotic-fidelity requirement; schedule-specific slippage
records.note: Caspase inhibition did not alter unperturbed mitotic fidelity, and pan-caspase blockade did not prevent slippage; caspase9-only versus combined depletion had different drug-context effects.

records.title: Spindle assembly checkpoint regulates mitotic cell cycle progression during preimplantation embryo development.
records.model: Mouse preimplantation embryos with SAC overexpression/RNAi
records.note: Excess Bub3/BubR1/Mad2 blocked chromatid separation, whereas depletion caused aneuploidy and poor implantation/development; nocodazole tested checkpoint failure.

records.title: Identification of DW532 as a novel anti-tumor agent targeting both kinases and tubulin.
records.model: Cancer cells, tubulin assays and angiogenesis models
records.note: DW532 inhibited tubulin/EGFR/VEGFR2, produced abnormal division and apoptosis, with BubR1/Mps1 needed for arrest; not 7,8-dihydroxyflavone or a restorative intervention.

records.title: An essential role for p73 in regulating mitotic cell death.
records.model: p73/Bim-silenced cells during prolonged mitotic arrest
records.note: p73/Bim loss prevented death independently of BubR1/Mad2-mediated exit timing; survival rescue does not demonstrate corrected chromosome segregation.

records.title: DIAGNOSTIC OF IMMUNE GRAFT TOLERANCE USING TMTC3 GENE EXPRESSION LEVELS
records.model: TMTC3 transplant-tolerance patent
records.note: WO patent repeats TMTC3 diagnostic exclusions including BUB1B and proposes protein medicaments for rejection; no administered rescue results.

records.title: Mps1 directs the assembly of Cdc20 inhibitory complexes during interphase and mitosis to control M phase timing and spindle checkpoint signaling.
records.model: Analogue-sensitive MPS1-reconstituted human knockout cells
records.note: Selective chemical-genetic Mps1 inhibition shortened mitosis to 12 minutes and disrupted Cdc20-Mad2/BubR1 complexes and kinetochore signaling; mechanistic inhibition, not rescue.

records.title: Constitutive Mad1 targeting to kinetochores uncouples checkpoint signalling from chromosome biorientation.
records.model: Engineered kinetochore-tethered Mad1 cells
records.note: Mad1 targeting arrested correctly bioriented cells and required Aurora/Mps1/BubR1 activities but not Polo-like kinase; spatial signaling experiment without an administered restorative agent.

records.title: A new view of the spindle checkpoint.
records.model: Commentary on APC/C inhibition studies
records.note: Discusses new studies proposing stronger APC inhibition by BubR1 than Mad2; not an independent intervention.

records.title: The DNA damage response to non-replicating adeno-associated virus: Centriole overduplication and mitotic catastrophe independent of the spindle checkpoint.
records.model: p53-deficient osteosarcoma cells
records.note: Nonreplicating virus triggered Chk1-dependent centrosome overduplication and mitotic catastrophe even when MAD2/BUBR1 were impaired; a damage model, not rescue.

records.title: Elevating the frequency of chromosome mis-segregation as a strategy to kill tumor cells.
records.model: Four tumor lines and normal fibroblasts with SAC knockdown
records.outcome_direction: tumor killing by increased segregation errors
records.note: Partial BubR1/Mps1 reduction sensitized tumors to low Taxol through greater missegregation; Mps1-reduced fibroblasts were not sensitized. Selectivity does not imply correction of deficient muscle.

records.title: Spindle assembly checkpoint and its regulators in meiosis.
records.model: 91 meiosis/SAC studies from 1991–2011
records.note: Summarizes SAC and attachment/spindle regulators across species and sexes, emphasizing unresolved regulatory interactions rather than a rescue drug.

records.title: Regulation of a dynamic interaction between two microtubule-binding proteins, EB1 and TIP150, by the mitotic p300/CBP-associated factor (PCAF) orchestrates kinetochore microtubule plasticity and chromosome stability during mitosis.
records.model: TIP150/EB1/PCAF cell assays
records.note: Peptide disruption or persistent EB1 acetylation impaired alignment; BubR1 suppression bypassed arrest but left whole-chromosome aneuploidy, separating exit from rescue.

records.title: Tracing the pathway of spindle assembly checkpoint signaling.
records.model: Commentary on BubR1-containing APC/C inhibitor complex
records.note: Highlights Mad2-independent inhibition by a BubR1-containing complex in another paper; no new therapeutic result.

records.title: Mitotic requirement for aurora A kinase is bypassed in the absence of aurora B kinase.
records.model: Cells with Aurora pharmacology/RNAi
records.note: Aurora-B loss bypassed the mitotic requirement for Aurora A and produced polyploidy; an adverse-direction counterpoint to treating all Aurora inhibition as restorative.

records.title: Kinase activity of fission yeast Mph1 is required for Mad2 and Mad3 to stably bind the anaphase promoting complex.
records.model: Fission yeast Mph1 kinase-dead and Mad2 phosphosite mutants
records.note: Loss of Mph1 activity or Mad2 phosphorylation weakened APC/C binding and arrest; no administered compensation strategy.

records.title: Molecular mechanisms of the antitumor activity of SB225002: a novel microtubule inhibitor.
records.model: p53-mutant cancer lines including NCI/Adr-Res, HLE and SW480
records.note: SB225002 destabilized tubulin and caused BubR1-dependent arrest, unlike related IL8RB antagonist SB265610; p38 inhibition affected death in SW480, demonstrating context-specific off-target pharmacology.

records.title: Biochemical analysis of the Anaphase Promoting Complex: activities of E2 enzymes and substrate competitive (pseudosubstrate) inhibitors.
records.model: In-vitro APC/C ubiquitination assay protocols
records.note: Describes E2-dependent pseudosubstrate inhibition by Emi1/BubR1 and progressively complex biochemical protocols; inhibitors are regulatory proteins, not tested rescue drugs.

records.title: p53 deficiency and defective mitotic checkpoint in proliferating T lymphocytes increase chromosomal instability through aberrant exit from mitotic arrest.
records.model: Primary proliferating T cells, dominant-negative BubR1 and p53 deficiency
records.note: Compromised checkpoint or p53 allowed greater polyploidy after prolonged spindle damage; preventing cell death alone did not protect genome integrity.

records.title: MTBP plays a crucial role in mitotic progression and chromosome segregation.
records.model: MTBP overexpression/downregulation cells
records.note: Excess MTBP delayed exit and deficiency shortened metaphase, both causing missegregation; Mad1/Mad2 recruitment changed while BubR1 recruitment did not.

records.title: Aneuploidy-cancer predisposition syndromes: a new link between the mitotic spindle checkpoint and cancer.
records.model: Cancer predisposition/MVA gene discovery discussion
records.note: Links recessive BUB1B mutations, mosaic aneuploidy and childhood cancer; no therapeutic experiment is reported.

records.title: Defects in chromosome congression and mitotic progression in KIF18A-deficient cells are partly mediated through impaired functions of CENP-E.
records.model: KIF18A-depleted HeLa cells with CENP-E-domain expression
records.note: KIF18A loss accelerated CENP-E degradation; wild-type CENP-E tail expression suppressed congression defects, a protein-expression rescue rather than inhibitor treatment.

records.title: ERK3 is required for metaphase-anaphase transition in mouse oocyte meiosis.
records.model: ERK3-morpholino mouse oocytes
records.note: ERK3 loss destabilized attachments and retained BubR1 with MI arrest; Taxol localized ERK3 to spindle structures rather than rescuing deficiency.

records.title: The mitotic checkpoint in cancer and aging: what have mice taught us?
records.model: Mouse SAC-deficiency/cancer/aging literature
records.note: Reviews aneuploidy-prone mouse models and BubR1's aging role, without a new administered treatment result.

records.title: Intrakinetochore localization and essential functional domains of Drosophila Spc105.
records.model: Drosophila Spc105 truncation/localization assays
records.note: Removing the repetitive central third preserved essential Spc105 function and supported a flexible outer-kinetochore platform model; no rescue drug.

records.title: METHOD AND KIT FOR ESTIMATING SIDE EFFECT BY PACLITAXEL THERAPY
records.model: Patent on paclitaxel-associated granulocytopenia prediction
records.note: CYP2C8/BUB1b SNP panels are proposed to predict toxicity; patent abstract gives no administered restoration or verified predictive performance.

records.title: Activated PTHLH coupling feedback phosphoinositide to G-protein receptor signal-induced cell adhesion network in human hepatocellular carcinoma by systems-theoretic analysis.
records.model: HCC versus hepatitis/cirrhosis network inference
records.note: PTHLH feedback/cell-adhesion network containing BUB1B was inferred from GEO expression; signaling 'activation' does not describe drug administration.

records.title: Critical role of Pcid2 in B cell survival through the regulation of MAD2 expression.
records.model: Pcid2-siRNA cells and B-cell-specific knockout mice
records.note: Pcid2 controlled MAD2 RNA export without changing BUBR1; loss increased apoptosis/polyploidy and removed mature B cells, with no therapeutic rescue.

records.title: Synthesis and preclinical evaluations of 2-(2-fluorophenyl)-6,7-methylenedioxyquinolin-4-one monosodium phosphate (CHM-1-P-Na) as a potent antitumor agent.
records.model: Breast cancer cells and SKOV3 xenograft mice
records.note: Phosphate prodrug delivered active CHM1 and suppressed xenografts; BubR1 correlated with response to microtubule disruption. Safety profiling and tumor efficacy are not MVA muscle evidence.

records.title: Loss of spindle assembly checkpoint-mediated inhibition of Cdc20 promotes tumorigenesis in mice.
records.model: Mad2-binding-defective Cdc20 AAA cells/mice
records.note: Additional BubR1 expression failed to rescue mutant Cdc20 checkpoint impairment; homozygotes died prenatally and heterozygotes developed tumors, limiting generic abundance assumptions.

records.title: Evaluation of activity and combination strategies with the microtubule-targeting drug sagopilone in breast cancer cell lines.
records.model: Breast cancer cell lines with siRNA drug-modifier screen
records.note: SAC defects conferred sagopilone resistance; genetic KIF2C inhibition enhanced arrest while KIF11 inhibition antagonized it, so a proposed inhibitor combination is not a proven administered rescue.

records.title: The mitotic checkpoint: a signaling pathway that allows a single unattached kinetochore to inhibit mitotic exit.
records.model: SAC signaling models
records.note: Compares Cdc20 sequestration and direct MCC inhibition models with a proposed kinase amplification cascade; no pharmacological rescue.

records.title: Spindle assembly checkpoint signalling is uncoupled from chromosomal position in mouse oocytes.
records.model: Wild-type/CENP-E-depleted mouse oocytes
records.outcome_direction: checkpoint fails to track polar-chromosome risk
records.note: Oocyte kinetochores lost Mad2 despite defective attachments; CENP-E also stabilized BubR1 and promoted biorientation. No administered restoration was shown.

records.title: Septin2 is modified by SUMOylation and required for chromosome congression in mouse oocytes.
records.model: Mouse oocytes plus septin2 siRNA
records.note: Septin disruption activated BubR1-positive checkpoint and blocked MI/anaphase transition; post-MI inhibition spared cytokinesis, showing timing dependence rather than rescue.

records.title: Centromere localization of INCENP-Aurora B is sufficient to support spindle checkpoint function.
records.model: Mitotic cells with CenpB-INCENP fusion
records.outcome_direction: drug damage with partial genetic checkpoint rescue
records.note: Actinomycin D displaced active CPC and caused SAC override/misalignment; tethering Aurora B restored BubR1 recruitment/SAC but not alignment or cytokinesis. Rescue was genetic and incomplete.

records.title: Mitotic catastrophe and cell death induced by depletion of centrosomal proteins.
records.model: Centrosomal-protein-depleted cells with checkpoint/Chk2 siRNA
records.outcome_direction: mitotic catastrophe; genetic reduction of death
records.note: AuroraA/ninein/TOG loss caused spindle abnormalities/death, intensified by BubR1/Mad2 loss; Chk2 knockdown reduced death without demonstrated fidelity restoration.

records.title: HMBA depolymerizes microtubules, activates mitotic checkpoints and induces mitotic block in MCF-7 cells by binding at the colchicine site in tubulin.
records.model: MCF7 cells and purified tubulin
records.note: This anthracenone HMBA bound the colchicine site, activated BubR1/Mad2 and caused arrest/apoptosis; acronym must not be conflated with hexamethylene bisacetamide.

records.title: Dido disruption leads to centrosome amplification and mitotic checkpoint defects compromising chromosome stability.
records.model: Dido-disrupted mouse/cell models
records.note: Dido3 disruption caused early BubR1 degradation, poor mitotic arrest and extra centrosomes; no drug stabilization rescue was tested.

records.title: Clearance of p16Ink4a-positive senescent cells delays ageing-associated disorders.
records.model: BubR1 progeroid mice carrying INK-ATTAC transgene
records.outcome_direction: genetically enabled senescent-cell clearance delays tissue pathology
records.note: Drug-triggered engineered clearance delayed muscle/adipose/eye pathology and late clearance slowed progression. This is same-gene tissue benefit dependent on a suicide transgene, not efficacy of a conventional senolytic.

records.title: Aurora kinase B, epigenetic state of centromeric heterochromatin and chiasma resolution in oocytes.
records.model: Mouse oocytes
records.note: Low-dose Aurora-B inhibition blocked polar bodies, perturbed spindles/chiasma resolution and altered chromatin; arrest limited segregation errors while increasing polyploidy, an explicit context-specific counterpoint.

records.title: MST1 limits the kinase activity of aurora B to promote stable kinetochore-microtubule attachment.
records.model: MST1/NDR1-depleted HeLa cells
records.note: MST1/NDR1 loss hyperactivated Aurora B; Aurora-B depletion restored K-fiber stability. Rescue is genetic, despite a plausible Aurora-pharmacology bridge.

records.title: Chromosomal instability, colorectal cancer and taxane resistance.
records.model: CRC chromosomal-instability/taxane literature
records.note: Links BubR1 loss/AuroraA excess to microtubule-drug resistance and proposes CIN-stratified taxane trials; no healthy-tissue rescue.

records.title: Identification of a candidate prognostic gene signature by transcriptome analysis of matched pre- and post-treatment prostatic biopsies from patients with advanced prostate cancer.
records.model: Four advanced hormone-naive prostate cancer patients
records.note: Paired biopsies after combined treatment revealed downregulated cell-cycle regulators and a seven-gene prognostic panel including BUB1B; small tumor transcriptomic study, not rescue.

records.title: Biological features of core networks that result from a high-fat diet in hepatic and pulmonary tissues in mammary tumour-bearing, obesity-resistant mice.
records.model: 4T1 mammary-tumor-bearing BALB/c mice
records.note: High-fat feeding altered liver inflammation and lung cell-cycle networks including Bub1b, consistent with metastatic support; dietary exposure did not rescue deficient muscle.

records.title: Anaphase onset does not require the microtubule-dependent depletion of kinetochore and centromere-binding proteins.
records.model: Microinjected PtK1 cells
records.outcome_direction: forced anaphase despite retained kinetochore proteins
records.note: Mad1 fragment induced premature anaphase in nocodazole while BubR1/Mad2 remained at kinetochores; probe demonstrates localization is not sufficient arrest evidence.

records.title: U2OS cells lacking Chk1 undergo aberrant mitosis and fail to activate the spindle checkpoint.
records.model: Chk1-depleted U2OS cells
records.note: Chk1 loss reduced Mad2/BubR1, caused multinucleation/tetraploidy and prevented nocodazole arrest; no restorative drug experiment.

records.title: Variants in the ATM-BRCA2-CHEK2 axis predispose to chronic lymphocytic leukemia.
records.model: 992 CLL patients and 2707 controls
records.note: BUB1B Q349R and ATM/BRCA2/CHEK2 coding variants associated with CLL risk; no treatment effect was assessed.

records.title: The promoter region of the human BUBR1 gene and its expression analysis in lung cancer.
records.model: Lung cancer lines and cloned human BUBR1 promoter
records.note: BUBR1 was upregulated in all tested cancer lines; 424bp promoter activity and consensus factor motifs define regulation hypotheses without administered activation.

records.title: A functional genomic screen identifies a role for TAO1 kinase in spindle-checkpoint signalling.
records.model: Human kinase/phosphatase functional screen
records.note: TAO1 interacted with BubR1 and supported Mad2 enrichment at defective attachments; genetic screening does not identify an administered TAO1 rescue agent.

records.title: Method and kit for estimating side effect by paclitaxel therapy
records.model: Chinese patent on paclitaxel toxicity prediction
records.note: CYP2C8/BUB1b polymorphism kit claims granulocytopenia risk prediction, corresponding to other jurisdictional patent abstracts; no efficacy study.

records.title: p38α MAPK is a MTOC-associated protein regulating spindle assembly, spindle length and accurate chromosome segregation during mouse oocyte meiotic maturation.
records.model: p38alpha-morpholino mouse oocytes
records.outcome_direction: spindle/checkpoint defects; partial genetic morphology rescue
records.note: p38alpha loss decreased BubR1 and increased aneuploidy; Eg5 depletion rescued spindle elongation but not stated chromosome fidelity, warning against generic p38 inhibition.

records.title: Requirement for proteolysis in spindle assembly   checkpoint silencing.
records.model: Mammalian mitotic cells
records.note: CDK/Aurora inhibitors dissociated Mad2-Cdc20 despite blocked proteolysis; okadaic acid did not prevent dissociation. Checkpoint silencing is not restored productive division.

records.title: Mitotic arrest and JNK-induced proteasomal degradation of FLIP and Mcl-1 are key events in the sensitization of breast tumor cells to TRAIL by antimicrotubule agents.
records.model: Breast tumor cells
records.note: Microtubule agents triggered BubR1-dependent arrest/JNK-mediated FLIP/Mcl1 loss and TRAIL apoptosis; SP600125 suppressed arrest and killing, not deficient-tissue restoration.

records.title: Dual inhibition of Cdc20 by the spindle checkpoint.
records.model: Checkpoint-Cdc20 regulatory literature
records.note: Describes dual inhibition of Cdc20 activity and abundance by MCC to sustain arrest with few unattached kinetochores; no new drug result.

records.title: Transcriptomic changes induced by mycophenolic acid in gastric cancer cells.
records.model: AGS gastric cancer cells
records.note: MPA altered cell-cycle/SAC genes including BUB1B, inhibited PI3K-AKT-mTOR and induced p53/FAS pathways; anticancer effects cannot establish mTOR-linked MVA rescue.

records.title: CenH3/CID incorporation is not dependent on the chromatin assembly factor CHD1 in Drosophila.
records.model: Drosophila CHD1 RNAi and mutant embryos
records.note: CHD1 loss left CenH3/CENPC/BubR1 localization intact, unlike claims in other species; a negative mechanistic result without pharmacology.

records.title: METHOD AND KIT FOR ESTIMATING SIDE EFFECT BY PACLITAXEL THERAPY
records.model: WO patent on paclitaxel granulocytopenia prediction
records.note: Claims SNP-based toxicity estimation using CYP2C8/BUB1b and a reagent kit; same topic as KR/CN patent records, not separate treatment evidence.

records.title: Bub1 is essential for assembly of the functional inner centromere.
records.model: Bub1-depleted Xenopus extracts and HeLa cells
records.note: Bub1 loss destabilized/misplaced CPC and altered Shugoshin loading; Bub1 kinase-dependent architecture is distinct from BUB1B restoration.

records.title: [Assembly of correct kinetochore architecture in Xenopus laevis egg extract requires transition of sperm DNA through interphase].
records.model: Xenopus egg-extract chromosome assembly protocols
records.note: Direct CSF assembly reduced BubR1/outer-kinetochore and CPC recruitment, whereas passage through interphase restored somatic-like architecture; protocol correction, not therapeutic rescue.

records.title: Mediator of DNA damage checkpoint 1 (MDC1) regulates mitotic progression.
records.model: hMDC1-siRNA cells
records.note: MDC1 loss impaired Cdc20/APC-C association and caused arrest independent of BubR1 or ATM/ATR signaling; no drug implementation is given.

records.title: Cell cycle-dependent cytotoxicity and mitotic spindle checkpoint dependency of investigational and approved antimitotic agents.
records.model: Checkpoint-proficient/deficient cancer panels and inducible p27 cells
records.note: Most agents killed proficient cells more; HDAC inhibitor and BYK72767 were exceptions. BubR1 phosphorylation and mitotic index failed to predict killing, and unnamed drugs require full-text identity accounting.

records.title: Hydrophobic bile acid-induced micronuclei formation, mitotic perturbations, and decreases in spindle checkpoint proteins: relevance to genomic instability in colon carcinogenesis.
records.model: Noncancerous NCM460 and HT29/HCT116 colon cells
records.note: DOC increased micronuclei/aberrant mitoses and lowered Mad2/BubR1/securin; nocodazole challenge confirmed defective activation, not protection.

records.title: METHOD AND KIT FOR ESTIMATING SIDE EFFECT BY PACLITAXEL THERAPY
records.model: European paclitaxel-toxicity diagnostic patent
records.note: CYP2C8/BUB1b SNP kit predicts granulocytopenia risk in the claim; no drug-rescue data, overlapping the WO/KR/CN patent topic.

records.title: Minor alteration of microtubule dynamics causes loss of tension across kinetochore pairs and activates the spindle checkpoint.
records.model: HeLa cells and microtubule-dynamics assays
records.note: Noscapine paused microtubule dynamics without changing polymer mass, leaving some polar chromosomes and poor tension; subtler tubulin perturbation still was not fidelity rescue.

records.title: Loss of APC induces polyploidy as a result of a combination of defects in mitosis and apoptosis.
records.model: APC-depleted U2OS/HCT116 cells and in-vivo model
records.note: APC loss reduced Bub1/BubR1 recruitment, weakened SAC and lowered apoptosis, increasing tetraploidy independently of beta-catenin activation.

records.title: Three Epstein-Barr virus latency proteins independently promote genomic instability by inducing DNA damage, inhibiting DNA repair and inactivating cell cycle checkpoints.
records.model: EBV latency-protein-transfected BJAB lymphoma cells
records.note: EBNA3C transcriptionally lowered BubR1 and disabled SAC; EBNA1 and LMP1 separately affected ROS/repair. No antiviral or restorative drug experiment.

records.title: Identifying new human oocyte marker genes: a microarray approach.
records.model: Human oocyte/cumulus microarrays
records.note: BUB1B/BUB3 and other genes were candidate competence markers from broad expression profiling; IVF selection relevance is not intervention efficacy.

records.title: WD repeat-containing mitotic checkpoint proteins act as transcriptional repressors during interphase.
records.model: Bub3/Cdc20 expression and heterologous DNA-binding assays
records.note: Bub3/Cdc20 associated with HDACs and acted as transcriptional repressors; reduced expression impaired interphase cycling, without an administered HDAC-rescue study.

records.title: Age-related genetic abnormalities: the Achilles' heel for customizing therapy in elderly lung cancer patients.
records.model: Elderly NSCLC therapy/genetics literature
records.note: Discusses cisplatin, docetaxel and EGFR inhibitors against age-related repair/checkpoint profiles; no drug efficacy in BUB1B deficiency is reported.

records.title: UBE2S elongates ubiquitin chains on APC/C substrates to promote mitotic exit.
records.model: UBE2S-depleted cells and APC/C assays
records.outcome_direction: suppressed slippage; drug bypass of checkpoint
records.note: UBE2S loss prolonged drug-induced arrest and impaired substrate degradation; Aurora-B inhibition or BUBR1 depletion bypassed the need for UBE2S, not demonstrated faithful rescue.

records.title: Curcumin suppresses the dynamic instability of microtubules, activates the mitotic checkpoint and induces apoptosis in MCF-7 cells.
records.model: MCF7 cells with live microtubule imaging
records.note: Curcumin dampened dynamics, disrupted attachments/Eg5 and recruited BubR1/Mad2; additive vinblastine and antagonistic paclitaxel effects concern cancer growth inhibition.

records.title: Genes encoding proteins involved in mitotic checkpoint control and methods of use thereof
records.model: Human BUB-gene/protein patent
records.note: Patent describes BUB1A/BUB1B/BUB3 and proposes antiproliferative targeting; no administered compound or rescue result appears.

records.title: Osteoprotegerin secreted by inflammatory and invasive breast cancer cells induces aneuploidy, cell proliferation and angiogenesis.
records.model: Normal HMEC spheres and invasive breast-cancer models
records.note: OPG increased BubR1/Bub1/AuroraA alongside abnormal copy numbers and proliferation in normal mammary spheres; increased checkpoint-protein expression did not confer protection.

records.title: Inhibition of cell proliferation by a resveratrol analog in human pancreatic and breast cancer cells.
records.model: Breast/pancreatic cancer cells and tubulin assays
records.note: Resveratrol analogue 11b raised BubR1 but blocked tubulin and caused arrest/death at lower concentrations than resveratrol; neither agent showed MVA tissue restoration.

records.title: ATP is required for the release of the anaphase-promoting complex/cyclosome from inhibition by the mitotic checkpoint.
records.model: APC/C and MCC disassembly biochemistry
records.note: ATP beta-gamma cleavage was needed for free/bound MCC disassembly independently of proteasome or persistent Cdk1; energy use is a biochemical mechanism, not an NAD-drug test.

records.title: Heat shock protein inhibitors, 17-DMAG and KNK437, enhance arsenic trioxide-induced mitotic apoptosis.
records.model: Cancer cells with HSP inhibition/siRNA
records.note: HSP90/HSP-synthesis inhibitors augmented arsenic spindle abnormalities, BubR1 phosphorylation and death; chaperone inhibition is cytotoxic sensitization, not BUBR1 stabilization.

records.title: Structural analysis of Bub3 interactions in the mitotic spindle checkpoint.
records.model: Yeast Mad3/Bub3 peptide structures and mutants
records.note: GLEBS peptides bound Bub3 at about 5 micromolar and interface disruption caused checkpoint/chromosome defects; no administered protein stabilizer.

records.title: Method and Kit for Predicting Adverse Side Effects of Paclitaxel Therapy
records.model: US paclitaxel adverse-effect diagnostic patent
records.note: Repeated CYP2C8/BUB1b SNP kit disclosure predicts granulocytopenia risk; not evidence that paclitaxel treats BUB1B deficiency.

records.title: Arecoline arrests cells at prometaphase by deregulating mitotic spindle assembly and spindle assembly checkpoint: implication for carcinogenesis.
records.model: Arecoline-exposed dividing cells
records.outcome_direction: spindle damage and possible checkpoint weakening
records.note: Arecoline stabilized distorted spindles with misaligned chromosomes and differential BubR1/Mps1 modification; checkpoint-gene upregulation accompanied carcinogenic instability.

records.title: TRF1 controls telomere length and mitotic fidelity in epithelial homeostasis.
records.model: Epithelial TRF1-transgenic mice with XPF loss
records.note: TRF1 excess shortened telomeres and increased spindle abnormalities; XPF absence rescued telomere length, not a drug-mediated BubR1 phenotype.

records.title: Direct role of dynein motor in stable kinetochore-microtubule attachment, orientation, and alignment.
records.model: Dynein-tail/RNAi cells and metaphase microinjection
records.note: Motor disruption retained BubR1/Mad1 on aligned kinetochores and destabilized K-fibers; MG132 maintained assay arrest rather than rescuing the defect.

records.title: Polyploidy impairs human aortic endothelial cell function and is prevented by nicotinamide phosphoribosyltransferase.
records.model: Aging/high-glucose human aortic endothelial cells
records.note: Modest Nampt overexpression prevented polyploidy through increased SIRT1 and reduced ROS, explicitly without enhanced SIRT2/PARP1; no administered NAD precursor efficacy was demonstrated.

records.title: Modeling the temporal evolution of the spindle assembly checkpoint and role of Aurora B kinase.
records.model: Mathematical multicentric SAC/Aurora-B model
records.note: Simulation predicted prolonged prometaphase at an inhibitor range not experimentally tested; this must not count as an administered Aurora-B rescue.

records.title: The unique N terminus of the UbcH10 E2 enzyme controls the threshold for APC activation and enhances checkpoint regulation of the APC.
records.model: UbcH10 mutants and APC/C biochemical assays
records.outcome_direction: increased APC/C activity and checkpoint bypass
records.note: Mutating the E2 N terminus broadened substrate ubiquitination and resisted Emi1/BubR1 inhibition, bypassing SAC; no drug intervention.

records.title: Gene expression profiles in gallbladder cancer: the close genetic similarity seen for early and advanced gallbladder cancers may explain the poor prognosis.
records.model: 17 gallbladder tissues
records.note: BUB1B was among PCR-validated overexpressed candidates; early/advanced tumors were transcriptionally similar, without therapy testing.

records.title: Regulation of APC-Cdc20 by the spindle checkpoint.
records.model: APC-Cdc20 checkpoint literature
records.note: Reviews attachment/tension sensing and inhibitory BubR1/Bub3/Mad2/Cdc20 complexes; no new intervention result.

records.title: Core exosome-independent roles for Rrp6 in cell cycle progression.
records.model: Drosophila Rrp6-depleted S2 cells
records.note: Rrp6 loss impaired mitosis despite normal poison-induced BubR1 recruitment; kinetochore localization alone did not rescue mitotic-marker defects.

records.title: Dual roles of human BubR1, a mitotic checkpoint kinase, in the monitoring of chromosomal instability.
records.model: Polyploid cells, colon tumors and nude-mouse tumors
records.note: Reintroduced BubR1 killed polyploid cells and suppressed tumors after protein loss during prolonged checkpoint stress; genetic antineoplastic selection is distinct from muscle renewal.

records.title: Histone deacetylase inhibitors induce mitotic slippage.
records.model: Dividing cells under HDAC inhibition
records.note: HDAC inhibitors prevented centromeric CPC accumulation, impaired BubR1 phosphorylation and allowed aberrant segregation despite misalignment; primary identities/doses matter for acetylation-route comparisons.

records.title: BRCA1 regulates gene expression for orderly mitotic progression.
records.model: BRCA1-siRNA DU145/MCF7 cells
records.note: BRCA1 knockdown reduced BUB1B and other mitotic transcripts, weakened spindle checkpoint and produced multinucleation; no drug restoration.

records.title: The roles of MAD1, MAD2 and MAD3 in meiotic progression and the segregation of nonexchange chromosomes.
records.model: Yeast nonexchange-chromosome meiosis with human BubR1 complementation
records.note: Human BubR1 substituted for MAD3's nonexchange-chromosome segregation role; MAD3 prophase timing differed from MAD1/MAD2 surveillance, without an administered candidate.

records.title: Frequent impairment of the spindle assembly checkpoint in hepatocellular carcinoma.
records.model: Eight HCC lines and 50 HCC specimens
records.note: Five aneuploid lines failed checkpoint tests, but BUB1/BUBR1/CDC20 polymorphisms did not explain them; drugs were phenotype probes, not rescue.

records.title: Antibody-based proteomics for esophageal cancer: Identification of proteins in the nuclear factor-kappaB pathway and mitotic checkpoint.
records.model: Three esophageal cancers with antibody-array validation
records.note: BubR1/Mad2 and NF-kappaB-related proteins were aberrantly expressed; profiling does not establish therapeutic NF-kappaB or BUBR1 modulation.

records.title: Dietary flavonoid fisetin induces a forced exit from mitosis by targeting the mitotic spindle checkpoint.
records.model: Human cell lines including unperturbed cancer cells
records.outcome_direction: forced mitotic exit and cytokinesis failure
records.note: Fisetin directly inhibited Aurora B, displaced BubR1/Bub1 and overrode arrest, causing premature segregation and failed cytokinesis; a material context/dose counterpoint to senolytic or checkpoint-restoration claims.

records.title: A genistein derivative, ITB-301, induces microtubule depolymerization and mitotic arrest in multidrug-resistant ovarian cancer.
records.model: Multidrug-resistant ovarian/breast/AML cells
records.note: Genistein glycoside ITB301 depolymerized tubulin and killed resistant tumor cells; BUBR1 knockdown reduced killing. Parent genistein cannot inherit analogue efficacy.

records.title: MCAK is present at centromeres, midspindle and chiasmata and involved in silencing of the spindle assembly checkpoint in mammalian oocytes.
records.model: Mouse oocytes with MCAK/MAD2 knockdown
records.note: MCAK loss delayed congression/arrested MI; MAD2 knockdown released arrest but produced abnormal MII spindles/hypoploidy. Inhibitors were mechanistic probes without a stated rescue result.

records.title: A leukemia fusion protein attenuates the spindle checkpoint and promotes aneuploidy.
records.model: AML1-ETO truncated-fusion leukemia cells
records.note: AEtr cells lost BubR1/securin during nocodazole challenge and failed arrest; oncogenic fusion expression is the causal perturbation.

records.title: Expression changes of the MAD mitotic checkpoint gene family in renal cell carcinomas characterized by numerical chromosome changes.
records.model: 30 papillary/chromophobe RCC and 36 normal kidney samples
records.note: MAD-family expression differed by tumor subtype whereas BUB1/BUBR1/BUB3 did not significantly differ; no treatment effect.

records.title: Glyfoline induces mitotic catastrophe and apoptosis in cancer cells.
records.model: Human cancer cells
records.outcome_direction: tumor catastrophe; reduced spindle multipolarity with Eg5 inhibitor
records.note: Glyfoline enhanced asters and induced checkpoint-independent catastrophe/apoptosis; S-trityl-cysteine reduced multipolarity/multinucleation but did not establish normal division or MVA rescue.

records.title: NOVEL GENES ENCODING PROTEINS INVOLVED IN MITOTIC CHECKPOINT CONTROL AND METHODS OF USE THEREOF
records.model: WO BUB-gene/protein patent
records.note: Describes BUB sequences/proteins as targets for future cancer agents, repeating the US patent topic without a tested therapeutic compound.

records.title: Aurora-C kinase deficiency causes cytokinesis failure in meiosis I and production of large polyploid oocytes in mice.
records.model: Mouse oocytes expressing kinase-dead AuroraC or INCENP deletion
records.note: AuroraC disruption reduced BubR1 recruitment and caused cytokinesis failure; no AuroraB protein was detected in this study, underscoring attribution issues in oocyte inhibitor studies.

records.title: Identification of genes associated with progression and metastasis of advanced cervical cancers after radiotherapy by cDNA microarray analysis.
records.model: 28 advanced cervical-cancer patients before radiotherapy
records.note: Pretreatment BUB1B/TTK and other genes contributed to a low-specificity predictive signature; radiotherapy outcomes do not demonstrate drug restoration.

records.title: ECRG2 disruption leads to centrosome amplification and spindle checkpoint defects contributing chromosome instability.
records.model: ECRG2-depleted/overexpressing cells
records.note: ECRG2 loss reduced BubR1 and p53 signaling, causing extra centrosomes; overexpression restored p53-mediated centrosome suppression, without a pharmacologic implementation.

records.title: The inhibition of Aurora A abrogates the mitotic delay induced by microtubule perturbing agents.
records.model: Mitotically arrested cells and AuroraA RNAi
records.note: Selective AuroraA inhibition accelerated exit during spindle-drug exposure despite retained kinetochore BubR1 and active AuroraB; checkpoint localization is not functional rescue.

records.title: Synergistic mitosis-arresting effects of arsenic trioxide and paclitaxel on human malignant lymphocytes.
records.model: Three malignant lymphocyte lines and primary cells
records.note: Low-dose combination increased BubR1-Cdc20 inhibitory complexes and dysregulated Cdk1 before apoptosis; more MCC here serves tumor killing.

records.title: The human Mis12 complex is required for kinetochore assembly and proper chromosome segregation.
records.model: Mis12-subunit-depleted human/chicken cells
records.note: Loss of the four-subunit Mis12 complex reduced Ndc80/BubR1/CENPE recruitment and K-fibers, with mitotic delay; no drug rescue.

records.title: Genomic and cytological analysis of the Y chromosome of Drosophila melanogaster: telomere-derived sequences at internal regions.
records.model: Drosophila Y chromosome BAC mapping and cytology
records.note: Internal telomere-derived sequences and BubR1 staining support a proposed Y-chromosome evolutionary origin; no rescue intervention.

records.title: Up-regulation of pro-apoptotic protein Bim and down-regulation of anti-apoptotic protein Mcl-1 cooperatively mediate enhanced tumor cell death induced by the combination of ERK kinase (MEK) inhibitor and microtubule inhibitor.
records.model: ERK-active tumor cells
records.note: Unnamed MEK and microtubule inhibitors jointly induce Bim/Mcl-1-dependent mitotic death; BUBR1 or MAD2 depletion reduces death. This exploits checkpoint activity rather than restoring healthy tissue.

records.title: Analysis of anaphase inhibitors in fission yeast
records.model: Fission yeast Mad3/MCC thesis
records.note: Mad3 KEN-box mutants establish roles in checkpoint inhibition, MCC/APC binding and protein turnover. Entire saved text read, but source itself ends '(continues)' and is incomplete.

records.title: Requirement of a functional spindle checkpoint for arsenite-induced apoptosis.
records.model: Ten p53-defective cancer cell lines
records.outcome_direction: anticancer killing; chromosome instability in survivors
records.note: Arsenic-trioxide apoptosis tracks checkpoint competence; BUBR1/MAD2 depletion reduces arrest and death but increases micronucleated or multinucleated survivors. BrdU is a proliferation label and camptothecin a mechanistic comparator.

records.title: Telomere capping and cellular checkpoints: clues from fruit flies.
records.model: Drosophila telomere/checkpoint literature
records.note: Reviews telomere uncapping, MRN/ATM/ATR signaling and BubR1-linked spindle checkpoint activity; no new pharmacologic rescue experiment.

records.title: Sgt1 is required for human kinetochore assembly.
records.model: Sgt1-depleted HeLa cells
records.note: Sgt1 RNAi disrupts kinetochore assembly, removes multiple checkpoint/attachment proteins including BubR1, and weakens the checkpoint despite mitotic delay.

records.title: Expression of oncogenic kinase Bcr-Abl impairs mitotic checkpoint and promotes aberrant divisions and resistance to microtubule-targeting agents.
records.model: Bcr-Abl-expressing cells in matched genetic backgrounds
records.note: Imatinib partly reverses BRCA1 loss and resistance to spindle-damage death. Bcr-Abl also lowers BUBR1 and other checkpoint proteins, but the abstract does not establish that imatinib restores BUBR1 or faithful segregation.

records.title: Dual role of topoisomerase II in centromere resolution and aurora B activity.
records.model: Topoisomerase-II-depleted/inhibited Drosophila S2 and HeLa cells
records.note: Topoisomerase-II loss or unnamed inhibitors cause nondisjunction and syntelic attachments with low Aurora B activity; BubR1 codepletion restores Aurora B and releases most syntelic attachments. This context-specific genetic interaction is not normal-tissue rescue.

records.title: RPA phosphorylation facilitates mitotic exit in response to mitotic DNA damage.
records.model: Cells with mitotic DNA damage and RPA2 phosphosite mutants
records.outcome_direction: inhibited exit; increased death with phosphorylation defect
records.note: Bleomycin induces mitotic damage; RPA2 phosphorylation supports subsequent exit and viability. UCN-01 reduces mitotic exit, while mutant RPA2 prolongs BubR1 staining and increases apoptosis; no BUBR1-deficiency rescue.

records.title: The Rae1-Nup98 complex prevents aneuploidy by inhibiting securin degradation.
records.model: Rae1/Nup98 double-haploinsufficient mice and cells
records.note: Combined dosage loss causes early securin degradation and premature chromatid separation; the Rae1-Nup98 complex restrains APC-Cdh1 alongside the BubR1-APC-Cdc20 timing system.

records.title: Inhibition of Chk1 kills tetraploid tumor cells through a p53-dependent pathway.
records.model: Tetraploid colon cancer cells and xenografts
records.note: Genetic and unnamed pharmacologic Chk1 inhibition disrupt checkpoint function and induce p53-dependent tetraploid tumor death, reversing cisplatin resistance. Unnamed Chk1 compound requires primary-source accounting; this is not rescue.

records.title: Suppression of microtubule dynamics by benomyl decreases tension across kinetochore pairs and induces apoptosis in cancer cells.
records.model: HeLa cancer cells
records.note: Benomyl suppresses microtubule dynamics, reduces kinetochore tension and increases checkpoint-associated BubR1 before apoptosis. Proposed anticancer utility is not evidence of healthy-tissue benefit.

records.title: Loss of CHFR in human mammary epithelial cells causes genomic instability by disrupting the mitotic spindle assembly checkpoint.
records.model: CHFR-depleted nontransformed MCF10A mammary cells
records.note: CHFR loss elevates Aurora A, disrupts spindles and MAD2/BUBR1 localization, and causes cytokinesis failure; nocodazole probes CHFR-dependent tubulin ubiquitination.

records.title: Taxanes, microtubules and chemoresistant breast cancer.
records.model: Breast cancer taxane literature
records.note: Reviews paclitaxel/docetaxel action and resistance markers including BUBR1 and Aurora A; no primary normal-tissue rescue outcome.

records.title: Plk4 haploinsufficiency causes mitotic infidelity and carcinogenesis.
records.model: Plk4-haploinsufficient mice and MEFs; human liver cancers
records.note: Plk4 dosage loss causes centrosome/spindle errors and increased tumors, with lower BubR1 and altered p53/p21/cyclin regulation after hepatectomy; no drug rescue.

records.title: Arsenic trioxide suppresses paclitaxel-induced mitotic arrest.
records.model: HeLa and p53-defined HCT116 cancer cells
records.note: Arsenic trioxide suppresses paclitaxel-induced arrest and BubR1/Cdc20/Cdc27 phosphorylation, mainly by slowing S phase rather than accelerating mitotic exit. This is drug antagonism in cancer cells, not chromosome-fidelity rescue.

records.title: CPEB controls oocyte growth and follicle development in the mouse.
records.model: Oocyte-specific Cpeb knockdown transgenic mice
records.note: CPEB binds Bub1b and several other oocyte mRNAs; knockdown causes abnormal divisions, spindle defects and infertility. Demonstrated translational reduction concerns Gdf9, not an administered BubR1-restoring agent.

records.title: Pathway-based classification of cancer subtypes.
records.model: Breast metastasis and ovarian survival expression datasets
records.note: Pathway-level features improve cross-dataset marker reproducibility; BUB1B is one of six breast cancer gene markers. No treatment experiment establishes rescue.

records.title: Studying mitotic checkpoint by illustrating dynamic kinetochore protein behavior and chromosome motion in living Drosophila syncytial embryos.
records.model: Living Drosophila syncytial embryos
records.note: Describes live confocal imaging of GFP-tagged checkpoint proteins, exemplified by Cdc20 and Mad2, to study kinetochore dynamics; no therapeutic intervention.

records.title: Running on a treadmill: dynamic inhibition of APC/C by the spindle checkpoint.
records.model: Budding-yeast APC/C checkpoint studies
records.note: Reviews Mad3 substrate-like binding and Cdc20 ubiquitination as a dynamic APC/C inhibition switch; no administered rescue agent.

records.title: The survivin/Aurora B complex: its role in coordinating tension and attachment.
records.model: Human-cell survivin/Aurora B literature
records.note: Synthesizes loss-of-function evidence that survivin/Aurora B corrects attachments and controls BubR1 kinetochore affinity; argues for its genome-stability role without pharmacologic rescue data.

records.title: Mps1 phosphorylation by MAP kinase is required for kinetochore localization of spindle-checkpoint proteins.
records.model: Xenopus egg extracts with Mps1 phosphosite mutants
records.note: Nonphosphorylatable Mps1 S844A loses kinetochore/checkpoint function despite preserved kinase activity; phosphomimetic S844D restores function. Genetic rescue does not demonstrate a MAPK-activating drug.

records.title: Caspases-dependent cleavage of mitotic checkpoint proteins in response to microtubule inhibitor.
records.model: Cells under sustained microtubule damage
records.outcome_direction: mixed checkpoint-protein cleavage and tumor-cell apoptosis
records.note: Unnamed microtubule and caspase inhibitors reveal caspase-sensitive Bub1/BubR1 cleavage. Cleavage-resistant genetic mutants increase apoptosis and remove polyploid cells, not restore normal proliferation.

records.title: Dynactin targets Pavarotti-KLP to the central spindle during anaphase and facilitates cytokinesis in Drosophila S2 cells.
records.model: p150Glued-depleted Drosophila S2 cells
records.note: Dynactin depletion produces asynchronous segregation and delayed centralspindlin targeting, with BubR1 retained on nonsegregating chromosomes; no drug rescue.

records.title: Juglone inactivates cysteine-rich proteins required for progression through mitosis.
records.model: Mitotic cultured cells
records.outcome_direction: mitotic disruption and nonspecific protein modification
records.note: Juglone blocks spindle formation and mitotic exit independently of Pin1, covalently modifying cysteine-rich proteins and obscuring BubR1/tubulin epitopes. It is not a selective Pin1 or BubR1 rescue probe.

records.title: Molecular mode of action and role of TP53 in the sensitivity to the novel epothilone sagopilone (ZK-EPO) in A549 non-small cell lung cancer cells.
records.model: Non-small-cell lung cancer lines including A549
records.outcome_direction: dose-dependent aneuploidy or arrest; anticancer effect
records.note: Low nanomolar treatment produces aneuploidy with limited apoptosis; higher doses arrest mitosis and upregulate BUBR1. Increased BUBR1 here accompanies cytoskeletal damage, not rescued fidelity.

records.title: Screening and functional analysis of differentially expressed genes in EBV-transformed lymphoblasts.
records.model: Matched normal lymphocytes and EBV-transformed lymphoblasts from seven donors
records.note: EBV transformation increases BUB1B and mitosis genes while suppressing immune/apoptotic pathways; virus exposure is a damaging transformation model, not therapeutic restoration.

records.title: An antitubulin agent BCFMT inhibits proliferation of cancer cells and induces cell death by inhibiting microtubule dynamics.
records.model: Cancer-cell panel; tubulin assays
records.note: BCFMT suppresses microtubule dynamics, perturbs spindles and recruits BubR1/Mad2 before apoptosis, including in resistant cancer lines; the labeled vinblastine is a binding competitor probe.

records.title: Dynamic changes in gene expression in vivo predict prognosis of tamoxifen-treated patients with breast cancer.
records.model: ER-positive ZR-75-1 xenografts and breast-cancer cohorts
records.outcome_direction: tumor response with reduced proliferation signature
records.note: Tamoxifen transiently reduces BUB1B and other proliferation genes; timed expression responses predict tumor prognosis. This is endocrine tumor response, not a BUBR1-restoration experiment.

records.title: Phosphorylation of Cdc20 is required for its inhibition by the spindle checkpoint.
records.model: Xenopus egg extracts with Cdc20 phosphorylation mutants
records.note: Cdc20 phosphorylation-deficient mutants retain APC activation but lose checkpoint-protein affinity and checkpoint responsiveness; establishes regulation without a drug rescue.

records.title: Rotenone inhibits mammalian cell proliferation by inhibiting microtubule assembly through tubulin binding.
records.model: HeLa and MCF-7 cells; purified tubulin
records.note: Rotenone binds tubulin and inhibits assembly, causing spindle defects and kinetochore BubR1 accumulation at antiproliferative doses. This toxicant phenotype is not BubR1 functional rescue.

records.title: Dicer is essential for formation of the heterochromatin structure in vertebrate cells.
records.model: Dicer conditional-loss chicken-human hybrid DT40 cells
records.outcome_direction: heterochromatin defects and chromosome separation errors
records.note: Dicer loss causes premature sister separation and death with abnormal Rad21/BubR1 localization while core kinetochore markers remain; no drug intervention.

records.title: Proteome analysis of apoptosis signaling by S-trityl-L-cysteine, a potent reversible inhibitor of human mitotic kinesin Eg5.
records.model: HeLa cells with GFP-alpha-tubulin; proteomics
records.outcome_direction: mitotic arrest followed by anticancer apoptosis
records.note: Eg5 inhibition activates BubR1 phosphorylation and a prolonged checkpoint arrest before intrinsic apoptosis. Checkpoint activation is part of tumor-cell killing, not restored division.

records.title: AuroraA overexpression overrides the mitotic spindle checkpoint triggered by nocodazole, a microtubule destabilizer.
records.model: Aurora A-overexpressing human cells
records.note: Excess Aurora A disrupts Cdc20-BubR1 complex assembly and permits exit after nocodazole independent of Aurora A kinase activity, limiting simple kinase-inhibitor inference.

records.title: The spindle assembly checkpoint is not essential for CSF arrest of mouse oocytes.
records.model: Mouse oocytes with dominant-negative checkpoint proteins
records.outcome_direction: checkpoint disruption with preserved CSF arrest
records.note: Dominant-negative Bub1/Mad2/BubR1 or checkpoint-resistant Cdc20 accelerate meiosis and abolish damage-induced arrest but do not remove mouse metaphase-II CSF arrest; species/context distinction.

records.title: The transforming acidic coiled coil 3 protein is essential for spindle-dependent chromosome alignment and mitotic survival.
records.model: TACC3-depleted HeLa cells
records.outcome_direction: arrest, cell death and polyploid escape
records.note: TACC3 depletion impairs spindle alignment and kinetochore Aurora B/BubR1/Ndc80, producing death or polyploid slippage. Target proposal is anticancer, not restoration.

records.title: Dynamic behavior of Nuf2-Hec1 complex that localizes to the centrosome and centromere and is essential for mitotic progression in vertebrate cells.
records.model: Conditional Nuf2/Hec1-loss chicken DT40 cells
records.note: Nuf2-Hec1 loss abolishes Mad2 localization while retaining BubR1 and core centromeric markers; imaging defines complex dynamics rather than therapeutic rescue.

records.title: Human BUBR1 is a mitotic checkpoint kinase that monitors CENP-E functions at kinetochores and binds the cyclosome/APC.
records.model: Human cells under spindle perturbation
