records.note: Establishes BUBR1 necessity for spindle-damage arrest and prevention of premature anaphase, links its response to CENP-E and APC association. Microtubule inhibitors are unnamed in the saved abstract.

records.title: The vascular targeting agent combretastatin-A4 and a novel cis-Restricted {beta}-Lactam Analogue, CA-432, induce apoptosis in human chronic myeloid leukemia cells and ex vivo patient samples including those displaying multidrug resistance.
records.model: Leukemia lines and ex vivo CML samples including resistant disease
records.note: CA-4 and stable beta-lactam analog CA-432 disrupt tubulin and induce apoptosis, with prolonged BubR1 phosphorylation in K562; ex vivo killing exceeds imatinib. Dasatinib resistance describes specimens, not proven dosing here.

records.title: HOXB13:IL17BR and molecular grade index and risk of breast cancer death among patients with lymph node-negative invasive disease.
records.model: Node-negative breast cancer case-control cohort
records.note: BUB1B-containing MGI and Breast Cancer Index associate with breast cancer mortality in tamoxifen-treated and untreated subgroups; this observational signature study tests no rescue.

records.title: Uncoupling the central spindle-associated function of the chromosomal passenger complex from its role at centromeres.
records.model: Survivin-depleted cells complemented with mutants
records.note: Survivin C terminus supports cytokinesis while an intact BIR domain is required for centromeric CPC/BubR1 recruitment and checkpoint function; separation of functions, no drug.

records.title: Combretastatin A-4 inhibits cell growth and metastasis in bladder cancer cells and retards tumour growth in a murine orthotopic bladder tumour model.
records.model: Bladder cancer cells and murine orthotopic tumors
records.note: CA-4 causes apoptosis, multinucleation and reduced BubR1/Bub3, and intravesical delivery retards tumors. Survival of healthy BUB1B-deficient tissue was not tested.

records.title: BRCA1 downregulation leads to premature inactivation of spindle checkpoint and confers paclitaxel resistance.
records.model: BRCA1-depleted MCF-7 breast cancer cells
records.note: BRCA1 RNAi lowers BubR1-related checkpoint competence, causes premature chromatid separation and paclitaxel resistance. Endogenous BRCA1 regulation does not establish an administered restoration drug.

records.title: Crystal structure of the spindle assembly checkpoint protein Bub3.
records.model: Saccharomyces cerevisiae Bub3 crystal structure
records.note: Defines seven-bladed Bub3 beta-propeller surfaces proposed to bind Bub1/Mad3 and compares Rae1; no cellular or pharmacologic rescue experiment.

records.title: Antimitotic effect of the retinoid 4-oxo-fenretinide through inhibition of tubulin polymerization: a novel mechanism of retinoid growth-inhibitory activity.
records.model: Ovarian and breast cancer lines; cell-free tubulin
records.note: Fenretinide metabolite inhibits tubulin polymerization, produces multipolar spindles and BUBR1 phosphorylation. Its distinct mechanism cannot be assigned indiscriminately to parent fenretinide or interpreted as fidelity rescue.

records.title: Overexpression of an Aurora-C kinase-deficient mutant disrupts the Aurora-B/INCENP complex and induces polyploidy.
records.model: HeLa Tet-Off cells expressing kinase-deficient Aurora C
records.note: Aurora C kinase-deficient overexpression disrupts Aurora B-INCENP and reduces BubR1 kinetochore localization; tetracycline regulates the engineered construct, not therapeutic restoration.

records.title: CENP-E forms a link between attachment of spindle microtubules to kinetochores and the mitotic checkpoint.
records.model: CENP-E-depleted mammalian cells
records.note: CENP-E loss yields persistent mono-orientation and pole fragmentation despite other motors, while CENP-E associates closely with BubR1; no administered rescue.

records.title: Two different mitotic checkpoint inhibitors of the anaphase-promoting complex/cyclosome antagonize the action of the activator Cdc20.
records.model: Checkpoint-arrested cell extracts and APC/C immunoprecipitates
records.note: Separates endogenous MCC and MCF2 inhibitors, both antagonized by high Cdc20. These are checkpoint protein complexes, not administered small-molecule inhibitors.

records.title: Putative direct and indirect Wnt targets identified through consistent gene expression changes in APC-mutant intestinal adenomas from humans and mice.
records.model: Human and mouse APC-mutant intestinal adenomas
records.note: Cross-species adenoma profiles identify Wnt-associated genes and elevated BUB1/BUB1B; proposed targets derive from expression and in silico motifs rather than treatment rescue.

records.title: Gene expression profiling reveals a new classification of adrenocortical tumors and identifies molecular predictors of malignancy and survival.
records.model: 153 adrenocortical tumors with discovery/validation cohorts
records.note: Combined BUB1B/PINK1 expression predicts carcinoma survival after adjustment; no administered drug or causal BUB1B-restoration experiment.

records.title: Analysis of Scc1-deficient cells defines a key metaphase role of vertebrate cohesin in linking sister kinetochores.
records.model: Conditional Scc1/cohesin-deficient vertebrate cells
records.note: Unnamed specific topoisomerase-II inhibition restores metaphase alignment and checkpoint silencing despite cohesin loss, consistent with preserved inter-sister tension. Abstract does not establish faithful anaphase, BUB1B-deficient rescue or muscle benefit; identify compound and downstream outcomes.

records.title: CENP-E as an essential component of the mitotic checkpoint in vitro.
records.model: Xenopus egg extracts depleted of CENP-E
records.note: High soluble MAD2 restores damage-induced mitotic arrest after CENP-E depletion or blocking antibody, demonstrating a downstream signaling bypass. Protein add-back in extracts is not an established systemic drug.

records.title: The spindle checkpoint functions of Mad3 and Mad2 depend on a Mad3 KEN box-mediated interaction with Cdc20-anaphase-promoting complex (APC/C).
records.model: Fission yeast Mad3 KEN-box mutants
records.note: Both Mad3 KEN boxes are necessary for checkpoint activity; the N-terminal box mediates MCC assembly and Mad2/Mad3 association with APC/C. No pharmacologic intervention.

records.title: Telomere-independent homologue pairing and checkpoint escape of accessory ring chromosomes in male mouse meiosis.
records.model: Male mice carrying ring minichromosomes
records.note: Accessory ring chromosomes self-pair or associate with heterochromatin and can bypass meiotic checkpoints; unaligned rings recruit MAD2/BUBR1 and trigger apoptosis. Chromosome-engineering mechanism, not rescue.

records.title: Mechanisms of mitotic cell death induced by chemotherapy-mediated G2 checkpoint abrogation.
records.model: p53-defective tumor cells
records.note: UCN-01 forces damaged cells into SAC-dependent mitotic arrest; unnamed Aurora B/CDK1 inhibitors enhance apoptosis by removing an antiapoptotic pathway. This explicitly exploits killing rather than protecting deficient normal tissue.

records.title: Induction of centrosome amplification during arsenite-induced mitotic arrest in CGL-2 cells.
records.model: CGL-2 cells under arsenite-induced mitotic arrest
records.outcome_direction: reduced toxicant-induced centrosome amplification and death
records.note: Unnamed CDK1 inhibitors or BUBR1/MAD2 knockdown terminate arrest and reduce arsenite-associated centrosome amplification/death; nocodazole is an arrest comparator. Survival effect lacks evidence of restored chromosome fidelity.

records.title: Five quantitative trait loci control radiation-induced adenoma multiplicity in Mom1R Apc Min/+ mice.
records.model: Backcrossed ApcMin/+ mouse panels
records.note: Maps radiation-sensitive polyposis loci; Bub1b is an in silico polymorphic candidate among spindle, repair and inflammatory genes. Exposure/genetic association does not establish Bub1b causality or rescue.

records.title: Minireview: branded from the start-distinct oncogenic initiating events may determine tumor fate in the thyroid.
records.model: Thyroid follicular neoplasia literature
records.note: Discusses mitotic checkpoint changes and Ras signaling as possible origins of chromosomal instability; no primary drug-restoration outcome.

records.title: Polo-like kinase-1 is required for bipolar spindle formation but is dispensable for anaphase promoting complex/Cdc20 activation and initiation of cytokinesis.
records.model: Plk1-depleted human cells with survivin codepletion
records.note: Plk1 loss prevents bipolar spindle formation and activates Mad2/BubR1 arrest; survivin codepletion permits exit. Restored exit is not restored bipolarity or segregation fidelity.

records.title: Two distinct modes of cell death induced by doxorubicin: apoptosis and cell death through mitotic catastrophe accompanied by senescence-like phenotype.
records.model: Human hepatoma lines including Huh-7
records.note: Chronic low-dose doxorubicin lowers BubR1 and other checkpoint proteins, causing multinucleation and senescence-like mitotic catastrophe; high-dose exposure uses a different apoptotic program.

records.title: Septin 7 interacts with centromere-associated protein E and is required for its kinetochore localization.
records.model: SEPT7-depleted HeLa and MDCK cells
records.outcome_direction: genetic rescue of alignment and segregation
records.note: Exogenous GFP-SEPT7 restores CENP-E kinetochore localization and mitotic defects after SEPT7 depletion; direct SEPT7-CENP-E interaction supports target biology but no administered compound.

records.title: Induction of apoptosis by monastrol, an inhibitor of the mitotic kinesin Eg5, is independent of the spindle checkpoint.
records.model: BUBR1- or MAD2-depleted HeLa cells
records.note: Monastrol causes apoptosis even after checkpoint-deficient premature exit, whereas paclitaxel yields more polyploid survivors. Drug-specific death outcomes should not be called functional rescue.

records.title: Mechanism of cell death induced by cis-3, 4', 5-trimethoxy-3'-aminostilbene in ovarian cancer.
records.model: UCI101 ovarian cancer cells
records.note: Low-dose stilbene 5c causes mitochondrial/ROS-associated death without arrest; higher doses transiently elevate BubR1 and arrest G2/M. A derivative-specific killing result, not parent stilbene or BUBR1 restoration.

records.title: Identification of two novel components of the human NDC80 kinetochore complex.
records.model: hSPC25-depleted HeLa cells
records.outcome_direction: mitotic defects; partial localization recovery after depolymerization
records.note: hSPC25 loss disrupts NDC80/MAD1 recruitment, spindles and survival while largely retaining BubR1. Microtubule depolymerization restores MAD1 localization but does not establish corrected division; reagent unnamed.

records.title: Increased Expression of the Genes for Mitotic Spindle Assembly and Chromosome Segregation in Both Lung and Pancreatic Carcinomas.
records.model: Microdissected lung and pancreatic carcinomas versus normal epithelia
records.note: BUB1B and other segregation genes are elevated in both tumor types; target suggestions derive from expression correlation, not intervention efficacy.

records.title: The influence of genes on the aging process of mice: a statistical assessment of the genetics of aging.
records.model: Statistical reanalysis of published mouse longevity cohorts
records.outcome_direction: no statistical evidence for altered aging rate in BubR1 cohort
records.note: Gompertz analysis finds no evidence that BubR1 perturbation changes the age-dependent mortality slope, while noting possible age-independent mortality effects. This qualification concerns an aging-rate definition and does not negate documented tissue phenotypes.

records.title: hNuf2 inhibition blocks stable kinetochore-microtubule attachment and induces mitotic cell death in HeLa cells.
records.model: hNuf2-depleted HeLa cells
records.note: hNuf2 RNAi leaves motors and detectable BubR1/Mad2 at kinetochores but prevents stable microtubule attachment, causing prometaphase arrest and mitotic death.

records.title: Silencing Cenp-F weakens centromeric cohesion, prevents chromosome alignment and activates the spindle checkpoint.
records.model: Cenp-F-depleted cultured cells
records.note: Cenp-F RNAi impairs tension and error resolution, prematurely separates chromatids and triggers BubR1-dependent arrest. Farnesylation is background biology; no farnesylation-directed rescue drug tested in abstract.

records.title: Sensitivity to sodium arsenite in human melanoma cells depends upon susceptibility to arsenite-induced mitotic arrest.
records.model: Human melanoma cell lines
records.note: Arsenite-resistant lines have weaker BUBR1 expression and fail to arrest in mitosis; unnamed inhibitors of glutathione synthesis/GST/MRP reduce resistance. Killing sensitivity is not healthy-tissue rescue.

records.title: Mitotic spindle checkpoint inactivation by trichostatin a defines a mechanism for increasing cancer cell killing by microtubule-disrupting agents.
records.model: Synchronized human cancer cells
records.note: An eight-hour TSA exposure at 200 ng/mL impairs BubR1 phosphorylation/localization and causes chromosome missegregation despite preserved spindle formation, enhancing antimitotic killing. Direct counterevidence to nonspecific HDAC restoration assumptions.

records.title: Partially functional Cenpa-GFP fusion protein causes increased chromosome missegregation and apoptosis during mouse embryogenesis.
records.model: Cenpa-GFP knock-in mouse embryos
records.note: Homozygous fusion-protein embryos initially divide and recruit BubR1/Mad2 but later missegregate chromosomes and die, showing recruitment alone does not assure fidelity.

records.title: Components of the human spindle checkpoint control mechanism localize specifically to the active centromere on dicentric chromosomes.
records.model: Human dicentric chromosome cytology
records.note: BUB1/BUBR1/BUB3/MAD2 and APC/checkpoint markers localize only to the active centromere; no intervention or functional rescue.

records.title: Roles of polo-like kinase 1 in the assembly of functional mitotic spindles.
records.model: Plk1-depleted synchronized mammalian cells
records.note: Hesperadin stabilizes attachments and allows APC-substrate degradation and mitotic exit after Plk1 depletion, but chromosomes do not segregate and cytokinesis fails. Monastrol is a spindle-force probe; endpoint explicitly cautions against equating exit with rescue.

records.title: Farnesyl transferase inhibitors impair chromosomal maintenance in cell lines and human tumors by compromising CENP-E and CENP-F function.
records.model: Cancer-cell lines and phase-I head/neck tumor samples
records.note: Lonafarnib removes CENP-E/F from metaphase kinetochores, lowers tension and activates BubR1 with lagging chromosomes; related defects occur in treated human tumors. This provides mechanistic caution for transferring progeria-drug logic to BUB1B MVA.

records.title: Fission yeast Mad3p is required for Mad2p to inhibit the anaphase-promoting complex and localizes to kinetochores in a Bub1p-, Bub3p-, and Mph1p-dependent manner.
records.model: Fission yeast mad3 deletion and protein overexpression
records.note: Mad3 is required for Mad2-overexpression-induced arrest and localizes via Bub1/Bub3/Mph1; adding upstream signal alone cannot bypass absent Mad3 in this system.

records.title: Survivin is required for stable checkpoint activation in taxol-treated HeLa cells.
records.model: Survivin-depleted HeLa cells
records.note: Survivin loss mislocalizes CPC and destabilizes BubR1 kinetochore retention; cells arrest after microtubule depolymerization but not Taxol-induced tension loss, and some become multinucleated.

records.title: Elevating the level of Cdc34/Ubc3 ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme in mitosis inhibits association of CENP-E with kinetochores and blocks the metaphase alignment of chromosomes.
records.model: Mammalian cells microinjected at prophase
records.note: Excess Cdc34 selectively prevents CENP-E recruitment while BubR1 remains; unnamed proteasome inhibitors fail to reverse arrest, suggesting a nonproteolytic ubiquitination mechanism.

records.title: Gene silencing of CENP-E by small interfering RNA in HeLa cells leads to missegregation of chromosomes after a mitotic delay.
records.model: CENP-E-depleted HeLa H2B-GFP cells
records.note: CENP-E RNAi reduces BubR1 hyperphosphorylation and permits anaphase with unaligned chromosomes; nocodazole presynchronization worsens errors, arrest and death. Delay alone does not ensure correction.

records.title: Mad3 KEN boxes mediate both Cdc20 and Mad3 turnover, and are critical for the spindle checkpoint.
records.model: Budding yeast Mad3 KEN-box mutants and overexpression
records.outcome_direction: checkpoint failure with either motif loss or excess Mad3
records.note: KEN30 controls MCC formation and protein turnover; fourfold Mad3 overproduction itself impairs biorientation and causes chromosome loss after unnamed antimicrotubule-drug recovery. Protein abundance needs functional/dose context.

records.title: Inhibition of TRIP1/S8/hSug1, a component of the human 19S proteasome, enhances mitotic apoptosis induced by spindle poisons.
records.model: HeLa cells expressing truncated TRIP1 or TRIP1 siRNA
records.note: TRIP1 disruption lowers proteasome activity and BubR1, enhancing death after spindle poisons or unnamed proteasome inhibitors. This genetic sensitization does not demonstrate pharmacologic checkpoint restoration.

records.title: Checkpoint inhibition of the APC/C in HeLa cells is mediated by a complex of BUBR1, BUB3, CDC20, and MAD2.
records.model: HeLa-derived purified MCC and APC/C assays
records.note: Purified BUBR1/BUB3/CDC20/MAD2 complex inhibits APC/C much more strongly than recombinant MAD2, with mitosis-specific APC/C sensitivity; biochemical mechanism, no therapeutic drug.

records.title: Effects of scaffold/matrix alteration on centromeric function and gene expression.
records.model: Human neocentromere and native centromere cell model
records.outcome_direction: dose-specific neutral or harmful centromere effects
records.note: TSA at 33 nM contracts scaffold attachment without noticeable segregation dysfunction; distamycin A at 75 micrograms/mL causes missegregation and increased BubR1. Neither treatment demonstrates rescue; TSA context qualifies broad class-level toxicity claims.

records.title: BRCA1: a novel prognostic factor in resected non-small-cell lung cancer.
records.model: Resected chemonaive NSCLC cohorts
records.note: Nine-gene expression panel includes BubR1, but BRCA1 is the validated independent survival predictor. Suggested chemotherapy customization is not a tested intervention in this study.

records.title: Genomic instability and colon cancer.
records.model: Colorectal cancer genomic-instability literature
records.note: Reviews mismatch-repair and chromosome-instability pathways including BUB1/BUBR1 mutations; proposed future exploitation of tumor instability is not a rescue result.

records.title: Mutation and expression analysis of human BUB1 and BUB1B in aneuploid breast cancer cell lines.
records.model: Nineteen aneuploid breast cancer cell lines
records.note: Finds variable BUB1/BUB1B expression and sequence variants but no predicted deleterious coding mutations, arguing against a frequent mutant-allele explanation in these lines.

records.title: Identification of a novel gene--SSK1--in human endothelial cells exposed to shear stress.
records.model: Human umbilical-vein endothelial cells
records.note: Laminar flow increases SSK1 transcript, a sequence related to newly described BUBR1; the abstract does not establish identity, functional checkpoint rescue or a pharmacologic agent.
